CheckpointBytes3Allocation.source:
import CheckpointBytes3Namespaces
import OraclePortStdAllocation

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.CheckpointBytes3Allocation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1Stage2

/-- Reservation outcome is an execution input, not an availability theorem.
The typed source Error is retained, together with all successful Vec content. -/
def filled (reserved : Bool) (n : Usize) (value : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31) verifier.Error) := do
  let out ← OraclePortStdAllocation.filled n value reserved
  match out with
  | .error _ => ok (.Err .Allocation)
  | .ok v => ok (.Ok v)

theorem filled_exact (reserved : Bool) (n : Usize) (value : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
    filled reserved n value =
      if reserved then ok (.Ok ⟨List.replicate n.val value,by simp; scalar_tac⟩)
      else ok (.Err .Allocation) := by
  cases reserved <;>
    simp [filled,OraclePortStdAllocation.filled_exact,OraclePortStdAllocation.filledSpec]

theorem filled_success_content (reserved : Bool) (n : Usize) (value : aspis_core.field.QM31)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec aspis_core.field.QM31)
    (success : filled reserved n value = ok (.Ok out)) :
    reserved = true ∧ out.val = List.replicate n.val value := by
  rw [filled_exact] at success
  cases reserved with
  | false => cases success
  | true =>
    have eq := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj success)
    exact ⟨rfl,(congrArg Subtype.val eq).symm⟩

theorem filled_rejection (n : Usize) (value : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
    filled false n value = ok (.Err verifier.Error.Allocation) := rfl

/-- A total all-reservation successful bridge would assert a false premise.
Success-conditioned source adoption can instead derive the reservation fact. -/
theorem no_unconditional_allocation_success (n : Usize) (value : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
    ¬ ∀ reserved, ∃ out, filled reserved n value = ok (.Ok out) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨out,success⟩ := h false
  cases success

#print axioms filled_exact
#print axioms filled_success_content
#print axioms filled_rejection
#print axioms no_unconditional_allocation_success
end AspisR1.CheckpointBytes3Allocation

/-! Concrete source-shaped callback content model. Allocation outcome remains
an execution parameter. Scalar from_le_bytes and helper implementation adoption
is the independent native operation boundary, not a kernel Rust extraction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.CheckpointBytes4Ops
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1Stage2 CheckpointBytes4Sections

def listEq {T U : Type} (inst : core.cmp.PartialEq T U) : List T → List U → Result Bool
  | [], [] => ok true
  | x::xs, y::ys => do
      let same ← inst.eq x y
      if same then listEq inst xs ys else ok false
  | _, _ => ok false

def eq {T U : Type} {N : Usize} (inst : core.cmp.PartialEq T U)
    (s : Slice T) (a : Array U N) : Result Bool :=
  if s.val.length = a.val.length then listEq inst s.val a.val else ok false

def ne {T U : Type} {N : Usize} (inst : core.cmp.PartialEq T U)
    (s : Slice T) (a : Array U N) : Result Bool := do
  let same ← eq inst s a
  ok (!same)

def headerLoop : Nat → core.slice.iter.Iter U8 → Result (Bool × core.slice.iter.Iter U8)
  | 0, it => ok (false,it)
  | n+1, it => do
      let (value,rest) ← core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next it
      match value with
      | none => ok (false,rest)
      | some b => if b != 0#u8 then ok (true,rest) else headerLoop n rest

def headerAny (it : core.slice.iter.Iter U8) : Result (Bool × core.slice.iter.Iter U8) :=
  headerLoop (it.slice.val.length+1) it

def finalLen : transport.Variant → Result Usize
  | .S1 => ok 256#usize | .S2 => ok 64#usize | .D => ok 64#usize

def checkpointSize (v : transport.Variant) : Result Usize := do
  let n ← finalLen v
  let weights ← 16#usize * n
  744#usize + weights

def tag : transport.Variant → Result U8
  | .S1 => ok 1#u8 | .S2 => ok 2#u8 | .D => ok 3#u8

def zeroK : Result K := ok ⟨⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩,⟨0#u32,0#u32⟩⟩

def queryLoop (seen : List U32) : List U32 → core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error
  | [] => .Ok ()
  | q::qs => if q.val ≥ 262144 ∨ q ∈ seen then .Err .Checkpoint
      else queryLoop (seen ++ [q]) qs

def validate (q : Array U32 22#usize) : Result (core.result.Result Unit verifier.Error) :=
  ok (queryLoop [] q.val)

def withK {T : Type} (read : ReadK) (r : verifier.Reader)
    (next : K → verifier.Reader → Result (core.result.Result T verifier.Error)) :
    Result (core.result.Result T verifier.Error) := do
  let (value,out) ← read r
  match value with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok x => next x out

/-- The ten reads in the shipped helper, in their source order. -/
def semanticUsing (read : ReadK) (bytes : Slice U8) (start : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array K 10#usize × Usize) verifier.Error) :=
  withK read ⟨bytes,start⟩ fun x0 r1 =>
  withK read r1 fun x1 r2 =>
  withK read r2 fun x2 r3 =>
  withK read r3 fun x3 r4 =>
  withK read r4 fun x4 r5 =>
  withK read r5 fun x5 r6 =>
  withK read r6 fun x6 r7 =>
  withK read r7 fun x7 r8 =>
  withK read r8 fun x8 r9 =>
  withK read r9 fun x9 r10 =>
  ok (.Ok (Array.make 10#usize [x0,x1,x2,x3,x4,x5,x6,x7,x8,x9],r10.at))

def readSemanticAlpha := semanticUsing CheckpointBytes3Reader.readK

/-- Source mutable next/back loop, over precisely the actual Vec length. -/
def weightsUsing (read : ReadK) (bytes : Slice U8) (start : Usize) (v : alloc.vec.Vec K) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec K × Usize) verifier.Error) := do
  let result ← weightLoop read v.val.length ⟨bytes,start⟩ ⟨⟨v.val,v.property⟩,0⟩
  match result with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok (it,r) => ok (.Ok (⟨it.slice.val,it.slice.property⟩,r.at))

def readWeights := weightsUsing CheckpointBytes3Reader.readK

/-- This legacy callback is unused by resumeWithOps, which emits all twenty-two
raw query reads directly. It still has a concrete ordered implementation. -/
def queryUsing (bytes : Slice U8) (start : Usize) :
    Result (Array U32 22#usize × Usize) := do
  let (b0,r1) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize ⟨bytes,start⟩
  let q0 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b0)
  let (b1,r2) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r1
  let q1 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b1)
  let (b2,r3) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r2
  let q2 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b2)
  let (b3,r4) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r3
  let q3 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b3)
  let (b4,r5) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r4
  let q4 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b4)
  let (b5,r6) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r5
  let q5 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b5)
  let (b6,r7) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r6
  let q6 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b6)
  let (b7,r8) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r7
  let q7 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b7)
  let (b8,r9) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r8
  let q8 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b8)
  let (b9,r10) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r9
  let q9 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b9)
  let (b10,r11) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r10
  let q10 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b10)
  let (b11,r12) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r11
  let q11 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b11)
  let (b12,r13) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r12
  let q12 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b12)
  let (b13,r14) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r13
  let q13 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b13)
  let (b14,r15) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r14
  let q14 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b14)
  let (b15,r16) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r15
  let q15 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b15)
  let (b16,r17) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r16
  let q16 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b16)
  let (b17,r18) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r17
  let q17 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b17)
  let (b18,r19) ← CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw 4#usize r18
  let q18 ← lift (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes b18)

def ops (reserved : Bool) : ResumeOps where
  checkpointSize := checkpointSize
  tag := tag
  finalLen := finalLen
  eq := eq
  ne := ne
  headerAny := headerAny
  raw := CheckpointBytes3Reader.raw
  readE := CheckpointBytes3Reader.readE
  readK := CheckpointBytes3Reader.readK
  validate := validate
  zeroK := zeroK
  filled := CheckpointBytes3Allocation.filled reserved
  readQueries := queryUsing
  readSemanticAlpha := readSemanticAlpha
  readWeights := readWeights

/-- Kernel C5 scalar identification through all ten reads, including Err. -/
theorem semantic_identification (bytes : Slice U8) (start : Usize) :
    readSemanticAlpha bytes start = semanticUsing c5ReadK bytes start := by
  have same : CheckpointBytes3Reader.readK = c5ReadK := funext read_k_identification
  unfold readSemanticAlpha
  rw [same]

/-- Kernel C5 scalar identification through every mutable weight read/write. -/
theorem weights_identification (bytes : Slice U8) (start : Usize) (v : alloc.vec.Vec K) :
    readWeights bytes start v = weightsUsing c5ReadK bytes start v := by
  have same : CheckpointBytes3Reader.readK = c5ReadK := funext read_k_identification
  unfold readWeights
  rw [same]

/-- The generic emitted-body theorem now consumes a closed callback record. -/
theorem successful_fields (reserved : Bool) {H : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (bytes proof public1 : Slice U8)
    (v : transport.Variant) (hash : H) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (success : verifier.resumeWithOps (ops reserved) D bytes proof public1 v hash =
      ok (.Ok (p,a))) :
    Nonempty (OraclePortCkptAbiSourceFields.Fields (ops reserved) bytes v p a) :=
  OraclePortCkptAbiSourceFields.successful_fields (ops reserved) D bytes proof public1 v hash p a success

/-- Successful execution derives allocation success; it does not assume it. -/
theorem successful_reservation (reserved : Bool) {H : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (bytes proof public1 : Slice U8)
    (v : transport.Variant) (hash : H) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (success : verifier.resumeWithOps (ops reserved) D bytes proof public1 v hash =
      ok (.Ok (p,a))) : reserved = true := by
  obtain ⟨f⟩ := successful_fields reserved D bytes proof public1 v hash p a success
  exact (CheckpointBytes3Allocation.filled_success_content reserved f.finalLength f.zero
    f.allocated f.allocation).1

#print axioms semantic_identification
#print axioms weights_identification
#print axioms successful_fields
#print axioms successful_reservation
end AspisR1.CheckpointBytes4Ops

import ChildJoin_Decoder
import CheckpointBytes5Join

/-! Fixed-header results for the concrete cone endpoints. These do not install
opaque adapter op10/op11 as these endpoints. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.ChildJoin_Checkpoint
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open MultiproofConeCanonical OraclePortCompactDraft CheckpointBytes5Effect
open CheckpointBytes5Inputs CheckpointBytesDigest ChildJoin_Decoder

theorem writer_header {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash)
    (H : Bytes → State) (oracle : Oracle D hash H)
    (wp : CheckpointBytes5Writer.Prepared) (wa : CheckpointBytes5Writer.Accumulator)
    (pm : OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.Prepared)
    (am : QueryAccumulator.State OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.E)
    (provenance : CheckpointBytes5Join.S1S7S8StateProvenance wp wa pm am)
    (proof public1 ck : Slice U8) (before after : Log)
    (success : run D hash (CheckpointBytes5Writer.writer wp wa proof public1) before = ok (ck,after)) :
    checkpointHeader (bytesOf ck.val) = some (H (bytesOf proof.val),H (bytesOf public1.val)) ∧
      ck.val.length = 1768 := by
  obtain ⟨encoding,_⟩ := CheckpointBytes5Writer.writer_effects D hash H oracle wp wa proof public1 ck
    provenance.size provenance.queriesBound provenance.canonical provenance.next before after success
  dsimp only at encoding
  constructor
  · rw [encoding]
    exact encoded_header H _ _ _ _
  · have length := congrArg List.length encoding
    simpa only [bytesOf,List.length_map,OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.encode_length] using length

theorem checked_wire (ck actual : Slice U8) (start finish : Usize)
    (success : core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
      ck {start := start, «end» := finish} = ok actual) :
    bytesOf actual.val = slice (bytesOf ck.val) start.val (finish.val-start.val) := by
  simp only [core.slice.index.Slice.index,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index] at success
  split at success
  · have same := congrArg Subtype.val (Result.ok.inj success)
    rw [← same]
    simp only [bytesOf,slice,List.slice,List.map_take,List.map_drop]
  · cases success

theorem reader_header (reserved : Bool) {Hash : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash)
    (H : Bytes → State) (oracle : Oracle D hash H)
    (ck proof public1 : Slice U8)
    (p : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Prepared) (a : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Accumulator)
    (success : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
      D ck proof public1 .S2 hash = ok (.Ok (p,a))) :
    checkpointHeader (bytesOf ck.val) = some (H (bytesOf proof.val),H (bytesOf public1.val)) := by
  obtain ⟨calls⟩ := CheckpointBytes4Comparison.successful_calls reserved D ck proof public1 .S2 hash p a success
  have hp := checked_wire ck calls.storedProof 16#usize 48#usize calls.proofField
  have hu := checked_wire ck calls.storedPublic 48#usize 80#usize calls.publicField
  have pp : calls.proofParts = AspisR1Stage2.WireTx2.singletonParts proof := by
    simpa only [lift,AspisR1Stage2.WireTx2.singletonParts,Result.ok.injEq] using calls.proofInput.symm
  have pu : calls.publicParts = AspisR1Stage2.WireTx2.singletonParts public1 := by
    simpa only [lift,AspisR1Stage2.WireTx2.singletonParts,Result.ok.injEq] using calls.publicInput.symm
  have proofHash := oracle _ _ calls.proofCall
  have publicHash := oracle _ _ calls.publicCall
  rw [pp,singleton_input] at proofHash
  rw [pu,singleton_input] at publicHash
  have proofBytes : slice (bytesOf ck.val) 16 32 = bytes (H (bytesOf proof.val)) := by
    rw [← proofHash,bytes_stateOf,← calls.proofEqual]
    exact hp.symm
  have publicBytes : slice (bytesOf ck.val) 48 32 = bytes (H (bytesOf public1.val)) := by
    rw [← publicHash,bytes_stateOf,← calls.publicEqual]
    exact hu.symm
  simp only [checkpointHeader,proofBytes,publicBytes,digest_bytes,Option.bind_eq_bind,Option.bind_some,pure]

#print axioms writer_header
#print axioms checked_wire
#print axioms reader_header
end AspisR1.ChildJoin_Checkpoint
end

import S2W_AuthenticatedInputs
import OraclePortCheckpointResumeC5

/-! Fixed C5 digest-field decoder: proof digest at 16, public digest at 48.
This decodes the two saved digests only; successful child execution owns the
remaining frame checks. No user-selected decoder is a parameter. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.ChildJoin_Decoder
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open MultiproofConeCanonical OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5

def digest (b : Bytes) : Option State :=
  if b.length = 32 then some (fun j => b[j.val]?.getD 0) else none

def checkpointHeader : S2W_AuthenticatedInputs.HeaderDecode := fun ck => do
  let hp ← digest (slice ck 16 32)
  let hu ← digest (slice ck 48 32)
  pure (hp,hu)

theorem digest_bytes (s : State) : digest (bytes s) = some s := by
  simp only [digest,bytes,List.length_ofFn,if_pos rfl]
  congr 1
  funext j
  simp only [List.getElem?_ofFn,j.isLt,Option.getD_some]

theorem encoded_header (H : Bytes → State) (proof public1 : Bytes)
    (p : Prepared) (a : QueryAccumulator.State K E) :
    checkpointHeader (encode H proof public1 p a) = some (H proof,H public1) := by
  have hp := OraclePortCheckpointSlicesC5.field_at H proof public1 p a 1 16 32
    (bytes (H proof)) rfl rfl rfl (by decide)
  have hu := OraclePortCheckpointSlicesC5.field_at H proof public1 p a 2 48 32
    (bytes (H public1)) rfl rfl rfl (by decide)
  simp only [checkpointHeader,hp,hu,digest_bytes,Option.bind_some,pure]

#print axioms digest_bytes
#print axioms encoded_header
end AspisR1.ChildJoin_Decoder
end

import ClaimsUnrolledParentRows
import S1ExtractedRoundChildrenV1
import S1SemanticFinishBoundsV1

/-! Install the complete emitted finite Claims VALUE interpretation in the
actual S1 finish consumer. Source getters and the existing full indexed decoder
are fixed. Native reserve/box ownership/error/cleanup/effect correspondence and
candidate adoption remain open; this file does not assert them as std trust.
-/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledFinish
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev ParentQM := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev MainQM := AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev ParentError := AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Error
abbrev MainError := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Error
abbrev MainPrefix := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Prefix
abbrev MainRecord := AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord
abbrev MainClaims := Array (Array MainQM 29#usize) 3#usize

/-- Two unresolved operational placeholders in this VALUE interpretation.
No successful allocation, zero content, frame or Claims postcondition occurs
in this dictionary. Their actual-runtime instance is NOT proved here. The
explicit mapError/boxArray value models ALSO retain their native std,
ownership/error/abort/cleanup/effect correspondence obligations. -/
structure StdCalls where
  reserve : {T : Type} → (A : Type) → alloc.vec.Vec T → Usize →
    Result ((core.result.Result Unit AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.alloc.collections.TryReserveError) × alloc.vec.Vec T)
  intoBox : {T : Type} → (A : Type) → alloc.vec.Vec T → Result (Slice T)

def fromMainError : MainError → ParentError
  | .Allocation  => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow  => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal  => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints  => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes  => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public  => .Public

def toMainError : ParentError → MainError
  | .Allocation  => .Allocation
  | .RowOrder a b => .RowOrder a b
  | .InvalidRow  => .InvalidRow
  | .Tag row => .Tag row
  | .Length row => .Length row
  | .NonCanonical row offset => .NonCanonical row offset
  | .Boundary round => .Boundary round
  | .Terminal  => .Terminal
  | .EqualCirclePoints  => .EqualCirclePoints
  | .TrailingBytes  => .TrailingBytes
  | .Public  => .Public

def fromMainQM (q : MainQM) : ParentQM := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def toMainQM (q : ParentQM) : MainQM := ⟨⟨q.c0.a,q.c0.b⟩,⟨q.c1.a,q.c1.b⟩⟩
def fromMainArray {n : Usize} (a : Array MainQM n) : Array ParentQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map fromMainQM,by simpa using a.property⟩
def toMainArray {n : Usize} (a : Array ParentQM n) : Array MainQM n :=
  ⟨a.val.map toMainQM,by simpa using a.property⟩
def fromMainPrefix (p : MainPrefix) : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix :=
  ⟨p.c1_root,p.records⟩
def toMainPrefix (p : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix) : MainPrefix :=
  ⟨p.c1_root,p.records⟩
def toMainRecord (r : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord) : MainRecord :=
  ⟨r.row,r.framed⟩

def sourceRecord (p : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.Prefix) (row : U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord ParentError) :=
  match AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record (toMainPrefix p) row with
  | .ok (.Ok r) => .ok (.Ok ⟨r.row,r.framed⟩)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (fromMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

/-- Actual complete indexed decode_k body already selected by S1, including
all errors and ambient fail/div. No chosen decoder outcome is a parameter. -/
def sourceDecode (n : Usize) (r : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.r1_wire.ValidatedRecord)
    (offset : Usize) : Result (core.result.Result (Array ParentQM n) ParentError) :=
  match AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren.decodeMain n (toMainRecord r) offset with
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok (fromMainArray a))
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (fromMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def external (std : StdCalls) : AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.External :=
  {reserve := std.reserve, intoBox := std.intoBox,
   validated := sourceRecord, decode := sourceDecode}

def toMainStatus :
    Result (core.result.Result AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.Claims ParentError) →
      Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError)
  | .ok (.Ok a) => .ok (.Ok ⟨a.val.map toMainArray,by simpa using a.property⟩)
  | .ok (.Err e) => .ok (.Err (toMainError e))
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div

def claims (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) : Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError) :=
  toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.candidate_claims.claims (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

def reference (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) : Result (core.result.Result MainClaims MainError) :=
  toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.claimsReference (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

/-- Complete parent refinement with actual source getter/decoder installed.
No assertion about native allocation/cleanup or candidate adoption is added. -/
theorem claims_value (std : StdCalls) (pre : MainPrefix) :
    claims std pre = reference std pre :=
  congrArg toMainStatus (AspisR1ClaimsUnrolledParent.claims_value (external std) (fromMainPrefix pre))

def install (std : StdCalls) (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries := {B with claims := claims std}

/-- Actual whole-finish success supplies this SAME Claims execution. No
separate accepted Claims equation, initialized storage or chosen rows premise.
All other finish children, native/std/refinement and release gates remain. -/
theorem finish_claims
    (std : StdCalls) (R : AspisR1PublicPreparation.RoundModel.Boundaries)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (pre : MainPrefix) (before : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (challenges : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Challenges)
    (obs : Option (AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Phase → Result Unit))
    (out : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (accepted : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.finish R (install std B)
      D pub pre before challenges obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    reference std pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) := by
  obtain ⟨running,t25,record25,record26,z0,t26,z1,t27,
      rounds,challenge,state,transcript,called,rest⟩ :=
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds.finish_success R (install std B)
      D pub pre before challenges obs out accepted
  change claims std pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) at called
  rw [claims_value] at called
  exact called

#print axioms claims_value
#print axioms finish_claims
end AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledFinish
end

import CurrentCompactFirstCompositionV1
import CurrentCallerUsizeArithmeticV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1CurrentCaller.ConcreteConstants
open AspisR1CurrentCaller

/-- The seven scalar/source-constant and fixed error-mapper leaves, with all
remaining operations unchanged. Source declarations and their expression DAG
are checked against the authoritative freeze by the packet checker. -/
def withConstants (ops : Ops) : Ops :=
  { ops with
    op0 := ok {c0:={a:=0#u32,b:=0#u32},c1:={a:=0#u32,b:=0#u32}},
    op2 := fun _ => ok .Parse,
    op12 := ok 16#usize,
    op13 := ok 7015#usize,
    op14 := ok 464#usize,
    op15 := ok 13831#usize,
    op21 := ok 7527#usize }

/-- Actual checked arithmetic of the emitted constants: outer success and
exact values, independent of all data/callbacks and malformed inputs. -/
theorem constants_total (ops : Ops) :
    compact.OFF_SEMANTIC (withConstants ops)=ok 16#usize ∧
    compact.OFF_Y1 (withConstants ops)=ok 7031#usize ∧
    compact.OFF_INACTIVE (withConstants ops)=ok 7495#usize ∧
    compact.LOGICAL_Y1=ok 928#usize ∧
    compact.LOGICAL_SEMANTIC (withConstants ops)=ok 13831#usize ∧
    ((13831#usize : Usize)+(928#usize : Usize))=ok 14759#usize ∧
    compact.OFF_FOLDED_ROOT (withConstants ops)=ok 7751#usize ∧
    compact.OFF_ROUND1 (withConstants ops)=ok 7783#usize := by
  have h1 : (16#usize+7015#usize : Result Usize)=ok 7031#usize := by
    apply UsizeArithmetic.add_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac
  have h2 : (7031#usize+464#usize : Result Usize)=ok 7495#usize := by
    apply UsizeArithmetic.add_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac
  have hm : (29#usize*32#usize : Result Usize)=ok 928#usize := by
    apply UsizeArithmetic.mul_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac
  have ht : (13831#usize+928#usize : Result Usize)=ok 14759#usize := by
    apply UsizeArithmetic.add_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac
  have hf : (7527#usize+224#usize : Result Usize)=ok 7751#usize := by
    apply UsizeArithmetic.add_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac
  have hr : (7751#usize+32#usize : Result Usize)=ok 7783#usize := by
    apply UsizeArithmetic.add_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac
  unfold compact.OFF_ROUND1 compact.OFF_FOLDED_ROOT compact.OFF_INACTIVE
    compact.OFF_Y1 compact.OFF_SEMANTIC compact.LOGICAL_Y1 compact.LOGICAL_SEMANTIC
  simp only [withConstants,bind_tc_ok,h1,h2,hm,ht,hf,hr,and_self]

theorem zero_total (ops : Ops) :
    aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO (withConstants ops)=
      ok {c0:={c0:={a:=0#u32,b:=0#u32},c1:={a:=0#u32,b:=0#u32}},
          c1:={c0:={a:=0#u32,b:=0#u32},c1:={a:=0#u32,b:=0#u32}}} := by
  unfold aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.ZERO
  rfl

/-- No length/canonicality input assumption: these are constant range facts,
not totality of expansion, parsing, semantic verification or tx1. -/
theorem source_ranges :
    16≤7031 ∧ 7031≤7495 ∧ 7495≤57607 ∧
    7751≤7783 ∧ 7783≤57607 ∧ 7783-7751=32 ∧
    13831≤14759 ∧ 14759-13831=928 ∧
    14759<4294967296 := by decide

/-- Enclosing current first theorem with these source leaves installed;
there are no free numeric-offset, zero or codec-error callbacks at this root. -/
theorem first_with_constants {E : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (ops : Ops) (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Unit) (error : verifier.Error → Result E)
    (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : FirstComposition.firstCurrent invalidAccountData (withConstants ops) D error
      bytes proof k=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ (s : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstCaller.DecoderStatement),
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1.decodeActual bytes=ok (.Ok s) ∧
      k=compact.SPLIT ∧ ∃ (zero : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
        (prepared : verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
        (semantic y1 : Slice U8) (v : verifier.View) (sem : r1_semantic.Verified Unit),
        ops.op5 proof semantic y1=ok (.Ok v) ∧
        ops.op9 D (FirstComposition.toCurrentPublic
          (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s))
          v.semantic () none=ok (.Ok sem) ∧
        ops.op8 D sem v () (Array.repeat 29#usize zero)=ok (.Ok prepared,scratch) ∧
        Tx1Reachability.afterPrepare (withConstants ops) D bytes proof k () none prepared scratch=ok (.Ok out) := by
  exact FirstComposition.first_current_prepared_new invalidAccountData (withConstants ops)
    D error bytes proof k out h

#print axioms constants_total
#print axioms zero_total
#print axioms source_ranges
#print axioms first_with_constants
end AspisR1CurrentCaller.ConcreteConstants

  {pool:=x.pool, deployment_domain:=x.deployment_domain, anchor_sequence:=x.anchor_sequence, anchor_root:=x.anchor_root, nullifier:=x.nullifier, asset_id:=x.asset_id, recipient_commitment:=x.recipient_commitment, change_commitment:=x.change_commitment}

  {pool:=x.pool, deployment_domain:=x.deployment_domain, anchor_sequence:=x.anchor_sequence, anchor_root:=x.anchor_root, nullifier:=x.nullifier, asset_id:=x.asset_id, amount:=x.amount, destination_token_account:=x.destination_token_account, change_commitment:=x.change_commitment}

def toCurrentPublic : OldPublic → Public

  | .Withdrawal p t => .Withdrawal (toCurrentWithdrawal p) (toCurrentTransition t)

  {live_snapshot:=toRetainedSnapshot x.live_snapshot,candidate_afterstate:=toRetainedAfterstate x.candidate_afterstate}

def toRetainedPublic : Public → OldPublic
  | .Transfer p t => .Transfer (toRetainedTransfer p) (toRetainedTransition t)
  | .Withdrawal p t => .Withdrawal (toRetainedWithdrawal p) (toRetainedTransition t)

/-- Every original public field is retained, for both variants. -/
theorem current_retained_roundtrip (p : Public) : toCurrentPublic (toRetainedPublic p)=p := by
  cases p <;> rfl

theorem retained_current_roundtrip (p : OldPublic) : toRetainedPublic (toCurrentPublic p)=p := by
  cases p <;> rfl

def retainedPhase : verifier.Phase → AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstCaller.Phase
  | .Parsed => .Parsed
  | .Semantic => .Semantic
  | .SemanticPart i => .SemanticPart i
  | .Prepare => .Prepare
  | .CheckpointRead => .CheckpointRead
  | .Merkle i => .Merkle i
  | .Query i => .Query i
  | .QueryPart i j => .QueryPart i j
  | .CheckpointWrite => .CheckpointWrite
  | .Relation => .Relation
  | .Final => .Final

/-- The actual current compact tx1 on the field-preserving public carrier.
The observer map preserves callbacks, not merely acceptance. Release callers
supply None, so the actual source verifier receives None. -/
def currentTx1 (ops : Ops) (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Unit)
    (pub : OldPublic) (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (digest : Unit)
    (obs : Option (AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstCaller.Phase → Result Unit)) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) verifier.Error) :=
  verifier.candidate.tx1 ops D (toCurrentPublic pub) bytes proof k digest
    (obs.map fun callback => fun phase => callback (retainedPhase phase))

/-- Complete retained first/first_decoded source control, with its tx1 child
now instantiated by the current compact caller, rather than a free callback. -/
def firstCurrent {E : Type} (invalidAccountData : E) (ops : Ops)
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Unit) (error : verifier.Error → Result E)
    (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) :=
  AspisR1PublicPreparation.RepinS6First.first invalidAccountData
    (currentTx1 ops D) error bytes proof k

/-- One enclosing first success derives its checked decoder, same public and
exact original byte/proof/k arguments, then the same-run compact preparation,
semantic verification, Prepared::new and post-scratch continuation. The old
independent decoder-success, selected-public, child-tx1, selected-View,
semantic-result, preparation-success and scratch witnesses are not premises. -/
theorem first_current_prepared_new {E : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (ops : Ops) (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Unit) (error : verifier.Error → Result E)
    (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : firstCurrent invalidAccountData ops D error bytes proof k=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ (s : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstCaller.DecoderStatement),
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1.decodeActual bytes=ok (.Ok s) ∧
      k=compact.SPLIT ∧ ∃ (zero : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
        (prepared : verifier.Prepared) (scratch : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize)
        (semantic y1 : Slice U8) (v : verifier.View) (sem : r1_semantic.Verified Unit),
        ops.op5 proof semantic y1=ok (.Ok v) ∧
        ops.op9 D (toCurrentPublic (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s))
          v.semantic () none=ok (.Ok sem) ∧
        ops.op8 D sem v () (Array.repeat 29#usize zero)=ok (.Ok prepared,scratch) ∧
        Tx1Reachability.afterPrepare ops D bytes proof k () none prepared scratch=ok (.Ok out) := by
  obtain ⟨s,pub,hd,hpub,htx⟩ := AspisR1PublicPreparation.RepinS6First.first_success
    invalidAccountData (currentTx1 ops D) error bytes proof k out h
  subst pub
  change verifier.candidate.tx1 ops D
    (toCurrentPublic (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s))
    bytes proof k () none=ok (.Ok out) at htx
  obtain ⟨hk,zero,prepared,scratch,semantic,y1,v,sem,hview,hsem,hnew,htail⟩ :=
    Tx1Reachability.tx1_prepared_new ops D
      (toCurrentPublic (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s))
      bytes proof k () out htx
  exact ⟨s,hd,hk,zero,prepared,scratch,semantic,y1,v,sem,hview,hsem,hnew,htail⟩

  {c0:={a:=x.c0.a,b:=x.c0.b},c1:={a:=x.c1.a,b:=x.c1.b}}

def currentE (x : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.WideExact) : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact := {c0:=currentQ x.c0,c1:=currentQ x.c1}
def currentPoint (x : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint) : aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint :=

def retainedVariant : transport.Variant → AspisR1PublicPreparation.transport.Variant

     lambda:=retainedQ x.challenges.lambda,chi:=retainedQ x.challenges.chi,
     theta:=retainedQ x.challenges.theta,zc:=mapArray retainedQ x.challenges.zc,
     mu:=retainedQ x.challenges.mu,eta:=retainedQ x.challenges.eta},

  {variant:=match x.variant with | .S1 => .S1 | .S2 => .S2 | .D => .D,
   semantic:=x.semantic,y1:=x.y1,inactive:=selectedE x.inactive,round0:=x.round0,

  | .Relation => .Relation
  | .Merkle => .Merkle
  | .Query => .Query
  | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint
  | .Allocation => .Allocation

theorem retained_selected_view (x : AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.verifier.View) :
    retainedView (selectedView x)=AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.preparedView x := by
  cases x with
  | mk variant semantic y1 inactive round0 folded_root round1 final_message query_bytes =>
    cases variant <;> rfl

/-- The actual selected View implementation, with full Result/error transport. -/
def sourceView (proof semantic y1 : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result verifier.View verifier.Error) := do
  let r ← AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.verifier.candidate.wide_view proof semantic y1
  ok (match r with | .Ok v => .Ok (selectedView v) | .Err e => .Err (selectedError e))

/-- Installed retained preparation backend. All fields of its result and its
post-scratch are transported. This definition does not assert original nested
claim/fission equivalence, Rust Std/P6 correspondence or adoption. -/
def sourcePrepared (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31 → Result PE)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (v : verifier.View) (hash : H) (g : Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize) :
    Result ((core.result.Result verifier.Prepared verifier.Error) ×
      Array aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact 29#usize) := do
  let (r,scratch) ← AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedScratchModel.entry
    (sourceBoundaries (installedBoundaries sampling embed)) (retainedDigest D)
    (retainedSem sem) (retainedView v) hash (mapArray retainedE g)
  ok ((match r with | .Ok out => .Ok (currentPrepared out) | .Err e => .Err (currentError e)),
    mapArray currentE scratch)

def install (ops : Ops) (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31 → Result PE) : Ops :=
  {ConcreteConstants.withConstants ops with op5:=sourceView,op8:=sourcePrepared sampling embed}

private theorem bind_success {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (out : B)
    (h : (do let a ← m;f a)=ok out) : ∃ a,m=ok a ∧ f a=ok out := by
  cases m with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h;cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h;cases h

/-- Enclosing installed first proof. Its one success premise derives actual
View decoding and concrete Prepared claim/powers/joint-rank facts; neither
inactive canonicality nor the desired claim/rank equation is a premise.
SourcePrepared's explicitly documented original-source/P6 boundary remains. -/
theorem first_installed_claim_and_rank {E M Cv : Type} {L : Nat}
    (invalidAccountData : E) (ops : Ops)
    (sampling : AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    (embed : AspisR1PublicPreparation.aspis_core.field.M31 → Result PE)
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Unit) (p : FS2.Duplex.Params M Cv L)
    (pubInput : Slice U8) (root : Array U8 32#usize) (length : U32)
    (error : verifier.Error → Result E) (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : FirstComposition.firstCurrent invalidAccountData (install ops sampling embed)
      D error bytes proof k=ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ (s : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstCaller.DecoderStatement),
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1.decodeActual bytes=ok (.Ok s) ∧
      k=compact.SPLIT ∧ ∃ (zero : aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
        (semantic y1 : Slice U8) (v : AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.verifier.View)
        (sem : r1_semantic.Verified Unit) (prepared : AspisR1PublicPreparation.verifier.Prepared)
        (scratch : Array PE 29#usize),
        AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.verifier.candidate.wide_view proof semantic y1=ok (.Ok v) ∧
        ops.op9 D (FirstComposition.toCurrentPublic
          (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic s)) v.semantic () none=ok (.Ok sem) ∧
        (Canonical (toClaimE prepared.gamma) ∧ Canonical (toClaimE prepared.kappa)) ∧
        OriginalPayloadClaimMeaning (retainedSem sem) v.y1
          (toClaimE (AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.prepCarrier v.inactive))
          (toClaimE prepared.gamma) (toClaimE prepared.kappa) (toClaimE prepared.claim)
          (mapArray toClaimE scratch) ∧
        JointRankTrace sampling embed (retainedDigest D) p pubInput root length
          (retainedSem sem) (AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.preparedView v) () prepared scratch ∧
        Tx1Reachability.afterPrepare (install ops sampling embed) D bytes proof k () none
          (currentPrepared prepared) (mapArray currentE scratch)=ok (.Ok out) := by
  obtain ⟨s,hd,hk,zero,prepared,scratch,semantic,y1,v,sem,hview,hsem,hnew,htail⟩ :=
    FirstComposition.first_current_prepared_new invalidAccountData (install ops sampling embed)
      D error bytes proof k out h
  change sourceView proof semantic y1=ok (.Ok v) at hview
  unfold sourceView at hview
  obtain ⟨r,hr,hview⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ hview
  cases r with
  | Err e => cases hview
  | Ok oldv =>
    have hv : selectedView oldv=v := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj hview)
    subst v
    change sourcePrepared sampling embed D sem (selectedView oldv) ()
      (Array.repeat 29#usize zero)=ok (.Ok prepared,scratch) at hnew
    unfold sourcePrepared at hnew
    obtain ⟨pair,hbackend,hnew⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ hnew
    rcases pair with ⟨r,oldScratch⟩
    cases r with
    | Err e => cases hnew
    | Ok oldPrepared =>
      have heq : (core.result.Result.Ok (currentPrepared oldPrepared),mapArray currentE oldScratch)=
          (core.result.Result.Ok prepared,scratch) := Result.ok.inj hnew
      have hp : currentPrepared oldPrepared=prepared := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (congrArg Prod.fst heq)
      have hg : mapArray currentE oldScratch=scratch := congrArg Prod.snd heq
      subst prepared
      subst scratch
      rw [retained_selected_view] at hbackend
      obtain ⟨hcan,hclaim,hrank⟩ :=
        AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.selected_view_preparation_original_payload_and_rank
          sampling embed (retainedDigest D) p pubInput root length (retainedSem sem)
          proof semantic y1 oldv () oldPrepared oldScratch
          (mapArray retainedE (Array.repeat 29#usize zero)) hr hbackend
      exact ⟨s,hd,hk,zero,semantic,y1,oldv,sem,oldPrepared,oldScratch,
        hr,hsem,hcan,hclaim,hrank,htail⟩

#print axioms retained_selected_view
#print axioms sourcePrepared
#print axioms first_installed_claim_and_rank
end AspisR1CurrentCaller.InstalledPreparation

import PublicCodecAgreement
import ExtractedDecoderPublicBridge

/-! Fixed carrier transport for the actual ASF8 decoder's returned statement.
The transition is copied from that statement; no equality to an independently
chosen transition or public is assumed. The two actual success equations remain
explicit until the source caller is extracted. This does not establish account
reachability, custody, or Rust/runtime preservation. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1 AspisR1PublicSerializer

namespace AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding
abbrev Transition := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1
abbrev Statement := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
abbrev Common := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1
abbrev Transfer := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1

/-- All six snapshot fields and all three candidate fields are retained. -/
def toTransition (t : Transition) : Whole431.Transition :=
  { live_snapshot :=
      { pool := t.live_snapshot.pool
        deployment_domain := t.live_snapshot.deployment_domain
        sequence := t.live_snapshot.sequence
        next_pair_index := t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
        current_root := t.live_snapshot.current_root
        frontier := t.live_snapshot.frontier }
    candidate_afterstate :=
      { next_pair_index := t.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
        next_root := t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
        next_frontier := t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier } }

def fromTransition (t : Whole431.Transition) : Transition :=
  { live_snapshot :=
      { pool := t.live_snapshot.pool
        deployment_domain := t.live_snapshot.deployment_domain
        sequence := t.live_snapshot.sequence
        next_pair_index := t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
        current_root := t.live_snapshot.current_root
        frontier := t.live_snapshot.frontier }
    candidate_afterstate :=
      { next_pair_index := t.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
        next_root := t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
        next_frontier := t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier } }

theorem from_to_transition (t : Transition) :
    fromTransition (toTransition t) = t := by
  cases t with
  | mk live after => cases live; cases after; rfl

theorem to_from_transition (t : Whole431.Transition) :
    toTransition (fromTransition t) = t := by
  cases t with
  | mk live after => cases live; cases after; rfl

/-- The eight transfer fields are copied without choosing a byte-derived value. -/
def toTransfer (p : Transfer) : Whole431.Transfer :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id
    recipient_commitment := p.recipient_commitment
    change_commitment := p.change_commitment }

/-- This fixed projection matches the variant/borrow expression in `first`.
That source observation is not a theorem about execution of `first`. -/
def toSerializer : Statement → Whole431.Public
  | .PrivateTransfer c p => .Transfer (toTransfer p) (toTransition c.lane_transition)
  | .Withdrawal c p => .Withdrawal (PublicBridge.toSerializer p)
      (toTransition c.lane_transition)

theorem transfer_projection (c : Common) (p : Transfer) :
    toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p) =
      .Transfer (toTransfer p) (toTransition c.lane_transition) := rfl

theorem withdrawal_projection (c : Common) (p : CallerBridge.Public) :
    toSerializer (.Withdrawal c p) =
      .Withdrawal (PublicBridge.toSerializer p) (toTransition c.lane_transition) := rfl

def projectRaw (s : Statement) : PublicSourceRaw.Public :=
  ExtractedPublicCheckedBridge432.projectRaw (toSerializer s)

/-- Computed from the fixed source-carrier projection, not from serialized bytes. -/
def computedPublic (s : Statement) : Option (R0P.Public SemanticPublicWire.M31) :=
  (PublicSourceRaw.toWire (projectRaw s)).map SemanticPublicWire.toPublic

/-- Transfer has no withdrawal amount guard; reuse the existing serializer
refinement and codec agreement without a new transfer-validator model. -/
theorem transfer_serializer_parsePublic (c : Common) (p : Transfer)
    (semantic : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
      (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p)) = ok (.Ok semantic)) :
    ∃ wire, PublicSourceRaw.toWire (projectRaw (.PrivateTransfer c p)) = some wire ∧
      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
        some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  have hraw := RawBridge431.extracted_refines_core
    (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p)) (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte)
    ⟨semantic, hs, rfl⟩
  have hguard : PublicRawAmountGuard.PaymentAmountGuard
      (RawBridge431.project (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p))) := by
    trivial
  obtain ⟨wire, hw, hd⟩ := PublicRawAmountGuardAgreement.decoded_of_guarded_core_success
    (RawBridge431.project (toSerializer (.PrivateTransfer c p)))
    (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) hraw hguard
  exact ⟨wire, hw, PublicCodecAgreement.parsePublic_of_decode _ _ hd⟩

/-- Both ASF8 variants. The same decoded statement fixes every serializer
argument, including the full lane transition. `hd` and `hs` remain actual
computation premises; neither is replaced by an assumed validation predicate. -/
theorem decoder_serializer_parsePublic (asf8 : Slice U8) (s : Statement)
    (semantic : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (hd : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      asf8 = ok (.Ok s))
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
      (toSerializer s) = ok (.Ok semantic)) :
    ∃ wire, PublicSourceRaw.toWire (projectRaw s) = some wire ∧
      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
        some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) := by
  cases s with
  | PrivateTransfer c p => exact transfer_serializer_parsePublic c p semantic hs
  | Withdrawal c p =>
    exact PublicBridge.decoder_serializer_parsePublic asf8 c p
      (toTransition c.lane_transition) semantic hd hs

/-- Equality with the computed fixed projection requires no `hbind` premise.
This computed value has not yet been identified with an actual caller input. -/
theorem decoder_serializer_eq_computed (asf8 : Slice U8) (s : Statement)
    (semantic : FieldsRefinement431.ByteVec)
    (hd : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      asf8 = ok (.Ok s))
    (hs : AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
      (toSerializer s) = ok (.Ok semantic)) :
    SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (semantic.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
      computedPublic s := by
  obtain ⟨wire, hw, hp⟩ := decoder_serializer_parsePublic asf8 s semantic hd hs
  simpa only [computedPublic, hw, Option.map_some] using hp

#print axioms from_to_transition
#print axioms to_from_transition
#print axioms transfer_projection
#print axioms withdrawal_projection
#print axioms transfer_serializer_parsePublic
#print axioms decoder_serializer_parsePublic
#print axioms decoder_serializer_eq_computed
end AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding

ExtractedFirstCallerReachability.source:
import ExtractedPublicPreparationBinding

/-! Parametric downstream interpretation of the complete emitted `first` body.
The decoder is the checked actual decoder and the selector the checked actual
selector on its fixed carrier. The three downstream globals are explicit
parameters. Their effects, failure/divergence, observer argument and error map
are retained. No downstream tx1, SDK, runtime, or custody theorem is claimed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstCaller
open PreparationBinding
abbrev Statement := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
abbrev Public := pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public
abbrev DecoderStatement := AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding.Statement
abbrev DecodeError := AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1

inductive Phase where
  | Parsed | Semantic | SemanticPart (i : U8) | Prepare | CheckpointRead
  | Merkle (i : Usize) | Query (i : Usize) | QueryPart (i : Usize) (j : U8)
  | CheckpointWrite | Relation | Final

/-- Interpret the emitted decoder boundary with the already checked actual
computation, transporting only its returned source carrier. -/
def decode (bytes : Slice U8) : Result (core.result.Result Statement DecodeError) := do
  let r ← AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes
  match r with
  | .Ok s => ok (.Ok (fromStatement s))
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)

/-- The generated closure ignores the decoder error and returns this value. -/
def decodeErrorClosure {E : Type} (invalidAccountData : E) :
    core.ops.function.FnOnce Unit DecodeError E :=
  { call_once := fun _ _ => ok invalidAccountData }

/-- Full emitted caller control flow. `()` is the emitted unit-struct
SolanaDigest carrier; the downstream interpreter receives it unchanged. -/
def first {E F : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (mark : Phase → Result Unit) (error : F → Result E)
    (public_bytes : Slice U8) (proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) E) := do
  let r ← decode public_bytes
  let r1 ← core.result.Result.map_err (decodeErrorClosure invalidAccountData) r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let public1 ←
      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public val
    let r2 ← tx1 public1 public_bytes proof k () (some mark)
    core.result.Result.map_err (BuiltinFnOnce F E) r2 error
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (alloc.vec.Vec U8) (core.convert.FromSame E) residual

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

private theorem map_error_success {E F A : Type} (r : core.result.Result A F)
    (error : F → Result E) (out : A)
    (h : core.result.Result.map_err (BuiltinFnOnce F E) r error = ok (.Ok out)) :
    r = .Ok out := by
  cases r with
  | Ok a =>
    change ok (core.result.Result.Ok a) = ok (.Ok out) at h
    have ha : a = out := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
    subst out
    rfl
  | Err e =>
    change (do let mapped ← error e; ok (core.result.Result.Err mapped)) = ok (.Ok out) at h
    obtain ⟨mapped, _, h⟩ := bind_success (error e) _ _ h
    cases h

/-- Caller success supplies hd and the exact public passed to the downstream
call. There is no hd, chosen-public equality, or continuation-success premise. -/
theorem first_success {E F : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (mark : Phase → Result Unit) (error : F → Result E)
    (asf8 proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : first invalidAccountData tx1 mark error asf8 proof k = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ (s : DecoderStatement) (supplied : Public),
      AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
        asf8 = ok (.Ok s) ∧
      supplied = preparationPublic s ∧
      tx1 supplied asf8 proof k () (some mark) = ok (.Ok out) := by
  unfold first at h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := bind_success (decode asf8) _ _ h
  cases r with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.map_err, decodeErrorClosure,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
    cases h
  | Ok selected =>
    unfold decode at hr
    obtain ⟨decoded, hd, hselected⟩ := bind_success
      (AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 asf8) _ _ hr
    cases decoded with
    | Err e => cases hselected
    | Ok s =>
      have hs : fromStatement s = selected :=
        core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj hselected)
      rw [← hs] at h
      simp only [bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.map_err,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, actual_selector_eq] at h
      obtain ⟨r, hcall, hmap⟩ := bind_success
        (tx1 (preparationPublic s) asf8 proof k () (some mark)) _ _ h
      have hr := map_error_success r error out hmap
      exact ⟨s, preparationPublic s, hd, rfl, hr ▸ hcall⟩

#print axioms decode
#print axioms first
#print axioms first_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.FirstCaller

import ExtractedPreparationSerializerLoop
import ExtractedDecoderPublicBinding

/-! All-outcome transport of the actual preparation serializer into the checked
serializer carrier. This supplies the serializer success witness from helper
success; no custody premise is involved. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.SerializerWhole
open SerializerFields SerializerLoop

def mapOutcome {α : Type} : Result (core.result.Result α NewError) →
    Result (core.result.Result α OldError)
  | .ok r => .ok (mapStatus r)

/-! The actual public_transcript success supplies PublicBinding's hs. Fixed
carrier copies preserve all serializer fields. Decoder reachability is a
separate caller obligation; custody is not a premise of this proof. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding
open AspisR1 AspisR1PublicSerializer
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open SerializerWhole

def fromTransition (t : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) :

      { pool := t.live_snapshot.pool
        deployment_domain := t.live_snapshot.deployment_domain
        sequence := t.live_snapshot.sequence
        next_pair_index := t.live_snapshot.next_pair_index
        current_root := t.live_snapshot.current_root
        frontier := t.live_snapshot.frontier }
    candidate_afterstate :=
      { next_pair_index := t.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
        next_root := t.candidate_afterstate.next_root
        next_frontier := t.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier } }

def fromTransfer (p : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id
    recipient_commitment := p.recipient_commitment
    change_commitment := p.change_commitment }

def fromWithdrawal (p : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id
    amount := p.amount
    destination_token_account := p.destination_token_account
    change_commitment := p.change_commitment }

def fromCommon (c : PublicBinding.Common) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 :=
  { master_account := c.master_account
    checkpoint_account := c.checkpoint_account
    selected_lane_account := c.selected_lane_account
    output_lane := c.output_lane
    checkpoint_sequence := c.checkpoint_sequence

def fromStatement : PublicBinding.Statement →
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
  | .PrivateTransfer c p => .PrivateTransfer (fromCommon c) (fromTransfer p)
  | .Withdrawal c p => .Withdrawal (fromCommon c) (fromWithdrawal p)

/-- Same fixed selector as the actual semantic_public method. -/
def preparationPublic : PublicBinding.Statement →
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public
  | .PrivateTransfer c p => .Transfer (fromTransfer p) (fromTransition c.lane_transition)
  | .Withdrawal c p => .Withdrawal (fromWithdrawal p) (fromTransition c.lane_transition)

theorem actual_selector_eq (s : PublicBinding.Statement) :
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public
      (fromStatement s) = ok (preparationPublic s) := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem projection_eq (s : PublicBinding.Statement) :
    toOld (preparationPublic s) = PublicBinding.toSerializer s := by
  cases s <;> rfl

/-- No serializer-success assumption: helper success produces the same bytes. -/
theorem helper_supplies_serializer_success
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (s : PublicBinding.Statement) (hash : H)
    (c1 : Array U8 32#usize) (out : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (h : r1_semantic.public_transcript D (preparationPublic s) hash c1 = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ bytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8,
      AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
        (PublicBinding.toSerializer s) = ok (.Ok bytes) ∧
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.new D hash (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes) c1 =
        ok (.Ok out) := by
  obtain ⟨bytes, hs, ht⟩ := PreparationSuccess.public_transcript_success D
    (preparationPublic s) hash c1 out h
  refine ⟨bytes, ?_, ht⟩
  rw [← projection_eq s, serializer_eq, hs]
  rfl

/-- Both ASF8 variants; hd is the remaining actual caller reachability fact. -/
theorem decoder_helper_parsePublic
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (asf8 : Slice U8)
    (s : PublicBinding.Statement) (hash : H) (c1 : Array U8 32#usize)
    (out : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
    (hd : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      asf8 = ok (.Ok s))
    (h : r1_semantic.public_transcript D (preparationPublic s) hash c1 = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ bytes wire,
      AspisR1PublicSerializer.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public.public_bytes
        (PublicBinding.toSerializer s) = ok (.Ok bytes) ∧
      PublicSourceRaw.toWire (PublicBinding.projectRaw s) = some wire ∧
      SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic (bytes.val.map RawBridge431.rawByte) =
        some (SemanticPublicWire.toPublic wire) ∧
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.new D hash (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes) c1 =
        ok (.Ok out) := by
  obtain ⟨bytes, hs, ht⟩ := helper_supplies_serializer_success D s hash c1 out h
  obtain ⟨wire, hw, hp⟩ := PublicBinding.decoder_serializer_parsePublic asf8 s bytes hd hs
  exact ⟨bytes, wire, hs, hw, hp, ht⟩

#print axioms actual_selector_eq
#print axioms projection_eq
#print axioms helper_supplies_serializer_success
#print axioms decoder_helper_parsePublic
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding

import ExtractedTx1Model

/-! Success inversion of the complete emitted approved tx1 body. Actual
observer dispatch, allocation constructor and error closures are retained;
View.parse, verify_observed, heap allocation, powers and query/checkpoint tail
remain explicit function parameters. No helper reachability inside verify,
full25 hread, downstream arithmetic, SDK or custody theorem is asserted. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1Reachability

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

/-- Exact initialized result follows from actual constructor success, without
assuming allocation success or accepting any staging panic definition. -/
theorem accumulator_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (v : transport.Variant)
    (out : verifier.Accumulator)
    (h : Tx1Model.newAccumulator B v = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ n weights,
      Tx1Model.final_len v = ok n ∧
      B.filled Tx1Model.copyInst n aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO = ok (.Ok weights) ∧
      out = ⟨weights, aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO, Tx1Model.one, 0#usize⟩ := by
  unfold Tx1Model.newAccumulator at h
  obtain ⟨n, hn, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨r, hr, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases r with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, Tx1Model.allocationErrorClosure,
      Tx1Model.allocationError, bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
    cases h
  | Ok weights =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, bind_tc_ok,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch] at h
    exact ⟨n, weights, hn, hr, (core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)).symm⟩

/-- All prefix calls and the final tail are reached on actual tx1 acceptance.
No supplied child-call success, chosen View/semantic/prepared value or observer
success is a premise. The same supplied pub and exact returned View.semantic
bytes reach the named verify boundary. -/
theorem tx1_success (B : Tx1Model.Boundaries) (P : PreparedModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (publicBytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (hash : H)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : Tx1Model.tx1 B P D pub publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    k.val ≤ 22 ∧ ∃ v sem prepared acc g,
      B.view proof = ok (.Ok v) ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Parsed = ok () ∧
      B.verify D pub v.semantic hash obs = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Semantic = ok () ∧
      PreparedModel.prepare P D sem v hash = ok (.Ok prepared) ∧
      Tx1Model.newAccumulator B v.variant = ok (.Ok acc) ∧
      B.powers 29#usize prepared.gamma = ok g ∧
      Tx1Model.mark obs .Prepare = ok () ∧
      B.finish D v prepared acc g publicBytes proof k hash obs = ok (.Ok out) := by
  unfold Tx1Model.tx1 at h
  split at h
  · cases h
  · rename_i hk
    have hbound : k.val ≤ 22 := by scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨viewResult, hv, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases viewResult with
    | Err e =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok v =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨u, hp, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      cases u
      obtain ⟨semResult, hs, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      cases semResult with
      | Err e =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, Tx1Model.semanticErrorClosure,
          Tx1Model.semanticError, bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
          core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
        cases h
      | Ok sem =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          bind_tc_ok] at h
        obtain ⟨u, hsm, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        cases u
        obtain ⟨prepResult, hprep, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        cases prepResult with
        | Err e =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
            core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
          cases h
        | Ok prepared =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at h
          obtain ⟨accResult, ha, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
          cases accResult with
          | Err e =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
              core.convert.FromSame.from, bind_tc_ok] at h
            cases h
          | Ok acc =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, bind_tc_ok] at h
            obtain ⟨g, hg, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨u, hm, hf⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            cases u
            exact ⟨hbound, v, sem, prepared, acc, g, hv, hp, hs, hsm,
              hprep, ha, hg, hm, hf⟩

#print axioms accumulator_success
#print axioms tx1_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1Reachability

    (stage : VTop_Stages.Ops) (finish : AspisR1Stage2.Stage2Finish.FinishOps F)
    (reserved : Bool) (query : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (geo : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.Ops C)

  GExp_FirstCode.code (base ops reserved query geo) B std hashv
    (GExp_InstalledPrepare.digest (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps adapter
      (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std))

    (stage : VTop_Stages.Ops) (finish : AspisR1Stage2.Stage2Finish.FinishOps F)
    (reserved : Bool) (query : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (geo : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.Ops C)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries) (std : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls)
    (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First) (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : SdkC_Source.Parts → Result SdkC_Source.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction
      (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps adapter (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std)
      native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.P1 sha256 H)
    (syscall : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256)
    (accounts1 accounts2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (f : FirstCut) (s : SecondCut)
    (cuts : SourceCuts (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps adapter (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std)
      accounts1 accounts2 saved f s) :
    SdkC_BatchPair.Returning hashv H (code adapter ops stage finish reserved query geo B std hashv f)
      (.Ok saved) := by
  apply SdkC_BatchPair.returning hashv sha256 H p1 syscall
  rw [SdkC_Source.erasure]
  unfold code
  rw [GExp_FirstSource.source _ _ _ _ _
    (S2W_DigestExtraction.native_binding _ native1 native2 hashv extraction ())]
  rw [installed]
  exact AspisS6CurrentFirstInstallation.current_success _ _ f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split () saved
    (AspisS6CurrentStage1CodecJoin.first_success _ f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split saved cuts.first)

def Canonical (q : Array U32 8#usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Fin 8,(q.val[i.val]'(by simpa only [q.property,show (8#usize).val=8 from rfl] using i.isLt)).val<2147483647

@[local step] theorem word (arr : Array U8 4#usize) :
    aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes arr
      ⦃ out => ∀ v,out=some v → v.val<2147483647 ⦄ := by
  unfold aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes
  step*
  all_goals intro v same
  all_goals simp_all [aspis_core.field.P]
  all_goals scalar_tac

@[local step] theorem option {T E : Type} (o : Option T) (e : E) :
    core.option.Option.ok_or o e ⦃ out => ∀ v,out=.Ok v → o=some v ⦄ := by
  apply exists_imp_spec
  cases o <;> refine ⟨_,rfl,?_⟩ <;> simp

theorem source (arr : Array U8 32#usize) (out : Array U32 8#usize)
    (accepted : atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical arr=ok (.Ok out)) : Canonical out := by
  have spec : atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical arr
      ⦃ result => ∀ q,result=.Ok q → Canonical q ⦄ := by
    unfold atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical
    step*
    all_goals intro q eq
    all_goals cases eq
    all_goals (have rv0 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r val (cf_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv0:=o_post _ (r_post _ rv0)
    all_goals (have rv1 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r1 val1 (cf1_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv1:=o1_post _ (r1_post _ rv1)
    all_goals (have rv2 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r2 val2 (cf2_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv2:=o2_post _ (r2_post _ rv2)
    all_goals (have rv3 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r3 val3 (cf3_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv3:=o3_post _ (r3_post _ rv3)
    all_goals (have rv4 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r4 val4 (cf4_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv4:=o4_post _ (r4_post _ rv4)
    all_goals (have rv5 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r5 val5 (cf5_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv5:=o5_post _ (r5_post _ rv5)
    all_goals (have rv6 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r6 val6 (cf6_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv6:=o6_post _ (r6_post _ rv6)
    all_goals (have rv7 := JFu_ResultBranch.value r7 val7 (cf7_post.trans (congrArg Result.ok (by assumption))))
    all_goals have hv7:=o7_post _ (r7_post _ rv7)
    all_goals unfold Canonical
    all_goals intro j
    all_goals fin_cases j <;> first
      | exact hv0
      | exact hv1
      | exact hv2
      | exact hv3
      | exact hv4
      | exact hv5
      | exact hv6
      | exact hv7
  obtain ⟨result,call,post⟩:=WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  have same : result=.Ok out := Result.ok.inj (call.symm.trans accepted)
  exact post out same

theorem chunk (arr : Array U8 32#usize) (canon : canonical (bytesOf arr.val))
    (k : Nat) (hk : k<8) :
    canonical (bytesOf [arr.val[4*k]'(by simp only [arr.property,show (32#usize).val=32 from rfl];omega),
      arr.val[4*k+1]'(by simp only [arr.property,show (32#usize).val=32 from rfl];omega),

      arr.val[4*k+2]'(by simp only [arr.property,show (32#usize).val=32 from rfl];omega),
      arr.val[4*k+3]'(by simp only [arr.property,show (32#usize).val=32 from rfl];omega)],by simp;scalar_tac⟩

    (by simp only [Array.to_slice,Slice.length,arr.property,show (32#usize).val=32 from rfl];omega) (by omega) (by decide) canon
  intro j hj

    unfold atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical

    case canon =>

    case canon =>
      simpa only [Array.make,i8_post,i9_post,i10_post,i11_post] using chunk arr canon 2 (by decide)
    case canon =>
      simpa only [Array.make,i12_post,i13_post,i14_post,i15_post] using chunk arr canon 3 (by decide)
    case canon =>
      simpa only [Array.make,i16_post,i17_post,i18_post,i19_post] using chunk arr canon 4 (by decide)
    case canon =>
      simpa only [Array.make,i20_post,i21_post,i22_post,i23_post] using chunk arr canon 5 (by decide)
    case canon =>
      simpa only [Array.make,i24_post,i25_post,i26_post,i27_post] using chunk arr canon 6 (by decide)
    case canon =>
      simpa only [Array.make,i28_post,i29_post,i30_post,i31_post] using chunk arr canon 7 (by decide)
    all_goals simp_all [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok]
    all_goals exact ⟨_,rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨out,call,q,same⟩:=WP.spec_imp_exists spec

import JHb_S2K_ResultHeader
import JFs_PublicValidation
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.JHb_Emit
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
open S2K
/-- Frozen emit_result control flow with an explicit return-data syscall and
its state. Field construction and codecs are the source S2K definitions.
This is a source model; native syscall/artifact association is not asserted. -/
def source {A E : Type}
    (syscall : S2I.ReturnData.State A E → List U8 → Result (S2I.ReturnData.State A E))
    (state : S2I.ReturnData.State A E) (statement : StatementAdmission.Statement) :
    Result (core.result.Result (S2I.ReturnData.State A E) AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError) := do
  let result := ResultAdmission.value statement
  let validated ← validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1 statement result
  match validated with
  | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
  | .Ok () =>
    let encoded ← encode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_v1 result
    match encoded with
    | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
    | .Ok bytes =>
      if bytes.val.length ≠ 792 then ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
      else if bytes.val.take 4 ≠ [65#u8,83#u8,82#u8,56#u8] then ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
      else do
        let state' ← syscall state bytes.val
        ok (.Ok state')

theorem accepted {A E : Type}
    (syscall : S2I.ReturnData.State A E → List U8 → Result (S2I.ReturnData.State A E))
    (runtime : S2I.ReturnData.RuntimePremise syscall)
    (state : S2I.ReturnData.State A E) (statement : StatementAdmission.Statement)
    (valid : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 statement=ok (.Ok ())) :
    source syscall state statement=ok (.Ok (S2I.ReturnData.set state (ResultPayload.bytes statement).val)) := by
  unfold source
  dsimp only
  rw [ResultBinding.validated statement valid,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [ResultPayload.encoded statement valid,bind_tc_ok]
  dsimp only
  rw [if_neg (by exact not_not_intro (ResultPayload.bytes statement).property)]
  rw [if_neg (by exact not_not_intro (ResultHeader.magic statement))]
  rw [runtime,bind_tc_ok]
#print axioms accepted

theorem real {A E : Type}
    (syscall : S2I.ReturnData.State A E → List U8 → Result (S2I.ReturnData.State A E))
    (runtime : S2I.ReturnData.RuntimePremise syscall) (state : S2I.ReturnData.State A E) :
    source syscall state JFs_PublicValue.value=
      ok (.Ok (S2I.ReturnData.set state (ResultPayload.bytes JFs_PublicValue.value).val)) :=
  accepted syscall runtime state _ JFs_PublicValidation.source
#print axioms real
end AspisR1.JHb_Emit
end

import S2K_AfterstateEncoding

/-! Success inversion through the actual late-public encoder, preserving the
SAME candidate. Child encoders remain opaque; no call success is postulated. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.LateAdmission
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile pool_v1.pair_terminal

elab "s2k_unpair" : tactic =>
  Lean.Elab.Tactic.liftMetaTactic fun goal => goal.withContext do
    for decl in ← Lean.getLCtx do
      let type ← Lean.Meta.whnf decl.type
      if type.isAppOfArity ``Prod 2 then
        return (← goal.cases decl.fvarId).toList.map (·.mvarId)
    throwError "no product variable"

elab "s2k_uncase" : tactic =>
  Lean.Elab.Tactic.liftMetaTactic fun goal => goal.withContext do
    for decl in ← Lean.getLCtx do
      let type ← Lean.Meta.whnf decl.type
      if type.isAppOfArity ``core.result.Result 2 ||
          type.isAppOfArity ``core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow 2 ||
          type.isConstOf ``core.convert.Infallible then
        return (← goal.cases decl.fvarId).toList.map (·.mvarId)
    throwError "no result/control-flow variable"

theorem candidate (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)
    (h : encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s before = ok (.Ok (),after)) :
    ∃ bytes, encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s.candidate_afterstate = ok (.Ok bytes) := by
  unfold encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 at h
  simp only [Bind.bind, Aeneas.Std.bind, core.result.Result.map_err,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
    core.convert.FromSame.from] at h
  repeat' first
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,by assumption⟩)
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,rfl⟩)
    | (solve | cases h)
    | (dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at h)
    | (s2k_unpair <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | (s2k_uncase <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | (split at h)

theorem validated (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)
    (h : encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s before = ok (.Ok (),after)) :
    validate_verified_afterstate s.candidate_afterstate = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  obtain ⟨bytes,run⟩ := candidate s before after h
  have status := AfterstateStatus.status_exact s.candidate_afterstate
  rw [run] at status
  exact status.symm

theorem payload (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (before after : Slice U8)
    (h : encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s before = ok (.Ok (),after)) :
    encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s.candidate_afterstate =
      ok (.Ok (AfterstateEncoding.bytes s.candidate_afterstate)) :=
  AfterstateEncoding.encode_exact _ (validated s before after h)

#print axioms candidate
#print axioms validated
#print axioms payload
end AspisR1.S2K.LateAdmission

import JHb_S2K_ResultEncoding
import JHb_S2K_StatementLane
import S2I_ReturnData

/-! Source field-boundary byte/effect composition. This is the returning
syscall suffix, not an installed whole-native-emitter child. Validation and
native caller reachability must still precede this cut. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.ResultEvent
open S2I.ReturnData

def emitFields {A E : Type} (syscall : State A E → List U8 → Result (State A E))
    (state : State A E) (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) := do
  let out ← S2K_ResultBytes.S2K_reference_bytes master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate
  syscall state out.val

theorem source_event {A E : Type}
    (syscall : State A E → List U8 → Result (State A E))
    (runtime : RuntimePremise syscall) (state : State A E)
    (master selected nullifier : Array U8 32#usize)
    (kind lane : U8) (afterstate : Array U8 688#usize) :
    let out := ResultEncoding.stores (Array.repeat 792#usize 0#u8)
      master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate
    emitFields syscall state master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate = ok (set state out.val) ∧
    out.val.length = 792 ∧ out.val ≠ [] ∧
    (set state out.val).accounts = state.accounts ∧
    (set state out.val).events = state.events ++ [.setReturnData out.val] := by
  dsimp only
  let out := ResultEncoding.stores (Array.repeat 792#usize 0#u8)
    master selected nullifier kind lane afterstate
  have width : out.val.length = 792 := out.property
  have event := nonempty_event syscall runtime state out.val width
  refine ⟨?_,width,event.2.1,event.2.2.1,event.2.2.2⟩
  unfold emitFields
  rw [ResultEncoding.source_value]
  exact event.1

#print axioms source_event
end AspisR1.S2K.ResultEvent
