import JHb_S2K_LateAdmission

set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal pool_v1.pair_tree_profile pool_v1.pair_terminal
abbrev Statement := PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1

def common : Statement → PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1
  | .PrivateTransfer c _ => c
  | .Withdrawal c _ => c

elab "s2k_unbool" : tactic =>
  Lean.Elab.Tactic.liftMetaTactic fun goal => goal.withContext do
    for decl in ← Lean.getLCtx do
      let type ← Lean.Meta.whnf decl.type
      if type.isConstOf ``Bool then
        return (← goal.cases decl.fvarId).toList.map (·.mvarId)
    throwError "no boolean variable"

theorem late (s : Statement)
    (h : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    ∃ before after, encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1
      (common s).lane_transition before = ok (.Ok (),after) := by
  cases s <;> unfold validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 at h
  all_goals simp only [common,PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common,
    statement_public_common,bind_tc_ok,Bind.bind,Aeneas.Std.bind,
    core.result.Result.map_err,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
    core.convert.FromSame.from] at h ⊢
  all_goals generalize Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 = zero_bindings at h
  all_goals generalize Array.repeat 1520#usize 0#u8 = late_buffer at h
  all_goals repeat' first
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,_,by assumption⟩)
    | (solve | exact ⟨_,_,rfl⟩)
    | (solve | cases h)
    | (rw [if_pos (show true = true from rfl)] at h)
    | (rw [if_neg (show ¬ (false = true) by decide)] at h)
    | (dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry] at h)
    | (s2k_unpair <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | (s2k_uncase <;> simp_all only [Result.ok.injEq,Prod.mk.injEq])
    | s2k_unbool
    | (split at h)

theorem afterstate (s : Statement)
    (h : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    validate_verified_afterstate (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  obtain ⟨before,after,run⟩ := late s h
  exact LateAdmission.validated _ before after run

theorem payload (s : Statement)
    (h : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate =
      ok (.Ok (AfterstateEncoding.bytes (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate)) :=
  AfterstateEncoding.encode_exact _ (afterstate s h)

#print axioms late
#print axioms afterstate
#print axioms payload
end AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission

import JHf_ProgramErrorCarrier

def source (request : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1)
    (accounts : r1_pool_adapter.AuthenticatedAsq8Accounts)
    (candidate : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1) :
    Result (core.result.Result
      aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
      solana_program_error.ProgramError) := do
  let result ← AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.r1_pool_adapter.reconstruct_asq8_statement
    (JHf_Carrier.toRequest request) (JHf_Carrier.toAuthenticatedAsq8Accounts accounts)
    (JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 candidate)
  match result with
  | .Ok statement=>ok (.Ok (JHf_Carrier.fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 statement))
  | .Err error=>ok (.Err (JHf_ProgramErrorCarrier.fromRaw error))

theorem no_success (accounts : r1_pool_adapter.AuthenticatedAsq8Accounts)
    (candidate : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1)
    (faithful : accounts.live_snapshot.deployment_domain=JHf_DomainBytes.master) :
    ¬∃ out,source JHd_RequestCarrier.actual accounts candidate=ok (.Ok out) := by
  rintro ⟨out,run⟩
  unfold source at run
  have impossible:=JHf_NoReconstruction.source (JHf_Carrier.toAuthenticatedAsq8Accounts accounts)
    (JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 candidate) faithful
  change ¬∃ out,AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.r1_pool_adapter.reconstruct_asq8_statement
    (JHf_Carrier.toRequest JHd_RequestCarrier.actual) (JHf_Carrier.toAuthenticatedAsq8Accounts accounts)
    (JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 candidate)=ok (.Ok out) at impossible
  cases call : AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.r1_pool_adapter.reconstruct_asq8_statement
      (JHf_Carrier.toRequest JHd_RequestCarrier.actual) (JHf_Carrier.toAuthenticatedAsq8Accounts accounts)
      (JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 candidate) with
  | fail e=>simp only [call,bind_tc_fail] at run;cases run
  | div=>simp only [call,bind_tc_div] at run;cases run
  | ok result=>
    cases result with
    | Err e=>simp only [call,bind_tc_ok] at run;cases run
    | Ok value=>exact impossible ⟨value,call⟩
#print axioms no_success
end AspisR1.JHf_ReconstructionSlot

import AdapterRwScalar
import JHf_ProofWindow
import JHf_ScanCodec
import JHd_ScanValue
import S6CurrentAdapterCarrierV1
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.JHf_Scan

/-- Direct source control-flow model of scan_proof_buffer. Both codecs are
actual extracted operations; no successful child return is installed.
Native/source/ELF association of this model remains a separate obligation. -/
def source (bytes : Slice U8) : Result (core.result.Result
    AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.ScannedAsqaProof AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError) := do
  let expected ← lift (Usize.checked_add 688#usize 57607#usize)
  match expected with
  | none=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
  | some size=>
    if Slice.len bytes != size then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else do
      let header ← core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
        bytes {start:=0#usize,«end»:=688#usize}
      let decoded ← decode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 header
      match decoded with
      | .Err _=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
      | .Ok candidate=>
        let encoded ← encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 candidate
        match encoded with
        | .Err _=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
        | .Ok encoded=>
          if encoded.val != header.val then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else do
            let tag ← Slice.index_usize bytes 696#usize
            if tag != 2#u8 then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else
              ok (.Ok ⟨AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.fromPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 candidate,57607#usize⟩)

    have h:=JHb_Header.length

  simp only [lift,show Usize.checked_add 688#usize 57607#usize=some 58295#usize from AdapterRw.Scalar.checked_add_eq _ _ _ (by scalar_tac),
    bind_tc_ok,size,show (58295#usize !=58295#usize)=false from rfl,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,
    JHf_ProofWindow.first,JHb_Header.candidate,JHf_ScanCodec.encoded,
    show (JHb_Header.value.val !=JHb_Header.value.to_slice.val)=false from by simp only [Array.to_slice];simp,
    JHf_ProofWindow.tag,show (2#u8 !=2#u8)=false from rfl]
  rfl
#print axioms real
end AspisR1.JHf_Scan

import FIo_ReduceBounds
import FIo_NativeFuns
import LPe_MersenneReduction
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_ReductionWord
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The native word fold has the natural value used in LPe's reduction theorem. -/
theorem fold_value (x : U64) :
    (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x).val = LPe_MersenneReduction.fold x.val :=
by
  unfold FIo_ReduceBounds.fold U64.wrapping_add
  rw [UScalar.wrapping_add_val_eq, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (FIo_ReduceBounds.sum_bound x)]
  have low : (x &&& 2147483647#u64).val = x.val % 2147483648 := by
    change (x.bv &&& (2147483647 : BitVec 64)).toNat = x.val % 2147483648
    rw [BitVec.toNat_and]
    exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod x.val 31
  rw [low, FIo_ReduceBounds.shr_val]
  rfl

theorem twice_value (x : U64) :
    (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val =
      LPe_MersenneReduction.fold (LPe_MersenneReduction.fold x.val) := by
  rw [fold_value, fold_value]

/-- Exact value of the actual extracted private reducer, including word casts
and wrapping subtraction. No successful output observation is a premise. -/
theorem native_reduce (x : U64) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce x = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  have hx : x.val < 18446744073709551616 := by scalar_tac
  have small : (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val < 4294967294 := by
    rw [twice_value]
    exact LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_twice_lt x.val hx
  have value := twice_value x
  have residue := LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce_eq_mod x.val hx
  unfold FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce
  simp only [FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.P, lift, bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x) ≥ 2147483647#u64
    then ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (U64.wrapping_sub
      (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)) 2147483647#u64))
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)))) = ok z ∧ _
  split
  · rename_i h
    have lower : 2147483647 ≤ (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · unfold U64.wrapping_sub
      rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
      norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
      unfold LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce at residue
      rw [if_pos (by omega)] at residue
      omega
    · unfold U64.wrapping_sub
      rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
      norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
      omega
  · rename_i h
    have lower : (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)).val < 2147483647 := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_, rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq]
      norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
      unfold LPe_MersenneReduction.reduce at residue
      rw [if_neg (by omega)] at residue
      omega
    · scalar_tac

#print axioms fold_value
#print axioms twice_value
#print axioms native_reduce
end AspisR1.LPf_ReductionWord

import MultiproofConeWordScan
import R1M31ParserArray
import OraclePortCompactDraft

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.MultiproofConeEndian
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.RetainedFieldByteCodec

/-- Reuse the retained all-input M31 parser theorem, including rejection;
no canonical-operand premise is introduced at the byte boundary. -/
theorem strict_word_iff (a : Array U8 4#usize) :
    (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes a).val < 2147483647 ↔
      (decodeWordLE (M31ParserArray.arrayBytes a)).val < 2147483647 := by
  have h := M31ParserArray.parser_refines_array a
  unfold AspisR1M31Parser.field.M31.from_le_bytes AspisR1M31Parser.field.P at h
  simp only [lift, bind_tc_ok, UScalar.le_equiv,
    show (2147483647#u32).val = 2147483647 from rfl] at h
  have order : 2147483647 ≤ (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes a).val ↔
      ¬ (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes a).val < 2147483647 := by omega
  simp only [order] at h
  by_cases hs : (core.num.U32.from_le_bytes a).val < 2147483647 <;>
    by_cases hm : (decodeWordLE (M31ParserArray.arrayBytes a)).val < 2147483647 <;>
    simp_all [decodeM31LE, m31Modulus, rawCandidateCount] <;> omega

/-- Four-byte mathematical little-endian framing is the retained word codec. -/
theorem little_four (b : WordBytes) :
    OraclePortCompactDraft.little (List.ofFn b) = (decodeWordLE b).val := by
  simp [List.ofFn_succ, OraclePortCompactDraft.little, decodeWordLE]
  ring

#print axioms strict_word_iff
#print axioms little_four
end AspisR1.MultiproofConeEndian

import LPi_TowerValues
import LPf_WideConstruction
import AspisR1Post25Sampler.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBG_WideCarriers
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1 LPi_FieldValues

theorem wide_add (x y : NE) (hx : canonE x) (hy : canonE y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add x y = ok z ∧
      canonE z ∧ ew z = (addQ (qw x.c0) (qw y.c0), addQ (qw x.c1) (qw y.c1)) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := LPi_TowerValues.qm_add x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,vb⟩ := LPi_TowerValues.qm_add x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.add,
    ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],⟨ca,cb⟩,Prod.ext va vb⟩

theorem limbs_result (a b c d e f g h : U32) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs
      (Array.make 8#usize [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]) =
      ok (if a < 2147483647#u32 ∧ b < 2147483647#u32 ∧ c < 2147483647#u32 ∧
        d < 2147483647#u32 ∧ e < 2147483647#u32 ∧ f < 2147483647#u32 ∧
        g < 2147483647#u32 ∧ h < 2147483647#u32
        then some (LPf_WideConstruction.value a b c d e f g h) else none) := by
  simp [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_limbs,
    Array.index_usize,Array.make,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,LPf_WideConstruction.value]
  repeat' split
  all_goals simp_all <;> omega

theorem to_limbs_result (x : NE) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.to_limbs x =
      ok (Array.make 8#usize [x.c0.c0.a,x.c0.c0.b,x.c0.c1.a,x.c0.c1.b,
        x.c1.c0.a,x.c1.c0.b,x.c1.c1.a,x.c1.c1.b]) := rfl

/-- Wrong lengths reject before any byte index, for arbitrary machine slices. -/
theorem wrong_byte_length (bytes : Slice U8) (h : bytes.val.length ≠ 32) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes bytes = ok none := by
  have hn : Slice.len bytes != 32#usize := by
    simp only [bne_iff_ne]
    intro eq
    have values := congrArg UScalar.val eq
    apply h
    change bytes.val.length = 32 at values
    exact values
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.from_le_bytes,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.BYTE_LEN,hn,if_true]

abbrev PQ := AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.QM31
abbrev PE := AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact
def pw (x : PQ) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  (x.c0.a.val,x.c0.b.val,x.c1.a.val,x.c1.b.val)
def reduced (x : PQ) : Nat × Nat × Nat × Nat :=
  (x.c0.a.val%2147483647,x.c0.b.val%2147483647,
   x.c1.a.val%2147483647,x.c1.b.val%2147483647)

theorem remainder (x : U32) : ∃ z, x % 2147483647#u32 = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 :=
  WP.spec_imp_exists (UScalar.rem_spec x (y:=2147483647#u32) (by decide))

theorem canonical_qm31 (x : PQ) : ∃ z,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31 x = ok z ∧ pw z = reduced x := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va⟩ := remainder x.c0.a
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb⟩ := remainder x.c0.b
  obtain ⟨c,hc,vc⟩ := remainder x.c1.a
  obtain ⟨d,hd,vd⟩ := remainder x.c1.b
  refine ⟨⟨⟨a,b⟩,⟨c,d⟩⟩,?_,Prod.ext va (Prod.ext vb (Prod.ext vc vd))⟩
  simp only [AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.canonical_qm31.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnTupleM31M31.call,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.P,ha,hb,hc,hd,bind_tc_ok]

theorem wide_new (x y : PQ) : ∃ z : PE,
    AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact.new x y = ok z ∧
      (pw z.c0,pw z.c1) = (reduced x,reduced y) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va⟩ := canonical_qm31 x
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb⟩ := canonical_qm31 y
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact.new,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],
    Prod.ext va vb⟩

#print axioms wide_add
#print axioms limbs_result
#print axioms to_limbs_result
#print axioms wrong_byte_length
#print axioms remainder
#print axioms canonical_qm31
#print axioms wide_new
end NBG_WideCarriers

import NBK_LiveBytes
import JFt_SnapshotConstants
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace NBK_LivePrepare
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder AspisR1.S2K
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile
abbrev Snapshot := PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1

def run {T : Type} (snapshot : Snapshot) (output : Slice U8)
    (k : LoopStep.Iter → Slice U8 → Result T) : Result T := do
      let (s, index_mut_back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8) output { «end» := 8#usize }
      let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_MAGIC)
      let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
      let output2 := index_mut_back s2
      let output3 ← Slice.update output2 8#usize pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_VERSION
      let (s3, index_mut_back1) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output3 { start := 16#usize, «end» := 48#usize }
      let a ← pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_TREE_FORMAT_BINDING
      let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
      let s5 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s3 s4
      let output4 := index_mut_back1 s5
      let (s6, index_mut_back2) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output4 { start := 48#usize, «end» := 80#usize }
      let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice snapshot.pool)
      let s8 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s6 s7
      let output5 := index_mut_back2 s8
      let (s9, index_mut_back3) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output5 { start := 80#usize, «end» := 112#usize }
      let s10 ← lift (Array.to_slice snapshot.deployment_domain)
      let s11 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s9 s10
      let output6 := index_mut_back3 s11
      let (s12, index_mut_back4) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output6 { start := 112#usize, «end» := 120#usize }
      let a1 ← lift (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes snapshot.sequence)
      let s13 ← lift (Array.to_slice a1)
      let s14 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s12 s13
      let output7 := index_mut_back4 s14
      let (s15, index_mut_back5) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output7 { start := 120#usize, «end» := 128#usize }
      let a2 ← lift (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes snapshot.next_pair_index)
      let s16 ← lift (Array.to_slice a2)
      let s17 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s15 s16
      let output8 := index_mut_back5 s17
      let (s18, index_mut_back6) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output8 { start := 128#usize, «end» := 160#usize }
      let a3 ← atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical snapshot.current_root
      let s19 ← lift (Array.to_slice a3)
      let s20 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s18 s19
      let s21 ← lift (Array.to_slice snapshot.frontier)
      let i1 ← core.slice.Slice.iter s21
      let iter ← core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)) i1
      let output9 := index_mut_back6 s20
      k iter output9

def value (a : Snapshot) (output : Slice U8) : Slice U8 :=
  ⟨((((((((output.val.setSlice! 0 POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_MAGIC.val).set
      8 POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_VERSION).setSlice!
      16 AspisR1.JFt_SnapshotConstants.formatArray.val).setSlice!
      48 a.pool.val).setSlice! 80 a.deployment_domain.val).setSlice!
      112 (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes a.sequence).val).setSlice!
      120 (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes a.next_pair_index).val).setSlice!
      128 (DigestBytes.bytes a.current_root).val), by
        simpa only [List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set] using output.property⟩

theorem exact {T : Type} (a : Snapshot) (output : Slice U8)
    (size : output.length = 800) (k : LoopStep.Iter → Slice U8 → Result T) :
    run a output k = k (Iterator.cursor a.frontier 0#usize) (value a output) := by
  have len : output.val.length = 800 := size
  unfold run
  simp only [DigestBytes.exact,AspisR1.JFt_SnapshotConstants.format_call,bind_tc_ok,lift]
  simp [core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut, core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice, core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,
    Slice.length, Slice.len, Slice.update, len, List.slice,
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_MAGIC,
    core.slice.Slice.iter, core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default,
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.default, Iterator.cursor,value]

#print axioms exact
end NBK_LivePrepare

import NBK_LivePrepare
import NBK_Fill
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBK_LiveResult
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder AspisR1.S2K
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile
abbrev Snapshot := PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1

def zero : Slice U8 := (Array.repeat 800#usize 0#u8).to_slice

def bytes (s : Snapshot) : Slice U8 :=
  NBK_LiveBytes.fold s.frontier.val 0 (NBK_LivePrepare.value s zero)

theorem success (s : Snapshot) (output : Slice U8)
    (size : output.length = 800)
    (valid : validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s output = ok (.Ok (),bytes s) := by
  have len : Slice.len output = 800#usize := by scalar_tac
  simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1,len,
    POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES, bne_self_eq_false, if_false,
    valid,bind_tc_ok,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  have fill : core.slice.Slice.fill core.clone.CloneU8 output 0#u8 = ok zero := by
    rw [NBK_Fill.source]
    congr 1
    apply Subtype.ext
    change List.replicate output.length 0#u8 = List.replicate 800 0#u8
    rw [size]
  rw [fill]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  change NBK_LivePrepare.run s zero (fun iter out => do
    let encoded ← encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop iter out
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok (),encoded)) = _
  rw [NBK_LivePrepare.exact s zero (by simp only [zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]; rfl)]
  have prepared_size : (NBK_LivePrepare.value s zero).length = 800 := by
    simp only [NBK_LivePrepare.value,Slice.length,zero,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set,List.length_replicate]
    rfl
  rw [NBK_LiveBytes.loop_exact s.frontier 0#usize (by decide) _ prepared_size]
  rfl

theorem source (s : Snapshot) (output : Slice U8) :
    encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s output =
      if output.length ≠ 800 then ok (.Err .WrongLength,output)
      else match NBH_LiveValidator.result s with
        | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok (),bytes s)
        | .Err e => ok (.Err e,output) := by
  by_cases size : output.length = 800
  · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr size)]
    have val := NBH_LiveValidator.source s
    cases r : NBH_LiveValidator.result s with
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      rw [r] at val
      exact success s output size val
    | Err e =>
      rw [r] at val
      have len : Slice.len output = 800#usize := by scalar_tac
      simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1,len,
        POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES, bne_self_eq_false, if_false,
        val,bind_tc_ok,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
      rfl
  · rw [if_pos size]
    have len : Slice.len output ≠ 800#usize := by scalar_tac
    simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1,
      POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES, ne_eq, bne_iff_ne, len, not_false_eq_true, if_true]

#print axioms success
#print axioms source
end NBK_LiveResult

import NBK_SliceStore
import S2K_Iterator
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace NBK_LiveStep
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open AspisR1.S2K.LoopStep (Digest Iter next)
abbrev body := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop.body

theorem body_done (iter iter' : Iter) (output : Slice U8)
    (done : next iter = ok (none,iter')) :
    body iter output = ok (ControlFlow.done output) := by
  simp only [body, pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop.body,
    done, bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

private theorem mk (n : Nat) (h : UScalar.inBounds .Usize n) :
    UScalar.tryMk .Usize n = ok (Usize.ofNatCore n h) := by
  simp only [UScalar.tryMk, UScalar.tryMkOpt,
    dif_pos ((UScalar.check_bounds_eq_inBounds .Usize n).mpr h), Result.ofOption]
  rfl

theorem body_write (iter iter' : Iter) (output : Slice U8)
    (level : Usize) (node : Digest) (bytes : Array U8 32#usize)
    (reached : next iter = ok (some (level,node),iter'))
    (range : level.val < 20) (size : output.length = 800)
    (encoded : atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical node = ok bytes) :
    body iter output = ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',output.setSlice! (160+32*level.val) bytes.val)) := by
  have mul : 32#usize * level = ok (Usize.ofNatCore (32*level.val) (by scalar_tac)) := by
    change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (32*level.val) = _
    exact mk _ _
  have add : 160#usize + Usize.ofNatCore (32*level.val) (by scalar_tac) =
      ok (Usize.ofNatCore (160+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac)) := by
    change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (160+32*level.val) = _
    exact mk _ _
  have stop : Usize.ofNatCore (160+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac) + 32#usize =
      ok (Usize.ofNatCore (192+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac)) := by
    change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (160+32*level.val+32) = _
    have eqn : 160+32*level.val+32 = 192+32*level.val := by omega
    simp only [eqn]
    exact mk _ _
  simp only [body, pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop.body,
    reached, bind_tc_ok]
  change (do
    let i ← 32#usize * level
    let start ← 160#usize + i
    let stop ← start + 32#usize
    let (s, back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8) output {start, «end» := stop}
    let a ← atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical node
    let src ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
    let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
    ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',back copied))) = _
  simp only [mul, add, stop, encoded, bind_tc_ok]
  have run := NBK_SliceStore.exact output
    (Usize.ofNatCore (160+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac))
    (Usize.ofNatCore (192+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac)) bytes
    (by change 160+32*level.val ≤ 192+32*level.val; omega)
    (by rw [size]; change 192+32*level.val ≤ 800; omega)
    (by change 192+32*level.val-(160+32*level.val)=32; omega)
  unfold NBK_SliceStore.store at run
  change (do
    let (s, back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
      output {start := Usize.ofNatCore (160+32*level.val) _, «end» := Usize.ofNatCore (192+32*level.val) _}
    let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
    let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
    ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',back copied))) = _
  have lifted := congrArg (fun r => do
    let a ← r
    ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',a) : ControlFlow (Iter × Slice U8) (Slice U8))) run
  cases indexed : core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8) output
      {start := Usize.ofNatCore (160+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac),
       «end» := Usize.ofNatCore (192+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac)} with
  | fail e => simp only [indexed, bind_tc_fail] at run; cases run
  | div => simp only [indexed, bind_tc_div] at run; cases run
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨s,back⟩
    simp only [indexed, bind_tc_ok] at lifted ⊢
    change (do
      let a ← (do
        let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
        let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
        ok (back copied))
      ok (ControlFlow.cont (iter',a))) = _ at lifted
    have proj : (Usize.ofNatCore (160+32*level.val) (by scalar_tac)).val = 160+32*level.val := by rfl
    simpa only [bind_assoc_eq, bind_tc_ok, proj] using lifted

#print axioms mk
#print axioms body_done
#print axioms body_write
end NBK_LiveStep

import NBN_StatementResult
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_BindingChecks
abbrev ErrT := NBN_StatementResult.Error
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
abbrev Common := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def chain (c : Common) (p : NBD_TerminalProjection.Parts)
    (tail : core.result.Result Unit ErrT) : core.result.Result Unit ErrT :=
  if p.1 ≠ c.master_account then .Err .MasterBindingMismatch
  else if p.2.1 ≠ c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain then .Err .DeploymentBindingMismatch
  else if c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool ≠ c.master_account then .Err .MasterBindingMismatch
  else if p.2.2.1 ≠ c.checkpoint_sequence then .Err .CheckpointBindingMismatch
  else if p.2.2.2.1 ≠ c.historical_global_anchor then .Err .HistoricalAnchorMismatch
  else tail

def tail (s : Statement) : core.result.Result Unit ErrT :=
  match NBN_OutputLane.result (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | .Err e => .Err (.Account e)
  | .Ok lane => if lane ≠ (common s).output_lane then .Err .OutputLaneMismatch
    else match lateStatus (common s).lane_transition with
      | .Err e => .Err (.LaneTransition e)
      | .Ok _ => .Ok ()

theorem factor (s : Statement) : suffix s = chain (common s) (parts s) (tail s) := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem fields (c : Common) (p : NBD_TerminalProjection.Parts)
    (t : core.result.Result Unit ErrT) (h : chain c p t = .Ok ()) :
    p.1 = c.master_account ∧ p.2.1 = c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain ∧
    c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool = c.master_account ∧
    p.2.2.1 = c.checkpoint_sequence ∧ p.2.2.2.1 = c.historical_global_anchor := by
  unfold chain at h
  by_cases h1 : p.1 = c.master_account
  · simp only [h1,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false] at h
    by_cases h2 : p.2.1 = c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain
    · simp only [h2,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false] at h
      by_cases h3 : c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool = c.master_account
      · simp only [h3,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false] at h
        by_cases h4 : p.2.2.1 = c.checkpoint_sequence
        · simp only [h4,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false] at h
          by_cases h5 : p.2.2.2.1 = c.historical_global_anchor
          · exact ⟨h1,h2,h3,h4,h5⟩
          · simp only [h5,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true] at h; cases h
        · simp only [h4,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true] at h; cases h
      · simp only [h3,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true] at h; cases h
    · simp only [h2,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true] at h; cases h
  · simp only [h1,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true] at h; cases h

#print axioms factor
#print axioms fields
end NBN_BindingChecks

theorem registry_unconstrained {F E : Type} (c : DrvC_Installation.Configuration F E)
    (r : AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.verifier_registry.VerifierRegistryV1) :
    ∃ cFalse cTrue : DrvC_Installation.Configuration F E,
      (DrvC_Installation.sdk cFalse).op25 r = ok false ∧
      (DrvC_Installation.sdk cTrue).op25 r = ok true := by
  exact ⟨{c with adapter := {c.adapter with op25 := fun _ => ok false}},
    {c with adapter := {c.adapter with op25 := fun _ => ok true}},rfl,rfl⟩

/-- No universally quantified adapter can be given a fixed op25 law from selection. -/
theorem no_fixed_registry_law {F E : Type} (c : DrvC_Installation.Configuration F E)
    (r : AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.verifier_registry.VerifierRegistryV1)
    (expected : Bool) :
    ¬ (∀ d : DrvC_Installation.Configuration F E,
      (DrvC_Installation.sdk d).op25 r = ok expected) := by
  intro h
  obtain ⟨cf,ct,hf,ht⟩ := registry_unconstrained c r
  have ef : false = expected := Result.ok.inj (hf.symm.trans (h cf))
  have et : true = expected := Result.ok.inj (ht.symm.trans (h ct))
  cases ef.trans et.symm

#print axioms registry_unconstrained
#print axioms no_fixed_registry_law
end NBN_CallbackObstruction

noncomputable section
namespace NBN_DigestResultDependency
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder AspisR1.S2K
abbrev Digest := Array U32 8#usize
abbrev Encode := Digest → Result (Array U8 32#usize)

/-- Full lower law: exact output AND ok status, on each caller-proved domain. -/
def NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical (encode : Encode) : Prop :=
  ∀ d, NBD_DigestInduction.Canonical d → encode d = ok (DigestBytes.bytes d)

def NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeRaw (encode : Encode) : Prop :=
  ∀ d, encode d = ok (DigestBytes.bytes d)

def foldM {T : Type} (encode : Encode) (store : Nat → Array U8 32#usize → T → T) :
    List Digest → Nat → T → Result T
  | [],_,out => ok out
  | d::ds,k,out => do
    let b ← encode d
    foldM encode store ds (k+1) (store k b out)

def foldModel {T : Type} (store : Nat → Array U8 32#usize → T → T) :
    List Digest → Nat → T → T
  | [],_,out => out
  | d::ds,k,out => foldModel store ds (k+1) (store k (DigestBytes.bytes d) out)

theorem fold_exact {T : Type} (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (store : Nat → Array U8 32#usize → T → T) (ds : List Digest)
    (domain : ∀ d ∈ ds, NBD_DigestInduction.Canonical d) (k : Nat) (out : T) :
    foldM encode store ds k out = ok (foldModel store ds k out) := by
  induction ds generalizing k out with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d ds ih =>
    rw [foldM,lower d (domain d (by simp))]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,foldModel]
    exact ih (fun x hx => domain x (by simp [hx])) (k+1) _

theorem live_model (ds : List Digest) (k : Nat) (out : Slice U8) :
    foldModel (fun i b (o : Slice U8) => o.setSlice! (160+32*i) b.val) ds k out =
      NBK_LiveBytes.fold ds k out := by
  induction ds generalizing k out with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d ds ih => exact ih (k+1) _

theorem after_model (ds : List Digest) (k : Nat) (out : Array U8 688#usize) :
    foldModel (fun i b (o : Array U8 688#usize) => o.setSlice! (48+32*i) b.val) ds k out =
      AfterstateBytes.fold ds k out := by
  induction ds generalizing k out with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d ds ih => exact ih (k+1) _

theorem live_caller (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (s : NBH_LiveValidator.Snapshot) (valid : NBH_LiveValidator.result s = .Ok ()) (out : Slice U8) :
    encode s.current_root = ok (DigestBytes.bytes s.current_root) ∧
    foldM encode (fun i b (o : Slice U8) => o.setSlice! (160+32*i) b.val) s.frontier.val 0 out =
      ok (NBK_LiveBytes.fold s.frontier.val 0 out) := by
  have d := NBN_ValidatorDomains.live s valid
  refine ⟨lower _ d.2.2.2.2.1,?_⟩
  rw [fold_exact encode lower _ _ (NBN_FrontierDependency.rows_canonical _ d.2.2.2.2.2),live_model]

theorem after_caller (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (s : NBH_Validators.Afterstate) (valid : NBH_Validators.afterResult s = .Ok ()) (out : Array U8 688#usize) :
    encode s.next_root = ok (DigestBytes.bytes s.next_root) ∧
    foldM encode (fun i b (o : Array U8 688#usize) => o.setSlice! (48+32*i) b.val) s.next_frontier.val 0 out =
      ok (AfterstateBytes.fold s.next_frontier.val 0 out) := by
  have d := NBN_ValidatorDomains.afterstate s valid
  refine ⟨lower _ d.2.2.1,?_⟩
  rw [fold_exact encode lower _ _ (NBN_FrontierDependency.rows_canonical _ d.2.2.2),after_model]

#print axioms fold_exact
#print axioms live_model
#print axioms after_model
#print axioms live_caller
#print axioms after_caller
end NBN_DigestResultDependency

def tag : Statement → U8
  | .PrivateTransfer _ _ => 1#u8
  | .Withdrawal _ _ => 2#u8

def commonBytes (s : Statement) : List U8 :=
  AspisS6OuterByteLayout.common_prefix (fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 (common s)) (tag s)

def bytes (s : Statement) (pay : Array U8 216#usize) : Array U8 1880#usize :=
  ⟨(commonBytes s ++ (NBN_LateTail.value (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.header).val) ++ pay.val, by
    have p := AspisS6OuterByteLayout.common_length (fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 (common s)) (tag s)
    have l := (NBN_LateInvariant.value_length (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.header).trans NBN_LateResult.header_length
    have q := pay.property
    change pay.val.length = 216 at q
    change (NBN_LateTail.value (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.header).val.length = 1520 at l
    change (commonBytes s).length = 144 at p
    simp only [List.length_append,p,l,q]
    rfl⟩

theorem length (s : Statement) (pay : Array U8 216#usize) : (bytes s pay).val.length = 1880 :=
  (bytes s pay).property

abbrev Encode := NBN_DigestResultDependency.Encode
abbrev NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical := NBN_DigestResultDependency.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical

def afterHeader (a : Afterstate) (output : Array U8 688#usize) (root : Array U8 32#usize) : Array U8 688#usize :=
  ⟨(((((((output.val.setSlice! 0 POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_MAGIC.val).set
      4 POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIER_TRANSPORT_VERSION).set
      5 pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_TREE_STORAGE_FORMAT_VERSION).set
      6 pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION).set 7 1#u8).setSlice!
      8 (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes a.next_pair_index).val).setSlice!
      16 root.val), by
        simp only [List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set,output.property]⟩

def liveHeader (a : Snapshot) (output : Slice U8) (root : Array U8 32#usize) : Slice U8 :=
  ⟨((((((((output.val.setSlice! 0 pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_MAGIC.val).set
      8 pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_VERSION).setSlice!
      16 AspisR1.JFt_SnapshotConstants.formatArray.val).setSlice!
      48 a.pool.val).setSlice! 80 a.deployment_domain.val).setSlice!
      112 (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes a.sequence).val).setSlice!
      120 (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes a.next_pair_index).val).setSlice!
      128 root.val), by
        simpa only [List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set] using output.property⟩

    afterHeader a out (DigestBytes.bytes a.next_root) = AfterstatePrepare.value a out := by rfl

theorem live_header (a : Snapshot) (out : Slice U8) :
    liveHeader a out (DigestBytes.bytes a.current_root) = NBK_LivePrepare.value a out := by rfl

/-- Source control summary; encoded child Results retain fail/div. -/
def after (encode : Encode) (a : Afterstate) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 688#usize) PoolV1PairVerifierTransportErrorV1) :=
  match NBH_Validators.afterResult a with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok _ => do
    let root ← encode a.next_root
    let out ← NBN_DigestResultDependency.foldM encode
      (fun i b (o : Array U8 688#usize) => o.setSlice! (48+32*i) b.val)
      a.next_frontier.val 0 (afterHeader a (Array.repeat 688#usize 0#u8) root)
    ok (.Ok out)

def live (encode : Encode) (s : Snapshot) (out : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotErrorV1 × Slice U8) :=
  if out.length ≠ 800 then ok (.Err .WrongLength,out)
  else match NBH_LiveValidator.result s with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e,out)
    | .Ok _ => do
      let root ← encode s.current_root
      let written ← NBN_DigestResultDependency.foldM encode
        (fun i b (o : Slice U8) => o.setSlice! (160+32*i) b.val)
        s.frontier.val 0 (liveHeader s NBK_LiveResult.zero root)
      ok (.Ok (),written)

theorem after_source (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode) (a : Afterstate) :
    after encode a = encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 a := by
  rw [NBK_AfterstateResult.source]
  cases valid : NBH_Validators.afterResult a with
  | Err e => simp only [after,valid]
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp only [after,valid]
    let prepared := AfterstatePrepare.value a (Array.repeat 688#usize 0#u8)
    have calls := NBN_DigestResultDependency.after_caller encode lower a valid prepared
    rw [calls.1]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok,after_header]
    rw [calls.2]
    rfl

theorem live_source (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (s : Snapshot) (out : Slice U8) :
    live encode s out = pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s out := by
  rw [NBK_LiveResult.source]
  by_cases size : out.length = 800
  · simp only [live,size,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false]
    cases valid : NBH_LiveValidator.result s with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      let prepared := NBK_LivePrepare.value s NBK_LiveResult.zero
      have calls := NBN_DigestResultDependency.live_caller encode lower s valid prepared
      rw [calls.1]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,live_header]
      rw [calls.2]
      rfl
  · simp only [live,size,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true]

#print axioms after_source
#print axioms live_source
end NBN_EncoderSummary

import NBN_ValidatorDomains
import NBK_LiveResult
import NBK_AfterstateResult
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_FrontierDependency
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder AspisR1.S2K
abbrev Digest := Array U32 8#usize
abbrev Encode := Digest → Array U8 32#usize

/-- Exact named lower bridge needed on caller-proved canonical inputs. -/
def NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical (encode : Encode) : Prop :=
  ∀ d, NBD_DigestInduction.Canonical d → encode d = DigestBytes.bytes d

/-- The unguarded first-byte helper needs the stronger all-raw lower domain. -/
def NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeRaw (encode : Encode) : Prop :=
  ∀ d, encode d = DigestBytes.bytes d

def liveFold (encode : Encode) : List Digest → Nat → Slice U8 → Slice U8
  | [],_,out => out
  | d::ds,k,out => liveFold encode ds (k+1) (out.setSlice! (160+32*k) (encode d).val)

def afterFold (encode : Encode) : List Digest → Nat → Array U8 688#usize → Array U8 688#usize
  | [],_,out => out
  | d::ds,k,out => afterFold encode ds (k+1) (out.setSlice! (48+32*k) (encode d).val)

theorem live_fold (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (ds : List Digest) (all : ∀ d ∈ ds, NBD_DigestInduction.Canonical d)
    (k : Nat) (out : Slice U8) :
    liveFold encode ds k out = NBK_LiveBytes.fold ds k out := by
  induction ds generalizing k out with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d ds ih =>
    have first := lower d (all d (by simp))
    simp only [liveFold,NBK_LiveBytes.fold,first]
    exact ih (fun x hx => all x (by simp [hx])) (k+1) _

theorem after_fold (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (ds : List Digest) (all : ∀ d ∈ ds, NBD_DigestInduction.Canonical d)
    (k : Nat) (out : Array U8 688#usize) :
    afterFold encode ds k out = AfterstateBytes.fold ds k out := by
  induction ds generalizing k out with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons d ds ih =>
    have first := lower d (all d (by simp))
    simp only [afterFold,AfterstateBytes.fold,first]
    exact ih (fun x hx => all x (by simp [hx])) (k+1) _

theorem rows_canonical (rows : NBH_Frontier.Frontier)
    (all : NBH_Frontier.CanonicalFrom rows 0) :
    ∀ d ∈ rows.val, NBD_DigestInduction.Canonical d := by
  intro d mem
  obtain ⟨i,hi,same⟩ := List.mem_iff_getElem.mp mem
  have bound : i < 20 := by have := rows.property; scalar_tac
  have h := all ⟨i,bound⟩ (by omega)
  simpa only [same] using h

theorem live_caller (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (s : NBH_LiveValidator.Snapshot) (valid : NBH_LiveValidator.result s = .Ok ())
    (out : Slice U8) :
    encode s.current_root = DigestBytes.bytes s.current_root ∧
    liveFold encode s.frontier.val 0 out = NBK_LiveBytes.fold s.frontier.val 0 out := by
  have domain := NBN_ValidatorDomains.live s valid
  exact ⟨lower _ domain.2.2.2.2.1,
    live_fold encode lower _ (rows_canonical _ domain.2.2.2.2.2) 0 out⟩

theorem after_caller (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (a : NBH_Validators.Afterstate) (valid : NBH_Validators.afterResult a = .Ok ())
    (out : Array U8 688#usize) :
    encode a.next_root = DigestBytes.bytes a.next_root ∧
    afterFold encode a.next_frontier.val 0 out = AfterstateBytes.fold a.next_frontier.val 0 out := by
  have domain := NBN_ValidatorDomains.afterstate a valid
  exact ⟨lower _ domain.2.2.1,
    after_fold encode lower _ (rows_canonical _ domain.2.2.2) 0 out⟩

#print axioms live_fold
#print axioms after_fold
#print axioms rows_canonical
#print axioms live_caller
#print axioms after_caller
end NBN_FrontierDependency

def raw (statement : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 × Slice U8) := do
      let i7 ← 32#usize + pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES
      let (s15, index_mut_back5) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output { start := 32#usize, «end» := i7 }
      let (r, s16) ← pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 statement.live_snapshot s15
      let r1 ← core.result.Result.map_err pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairLiveSnapshotErrorV1PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 r ()
      let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
      match cf with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        let r2 ← pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 statement.candidate_afterstate
        let r3 ← core.result.Result.map_err pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairVerifierTransportErrorV1PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 r2 ()
        let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
        match cf1 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val => let output9 := index_mut_back5 s16
                                                            let (s17, index_mut_back6) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) output9 { start := i7 }
                                                            let s18 ← lift (Array.to_slice val)
                                                            let s19 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s17 s18
                                                            let output10 := index_mut_back6 s19
                                                            ok (core.result.Result.Ok (), output10)
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => let r4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual Unit (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1) residual
                                                              let output9 := index_mut_back5 s16
                                                              ok (r4, output9)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => let r2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual Unit (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1) residual
                                                            let output9 := index_mut_back5 s16
                                                            ok (r2, output9)


theorem bind_ext {α β : Type} (r : Result α) (f g : α → Result β)
    (h : ∀ x, f x = g x) :
    (do let x ← r; f x) = (do let x ← r; g x) := by
  cases r <;> simp_all only [bind_tc_ok,bind_tc_fail,bind_tc_div]

theorem raw_eq (s : PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) (output : Slice U8) :
    raw s output = NBN_LateTail.run s output := by
  unfold raw NBN_LateTail.run
  apply bind_ext
  intro i7
  apply bind_ext
  intro window
  rcases window with ⟨input,back⟩
  apply bind_ext
  intro child
  rcases child with ⟨r,live⟩
  cases r with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,bind_tc_ok,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
    apply bind_ext
    intro after
    cases after <;> rfl

#print axioms bind_ext
#print axioms raw_eq
end NBN_LateFactor

def run {T : Type} (output : Slice U8) (k : Slice U8 → Result T) : Result T := do
      let (s, index_mut_back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8) output { «end» := 8#usize }
      let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_MAGIC)
      let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
      let output2 := index_mut_back s2
      let output3 ← Slice.update output2 8#usize pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_VERSION
      let output4 ← Slice.update output3 9#usize pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_ITEM_COUNT
      let (s3, index_mut_back1) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output4 { start := 10#usize, «end» := 12#usize }
      let i2 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U16 pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_HEADER_BYTES)
      let a ← lift (core.num.U16.to_le_bytes i2)
      let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
      let s5 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s3 s4
      let output5 := index_mut_back1 s5
      let (s6, index_mut_back2) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output5 { start := 12#usize, «end» := 16#usize }
      let i3 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES)
      let a1 ← lift (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes i3)
      let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice a1)
      let s8 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s6 s7
      let output6 := index_mut_back2 s8
      let (s9, index_mut_back3) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output6 { start := 16#usize, «end» := 20#usize }
      let i4 ← pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES
      let i5 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 i4)
      let a2 ← lift (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes i5)
      let s10 ← lift (Array.to_slice a2)
      let s11 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s9 s10
      let output7 := index_mut_back3 s11
      let (s12, index_mut_back4) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output7 { start := 20#usize, «end» := 24#usize }
      let i6 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U32 1520#usize)
      let a3 ← lift (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes i6)
      let s13 ← lift (Array.to_slice a3)
      let s14 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s12 s13
      let output8 := index_mut_back4 s14
      k output8

def value (output : Slice U8) : Slice U8 :=
  ⟨((((((output.val.setSlice! 0 POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_MAGIC.val).set
    8 POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_VERSION).set
    9 POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_ITEM_COUNT).setSlice!
    10 (core.num.U16.to_le_bytes 32#u16).val).setSlice!
    12 (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes 800#u32).val).setSlice!
    16 (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes 688#u32).val).setSlice!
    20 (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes 1520#u32).val, by
      simpa only [List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set] using output.property⟩

theorem exact {T : Type} (output : Slice U8) (size : output.length = 1520)
    (k : Slice U8 → Result T) : run output k = k (value output) := by
  have len : output.val.length = 1520 := size
  have afterSize : pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES = ok 688#usize := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_PAYLOAD_BYTES
    have h : (8#usize + 680#usize) ⦃ r => r = 688#usize ⦄ := by
      step* <;> scalar_tac
    obtain ⟨r, call, same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists h
    exact same ▸ call
  have cast16 : UScalar.cast .U16 32#usize = 32#u16  := by scalar_tac
  have cast800 : UScalar.cast .U32 800#usize = 800#u32  := by scalar_tac
  have cast688 : UScalar.cast .U32 688#usize = 688#u32  := by scalar_tac
  have cast1520 : UScalar.cast .U32 1520#usize = 1520#u32  := by scalar_tac
  unfold run
  simp only [AspisR1.JFs_LateConstants.size,bind_tc_ok,lift]
  simp [afterSize,cast16,cast800,cast688,cast1520, core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut, core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice,core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,
    Slice.length,Slice.len,Slice.update,len,List.slice,value,
    POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_MAGIC,POOL_V1_PAIR_LATE_PUBLIC_STATEMENT_HEADER_BYTES,
    POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES]

#print axioms exact
end NBN_LatePrepare

theorem factor (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8)

  simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1,
    AspisR1.JFs_LateConstants.size,bind_tc_ok,len,bne_self_eq_false,if_false,
    lift,NBK_LatePreflight.option_ne,index,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,decide_false]
  have tail_eq : NBN_LateFactor.raw s = NBN_LateTail.run s :=
    funext (NBN_LateFactor.raw_eq s)
  rw [← tail_eq]
  rfl

def zero : Slice U8 := (Array.repeat 1520#usize 0#u8).to_slice
def header : Slice U8 := NBN_LatePrepare.value zero

theorem header_length : header.length = 1520 := by
  simp only [header,NBN_LatePrepare.value,Slice.length,zero,Array.to_slice,
    Array.repeat_val,List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set,List.length_replicate]
  rfl

theorem source (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s output =
      if output.length ≠ 1520 then ok (.Err .WrongLength,output)
      else if U64.checked_add s.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 ≠
          some s.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index then
        ok (.Err .AfterstateIndexMismatch,output)
      else ok (NBN_LateTail.status s,NBN_LateTail.value s header) := by
  by_cases size : output.length = 1520
  · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr size)]
    by_cases index : U64.checked_add s.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 =
      some s.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
    · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr index),factor s output size index,NBK_Fill.source]
      have filled : NBK_Fill.value output 0#u8 = zero := by
        apply Subtype.ext
        change List.replicate output.length 0#u8 = List.replicate 1520 0#u8
        rw [size]
      rw [filled]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [NBN_LatePrepare.exact zero (by simp only [zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]; rfl)]
      exact NBN_LateTail.exact s header header_length
    · rw [if_pos index]
      exact NBK_LatePreflight.wrong_index s output size index
  · rw [if_pos size]
    exact NBK_LatePreflight.wrong_length s output size

#print axioms factor
#print axioms header_length
#print axioms source
end NBN_LateResult

import NBN_EncoderSummary
import NBN_LateResult
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_LateSummary
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

abbrev Statement := PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1
abbrev Error := PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1
abbrev Encode := NBN_EncoderSummary.Encode
abbrev NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical := NBN_EncoderSummary.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical

def tail (encode : NBN_EncoderSummary.Encode) (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit Error × Slice U8) := do
  let i7 ← 32#usize + POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES
  let (s15, back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8) output {start := 32#usize, «end» := i7}
  let (r, s16) ← NBN_EncoderSummary.live encode s.live_snapshot s15
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Snapshot e), back s16)
  | .Ok _ =>
    let r2 ← NBN_EncoderSummary.after encode s.candidate_afterstate
    match r2 with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Afterstate e), back s16)
    | .Ok bytes =>
      let (dest, back2) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8) (back s16) {start := i7}
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 dest bytes.to_slice
      ok (.Ok (), back2 copied)


theorem tail_source (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) : tail encode s output = NBN_LateTail.run s output := by
  unfold tail NBN_LateTail.run
  simp only [NBN_EncoderSummary.live_source encode lower,NBN_EncoderSummary.after_source encode lower]
  rfl

def run (encode : Encode) (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit Error × Slice U8) :=
  if output.length ≠ 1520 then ok (.Err .WrongLength,output)
  else if U64.checked_add s.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 ≠
      some s.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index then ok (.Err .AfterstateIndexMismatch,output)
  else do
    let filled ← core.slice.Slice.fill core.clone.CloneU8 output 0#u8
    NBN_LatePrepare.run filled (tail encode s)

theorem source (encode : Encode) (lower : NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical encode)
    (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    run encode s output = encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s output := by
  unfold run
  by_cases size : output.length = 1520
  · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr size)]
    by_cases index : U64.checked_add s.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 =
        some s.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
    · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr index)]
      have same : tail encode s = NBN_LateTail.run s := funext (tail_source encode lower s)
      rw [same]
      exact (NBN_LateResult.factor s output size index).symm
    · rw [if_pos index]
      exact (NBK_LatePreflight.wrong_index s output size index).symm
  · rw [if_pos size]
    exact (NBK_LatePreflight.wrong_length s output size).symm

#print axioms tail_source
#print axioms source
end NBN_LateSummary

import NBN_LatePrepare
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace NBN_LateTail
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder AspisR1.S2K
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile
abbrev Statement := PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1
abbrev Error := PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1

def run (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit Error × Slice U8) := do
  let i7 ← 32#usize + POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES
  let (s15, back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8) output {start := 32#usize, «end» := i7}
  let (r, s16) ← encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s.live_snapshot s15
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Snapshot e), back s16)
  | .Ok _ =>
    let r2 ← pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s.candidate_afterstate
    match r2 with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Afterstate e), back s16)
    | .Ok bytes =>
      let (dest, back2) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8) (back s16) {start := i7}
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 dest bytes.to_slice
      ok (.Ok (), back2 copied)

def status (s : Statement) : core.result.Result Unit Error :=
  match NBH_LiveValidator.result s.live_snapshot with
  | .Err e => .Err (.Snapshot e)
  | .Ok _ => match NBH_Validators.afterResult s.candidate_afterstate with
    | .Err e => .Err (.Afterstate e)
    | .Ok _ => .Ok ()

def value (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) : Slice U8 :=
  match NBH_LiveValidator.result s.live_snapshot with
  | .Err _ => output
  | .Ok _ =>
    let live := output.setSlice! 32 (NBK_LiveResult.bytes s.live_snapshot).val
    match NBH_Validators.afterResult s.candidate_afterstate with
    | .Err _ => live
    | .Ok _ => live.setSlice! 832 (AfterstateEncoding.bytes s.candidate_afterstate).val

 theorem live_length (s : NBK_LiveResult.Snapshot) :
    (NBK_LiveResult.bytes s).length = 800 := by
  have fold_length (xs : List (Array U32 8#usize)) (i : Nat) (out : Slice U8) :
      (NBK_LiveBytes.fold xs i out).length = out.length := by
    induction xs generalizing i out with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs ih =>
      simpa only [NBK_LiveBytes.fold, ih, Slice.length, Slice.setSlice!,List.length_setSlice!]
  simp only [NBK_LiveResult.bytes,fold_length,NBK_LivePrepare.value,
    Slice.length,NBK_LiveResult.zero,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,
    List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set,List.length_replicate]
  rfl

 theorem exact (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) (size : output.length = 1520) :
    run s output = ok (status s, value s output) := by
  have len : output.val.length = 1520 := size
  unfold run
  simp only [POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES]
  have add : 32#usize + 800#usize = ok 832#usize := by
    have h : (32#usize + 800#usize) ⦃ r => r = 832#usize ⦄ := by step*
    obtain ⟨r, call, same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists h
    exact same ▸ call
  rw [add]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  simp [core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut, Slice.length,Slice.len,len]
  rw [NBK_LiveResult.source]
  simp [Slice.length, Slice.slice,List.slice,len]
  cases hv : NBH_LiveValidator.result s.live_snapshot with
  | Err e =>
    simp [hv,status,value,bind_tc_ok]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [List.setSlice!,List.length_take,List.length_drop,len]
    simp only [show min 800 (1520-32) = 800 by decide,
      show min 800 (min 800 (1520-32)) = 800 by decide]
    simp only [List.take_take,Nat.min_self]
    have restored := List.take_append_drop 800 (output.val.drop 32)
    simp only [List.drop_drop] at restored
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, restored, List.take_append_drop]
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp only [hv,bind_tc_ok]
    rw [NBK_AfterstateResult.source]
    cases ha : NBH_Validators.afterResult s.candidate_afterstate with
    | Err e => simp [ha,status,value,hv,bind_tc_ok,Slice.setSlice!]
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      simp [ha,hv,status,value,bind_tc_ok,
        core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice.index_mut,
        core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,Array.to_slice,Slice.length,Slice.len,
        Slice.slice,List.slice,List.length_setSlice!,len,live_length,
        (AfterstateEncoding.bytes s.candidate_afterstate).property,Slice.setSlice!,lift]

#print axioms live_length
#print axioms exact
end NBN_LateTail

import NBN_BindingChecks
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_StatementDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open NBN_StatementResult
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal

/-- Same-variant child, not an independently selected successful payment. -/
theorem payment_reached (s : Statement)
    (accepted : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    ∃ bytes, payment s = ok (.Ok bytes) ∧ suffix s = .Ok () := by
  rw [source] at accepted
  unfold result at accepted
  dsimp only at accepted
  split at accepted
  · cases accepted
  · split at accepted
    · cases accepted
    · cases hp : payment s with
      | fail e => simp only [hp,bind_tc_fail] at accepted; cases accepted
      | div => simp only [hp,bind_tc_div] at accepted; cases accepted
      | ok r =>
        simp only [hp,bind_tc_ok] at accepted
        cases r with
        | Err e => cases accepted
        | Ok bytes => exact ⟨bytes,rfl,Result.ok.inj accepted⟩

theorem bindings (s : Statement)
    (accepted : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    (parts s).1 = (common s).master_account ∧
    (parts s).2.1 = (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain ∧
    (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool = (common s).master_account ∧
    (parts s).2.2.1 = (common s).checkpoint_sequence ∧
    (parts s).2.2.2.1 = (common s).historical_global_anchor := by
  obtain ⟨_,_,h⟩ := payment_reached s accepted
  rw [NBN_BindingChecks.factor] at h
  exact NBN_BindingChecks.fields (common s) (parts s) (NBN_BindingChecks.tail s) h

theorem lane_late (s : Statement)
    (accepted : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    NBN_OutputLane.result (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 = .Ok (common s).output_lane ∧
    lateStatus (common s).lane_transition = .Ok () := by
  obtain ⟨_,_,h⟩ := payment_reached s accepted
  obtain ⟨hp,hd,hl,hs,ha⟩ := bindings s accepted
  simp only [suffix,hp,hd,hl,hs,ha,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false] at h
  cases lane : NBN_OutputLane.result (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | Err e => simp only [lane] at h; cases h
  | Ok value =>
    simp only [lane] at h
    split at h
    · cases h
    · rename_i same
      have eq : value = (common s).output_lane := not_not.mp same
      subst value
      refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
      cases late : lateStatus (common s).lane_transition with
      | Err e => simp only [late] at h; cases h
      | Ok u => cases u; rfl

theorem late_children (s : Statement)
    (accepted : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    U64.checked_add (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 =
      some (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index ∧
    NBH_LiveValidator.result (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot = .Ok () ∧
    NBH_Validators.afterResult (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate = .Ok () := by
  have h := (lane_late s accepted).2
  unfold lateStatus at h
  split at h
  · cases h
  · rename_i index
    refine ⟨not_not.mp index,?_⟩
    unfold NBN_LateTail.status at h
    cases live : NBH_LiveValidator.result (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot with
    | Err e => simp only [live] at h; cases h
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      simp only [live] at h
      refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
      cases after : NBH_Validators.afterResult (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate with
      | Err e => simp only [after] at h; cases h
      | Ok u => cases u; rfl

#print axioms payment_reached
#print axioms bindings
#print axioms lane_late
#print axioms late_children
end NBN_StatementDomains

import NBN_ValidatorSummary
import NBN_InstalledEncoder
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_StatementEncoderSummary
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult NBN_ValidatorSummary
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Raw := NBN_DigestResultDependency.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeRaw
abbrev BytesResult := Result (core.result.Result (List U8) NBN_StatementResult.Error)

def prefixBytes (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) : List U8 :=
  let c := AspisS6OuterCarrierBridge.fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 (common s)
  AspisS6FullForestEncoderNamed.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC.val ++
    [AspisS6FullForestEncoderNamed.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION,
     NBN_EncoderBytes.tag s,
     AspisS6FullForestEncoderNamed.aspis_statement.pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION,c.output_lane] ++
    c.master_account.val ++ c.checkpoint_account.val ++ c.selected_lane_account.val ++
    (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes c.checkpoint_sequence).val ++ anchor.val

theorem prefix_source (s : Statement) :
    prefixBytes s (AspisR1.S2K.DigestBytes.bytes (common s).historical_global_anchor) = NBN_EncoderBytes.commonBytes s := by
  unfold prefixBytes NBN_EncoderBytes.commonBytes AspisS6OuterByteLayout.common_prefix
  rw [AspisS6NativeAfterstateEncoderReuse.native_digest_bytes]
  rfl

def observe (r : Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 1880#usize) NBN_StatementResult.Error)) : BytesResult := do
  let r ← r
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok a => ok (.Ok a.val)

def run (enc : Encode) (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult) (s : Statement) : BytesResult := do
  let valid ← NBN_ValidatorSummary.run enc t w s
  match valid with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok _ =>
    let anchor ← enc (common s).historical_global_anchor
    let (status,late) ← NBN_LateSummary.run enc (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero
    match status with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e))
    | .Ok _ =>
      let pay ← paymentWith t w s
      match pay with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Payment e))
      | .Ok a => ok (.Ok ((prefixBytes s anchor ++ late.val) ++ a.val))

theorem source (enc : Encode) (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult)
    (hd : Raw enc) (ht : NBN_Dep_TransferEncode t) (hw : NBN_Dep_WithdrawalEncode w) (s : Statement) :
    run enc t w s = observe (AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode s) := by
  have hc : NBN_DigestResultDependency.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical enc := fun d _ => hd d
  obtain ⟨v,hv⟩ := AspisS6NativeForestTotal.validate_total s
  have validation := NBN_ValidatorSummary.source enc t w hc ht hw s
  rw [hv] at validation
  cases v with
  | Err e =>
    rw [NBN_EncoderRejection.source s e hv]
    simp only [run,validation,observe,bind_tc_ok]
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    obtain ⟨pay,hpay,_⟩ := NBN_StatementDomains.payment_reached s hv
    have late := (NBN_LateInvariant.statement_ready s hv NBN_LateResult.zero (by
      simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate];rfl)).1
    have contents : AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode s = ok (.Ok (NBN_EncoderBytes.bytes s pay)) := by
      rw [NBN_EncoderResult.source]
      simp only [NBN_EncoderResult.result,← NBN_StatementResult.source,hv,hpay,bind_tc_ok]
    simp only [run,validation,bind_tc_ok]
    rw [hd _,NBN_LateSummary.source enc hc,late]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [payment_source t w ht hw s,hpay]
    simp only [bind_tc_ok]
    rw [prefix_source,contents]
    rfl

#print axioms prefix_source
#print axioms source
end NBN_StatementEncoderSummary

import NBN_ArrayNe
import NBN_OutputLane
import NBN_LateResult
import NBK_StatementPrefix
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_StatementResult
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Statement := PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
abbrev Error := PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
abbrev PaymentError := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError
abbrev common := NBD_TerminalProjection.common
abbrev parts := NBD_TerminalProjection.parts
abbrev zero := NBK_StatementPrefix.zero

def payment (s : Statement) : Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError) :=
  match s with
  | .PrivateTransfer _ p => pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1 p
  | .Withdrawal _ p => pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 p

def lateStatus (s : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1) :
    core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 :=
  if U64.checked_add s.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 ≠
      some s.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index then .Err .AfterstateIndexMismatch
  else NBN_LateTail.status s

def suffix (s : Statement) : core.result.Result Unit Error :=
  let c := common s
  let (pool,deployment,sequence,anchor,nullifier,_) := parts s
  if pool ≠ c.master_account then .Err .MasterBindingMismatch
  else if deployment ≠ c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain then .Err .DeploymentBindingMismatch
  else if c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool ≠ c.master_account then .Err .MasterBindingMismatch
  else if sequence ≠ c.checkpoint_sequence then .Err .CheckpointBindingMismatch
  else if anchor ≠ c.historical_global_anchor then .Err .HistoricalAnchorMismatch
  else match NBN_OutputLane.result nullifier with
    | .Err e => .Err (.Account e)
    | .Ok lane => if lane ≠ c.output_lane then .Err .OutputLaneMismatch
      else match lateStatus c.lane_transition with
        | .Err e => .Err (.LaneTransition e)
        | .Ok _ => .Ok ()

def result (s : Statement) : Result (core.result.Result Unit Error) :=
  let c := common s
  if c.master_account = zero ∨ c.checkpoint_account = zero ∨ c.selected_lane_account = zero then
    ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding)
  else if 8 ≤ c.output_lane.val then ok (.Err .InvalidOutputLane)
  else do
    let r ← payment s
    match r with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Payment e))
    | .Ok _ => ok (suffix s)

theorem source (s : Statement) : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = result s := by
  by_cases hm : (common s).master_account = zero
  · rw [NBK_StatementPrefix.zero_rejected s (Or.inl hm)]
    simp [result,hm]
  · by_cases hc : (common s).checkpoint_account = zero
    · rw [NBK_StatementPrefix.zero_rejected s (Or.inr (Or.inl hc))]
      simp [result,hc]
    · by_cases hs : (common s).selected_lane_account = zero
      · rw [NBK_StatementPrefix.zero_rejected s (Or.inr (Or.inr hs))]
        simp [result,hs]
      · by_cases lane : 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val
        · rw [NBK_StatementPrefix.lane_rejected s hm hc hs lane]
          simp [result,hm,hc,hs,lane]
        · unfold validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
          rw [NBD_TerminalProjection.source_common]
          simp only [NBH_ArrayEq.source,bind_tc_ok,hm,hc,hs,decide_false,if_false]
          have cast : core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from (common s).output_lane =
              Usize.ofNatCore (common s).output_lane.val (by scalar_tac) := by scalar_tac
          have small : ¬ (Usize.ofNatCore (common s).output_lane.val (by scalar_tac)) ≥ 8#usize := by scalar_tac
          simp only [lift,cast,bind_tc_ok,pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_LANE_COUNT,small,if_false]
          unfold result
          simp only [hm,hc,hs,lane,not_false_eq_true,or_self,if_false]
          cases s <;> simp only [payment]
          all_goals apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
          all_goals intro pay
          all_goals cases pay with
          | Err e => rfl
          | Ok bytes =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,bind_tc_ok,
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
            rw [NBD_TerminalProjection.source_parts]
            simp only [bind_tc_ok,NBN_ArrayNe.bytes,NBN_ArrayNe.words,
              NBN_OutputLane.source]
            simp only [suffix,common,parts,NBD_TerminalProjection.common,NBD_TerminalProjection.parts,
              Aeneas.Std.uncurry,decide_eq_true_eq,bne_iff_ne]
            simp only [Array.to_slice_mut,lift,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,
              NBN_LateResult.source,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
            simp only [show ¬ ((1520#usize).val ≠ 1520) by decide,if_false]
            simp only [lateStatus]
            repeat' first
              | rfl
              | (split <;> try simp_all only [bind_tc_ok,decide_eq_true_eq,bne_iff_ne])

    | .PrivateTransfer _ _ => 1#u8
    | .Withdrawal _ _ => 2#u8 := by cases s <;> rfl

import NBN_LateSummary
import NBN_FirstByteDependency
import NBN_StatementCut
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_ValidatorSummary
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev E := NBN_StatementResult.Error
abbrev Transfer := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev Withdrawal := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev PaymentResult := Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError)
abbrev Encode := NBN_EncoderSummary.Encode

def NBN_Dep_TransferEncode (f : Transfer → PaymentResult) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, f p = pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1 p

def NBN_Dep_WithdrawalEncode (f : Withdrawal → PaymentResult) : Prop :=
  ∀ p, f p = pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 p

def paymentWith (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult) : Statement → PaymentResult
  | .PrivateTransfer _ p => t p
  | .Withdrawal _ p => w p

theorem payment_source (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult)
    (ht : NBN_Dep_TransferEncode t) (hw : NBN_Dep_WithdrawalEncode w) (s : Statement) :
    paymentWith t w s = payment s := by
  cases s <;> first | exact ht _ | exact hw _

def chain (c : NBN_BindingChecks.Common) (p : NBD_TerminalProjection.Parts)
    (tail : Result (core.result.Result Unit E)) : Result (core.result.Result Unit E) :=
  if p.1 ≠ c.master_account then ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch)
  else if p.2.1 ≠ c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain then ok (.Err .DeploymentBindingMismatch)
  else if c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool ≠ c.master_account then ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch)
  else if p.2.2.1 ≠ c.checkpoint_sequence then ok (.Err .CheckpointBindingMismatch)
  else if p.2.2.2.1 ≠ c.historical_global_anchor then ok (.Err .HistoricalAnchorMismatch)
  else tail

theorem chain_pure (c : NBN_BindingChecks.Common) (p : NBD_TerminalProjection.Parts)
    (tail : core.result.Result Unit E) :
    chain c p (ok tail) = ok (NBN_BindingChecks.chain c p tail) := by
  unfold chain NBN_BindingChecks.chain
  repeat' first | rfl | split

def tail (enc : Encode) (s : Statement) : Result (core.result.Result Unit E) := do
  let lane ← NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc (parts s).2.2.2.2.1
  match lane with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Account e))
  | .Ok l =>
    if l ≠ (common s).output_lane then ok (.Err .OutputLaneMismatch)
    else do
      let (r,_) ← NBN_LateSummary.run enc (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero
      match r with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e))
      | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok ())

theorem tail_source (enc : Encode)
    (lower : NBN_DigestResultDependency.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical enc) (s : Statement) :
    tail enc s = ok (NBN_BindingChecks.tail s) := by
  unfold tail
  rw [NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane_source enc lower,NBN_OutputLane.source]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  unfold NBN_BindingChecks.tail
  cases lane : NBN_OutputLane.result (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok l =>
    by_cases mismatch : l = (common s).output_lane
    · simp only [mismatch,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false]
      rw [NBN_LateSummary.source enc lower,NBN_LateResult.source]
      have len : NBN_LateResult.zero.length = 1520 := by
        simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
        rfl
      rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr len)]
      unfold lateStatus
      by_cases index : U64.checked_add (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 ≠
          some (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
      · simp only [ne_eq] at index
        simp only [ne_eq,index,not_false_eq_true,if_true,bind_tc_ok]
        rfl
      · simp only [index,if_false,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
        cases NBN_LateTail.status (common s).lane_transition <;> rfl
    · simp only [mismatch,ne_eq,not_false_eq_true,if_true]

def run (enc : Encode) (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult) (s : Statement) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit E) :=
  if (common s).master_account = zero ∨ (common s).checkpoint_account = zero ∨
      (common s).selected_lane_account = zero then ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding)
  else if 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val then ok (.Err .InvalidOutputLane)
  else do
    let pay ← paymentWith t w s
    match pay with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Payment e))
    | .Ok _ => chain (common s) (parts s) (tail enc s)

theorem source (enc : Encode) (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult)
    (hd : NBN_DigestResultDependency.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical enc)
    (ht : NBN_Dep_TransferEncode t) (hw : NBN_Dep_WithdrawalEncode w) (s : Statement) :
    run enc t w s = pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s := by
  rw [NBN_StatementResult.source]
  unfold run result
  dsimp only
  rw [payment_source t w ht hw s,tail_source enc hd s,chain_pure,← NBN_BindingChecks.factor s]
  rfl

#print axioms payment_source
#print axioms chain_pure
#print axioms tail_source
#print axioms source
end NBN_ValidatorSummary
