theorem payment_source (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult)

theorem source (enc : Encode) (t : Transfer → PaymentResult) (w : Withdrawal → PaymentResult)

namespace NBP_CommonTail0

abbrev C := pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1

def run (output : Array U8 216#usize) (magic : Array U8 4#usize) (kind : K) (common : C) : Result (Array U8 216#usize) := do
  let (s, index_mut_back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output { «end» := 4#usize }
  let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice magic)
  let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
  let output1 := index_mut_back s2
  let output2 ← Array.update output1 4#usize pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PAYMENT_STATEMENT_VERSION
  let kind1 := read_discriminant kind
  let i ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 kind1)
  let output3 ← Array.update output2 5#usize i
  let output4 ← Array.update output3 6#usize pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
  NBP_CommonTail1.run output4 common

def expected (output : Array U8 216#usize) (magic : Array U8 4#usize) (kind : K) (common : C) : Array U8 216#usize :=
  let output := output.setSlice! 0 magic.val
  let output := output.set 4#usize 1#u8
  let output := output.set 5#usize (NBG_Header.tag kind)
  let output := output.set 6#usize 1#u8
  NBP_CommonTail1.expected output common

theorem result (output : Array U8 216#usize) (magic : Array U8 4#usize) (kind : K) (common : C) : run output magic kind common = ok (expected output magic kind common) := by
  unfold run
  simp only [pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_OFFSET,pool_v1.payment_relation.DEPLOYMENT_DOMAIN_OFFSET,
    pool_v1.payment_relation.ANCHOR_SEQUENCE_OFFSET,pool_v1.payment_relation.ANCHOR_ROOT_OFFSET,
    pool_v1.payment_relation.NULLIFIER_OFFSET,pool_v1.payment_relation.ASSET_ID_OFFSET,
    pool_v1.payment_relation.AMOUNT_OR_RESERVED_OFFSET,
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PAYMENT_STATEMENT_VERSION,
    pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION,NBP_DigestEncode.result,NBG_Header.tag_result,
    aspis_core.field.M31.to_le_bytes,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  rw [NBP_ArrayIndex.prefix_index output 4#usize (by decide)]
  change (do
    let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8
      (NBP_ArrayIndex.slice output 0#usize 4#usize) magic.to_slice
    _) = _
  rw [NBP_ArrayIndex.copy_range output 0#usize 4#usize magic (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [NBP_Store.update _ 4#usize 1#u8 (by decide),bind_tc_ok]
  rw [NBP_Store.update _ 5#usize (NBG_Header.tag kind) (by decide),bind_tc_ok]
  rw [NBP_Store.update _ 6#usize 1#u8 (by decide),bind_tc_ok]
  rw [NBP_CommonTail1.result]
  rfl
#print axioms result

namespace NBP_DecodeWord
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev word := NBG_WideBytes.word

/-- The first rejecting word stops before any later word is decoded. -/
theorem reject0 (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) (h0 : word bytes 0 >= P) :
    atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical bytes =
      ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest) := by
  have len : bytes.val.length = 32 := by simpa using bytes.property
  simp [word,NBG_WideBytes.word,P, len] at h0
  simp [atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical,Array.index_usize,
    Array.length,bytes.property,NBG_Atomic.m31_decode,h0,
    core.option.Option.ok_or,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
    core.convert.FromSame]

end NBP_DecodeWord

import NBP_DecodeWord
import NBP_Decode1
import NBP_Decode2
import NBP_Decode3
import NBP_Decode4
import NBP_Decode5
import NBP_Decode6
import NBP_Decode7
import NBP_DecodeSuccess
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_DigestDecode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBP_DecodeWord
/-- Source order, including all noncanonical rejections. -/
def decoded (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) :
    core.result.Result (Array U32 8#usize) atomic_statement.AtomicStatementError :=
  if word bytes 0 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 1 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 2 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 3 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 4 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 5 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 6 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  if word bytes 7 >= P then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else
  .Ok (NBG_WideBytes.limbs bytes)

theorem result (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) :
    atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical bytes = ok (decoded bytes) := by
  by_cases h0 : word bytes 0 >= P
  · simpa [decoded,h0,if_pos] using NBP_DecodeWord.reject0 bytes h0
  ·
    by_cases h1 : word bytes 1 >= P
    · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_pos] using NBP_Decode1.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) h1
    ·
      by_cases h2 : word bytes 2 >= P
      · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_pos] using NBP_Decode2.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) h2
      ·
        by_cases h3 : word bytes 3 >= P
        · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_pos] using NBP_Decode3.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) h3
        ·
          by_cases h4 : word bytes 4 >= P
          · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_pos] using NBP_Decode4.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) h4
          ·
            by_cases h5 : word bytes 5 >= P
            · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_pos] using NBP_Decode5.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) h5
            ·
              by_cases h6 : word bytes 6 >= P
              · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_neg,h6,if_pos] using NBP_Decode6.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) (lt_of_not_ge h5) h6
              ·
                by_cases h7 : word bytes 7 >= P
                · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_neg,h6,if_neg,h7,if_pos] using NBP_Decode7.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) (lt_of_not_ge h5) (lt_of_not_ge h6) h7
                · simpa [decoded,h0,if_neg,h1,if_neg,h2,if_neg,h3,if_neg,h4,if_neg,h5,if_neg,h6,if_neg,h7,if_neg] using NBP_DecodeSuccess.result bytes (lt_of_not_ge h0) (lt_of_not_ge h1) (lt_of_not_ge h2) (lt_of_not_ge h3) (lt_of_not_ge h4) (lt_of_not_ge h5) (lt_of_not_ge h6) (lt_of_not_ge h7)

#print axioms result
end NBP_DigestDecode

import S2K_DigestBytes
import NBG_WideBytes
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_DigestEncode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open AspisR1.S2K
/-- Exact full encoder, all raw limbs; reuses the existing decreasing-loop
induction on the selected cohort rather than re-proving it. -/
theorem result (digest : Array U32 8#usize) :
    atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical digest = ok (DigestBytes.bytes digest) :=
  DigestBytes.exact digest
/-- The same arbitrary pre-state update checked by native NBG_K020. -/
theorem step (digest : Array U32 8#usize) (index : Usize)
    (range : index.val < 8) (output : Array U8 32#usize) :
    atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop.body (DigestTotal.cursor digest index) output =
      ok (.cont
        (DigestTotal.cursor digest (Usize.ofNatCore (index.val+1) (by scalar_tac)),
         output.setSlice! (4*index.val)
           (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes
             (digest.val[index.val]'(by have := digest.property; change digest.val.length=8 at this; omega))).val)) :=
  DigestTotal.body_word digest index range output
#print axioms result
#print axioms step
#print axioms DigestBytes.loop_exact
#print axioms DigestTotal.next_row
#print axioms DigestTotal.exhausted
end NBP_DigestEncode

import NBP_CommonBytes
import NBP_CommonDecode
import NBG_PaymentValidators
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_PaymentModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev T := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev W := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev C := pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1
abbrev E := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError

def transfer_bytes (p : T) : Array U8 216#usize :=
  let o := NBP_CommonBytes.encoded (Array.repeat 216#usize 0#u8)
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PRIVATE_TRANSFER_STATEMENT_MAGIC .PrivateTransfer
    (NBG_PaymentValidators.tc p)
  let o := o.setSlice! 152 (AspisR1.S2K.DigestBytes.bytes p.recipient_commitment).val
  o.setSlice! 184 (AspisR1.S2K.DigestBytes.bytes p.change_commitment).val

def withdrawal_bytes (p : W) : Array U8 216#usize :=
  let o := NBP_CommonBytes.encoded (Array.repeat 216#usize 0#u8)
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_WITHDRAWAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC .Withdrawal
    (NBG_PaymentValidators.wc p)
  let o := o.setSlice! 148 (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes p.amount).val
  let o := o.setSlice! 152 p.destination_token_account.val
  o.setSlice! 184 (AspisR1.S2K.DigestBytes.bytes p.change_commitment).val

def transfer_encoded (p : T) : core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) E :=
  match NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer p with
  | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok (transfer_bytes p)
def withdrawal_encoded (p : W) : core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) E :=
  match NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal p with
  | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok (withdrawal_bytes p)

def transfer_public (c : C) (r z : Array U32 8#usize) : T :=
  ⟨c.pool,c.deployment_domain,c.anchor_sequence,c.anchor_root,c.nullifier,c.asset_id,r,z⟩
def withdrawal_public (c : C) (b : Array U8 216#usize) (z : Array U32 8#usize) : W :=
  ⟨c.pool,c.deployment_domain,c.anchor_sequence,c.anchor_root,c.nullifier,c.asset_id,
    core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (NBP_Read.chunk b 148 (by decide)),
    NBP_Read.chunk b 152 (by decide),z⟩

def transfer_decoded (b : Array U8 216#usize) : core.result.Result T E :=
  match NBG_Header.expected b pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PRIVATE_TRANSFER_STATEMENT_MAGIC .PrivateTransfer with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () =>
    if (b.val.drop 148).take 4 ≠ List.replicate 4 0#u8 then .Err .NonZeroReserved else
    match NBP_CommonDecode.decoded b with
    | .Err e => .Err e
    | .Ok c =>
      match NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 152 (by decide)) with
      | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
      | .Ok r =>
        match NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide)) with
        | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
        | .Ok z =>
          let p := transfer_public c r z
          match NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer p with
          | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok p

def withdrawal_decoded (b : Array U8 216#usize) : core.result.Result W E :=
  match NBG_Header.expected b pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_WITHDRAWAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC .Withdrawal with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () =>
    match NBP_CommonDecode.decoded b with
    | .Err e => .Err e
    | .Ok c =>
      match NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide)) with
      | .Err _ => .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
      | .Ok z =>
        let p := withdrawal_public c b z
        match NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal p with
        | .Err e => .Err e | .Ok () => .Ok p

import NBR_BlockConstruct
import NBL_OpeningTrace
import NBR_VecAppend
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NBR_OpeningConstruct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation NBL_BlockTrace
open AspisR1CurrentCaller.OriginalSerializerInstallation

/-- Construct every local opening observation from infallible digest replies
and the reached S2 view's actual root. No opening/scalar success is assumed. -/
theorem source {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (total : NBR_BlockConstruct.Total D)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (view : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (variant : view.variant=.S2) (root : Array U8 32#usize)
    (rootCall : view.folded_root=some root) (roundSize : view.round1.val.length=224) :
    Nonempty (NBL_OpeningTrace.Trace D sem view hash) := by
  obtain ⟨seed,seedCall⟩ := total hash (NBA_Transcript.seedParts sem.transcript.state)
  obtain ⟨gamma⟩ := NBR_BlockConstruct.scalar D total (⟨seed,hash⟩ : transcript.Transcript H)
    27#u8 view.y1 true (by decide)
  have serialize : NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.toBytes view.inactive=ok (expectedBytes view.inactive) := by
    rw [NBA_Installed.serializer_slot,sourceBytes_total]
  obtain ⟨kappa⟩ := NBR_BlockConstruct.scalar D total gamma.block.after
    28#u8 (Array.to_slice (expectedBytes view.inactive)) false (by decide)
  obtain ⟨alpha0⟩ := NBR_BlockConstruct.scalar D total kappa.block.after 29#u8 view.round0 false (by decide)
  obtain ⟨bytes1,appendRoot,bytesRoot⟩ := NBR_VecAppend.total
    (alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity U8 256#usize) (Array.to_slice root) (by
      change 0+root.val.length≤Usize.max
      rw [root.property]
      scalar_tac)
  have rootLen : bytes1.val.length=32 := by
    rw [bytesRoot]
    exact root.property
  obtain ⟨bytes2,appendRound,bytesRound⟩ := NBR_VecAppend.total bytes1 view.round1 (by
    change bytes1.val.length+view.round1.val.length≤Usize.max
    rw [rootLen,roundSize]
    scalar_tac)
  obtain ⟨alpha1⟩ := NBR_BlockConstruct.scalar D total alpha0.block.after
    30#u8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes2) false (by decide)
  exact ⟨⟨variant,seed,seedCall,gamma,expectedBytes view.inactive,serialize,
    kappa,alpha0,root,rootCall,bytes1,bytes2,appendRoot,appendRound,alpha1⟩⟩

#print axioms source
end AspisR1.NBR_OpeningConstruct
end

import NBA_Installed
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBR_VecAppend
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The exact U8 clone callback preserves each element of the SAME list. -/
theorem clone_list (xs : List U8) :
    List.mapM core.clone.CloneU8.clone xs=ok xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.mapM_cons,liftFun1,core.clone.impls.CloneU8.clone,
      bind_tc_ok,ih]
    rfl

theorem clone_slice (xs : Slice U8) : Slice.clone core.clone.CloneU8.clone xs=ok xs := by
  have h : List.mapM (liftFun1 core.clone.impls.CloneU8.clone) xs.val=ok xs.val := clone_list xs.val
  unfold Slice.clone List.clone
  split
  · rename_i v he
    have same : v=xs.val := Result.ok.inj (he.symm.trans h)
    subst v
    rfl
  · rename_i e he
    cases he.symm.trans h
  · rename_i he
    cases he.symm.trans h

/-- Exact concatenation with the std capacity precondition derived by callers.
No clone success or output byte equation is a hypothesis. -/
theorem extend (before : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (input : Slice U8)
    (bound : before.length+input.length≤Usize.max) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 before input=
      ok (⟨before.val++input.val,by simpa only [List.length_append] using bound⟩ : alloc.vec.Vec U8) := by
  have h : Slice.clone (liftFun1 core.clone.impls.CloneU8.clone) input=ok input := clone_slice input
  unfold alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice
  simp only [dif_pos bound]
  split
  · rename_i out he
    have same : out=input := Result.ok.inj (he.symm.trans h)
    subst out
    rfl
  · rename_i e he
    cases he.symm.trans h
  · rename_i he
    cases he.symm.trans h

theorem total (before : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (input : Slice U8)
    (bound : before.length+input.length≤Usize.max) :
    ∃ after, alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 before input=ok after ∧
      after.val=before.val++input.val := by
  exact ⟨_,extend before input bound,rfl⟩

#print axioms total
#print axioms clone_list
#print axioms clone_slice
#print axioms extend
end AspisR1.NBR_VecAppend

import NCA_InactiveModel
import KMX_CopyMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NCA_SerializerWindow
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

/-- Full-carrier byte law matched by the arbitrary-prestate native zip step.
All unselected bytes are retained on this same 32-byte array. -/
theorem frame (out : Array U8 32#usize) (limb : U32) (i j : Nat)
    (window : i<8) (index : j<32) :
    (out.setSlice! (4*i) (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val).val[j]! =
      if 4*i ≤ j ∧ j<4*i+4 then
        (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val[j-4*i]! else out.val[j]! := by
  have length := (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).property
  change (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val.length=4 at length
  by_cases inside : 4*i ≤ j ∧ j<4*i+4
  · rw [if_pos inside]
    have mid := Array.setSlice!_getElem!_middle out
      (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val (4*i) j (by scalar_tac)
    simpa only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using mid
  · rw [if_neg inside]
    by_cases early : j<4*i
    · simpa only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using
        Array.setSlice!_getElem!_prefix out (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val (4*i) j early
    · have late : 4*i+(core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val.length≤j := by omega
      simpa only [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq] using
        Array.setSlice!_getElem!_suffix out (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes limb).val (4*i) j late

/-- Reuse the existing exact mutable-iterator induction; no eight-step reduction.
This theorem retains its complete source carrier and continuation. -/
theorem induction (x : AspisR1WideToBytesSource.field.wide_exact.WideExact)
    (n : Nat) (bound : n≤8) (z : P6ToBytes.Steps.Zip) :
    P6ToBytes.OutputInvariant.zipSource ((P6ToBytes.StateInvariant.stateAt x n).2 z) =
      P6ToBytes.OutputInvariant.painted x n (P6ToBytes.OutputInvariant.zipSource z) :=
  P6ToBytes.OutputInvariant.stateAt_paints x n bound z

#print axioms frame
#print axioms induction
end AspisR1.NCA_SerializerWindow

import NDM_CohortGate
import NDM_CohortConstructors
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDM_CohortReconstruction
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
open aspis_statement.pool_v1
abbrev Request := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1
abbrev Auth := r1_pool_adapter.AuthenticatedAsq8Accounts
abbrev Candidate := pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1

def requested (request : Request) : U32 := match request.public with
 | .PrivateTransfer p=>p.asset_id
 | .Withdrawal p=>p.asset_id

def finish (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) := do
 let common ← r1_pool_adapter.asq8_common a c
 match request.public with
 | .PrivateTransfer p=>r1_pool_adapter.transfer_statement_box common p
 | .Withdrawal p=>r1_pool_adapter.withdrawal_statement_box common p

def direct (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) :=
 if a.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val+1=c.next_pair_index.val then
  if a.master.identity.asset_id=requested request then finish request a c
  else ok (core.result.Result.Err solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidInstructionData)
 else ok (core.result.Result.Err solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData)

theorem word_cond {T : Type} (x y : U32) (a b : T) :
 (if x.val=y.val then a else b)=(if x=y then a else b) := by
 have eqv : x.val=y.val ↔ x=y := ⟨UScalar.eq_of_val_eq,congrArg (fun z : U32=>z.val)⟩
 by_cases h : x=y <;> simp_all

/-- Actual emitted reconstruction control with actual emitted constructors,
 valid for every input. This is model-only; K082 gives no native gate credit. -/
theorem control (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) :
 r1_pool_adapter.reconstruct_asq8_statement request a c=direct request a c := by
 have gate := NDM_CohortGate.option_natural a.live_snapshot.next_pair_index c.next_pair_index
 simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok] at gate
 unfold r1_pool_adapter.reconstruct_asq8_statement
 simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
 rw [gate]

import NBN_U05
import NBP_DigestEncode
import NBP_TransferEncode
import NBP_WithdrawalEncode
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_CodecComposition
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder

/-- Total raw law; hence also valid at every canonical digest call site. -/
theorem digest_raw : NBN_DigestResultDependency.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeRaw
    atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical := NBP_DigestEncode.result

theorem digest_canonical : NBN_DigestResultDependency.NBN_Dep_DigestEncodeCanonical
    atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical := fun d _ => digest_raw d

/-- The safe payment reference returns the exact emitted Result on every
    typed payment, including rejection; no payment acceptance is assumed. -/
theorem transfer_law : NBN_ValidatorSummary.NBN_Dep_TransferEncode
    (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p)) :=
  fun p => (NBP_TransferEncode.result p).symm

theorem withdrawal_law : NBN_ValidatorSummary.NBN_Dep_WithdrawalEncode
    (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p)) :=
  fun p => (NBP_WithdrawalEncode.result p).symm

/-- Fully instantiated emitted validator composition; no inner codec premise. -/
theorem validator (s : NBN_StatementResult.Statement) :
    NBN_ValidatorSummary.run atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
      (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p))
      (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p)) s =
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s :=
  NBN_ValidatorSummary.source _ _ _ digest_canonical transfer_law withdrawal_law s

/-- Fully instantiated emitted encoder composition; exact bytes/error Result. -/
theorem encoder (s : NBN_StatementResult.Statement) :
    NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.run atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
      (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p))
      (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p)) s =
    NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.observe (AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode s) :=
  NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.source _ _ _ digest_raw transfer_law withdrawal_law s

#print axioms digest_raw
#print axioms digest_canonical
#print axioms transfer_law
#print axioms withdrawal_law
#print axioms validator
#print axioms encoder
end NED_CodecComposition

import NED_EncoderTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_EncoderCallDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
open NED_EncoderTrace

def LateShape (s : Statement) (xs : List Call) : Prop :=
  xs = [.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero] ∨
  xs = [.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero,.payment s]
def AnchorShape (s : Statement) (xs : List Call) : Prop :=
  xs = [.digest (common s).historical_global_anchor] ∨
  xs = [.digest (common s).historical_global_anchor,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero] ∨
  xs = [.digest (common s).historical_global_anchor,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero,.payment s]
def Shape (s : Statement) (xs : List Call) : Prop :=
  xs = [.validate s] ∨
  xs = [.validate s,.digest (common s).historical_global_anchor] ∨
  xs = [.validate s,.digest (common s).historical_global_anchor,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero] ∨
  xs = [.validate s,.digest (common s).historical_global_anchor,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero,.payment s]

theorem late_shape (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) :
    LateShape s (lateStep s anchor).2 := by
  unfold lateStep
  dsimp only
  cases h : NBN_LateSummary.run enc (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero with
  | fail e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | div => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | ok pair => cases pair with
    | mk status late => cases status with
      | Err e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
      | Ok u => simp only [h]; exact Or.inr rfl

theorem anchor_shape (s : Statement) : AnchorShape s (anchorStep s).2 := by
  unfold anchorStep
  dsimp only
  cases h : enc (common s).historical_global_anchor with
  | fail e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | div => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | ok anchor =>
    simp only [h]
    rcases late_shape s anchor with one | two
    · rw [one]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
    · rw [two]; exact Or.inr (Or.inr rfl)

theorem shape (s : Statement) : Shape s (run s).2 := by
  unfold run
  dsimp only
  cases h : NED_ExecutionComposition.validatorReference s with
  | fail e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | div => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | ok status => cases status with
    | Err e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
    | Ok u =>
      simp only [h]
      rcases anchor_shape s with one | two | three
      · rw [one]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      · rw [two]; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
      · rw [three]; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))

theorem validation_same (s arg : Statement)
    (reached : Call.validate arg ∈ (run s).2) : arg = s := by
  rcases shape s with one | two | three | four <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.validate.injEq]

theorem payment_same (s arg : Statement)
    (reached : Call.payment arg ∈ (run s).2) : arg = s := by
  rcases shape s with one | two | three | four <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.payment.injEq]

theorem digest_same (s : Statement) (arg : Array U32 8#usize)
    (reached : Call.digest arg ∈ (run s).2) : arg = (common s).historical_global_anchor := by
  rcases shape s with one | two | three | four <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.digest.injEq]

theorem late_domain (s : Statement) (arg : NBN_LateSummary.Statement) (out : Slice U8)
    (reached : Call.late arg out ∈ (run s).2) :
    arg = (common s).lane_transition ∧ out = NBN_LateResult.zero ∧ out.length = 1520 := by
  have same : arg = (common s).lane_transition ∧ out = NBN_LateResult.zero := by
    rcases shape s with one | two | three | four <;>
      simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.late.injEq,and_self]
  obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := same
  refine ⟨rfl,rfl,?_⟩
  simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
  rfl

#print axioms late_shape
#print axioms anchor_shape
#print axioms shape
#print axioms validation_same
#print axioms payment_same
#print axioms digest_same
#print axioms late_domain
end NED_EncoderCallDomains

import NED_ExecutionComposition
import NED_SubtreeComposition
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_EncoderTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
abbrev R := NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.BytesResult
inductive Call where
  | validate (s : Statement)
  | digest (d : Array U32 8#usize)
  | late (s : NBN_LateSummary.Statement) (out : Slice U8)
  | payment (s : Statement)
def enc := atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
def transfer (p : NBN_ValidatorSummary.Transfer) := ok (NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p)
def withdrawal (p : NBN_ValidatorSummary.Withdrawal) := ok (NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p)
def payment (s : Statement) := NBN_ValidatorSummary.paymentWith transfer withdrawal s

def payStep (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) (late : Slice U8) : R × List Call :=
  let r : R := do
    let pay ← payment s
    match pay with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Payment e))
    | .Ok a => ok (.Ok ((NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.prefixBytes s anchor ++ late.val) ++ a.val))
  (r,[.payment s])

def lateStep (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) : R × List Call :=
  let arg := (common s).lane_transition
  let out := NBN_LateResult.zero
  match NBN_LateSummary.run enc arg out with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.late arg out])
  | .div => (.div,[.late arg out])
  | .ok (.Err e,_) => (ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e)),[.late arg out])
  | .ok (.Ok _,late) => ((payStep s anchor late).1,.late arg out :: (payStep s anchor late).2)

def anchorStep (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  let d := (common s).historical_global_anchor
  match enc d with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.digest d])
  | .div => (.div,[.digest d])
  | .ok anchor => ((lateStep s anchor).1,.digest d :: (lateStep s anchor).2)

def run (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  let validation := NED_ExecutionComposition.validatorReference s
  match validation with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.validate s])
  | .div => (.div,[.validate s])
  | .ok (.Err e) => (ok (.Err e),[.validate s])
  | .ok (.Ok _) => ((anchorStep s).1,.validate s :: (anchorStep s).2)

def lateRef (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) : R := do
  let (status,late) ← NBN_LateSummary.run enc (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero
  match status with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e))
  | .Ok _ => (payStep s anchor late).1

theorem late_erases (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) :
    (lateStep s anchor).1 = lateRef s anchor := by
  unfold lateStep lateRef
  dsimp only
  cases h : NBN_LateSummary.run enc (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero with
  | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]
  | ok pair => cases pair with
    | mk status late => cases status <;> simp only [h,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]

theorem anchor_erases (s : Statement) :
    (anchorStep s).1 = (do let anchor ← enc (common s).historical_global_anchor; lateRef s anchor) := by
  unfold anchorStep
  dsimp only
  cases h : enc (common s).historical_global_anchor with
  | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]
  | ok anchor => simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]; exact late_erases s anchor

theorem erases (s : Statement) : (run s).1 =
    NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.observe (AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode s) := by
  rw [← NED_CodecComposition.encoder s]
  change (run s).1 = NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.run enc transfer withdrawal s
  unfold run NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.run
  dsimp only
  cases h : NED_ExecutionComposition.validatorReference s with
  | fail e => change NBN_ValidatorSummary.run enc transfer withdrawal s = _ at h; simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => change NBN_ValidatorSummary.run enc transfer withdrawal s = _ at h; simp only [h,bind_tc_div]
  | ok r => cases r with
    | Err e => change NBN_ValidatorSummary.run enc transfer withdrawal s = _ at h; simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
    | Ok u =>
      change NBN_ValidatorSummary.run enc transfer withdrawal s = _ at h
      simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
      rw [anchor_erases]
      rfl

#print axioms late_erases
#print axioms anchor_erases
#print axioms erases
end NED_EncoderTrace

import NED_CodecComposition
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_ExecutionComposition
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder

/-- The state and ordered effects are explicit. This is a transport carrier,
not a claim that Rust execution has been instantiated on this carrier. -/
structure Observation (R State Effect : Type) where
  result : R
  state : State
  effects : List Effect
  deriving DecidableEq

def validatorReference (s : NBN_StatementResult.Statement) :=
  NBN_ValidatorSummary.run atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
    (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p))
    (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p)) s

def encoderReference (s : NBN_StatementResult.Statement) :=
  NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.run atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
    (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p))
    (fun p => ok (NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p)) s

/-- Conditional transport of an already established SAME reference execution.
The physical equality is explicit; absent its concrete native certificate this
is not a CLOSED native root and must not be booked as one. -/
theorem validator_observation {State Effect : Type}
    (s : NBN_StatementResult.Statement) (st : State) (events : List Effect)
    (native : Observation (Result (core.result.Result Unit NBN_StatementResult.Error)) State Effect)
    (sameReferenceObservation : native = ⟨validatorReference s,st,events⟩) :
    native = ⟨pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s,st,events⟩ := by
  rw [sameReferenceObservation]
  exact congrArg (fun r => Observation.mk r st events) (NED_CodecComposition.validator s)

theorem encoder_observation {State Effect : Type}
    (s : NBN_StatementResult.Statement) (st : State) (events : List Effect)
    (native : Observation NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.BytesResult State Effect)
    (sameReferenceObservation : native = ⟨encoderReference s,st,events⟩) :
    native = ⟨NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.observe (AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode s),st,events⟩ := by
  rw [sameReferenceObservation]
  exact congrArg (fun r => Observation.mk r st events) (NED_CodecComposition.encoder s)

#print axioms validator_observation
#print axioms encoder_observation
end NED_ExecutionComposition

NED_PaymentValidation.source:
import NED_PaymentResultTransport
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_PaymentValidation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NED_PaymentCohorts NED_CommonValidation
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct

theorem transfer_result (p : T) :
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1 (toRawTransfer p) =
    ok (mapPayment (NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer p)) := by
  unfold aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1
  rw [NED_PaymentCohorts.transfer_common,bind_tc_ok,NED_CommonValidation.common_result,bind_tc_ok]
  cases h : NBG_PaymentChecks.common (NBG_PaymentValidators.tc p) with
  | Err e => simp [NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer,h,mapPayment,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame]
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp [NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer,h,mapPayment,NED_PaymentResultTransport.map_ite,canonical_result,
      toRawTransfer,AspisR1.JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1,
      AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.fromPoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError]
    repeat' split
    all_goals simp_all

theorem value_limit : aspis_statement.spend.VALUE_LIMIT = ok 1073741824#u32 := by
  unfold aspis_statement.spend.VALUE_LIMIT
  rfl

theorem withdrawal_result (p : W) :
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 (toRawWithdrawal p) =
    ok (mapPayment (NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal p)) := by
  unfold aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1
  rw [NED_PaymentCohorts.withdrawal_common,bind_tc_ok,NED_CommonValidation.common_result,bind_tc_ok]
  cases h : NBG_PaymentChecks.common (NBG_PaymentValidators.wc p) with
  | Err e => simp [NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal,h,mapPayment,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame]
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    by_cases large : 1073741824 ≤ p.amount.val <;>
      simp [NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal,h,large,mapPayment,NED_PaymentResultTransport.map_ite,canonical_result,
      toRawWithdrawal,AspisR1.JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1,
      AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.fromPoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1,
      NBG_PaymentChecks.zero_result,value_limit,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError]
    all_goals repeat' split
    all_goals simp_all +arith <;> scalar_tac

#print axioms transfer_result
#print axioms value_limit
#print axioms withdrawal_result
end NED_PaymentValidation

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder

theorem digest_decode : NBN_AfterDecodeTypes.NBN_Dep_DigestDecode
    (fun b => ok (NBP_DigestDecode.decoded b)) :=
  fun b => (NBP_DigestDecode.result b).symm

theorem after_encode (a : NBH_Validators.Afterstate) :
    NBN_EncoderSummary.after atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical a =
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 a :=
  NBN_EncoderSummary.after_source _ NED_CodecComposition.digest_canonical a

theorem live_encode (s : NBH_LiveValidator.Snapshot) (out : Slice U8) :
    NBN_EncoderSummary.live atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical s out =
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s out :=
  NBN_EncoderSummary.live_source _ NED_CodecComposition.digest_canonical s out

theorem late_encode (s : NBN_LateSummary.Statement) (out : Slice U8) :
    NBN_LateSummary.run atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical s out =
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s out :=
  NBN_LateSummary.source _ NED_CodecComposition.digest_canonical s out

theorem after_decode (bytes : Slice U8) :
    NBN_AfterstateDecoderDependency.run (fun b => ok (NBP_DigestDecode.decoded b)) bytes =
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 bytes :=
  NBN_AfterstateDecoderDependency.source _ digest_decode bytes

theorem first_byte (d : Array U32 8#usize) :
    NBN_FirstByteDependency.first atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical d =
    pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.first_canonical_byte d :=
  NBN_FirstByteDependency.first_source _ NED_CodecComposition.digest_raw d

theorem output_lane (d : Array U32 8#usize) :
    NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical d =
    pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.pool_v1_pair_forest_output_lane_v1 d :=
  NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane_source _ NED_CodecComposition.digest_canonical d

import NED_ValidatorTrace
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_ValidatorCallDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
open NED_ValidatorTrace

def TailShape (s : Statement) (xs : List Call) : Prop :=
  xs = [.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1] ∨
  xs = [.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero]

def Shape (s : Statement) (xs : List Call) : Prop :=
  xs = [] ∨ xs = [.payment s] ∨
  xs = [.payment s,.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1] ∨
  xs = [.payment s,.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero]

theorem tail_shape (s : Statement) : TailShape s (tail s).2 := by
  unfold tail
  dsimp only
  cases h : NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | fail e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | div => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | ok r => cases r with
    | Err e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
    | Ok l =>
      simp only [h]
      split
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl

theorem bindings_shape (s : Statement) :
    (bindings s).2 = [] ∨ TailShape s (bindings s).2 := by
  unfold bindings
  repeat' first | split | exact Or.inl rfl | exact Or.inr (tail_shape s)

theorem shape (s : Statement) : Shape s (run s).2 := by
  unfold run
  split
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · split
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · cases h : NED_ValidatorTrace.payment s with
      | fail e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      | div => simp only [h]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      | ok r => cases r with
        | Err e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
        | Ok bytes =>
          simp only [h]
          rcases bindings_shape s with none | one | two
          · rw [none]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
          · rw [one]; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
          · rw [two]; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))

/-- A logged late call has the SAME full record and fixed local output width.
The whole root need not accept: an error returned by that call is retained. -/
theorem late_domain (s : Statement) (arg : NBN_LateSummary.Statement) (out : Slice U8)
    (reached : Call.late arg out ∈ (run s).2) :
    arg = (common s).lane_transition ∧ out = NBN_LateResult.zero ∧ out.length = 1520 := by
  rcases shape s with none | one | two | three
  · simp only [none,List.not_mem_nil] at reached
  · simp only [one,List.mem_singleton,reduceCtorEq] at reached
  · simp only [two,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,or_self] at reached
  · simp only [three,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.late.injEq] at reached
    obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := reached
    refine ⟨rfl,rfl,?_⟩
    simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
    rfl

theorem payment_same (s : Statement) (arg : Statement)
    (reached : Call.payment arg ∈ (run s).2) : arg = s := by
  rcases shape s with none | one | two | three <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,
      reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.payment.injEq]

#print axioms tail_shape
#print axioms bindings_shape
#print axioms shape
#print axioms late_domain
#print axioms payment_same
end NED_ValidatorCallDomains

NED_ValidatorTrace.source:
import NED_CodecComposition
import NED_SubtreeComposition
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_ValidatorTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev E := NBN_StatementResult.Error
abbrev R := Result (core.result.Result Unit E)
inductive Call where
  | payment (statement : Statement)
  | lane (nullifier : Array U32 8#usize)
  | late (argument : NBN_LateSummary.Statement) (output : Slice U8)

def enc := atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
def transfer (p : NBN_ValidatorSummary.Transfer) := ok (NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p)
def withdrawal (p : NBN_ValidatorSummary.Withdrawal) := ok (NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p)
def payment (s : Statement) := NBN_ValidatorSummary.paymentWith transfer withdrawal s

def tail (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  let d := (parts s).2.2.2.2.1
  match NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc d with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.lane d])
  | .div => (.div,[.lane d])
  | .ok (.Err e) => (ok (.Err (.Account e)),[.lane d])
  | .ok (.Ok l) =>
    if l ≠ (common s).output_lane then (ok (.Err .OutputLaneMismatch),[.lane d])
    else
      let arg := (common s).lane_transition
      let out := NBN_LateResult.zero
      let r : R := do
        let (status,_) ← NBN_LateSummary.run enc arg out
        match status with
        | .Err e => ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e))
        | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok ())
      (r,[.lane d,.late arg out])

def bindings (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  if (parts s).1 ≠ (common s).master_account then (ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (parts s).2.1 ≠ (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain then (ok (.Err .DeploymentBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool ≠ (common s).master_account then (ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (parts s).2.2.1 ≠ (common s).checkpoint_sequence then (ok (.Err .CheckpointBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (parts s).2.2.2.1 ≠ (common s).historical_global_anchor then (ok (.Err .HistoricalAnchorMismatch),[])
  else tail s

def run (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  if (common s).master_account = zero ∨ (common s).checkpoint_account = zero ∨
      (common s).selected_lane_account = zero then (ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding),[])
  else if 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val then (ok (.Err .InvalidOutputLane),[])
  else match payment s with
    | .fail e => (.fail e,[.payment s])
    | .div => (.div,[.payment s])
    | .ok (.Err e) => (ok (.Err (.Payment e)),[.payment s])
    | .ok (.Ok _) => ((bindings s).1,.payment s :: (bindings s).2)

theorem tail_erases (s : Statement) : (tail s).1 = NBN_ValidatorSummary.tail enc s := by
  unfold tail NBN_ValidatorSummary.tail
  dsimp only
  cases h : NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
  | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]
  | ok r =>
    cases r with
    | Err e => simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
    | Ok l =>
      simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
      split <;> rfl

theorem bindings_erases (s : Statement) :
    (bindings s).1 = NBN_ValidatorSummary.chain (common s) (parts s) (NBN_ValidatorSummary.tail enc s) := by
  unfold bindings NBN_ValidatorSummary.chain
  repeat' first | split | rfl | exact tail_erases s

theorem erases (s : Statement) : (run s).1 =
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s := by
  rw [← NED_CodecComposition.validator s]
  change (run s).1 = NBN_ValidatorSummary.run enc transfer withdrawal s
  unfold run NBN_ValidatorSummary.run
  split
  · rfl
  · split
    · rfl
    · unfold payment
      cases h : NBN_ValidatorSummary.paymentWith transfer withdrawal s with
      | fail e => simp only [h,bind_tc_fail]
      | div => simp only [h,bind_tc_div]
      | ok r =>
        cases r with
        | Err e => simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
        | Ok bytes =>
          simp only [h,bind_tc_ok]
          exact bindings_erases s

/-- Every logged lane uses this statement's exact nullifier projection. -/
theorem lane_same (s : Statement) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (reached : Call.lane d ∈ (run s).2) : d = (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 := by
  unfold run at reached
  split at reached
  · cases reached
  · split at reached
    · cases reached
    · cases h : payment s with
      | fail e => simp only [h,List.mem_singleton] at reached; cases reached
      | div => simp only [h,List.mem_singleton] at reached; cases reached
      | ok r => cases r with
        | Err e => simp only [h,List.mem_singleton] at reached; cases reached
        | Ok bytes =>
          simp only [h,List.mem_cons] at reached
          rcases reached with bad | reached
          · cases bad
          · unfold bindings at reached
            repeat' first | split at reached | cases reached
            unfold tail at reached
            cases h : NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
            | fail e => simpa only [h,List.mem_singleton,Call.lane.injEq] using reached
            | div => simpa only [h,List.mem_singleton,Call.lane.injEq] using reached
            | ok r => cases r with
              | Err e => simpa only [h,List.mem_singleton,Call.lane.injEq] using reached
              | Ok l =>
                simp only [h] at reached
                split at reached
                · simpa only [List.mem_singleton,Call.lane.injEq] using reached
                · simp only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,Call.lane.injEq,reduceCtorEq,or_false] at reached
                  exact reached

#print axioms tail_erases
#print axioms bindings_erases
#print axioms erases
#print axioms lane_same
end NED_ValidatorTrace

def tail (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
def bindings (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
def run (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
theorem tail_erases (s : Statement) : (tail s).1 = NBN_ValidatorSummary.tail enc s := by

NED_WindowExtensionality.source:
import NED_EncoderCallDomains
import KMX_CopyMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_WindowExtensionality
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem array_ext {α : Type} {n : Usize} (a b : Array α n)
    (point : ∀ i : Fin n.val,
      a.val[i.val]'(by have := a.property; omega) =
      b.val[i.val]'(by have := b.property; omega)) : a = b := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · have := a.property; have := b.property; omega
  · intro i hi hj
    exact point ⟨i,by have := a.property; omega⟩

theorem late_zero (out : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1520)
    (point : ∀ i : Fin 1520, out.val[i.val]'(by change i.val < out.length; omega) = 0#u8) :
    out = NBN_LateResult.zero := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
    change out.length = 1520
    exact size
  · intro i hi hj
    have eq := point ⟨i,by change i < out.length at hi; omega⟩
    simpa only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.getElem_replicate] using eq

theorem prefix_frame {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (start count offset : Nat)
    (end_before_late : start + count ≤ 144) :
    KMX_CopyMeaning.loop src dst start count (144+offset) = dst (144+offset) := by
  apply KMX_CopyMeaning.copy_frame
  right; omega

structure Write (α : Type) where
  source : Nat → α
  start : Nat
  count : Nat

def applyWrites {α : Type} : List (Write α) → (Nat → α) → Nat → α
  | [], dst => dst
  | w::ws, dst => applyWrites ws (KMX_CopyMeaning.loop w.source dst w.start w.count)

theorem prefixes_frame {α : Type} (writes : List (Write α)) (dst : Nat → α)
    (bounded : ∀ w ∈ writes, w.start+w.count ≤ 144) (offset : Nat) :
    applyWrites writes dst (144+offset) = dst (144+offset) := by
  induction writes generalizing dst with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons w ws ih =>
    rw [applyWrites,ih _ (by intro v hv; exact bounded v (by simp [hv]))]
    exact prefix_frame w.source dst w.start w.count offset (bounded w (by simp))

#print axioms array_ext
#print axioms late_zero
#print axioms prefix_frame
#print axioms prefixes_frame
end NED_WindowExtensionality

import NED_DigestCohorts
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEE_M31SerializerDomain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1AdapterReconstruct

/-- The emitted scalar serializer calls the primitive u32 serializer on the
same raw word, including noncanonical representatives. -/
theorem primitive (word : U32) :
    aspis_core.field.M31.to_le_bytes word = ok (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes word) := by rfl

/-- Fixed-array carrier size distinguishes this source call from WideExact's
32-byte serializer. The native source receiver is self.0 : u32. -/
theorem width (word : U32) : (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes word).val.length = 4 := by
  exact (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes word).property

theorem widths_distinct : (4 : Nat) ≠ 32 := by decide

#print axioms primitive
#print axioms width
#print axioms widths_distinct
end NEE_M31SerializerDomain

import NEE_ValidatorMutation
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_OracleCallDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
open NED_ValidatorTrace NEE_ValidatorMutation
open NEE_ValidatorOracle

def TailShape (s : Statement) (xs : List Call) : Prop :=
  xs = [.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1] ∨
  xs = [.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero]

def Shape (s : Statement) (xs : List Call) : Prop :=
  xs = [] ∨ xs = [.payment s] ∨
  xs = [.payment s,.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1] ∨
  xs = [.payment s,.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1,.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero]

theorem tail_shape (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement) : TailShape s (NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane late s).2 := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail
  dsimp only
  cases h : lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | fail e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | div => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
  | ok r => cases r with
    | Err e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inl rfl
    | Ok l =>
      simp only [h]
      split
      · exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr rfl

theorem bindings_shape (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement) :
    (NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings pay lane late s).2 = [] ∨ TailShape s (NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings pay lane late s).2 := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings
  repeat' first | split | exact Or.inl rfl | exact Or.inr (tail_shape pay lane late s)

theorem shape (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement) : Shape s (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2 := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.run
  split
  · exact Or.inl rfl
  · split
    · exact Or.inl rfl
    · cases h : pay s with
      | fail e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      | div => simp only [h]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
      | ok r => cases r with
        | Err e => simp only [h]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
        | Ok bytes =>
          simp only [h]
          rcases bindings_shape pay lane late s with none | one | two
          · rw [none]; exact Or.inr (Or.inl rfl)
          · rw [one]; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inl rfl))
          · rw [two]; exact Or.inr (Or.inr (Or.inr rfl))

/-- A logged late call has the SAME full record and fixed local output width.
The whole root need not accept: an error returned by that call is retained. -/
theorem late_domain (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement) (arg : NBN_LateSummary.Statement) (out : Slice U8)
    (reached : Call.late arg out ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2) :
    arg = (common s).lane_transition ∧ out = NBN_LateResult.zero ∧ out.length = 1520 := by
  rcases shape pay lane late s with none | one | two | three
  · simp only [none,List.not_mem_nil] at reached
  · simp only [one,List.mem_singleton,reduceCtorEq] at reached
  · simp only [two,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,or_self] at reached
  · simp only [three,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.late.injEq] at reached
    obtain ⟨rfl,rfl⟩ := reached
    refine ⟨rfl,rfl,?_⟩
    simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
    rfl

theorem payment_same (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement) (arg : Statement)
    (reached : Call.payment arg ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2) : arg = s := by
  rcases shape pay lane late s with none | one | two | three <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,
      reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.payment.injEq]

/-- Every lane call uses the same nullifier, even for arbitrary failing
child replies. This is a caller-domain fact, not a child success premise. -/
theorem lane_same (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)
    (arg : Array U32 8#usize)
    (reached : Call.lane arg ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2) :
    arg = (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 := by
  rcases shape pay lane late s with none | one | two | three <;>
    simp_all only [List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,
      reduceCtorEq,false_or,or_false,Call.lane.injEq]

import NEE_ReachedSubstitution
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_ReachedRootModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
open NED_ValidatorTrace NEE_ValidatorMutation

/-- Ruling-(y) MODEL substitution with every open child law exposed by name.
This theorem does not claim that a Rust child, frame or physical instance has
been proved. The three laws must come from independently accepted bridges. -/
theorem result_and_effects (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)
    (payment_bridge : ∀ a, Call.payment a ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2 →
      pay a = NED_ValidatorTrace.payment a)
    (output_lane_bridge : ∀ d, Call.lane d ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2 →
      lane d = NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc d)
    (late_bridge : ∀ a out, Call.late a out ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2 →
      ignore (late a out) = ignore (NBN_LateSummary.run enc a out)) :
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s =
      (pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s,
       (NED_ValidatorTrace.run s).2) := by
  have joined := NEE_ReachedSubstitution.result_and_effects pay lane late s
    (by
      intro c reached
      cases c with
      | payment a => exact payment_bridge a reached
      | lane d => exact output_lane_bridge d reached
      | late a out => exact late_bridge a out reached)
  rw [joined]
  exact Prod.ext (NED_ValidatorTrace.erases s) rfl

#print axioms result_and_effects
end NEE_ReachedRootModel

NEE_ReachedSubstitution.source:
import NEE_OracleCallDomains
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_ReachedSubstitution
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
open NED_ValidatorTrace NEE_ValidatorMutation
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Full child equality is required only where the native caller reaches
that exact argument. The temporary late output is discarded by the caller. -/
def ReplyLaw (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) : Call → Prop
  | .payment a => pay a = NED_ValidatorTrace.payment a
  | .lane d => lane d = NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc d
  | .late a out => ignore (late a out) = ignore (NBN_LateSummary.run enc a out)

def Children (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement) : Prop :=
  ∀ c, c ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2 → ReplyLaw pay lane late c

theorem tail (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)
    (lane_bridge : lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 =
      NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc (parts s).2.2.2.2.1)
    (late_bridge : ∀ a out, Call.late a out ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane late s).2 →
      ignore (late a out) = ignore (NBN_LateSummary.run enc a out)) :
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane late s = NED_ValidatorTrace.tail s := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail NED_ValidatorTrace.tail
  dsimp only
  rw [lane_bridge]
  cases h : NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | fail e => simp only [h]
  | div => simp only [h]
  | ok r => cases r with
    | Err e => simp only [h]
    | Ok l =>
      simp only [h]
      split
      · rfl
      · rename_i same
        have reached : Call.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero ∈
            (NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane late s).2 := by
          simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail,lane_bridge,h,bind_tc_ok,same,if_false]
          simp
        change (ignore (late _ _),_) = (ignore (NBN_LateSummary.run enc _ _),_)
        rw [late_bridge _ _ reached]

theorem bindings (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)
    (children : ∀ c, c ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings pay lane late s).2 →
      ReplyLaw pay lane late c) :
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings pay lane late s = NED_ValidatorTrace.bindings s := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings at children ⊢
  unfold NED_ValidatorTrace.bindings
  repeat' first | rfl | split
  have child_tail : ∀ c, c ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane late s).2 →
      ReplyLaw pay lane late c := by
    simpa [*] using children
  have reached : Call.lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane late s).2 := by
    rcases NEE_OracleCallDomains.tail_shape pay lane late s with one | two <;>
      simp only [*,List.mem_cons,List.mem_singleton,true_or]
  exact tail pay lane late s (child_tail _ reached) (fun a out h => child_tail _ h)

/-- Exact caller Result and ordered arguments after substituting ONLY reached
child bridges. These are explicit inner hypotheses, not PhysicalInterpretation.
Native association and child framed contracts are separate evidence gates. -/
theorem result_and_effects (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)
    (children : Children pay lane late s) :
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s = NED_ValidatorTrace.run s := by
  by_cases h0 : (common s).master_account = zero ∨ (common s).checkpoint_account = zero ∨
      (common s).selected_lane_account = zero
  · simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,NED_ValidatorTrace.run,h0,if_true]
  by_cases h1 : 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val
  · simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,NED_ValidatorTrace.run,h0,h1,if_false,if_true]
  have reached : Call.payment s ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2 := by
    simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,h0,h1,if_false]
    cases pay s with
    | fail e => simp
    | div => simp
    | ok r => cases r <;> simp
  have hp : pay s = NED_ValidatorTrace.payment s := children _ reached
  cases hpay : NED_ValidatorTrace.payment s with
  | fail e => simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,NED_ValidatorTrace.run,h0,h1,if_false,hp,hpay]
  | div => simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,NED_ValidatorTrace.run,h0,h1,if_false,hp,hpay]
  | ok r => cases r with
    | Err e => simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,NED_ValidatorTrace.run,h0,h1,if_false,hp,hpay]
    | Ok bytes =>
      have hb : ∀ c, c ∈ (NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings pay lane late s).2 → ReplyLaw pay lane late c := by
        intro c hc
        apply children c
        simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,h0,h1,if_false,hp,hpay]
        exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hc
      simp only [NEE_ValidatorOracle.run,NED_ValidatorTrace.run,h0,h1,if_false,hp,hpay,
        bindings pay lane late s hb]

#print axioms bindings
#print axioms result_and_effects
#print axioms tail
end NEE_ReachedSubstitution

declarations.text: def ReplyLaw (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) : Call → Prop
def Children (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement) : Prop :=
theorem tail (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)
theorem bindings (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)
theorem result_and_effects (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (s : Statement)

import NEE_ValidatorOracle
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_ValidatorMutation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
abbrev LateError := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1
abbrev LateReply := Result (core.result.Result Unit LateError × Slice U8)

def mutate (f : Slice U8 → Slice U8) : LateReply → LateReply
  | .fail e => .fail e
  | .div => .div
  | .ok (status,out) => .ok (status,f out)

def ignore (r : LateReply) : NED_ValidatorTrace.R := do
  let (status,_) ← r
  match status with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e))
  | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok ())

/-- The local buffer never escapes the validator, even on a child error. -/
theorem discard (r : LateReply) (f : Slice U8 → Slice U8) :
    ignore (mutate f r) = ignore r := by
  cases r with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok p => rcases p with ⟨status,out⟩; cases status <;> rfl

abbrev Pay := Statement → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError)
abbrev Lane := Array U32 8#usize → Result (core.result.Result U8 pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.PoolV1PairForestAccountErrorV1)
abbrev Late := NBN_LateSummary.Statement → Slice U8 → LateReply

theorem tail (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (f : Slice U8 → Slice U8)
    (s : Statement) :
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane (fun a b => mutate f (late a b)) s =
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail pay lane late s := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.tail
  dsimp only
  cases h : lane (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | fail e => simp only [h]
  | div => simp only [h]
  | ok p => cases p with
    | Err e => simp only [h]
    | Ok l =>
      simp only [h]
      split
      · rfl
      · change (ignore (mutate f (late _ _)),_) = (ignore (late _ _),_)
        rw [discard]

theorem bindings (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late) (f : Slice U8 → Slice U8)
    (s : Statement) :
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings pay lane (fun a b => mutate f (late a b)) s =
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings pay lane late s := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.bindings
  repeat' first | split | rfl | exact tail pay lane late f s

/-- Arbitrary whole-buffer reply mutations preserve Result AND ordered calls. -/
theorem result_and_effects (pay : Pay) (lane : Lane) (late : Late)
    (f : Slice U8 → Slice U8) (s : Statement) :
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane (fun a b => mutate f (late a b)) s =
    NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorOracle.run
  split
  · rfl
  · split
    · rfl
    · cases pay s with
      | fail e => rfl
      | div => rfl
      | ok p => cases p with
        | Err e => rfl
        | Ok bytes => rw [bindings]

#print axioms discard
#print axioms tail
#print axioms bindings
#print axioms result_and_effects
end NEE_ValidatorMutation

NEE_ValidatorOracle.source:
import NED_ValidatorCallDomains
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_ValidatorOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
open NED_ValidatorTrace
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
def tail (pay : Statement → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError))
    (lane : Array U32 8#usize → Result (core.result.Result U8 pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.PoolV1PairForestAccountErrorV1))
    (late : NBN_LateSummary.Statement → Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 × Slice U8)) (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  let d := (parts s).2.2.2.2.1
  match lane d with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.lane d])
  | .div => (.div,[.lane d])
  | .ok (.Err e) => (ok (.Err (.Account e)),[.lane d])
  | .ok (.Ok l) =>
    if l ≠ (common s).output_lane then (ok (.Err .OutputLaneMismatch),[.lane d])
    else
      let arg := (common s).lane_transition
      let out := NBN_LateResult.zero
      let r : R := do
        let (status,_) ← late arg out
        match status with
        | .Err e => ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e))
        | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok ())
      (r,[.lane d,.late arg out])

def bindings (pay : Statement → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError))
    (lane : Array U32 8#usize → Result (core.result.Result U8 pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.PoolV1PairForestAccountErrorV1))
    (late : NBN_LateSummary.Statement → Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 × Slice U8)) (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  if (parts s).1 ≠ (common s).master_account then (ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (parts s).2.1 ≠ (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain then (ok (.Err .DeploymentBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool ≠ (common s).master_account then (ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (parts s).2.2.1 ≠ (common s).checkpoint_sequence then (ok (.Err .CheckpointBindingMismatch),[])
  else if (parts s).2.2.2.1 ≠ (common s).historical_global_anchor then (ok (.Err .HistoricalAnchorMismatch),[])
  else tail pay lane late s

def run (pay : Statement → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError))
    (lane : Array U32 8#usize → Result (core.result.Result U8 pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.PoolV1PairForestAccountErrorV1))
    (late : NBN_LateSummary.Statement → Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 × Slice U8)) (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  if (common s).master_account = zero ∨ (common s).checkpoint_account = zero ∨
      (common s).selected_lane_account = zero then (ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding),[])
  else if 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val then (ok (.Err .InvalidOutputLane),[])
  else match pay s with
    | .fail e => (.fail e,[.payment s])
    | .div => (.div,[.payment s])
    | .ok (.Err e) => (ok (.Err (.Payment e)),[.payment s])
    | .ok (.Ok _) => ((bindings pay lane late s).1,.payment s :: (bindings pay lane late s).2)


/-- Full oracle substitution, retaining all failed/diverging child prefixes. -/
theorem substitution (s : Statement) :
    run NED_ValidatorTrace.payment (NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc) (NBN_LateSummary.run enc) s =
    NED_ValidatorTrace.run s := by rfl

/-- Result projection of the same oracle execution. -/
theorem result (s : Statement) :
    (run NED_ValidatorTrace.payment (NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc) (NBN_LateSummary.run enc) s).1 =
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s := by
  rw [substitution,NED_ValidatorTrace.erases]

/-- Exact ordered argument-bearing call log, not only an acceptance decision. -/
theorem effects (s : Statement) :
    (run NED_ValidatorTrace.payment (NBN_FirstByteDependency.lane enc) (NBN_LateSummary.run enc) s).2 =
    (NED_ValidatorTrace.run s).2 := by rw [substitution]

#print axioms substitution
#print axioms result
#print axioms effects
end NEE_ValidatorOracle

import NEJ_ArrayFrame
import NED_WindowExtensionality
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEL_CopyArrayLaw
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem list_inside {α : Type} (dst src : List α) (start k : Nat)
    (fits : start + src.length ≤ dst.length)
    (inside : start ≤ k ∧ k < start + src.length) :
    (dst.setSlice! start src)[k]? = src[k-start]? := by
  have hs : start ≤ dst.length := by omega
  have hroom : min src.length (dst.length-start) = src.length := Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)
  simp only [List.setSlice!, hroom, List.take_length]
  rw [List.append_assoc]
  have hlen : (dst.take start).length = start := by
    exact (List.length_take).trans (Nat.min_eq_left hs)
  rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
  rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
  rw [hlen]

theorem array_spec {N W : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (src : Array U8 W)
    (start k : Nat) (fits : start + W.val ≤ N.val) :
    (dst.setSlice! start src.val).val[k]? =
      if start ≤ k ∧ k < start + W.val then src.val[k-start]? else dst.val[k]? := by
  by_cases hi : start ≤ k ∧ k < start + W.val
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    change (dst.val.setSlice! start src.val)[k]? = _
    apply list_inside
    · simpa only [src.property,dst.property] using fits
    · simpa only [src.property] using hi
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    apply NEJ_ArrayFrame.array_frame
    · simpa only [src.property] using fits
    · simpa only [src.property] using (show k < start ∨ start + W.val ≤ k by omega)

/-- Exact KMX value-loop to emitted back-write association on one arbitrary
complete prestate. Both touched values and every external frame byte agree. -/
theorem loop_binding {N W : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (src : Array U8 W)
    (start k : Nat) (fits : start + W.val ≤ N.val) :
    KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun j => src.val[j-start]?) (fun j => dst.val[j]?) start W.val k =
      (dst.setSlice! start src.val).val[k]? := by
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec, array_spec dst src start k fits]

#print axioms list_inside
#print axioms array_spec
#print axioms loop_binding
end NEL_CopyArrayLaw

declarations.text: theorem list_inside {α : Type} (dst src : List α) (start k : Nat)
theorem array_spec {N W : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (src : Array U8 W)
theorem loop_binding {N W : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (src : Array U8 W)

import NEL_SliceCopyLaw
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEL_LateDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem child_window_lengths (out : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1520) :
    ((out.val.drop 32).take 800).length = 800 ∧
    (out.val.drop 832).length = 688 := by
  change out.val.length = 1520 at size
  simp only [List.length_take,List.length_drop,size]
  decide

/-- Snapshot and afterstate windows partition the suffix; header bytes belong
neither to child, including when a child rejects. -/
theorem child_windows (k : Nat) :
    ((32 ≤ k ∧ k < 832) ∨ (832 ≤ k ∧ k < 1520)) ↔ 32 ≤ k ∧ k < 1520 := by omega

theorem header_frame (out src : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1520)
    (source_size : src.length = 800) (k : Nat) (header : k < 32) :
    (out.setSlice! 32 src.val).val[k]? = out.val[k]? := by
  apply NEJ_ArrayFrame.list_frame
  · change 32 + src.length ≤ out.length
    omega
  · exact Or.inl header

#print axioms child_window_lengths
#print axioms child_windows
#print axioms header_frame
end NEL_LateDomains

declarations.text: theorem header_frame (out src : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1520)

NEL_SliceCopyLaw.source:
import NEL_CopyArrayLaw
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEL_SliceCopyLaw
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Dynamic borrowed slices use the same value law, preserving their complete
original allocation outside the copied window. No independent poststate occurs. -/
theorem loop_binding (dst src : Slice U8) (start k : Nat)
    (fits : start + src.length ≤ dst.length) :
    KMX_CopyMeaning.loop (fun j => src.val[j-start]?) (fun j => dst.val[j]?)
      start src.length k = (dst.setSlice! start src.val).val[k]? := by
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec]
  change (if start ≤ k ∧ k < start + src.val.length then src.val[k-start]? else dst.val[k]?) =
    (dst.val.setSlice! start src.val)[k]?
  by_cases hi : start ≤ k ∧ k < start + src.val.length
  · rw [if_pos hi]
    exact (NEL_CopyArrayLaw.list_inside dst.val src.val start k fits hi).symm
  · rw [if_neg hi]
    exact (NEJ_ArrayFrame.list_frame dst.val src.val start k fits (by omega)).symm

#print axioms loop_binding
end NEL_SliceCopyLaw

import NEM_LaneReached
import NEM_SnapshotBorrow
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEM_LateOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open NBN_LateSummary (Statement)
abbrev Live := NBH_LiveValidator.Snapshot → Slice U8 →
  Result (core.result.Result Unit NBH_LiveValidator.Error × Slice U8)
abbrev After := NBH_Validators.Afterstate →
  Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 688#usize) NBH_Validators.AfterError)

def tail (live : Live) (after : After) (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit NBN_LateSummary.Error × Slice U8) := do
  let i7 ← 32#usize + pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES
  let (child,back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8) output {start := 32#usize, «end» := i7}
  let (r,post) ← live s.live_snapshot child
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Snapshot e),back post)
  | .Ok _ =>
    let r2 ← after s.candidate_afterstate
    match r2 with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Afterstate e),back post)
    | .Ok bytes =>
      let (dest,back2) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8) (back post) {start := i7}
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 dest bytes.to_slice
      ok (.Ok (),back2 copied)

def run (live : Live) (after : After) (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit NBN_LateSummary.Error × Slice U8) :=
  if output.length ≠ 1520 then ok (.Err .WrongLength,output)
  else if U64.checked_add s.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 ≠
      some s.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index then ok (.Err .AfterstateIndexMismatch,output)
  else do
    let filled ← core.slice.Slice.fill core.clone.CloneU8 output 0#u8
    NBN_LatePrepare.run filled (tail live after s)

theorem tail_substitution (s : Statement) (out : Slice U8) :
    tail pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1
      pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s out =
      NBN_LateSummary.tail NED_ValidatorTrace.enc s out := by
  unfold tail NBN_LateSummary.tail
  simp only [NED_ValidatorTrace.enc,← NED_SubtreeComposition.live_encode,← NED_SubtreeComposition.after_encode]
  rfl

theorem run_substitution (s : Statement) (out : Slice U8) :
    run pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1
      pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s out =
      NBN_LateSummary.run NED_ValidatorTrace.enc s out := by
  have same : tail pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1
      pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s =
      NBN_LateSummary.tail NED_ValidatorTrace.enc s := funext (tail_substitution s)
  unfold run NBN_LateSummary.run
  rw [same]

def late : NEE_ValidatorMutation.Late :=
  pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1

theorem value_and_frame (s : Statement) (out : Slice U8) :
    run pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1
      pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s out = late s out :=
  (run_substitution s out).trans (NED_SubtreeComposition.late_encode s out)

theorem late_reached (s : NBN_StatementResult.Statement) (a : Statement) (out : Slice U8)
    (_reached : NED_ValidatorTrace.Call.late a out ∈
      (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run NEM_PaymentReached.pay NEM_LaneReached.lane late s).2) :
    NEE_ValidatorMutation.ignore (late a out) =
      NEE_ValidatorMutation.ignore (NBN_LateSummary.run NED_ValidatorTrace.enc a out) :=
  congrArg NEE_ValidatorMutation.ignore (NED_SubtreeComposition.late_encode a out).symm

#print axioms tail_substitution
#print axioms run_substitution
#print axioms value_and_frame
#print axioms late_reached
end NEM_LateOracle

import NEE_ReachedRootModel
import NED_CodecComposition
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEM_PaymentReached
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult

def pay (s : Statement) :=
  NBN_ValidatorSummary.paymentWith
    pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1
    pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 s

/-- Exact emitted payment child selected by this statement, including every
rejection and all returned bytes. Native certificates remain separate. -/
theorem payment_instance (s : Statement) : pay s = NED_ValidatorTrace.payment s := by
  cases s with
  | PrivateTransfer c p =>
    exact (NED_CodecComposition.transfer_law p).symm
  | Withdrawal c p =>
    exact (NED_CodecComposition.withdrawal_law p).symm

/-- The first reached-child law is supplied on the SAME argument; no payment
PacketDomain, accepted-result, or independent execution premise remains. -/
theorem payment_reached (lane : NEE_ValidatorMutation.Lane)
    (late : NEE_ValidatorMutation.Late) (s a : Statement)
    (_reached : NED_ValidatorTrace.Call.payment a ∈
      (NEE_ValidatorOracle.run pay lane late s).2) :
    pay a = NED_ValidatorTrace.payment a := payment_instance a

#print axioms payment_instance
#print axioms payment_reached
end NEM_PaymentReached

NEM_SnapshotBorrow.source:
import NEL_LateDomains
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEM_SnapshotBorrow
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The actual emitted borrow and its back function, on the same allocation.
The poststate is arbitrary: this is not a one-cell mutation restriction. -/
theorem rejoin (out : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1520) :
    ∃ child back,
      core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
        out {start := 32#usize, «end» := 832#usize} = ok (child,back) ∧
      child.length = 800 ∧ ∀ post : Slice U8, back post = out.setSlice! 32 post.val := by
  have guard : (32#usize) ≤ 832#usize ∧ (832#usize).val ≤ out.length := by
    constructor
    · decide
    · rw [size]; decide
  simp only [core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,if_pos guard]
  refine ⟨_,_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
  · have len : out.val.length = 1520 := size
    simp only [Slice.length,List.slice,List.length_take,List.length_drop,len]
    decide
  · intro post
    rfl

/-- All possible 800-byte child poststates and every external allocation byte. -/
theorem poststate (out post : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1520)
    (post_size : post.length = 800) (k : Nat) :
    (out.setSlice! 32 post.val).val[k]? =
      if 32 ≤ k ∧ k < 832 then post.val[k-32]? else out.val[k]? := by
  rw [← NEL_SliceCopyLaw.loop_binding out post 32 k (by rw [post_size,size]; decide)]
  rw [KMX_CopyMeaning.loop_spec,post_size]

/-- The later afterstate write preserves the exact child's whole poststate. -/
theorem after_preserves_child (out post : Slice U8) (size : out.length = 1520)
    (after : Array U8 688#usize) (k : Nat) (earlier : k < 832) :
    ((out.setSlice! 32 post.val).setSlice! 832 after.val).val[k]? =
      (out.setSlice! 32 post.val).val[k]? := by
  apply NEJ_ArrayFrame.list_frame
  · have len : out.val.length = 1520 := size
    simp only [Slice.setSlice!,List.length_setSlice!,after.property,len]
    decide
  · exact Or.inl earlier

#print axioms rejoin
#print axioms poststate
#print axioms after_preserves_child
end NEM_SnapshotBorrow
