NEM_ValidatorComposed.source:
import NEM_LateOracle
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEM_ValidatorComposed
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult

/-- Concrete model G for the three SAME calls certified natively. The hybrid
native correspondence is checked separately by NEM_validate; this theorem
introduces no inner callee domain, interpretation, or bridge hypothesis. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (s : Statement) (state : State) :
    let observed := NEE_ValidatorOracle.run NEM_PaymentReached.pay NEM_LaneReached.lane
      NEM_LateOracle.late s
    (observed.1,state,observed.2) =
      (pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s,
       state,(NED_ValidatorTrace.run s).2) := by
  have same := NEE_ReachedRootModel.result_and_effects NEM_PaymentReached.pay
    NEM_LaneReached.lane NEM_LateOracle.late s
    (fun a reached => NEM_PaymentReached.payment_reached NEM_LaneReached.lane
      NEM_LateOracle.late s a reached)
    (fun d reached => NEM_LaneReached.lane_reached NEM_LateOracle.late s d reached)
    (fun a out reached => NEM_LateOracle.late_reached s a out reached)
  rw [same]

#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEM_ValidatorComposed

import NEQ_DecodeScalar
import NEQ_UnwrapDomains
import NBP_CommonDecode
import NEM_ValidatorComposed
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace NEQ_CommonDecode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev Common := pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1
abbrev Err := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError
abbrev DigestCall := Array U8 32#usize → Result (core.result.Result (Array U32 8#usize) atomic_statement.AtomicStatementError)
abbrev Validate := Common → Result (core.result.Result Unit Err)
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def run (decode : DigestCall) (validate : Validate) (b : Array U8 216#usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result Common Err) := do
  if NBP_CommonDecode.asset b >= 2147483647#u32 then ok (.Err .NonCanonicalAssetId)
  else
    let anchor ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 80 (by decide))
    match anchor with
    | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
    | .Ok a =>
      let nullifier ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 112 (by decide))
      match nullifier with
      | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
      | .Ok n =>
        let c := NBP_CommonDecode.common b a n
        let valid ← validate c
        match valid with
        | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
        | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok c)

theorem substitution (b : Array U8 216#usize) :
    run atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_common b =
      ok (NBP_CommonDecode.decoded b) := by
  unfold run NBP_CommonDecode.decoded
  simp only [NBP_DigestDecode.result,NBG_PaymentChecks.common_result,bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases invalid : NBP_CommonDecode.asset b >= 2147483647#u32
  · simp only [if_pos invalid]
  · simp only [if_neg invalid]
    cases a : NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 80 (by decide)) with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok anchor =>
      dsimp only
      cases n : NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 112 (by decide)) with
      | Err e => rfl
      | Ok nullifier =>
        dsimp only
        cases NBG_PaymentChecks.common (NBP_CommonDecode.common b anchor nullifier) <;> rfl

theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (b : Array U8 216#usize) (state : State) :
    (run atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_common b,state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (pool_v1.payment_relation.decode_common b,state,[]) := by
  rw [substitution,NBP_CommonDecode.result]

#print axioms substitution
#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEQ_CommonDecode

import NBG_Header

namespace NEQ_DecodeScalar
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder

theorem header_result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Array U8 216#usize)
    (magic : Array U8 4#usize) (kind : NBG_Header.K) (state : State) :
    (pool_v1.payment_relation.require_header bytes magic kind,state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (ok (NBG_Header.expected bytes magic kind),state,[]) :=
  congrArg (fun x => (x,state,([] : List Unit))) (NBG_Header.header_result bytes magic kind)

theorem m31_result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Array U8 4#usize) (state : State) :
    (aspis_core.field.M31.from_le_bytes bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (ok (let word := core.num.U32.from_le_bytes bytes
        if word >= 2147483647#u32 then none else some word),state,[]) :=
  congrArg (fun x => (x,state,([] : List Unit))) (NBG_Atomic.m31_decode bytes)

theorem digest_result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) (state : State) :
    (atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (ok (NBP_DigestDecode.decoded bytes),state,[]) :=
  congrArg (fun x => (x,state,([] : List Unit))) (NBP_DigestDecode.result bytes)

/-- Every actual unrolled word call passes these exact four SAME original bytes. -/
theorem digest_word_domain (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) (i : Nat) (bound : i<8) :
    ∃ word : Array U8 4#usize,
      word.val = (bytes.val.drop (4*i)).take 4 ∧ word.val.length=4 := by
  let word : Array U8 4#usize := NBP_Read.chunk bytes (4*i) (by change 4*i+4≤32;omega)
  exact ⟨word,rfl,word.property⟩

#print axioms header_result_state_effects
#print axioms m31_result_state_effects
#print axioms digest_result_state_effects
#print axioms digest_word_domain
end NEQ_DecodeScalar

import NED_EncoderCallDomains
import NEM_ValidatorComposed
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEQ_EncoderOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
open NED_EncoderTrace (Call R)
abbrev Validate := Statement → Result (core.result.Result Unit NBN_StatementResult.Error)
abbrev Pay := Statement → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError)
abbrev Late := NEE_ValidatorMutation.Late
abbrev Digest := Array U32 8#usize → Result (Array U8 32#usize)
def payStep (pay : Pay) (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) (late : Slice U8) : R × List Call :=
  let r : R := do
    let pay ← pay s
    match pay with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Payment e))
    | .Ok a => ok (.Ok ((NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.prefixBytes s anchor ++ late.val) ++ a.val))
  (r,[.payment s])

def lateStep (pay : Pay) (late : Late) (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) : R × List Call :=
  let arg := (common s).lane_transition
  let out := NBN_LateResult.zero
  match late arg out with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.late arg out])
  | .div => (.div,[.late arg out])
  | .ok (.Err e,_) => (ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e)),[.late arg out])
  | .ok (.Ok _,late) => ((payStep pay s anchor late).1,.late arg out :: (payStep pay s anchor late).2)

def anchorStep (pay : Pay) (late : Late) (digest : Digest) (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  let d := (common s).historical_global_anchor
  match digest d with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.digest d])
  | .div => (.div,[.digest d])
  | .ok anchor => ((lateStep pay late s anchor).1,.digest d :: (lateStep pay late s anchor).2)

def run (validate : Validate) (pay : Pay) (late : Late) (digest : Digest) (s : Statement) : R × List Call :=
  let validation := validate s
  match validation with
  | .fail e => (.fail e,[.validate s])
  | .div => (.div,[.validate s])
  | .ok (.Err e) => (ok (.Err e),[.validate s])
  | .ok (.Ok _) => ((anchorStep pay late digest s).1,.validate s :: (anchorStep pay late digest s).2)

theorem pay_substitution (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) (out : Slice U8) :
    payStep NEM_PaymentReached.pay s anchor out = NED_EncoderTrace.payStep s anchor out := by
  unfold payStep NED_EncoderTrace.payStep
  rw [NEM_PaymentReached.payment_instance]
  rfl

theorem late_substitution (s : Statement) (anchor : Array U8 32#usize) :
    lateStep NEM_PaymentReached.pay NEM_LateOracle.late s anchor = NED_EncoderTrace.lateStep s anchor := by
  unfold lateStep NED_EncoderTrace.lateStep
  dsimp only
  have same : NEM_LateOracle.late (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero =
      NBN_LateSummary.run NED_EncoderTrace.enc (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero :=
    (NED_SubtreeComposition.late_encode _ _).symm
  rw [same]
  cases h : NBN_LateSummary.run NED_EncoderTrace.enc (common s).lane_transition NBN_LateResult.zero with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok pair => cases pair with
    | mk status out => cases status with
      | Err e => rfl
      | Ok u =>
        simp only []
        rw [pay_substitution]

theorem anchor_substitution (s : Statement) :
    anchorStep NEM_PaymentReached.pay NEM_LateOracle.late atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical s =
      NED_EncoderTrace.anchorStep s := by
  unfold anchorStep NED_EncoderTrace.anchorStep NED_EncoderTrace.enc
  dsimp only
  cases h : atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical (common s).historical_global_anchor with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok anchor =>
    simp only []
    rw [late_substitution]

theorem substitution (s : Statement) :
    run pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      NEM_PaymentReached.pay NEM_LateOracle.late atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical s =
      NED_EncoderTrace.run s := by
  unfold run NED_EncoderTrace.run
  rw [← NED_CodecComposition.validator s]
  change (match NED_ExecutionComposition.validatorReference s with
    | .fail e => _ | .div => _ | .ok (.Err e) => _ | .ok (.Ok u) => _) = _
  cases h : NED_ExecutionComposition.validatorReference s with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok status => cases status with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok u =>
      simp only []
      rw [anchor_substitution]

theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (s : Statement) (state : State) :
    let observed := run pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      NEM_PaymentReached.pay NEM_LateOracle.late atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical s
    (observed.1,state,observed.2) =
      (NBN_StatementEncoderSummary.observe (AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode s),
       state,(NED_EncoderTrace.run s).2) := by
  dsimp only
  rw [substitution,NED_EncoderTrace.erases]

#print axioms pay_substitution
#print axioms late_substitution
#print axioms anchor_substitution
#print axioms substitution
#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEQ_EncoderOracle

NEQ_PaymentDecode.source:
import NEQ_CommonDecode
import NBP_TransferDecode
import NBP_WithdrawalDecode
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEQ_PaymentDecode
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open NBP_PaymentModel
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev CommonCall := Array U8 216#usize → Result (core.result.Result C E)
abbrev Decode := NEQ_CommonDecode.DigestCall
abbrev TransferCheck := T → Result (core.result.Result Unit E)
abbrev WithdrawalCheck := W → Result (core.result.Result Unit E)

def transferRun (common : CommonCall) (decode : Decode) (validate : TransferCheck)
    (b : Array U8 216#usize) : Result (core.result.Result T E) := do
  let h ← pool_v1.payment_relation.require_header b
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PRIVATE_TRANSFER_STATEMENT_MAGIC .PrivateTransfer
  match h with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok _ =>
    if (b.val.drop 148).take 4 ≠ List.replicate 4 0#u8 then ok (.Err .NonZeroReserved)
    else
      let c ← common b
      match c with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
      | .Ok c =>
        let r ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 152 (by decide))
        match r with
        | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
        | .Ok r =>
          let z ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide))
          match z with
          | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
          | .Ok z =>
            let p := transfer_public c r z
            let valid ← validate p
            match valid with | .Err e => ok (.Err e) | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok p)

def withdrawalRun (common : CommonCall) (decode : Decode) (validate : WithdrawalCheck)
    (b : Array U8 216#usize) : Result (core.result.Result W E) := do
  let h ← pool_v1.payment_relation.require_header b
    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_WITHDRAWAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC .Withdrawal
  match h with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok _ =>
    let c ← common b
    match c with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
    | .Ok c =>
      let z ← decode (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide))
      match z with
      | .Err _ => ok (.Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
      | .Ok z =>
        let p := withdrawal_public c b z
        let valid ← validate p
        match valid with | .Err e => ok (.Err e) | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok p)

theorem transfer_substitution (b : Array U8 216#usize) :
    transferRun pool_v1.payment_relation.decode_common atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical
      pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1 b =
      ok (transfer_decoded b) := by
  unfold transferRun transfer_decoded
  simp only [NBG_Header.header_result,NBP_CommonDecode.result,NBP_DigestDecode.result,
    NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer_result,bind_tc_ok]
  cases h : NBG_Header.expected b pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PRIVATE_TRANSFER_STATEMENT_MAGIC .PrivateTransfer with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok u =>
    dsimp only
    by_cases fee : (b.val.drop 148).take 4 ≠ List.replicate 4 0#u8
    · simp only [if_pos fee]
    · simp only [if_neg fee]
      cases c : NBP_CommonDecode.decoded b with
      | Err e => rfl
      | Ok common =>
        dsimp only
        cases r : NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 152 (by decide)) with
        | Err e => rfl
        | Ok recipient =>
          dsimp only
          cases z : NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide)) with
          | Err e => rfl
          | Ok change =>
            dsimp only
            cases NBG_PaymentValidators.transfer (transfer_public common recipient change) <;> rfl

theorem withdrawal_substitution (b : Array U8 216#usize) :
    withdrawalRun pool_v1.payment_relation.decode_common atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical
      pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 b =
      ok (withdrawal_decoded b) := by
  unfold withdrawalRun withdrawal_decoded
  simp only [NBG_Header.header_result,NBP_CommonDecode.result,NBP_DigestDecode.result,
    NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal_result,bind_tc_ok]
  cases h : NBG_Header.expected b pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_WITHDRAWAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC .Withdrawal with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok u =>
    dsimp only
    cases c : NBP_CommonDecode.decoded b with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok common =>
      dsimp only
      cases z : NBP_DigestDecode.decoded (NBP_Read.chunk b 184 (by decide)) with
      | Err e => rfl
      | Ok change =>
        dsimp only
        cases NBG_PaymentValidators.withdrawal (withdrawal_public common b change) <;> rfl

def transferFull (bytes : Slice U8) : Result (core.result.Result T E) :=
  if h : bytes.val.length=216 then
    transferRun pool_v1.payment_relation.decode_common atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical
      pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1 ⟨bytes.val,h⟩
  else ok (.Err .WrongLength)

def withdrawalFull (bytes : Slice U8) : Result (core.result.Result W E) :=
  if h : bytes.val.length=216 then
    withdrawalRun pool_v1.payment_relation.decode_common atomic_statement.decode_digest_canonical
      pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 ⟨bytes.val,h⟩
  else ok (.Err .WrongLength)

theorem transfer_result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Slice U8) (state : State) :
    (transferFull bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (pool_v1.payment_relation.decode_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1 bytes,state,[]) := by
  unfold transferFull
  rw [NBP_TransferDecode.result]
  by_cases h : bytes.val.length=216
  · rw [dif_pos h,dif_pos h,transfer_substitution]
  · rw [dif_neg h,dif_neg h]

theorem withdrawal_result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Slice U8) (state : State) :
    (withdrawalFull bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (pool_v1.payment_relation.decode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 bytes,state,[]) := by
  unfold withdrawalFull
  rw [NBP_WithdrawalDecode.result]
  by_cases h : bytes.val.length=216
  · rw [dif_pos h,dif_pos h,withdrawal_substitution]
  · rw [dif_neg h,dif_neg h]

import NEE_RawValidatorCohort
import NED_RawCarrierInverses
import NEM_ValidatorComposed
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEU_BoxModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct aspis_statement.pool_v1
abbrev Statement := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
abbrev Common := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1
abbrev Transfer := payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev Withdrawal := payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev Error := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
abbrev ProgramError := AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.solana_program_error.ProgramError

def status (s : Statement) : core.result.Result Unit Error :=
  NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
    (NED_ValidatorStatus.status (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw s))

def wrap (s : Statement) (r : core.result.Result Unit Error) :
    core.result.Result Statement ProgramError :=
  match r with | .Ok _ => .Ok s | .Err _ => .Err .InvalidInstructionData

theorem validator (s : Statement) :
    pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (status s) := by
  have h := NEE_RawValidatorCohort.result (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw s)
  rw [NED_RawCarrierInverses.statement] at h
  exact h

/-- Complete arbitrary-input emitted constructor Result, including every
validation rejection. The old sameCall premise is discharged, not packaged. -/
theorem transfer (c : Common) (p : Transfer) :
    r1_pool_adapter.transfer_statement_box c p =
      ok (wrap (.PrivateTransfer c p) (status (.PrivateTransfer c p))) := by
  unfold r1_pool_adapter.transfer_statement_box
  rw [validator]
  cases status (.PrivateTransfer c p) <;> rfl

theorem withdrawal (c : Common) (p : Withdrawal) :
    r1_pool_adapter.withdrawal_statement_box c p =
      ok (wrap (.Withdrawal c p) (status (.Withdrawal c p))) := by
  unfold r1_pool_adapter.withdrawal_statement_box
  rw [validator]
  cases status (.Withdrawal c p) <;> rfl

/-- Child execution is the already composed validator oracle, at precisely
this constructed raw statement's canonical carrier. -/
def run {State : Type} (s : Statement) (state : State) :=
  let observed := NEE_ValidatorOracle.run NEM_PaymentReached.pay NEM_LaneReached.lane
    NEM_LateOracle.late (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw s)
  ((do let reply ← observed.1
       ok (wrap s (NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult
         NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1 reply))),state,observed.2)

theorem transfer_result_state_effects {State : Type} (c : Common) (p : Transfer) (state : State) :
    run (.PrivateTransfer c p) state =
    (r1_pool_adapter.transfer_statement_box c p,state,
      (NED_ValidatorTrace.run (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.PrivateTransfer c p))).2) := by
  have child := NEM_ValidatorComposed.result_state_effects
    (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.PrivateTransfer c p)) state
  have reply := congrArg (fun x => x.1) child
  have trace := congrArg (fun x => x.2.2) child
  dsimp only at reply trace
  unfold run
  dsimp only
  rw [reply,trace,NED_ValidatorStatus.source,bind_tc_ok,transfer]
  rfl

theorem withdrawal_result_state_effects {State : Type} (c : Common) (p : Withdrawal) (state : State) :
    run (.Withdrawal c p) state =
    (r1_pool_adapter.withdrawal_statement_box c p,state,
      (NED_ValidatorTrace.run (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.Withdrawal c p))).2) := by
  have child := NEM_ValidatorComposed.result_state_effects
    (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.Withdrawal c p)) state
  have reply := congrArg (fun x => x.1) child
  have trace := congrArg (fun x => x.2.2) child
  dsimp only at reply trace
  unfold run
  dsimp only
  rw [reply,trace,NED_ValidatorStatus.source,bind_tc_ok,withdrawal]
  rfl

#print axioms validator
#print axioms transfer
#print axioms withdrawal
#print axioms transfer_result_state_effects
#print axioms withdrawal_result_state_effects
end NEU_BoxModel

import NEU_ReconstructAdopted
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEU_CallDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct aspis_statement.pool_v1
open NEU_ReconstructCore
inductive Call where
  | common : Auth → Candidate → Call
  | transfer : Common → payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 → Call
  | withdrawal : Common → payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 → Call

def calls (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) : List Call :=
  if a.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val+1=c.next_pair_index.val then
    if a.master.identity.asset_id=NDM_CohortReconstruction.requested request then
      .common a c :: (match request.public with
        | .PrivateTransfer p => [.transfer (common a c) p]
        | .Withdrawal p => [.withdrawal (common a c) p])
    else []
  else []

theorem reached_domains (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) :
    (∀ a' c', Call.common a' c' ∈ calls request a c → a'=a ∧ c'=c) ∧
    (∀ d p, Call.transfer d p ∈ calls request a c →
      d=common a c ∧ request.public=.PrivateTransfer p) ∧
    (∀ d p, Call.withdrawal d p ∈ calls request a c →
      d=common a c ∧ request.public=.Withdrawal p) := by
  unfold calls
  split
  · split
    · cases h : request.public <;> simp [h]
    · simp
  · simp

theorem common_packet (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) :
    NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon
      (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRawCommon (common a c)) = common a c :=
  NED_RawCarrierInverses.common _

theorem transfer_packet (c : Common) (p : payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1) :
    NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw
      (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.PrivateTransfer c p)) = .PrivateTransfer c p :=
  NED_RawCarrierInverses.statement _

theorem withdrawal_packet (c : Common) (p : payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1) :
    NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw
      (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.Withdrawal c p)) = .Withdrawal c p :=
  NED_RawCarrierInverses.statement _

def ReplyRange (s : NEU_BoxModel.Statement)
    (r : core.result.Result NEU_BoxModel.Statement NEU_BoxModel.ProgramError) : Prop :=
  r=.Ok s ∨ r=.Err .InvalidInstructionData

theorem transfer_reply_range (c : Common) (p : payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1) :
    ∃ r, r1_pool_adapter.transfer_statement_box c p=ok r ∧ ReplyRange (.PrivateTransfer c p) r := by
  refine ⟨NEU_BoxModel.wrap _ (NEU_BoxModel.status _),NEU_BoxModel.transfer c p,?_⟩
  cases NEU_BoxModel.status (.PrivateTransfer c p) <;> simp only [NEU_BoxModel.wrap,ReplyRange,or_true,true_or]

theorem withdrawal_reply_range (c : Common) (p : payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1) :
    ∃ r, r1_pool_adapter.withdrawal_statement_box c p=ok r ∧ ReplyRange (.Withdrawal c p) r := by
  refine ⟨NEU_BoxModel.wrap _ (NEU_BoxModel.status _),NEU_BoxModel.withdrawal c p,?_⟩
  cases NEU_BoxModel.status (.Withdrawal c p) <;> simp only [NEU_BoxModel.wrap,ReplyRange,or_true,true_or]

#print axioms reached_domains
#print axioms common_packet
#print axioms transfer_packet
#print axioms withdrawal_packet
#print axioms transfer_reply_range
#print axioms withdrawal_reply_range
end NEU_CallDomains

import NEU_PublicProjections

namespace NEU_CommonProjections
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open NEU_PublicProjections (get)
abbrev Common := AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1

def value (c : Common) (slot : Fin 15) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) : Nat :=
  match slot.val with
  | 0 => (get c.master_account j).val
  | 1 => (get c.checkpoint_account j).val
  | 2 => (get c.selected_lane_account j).val
  | 3 => c.output_lane.val
  | 4 => c.checkpoint_sequence.val
  | 5 => (get c.historical_global_anchor i).val
  | 6 => (get c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool j).val
  | 7 => (get c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain j).val
  | 8 => c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.sequence.val
  | 9 => c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val
  | 10 => (get c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.current_root i).val
  | 11 => (get (get c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.frontier k) i).val
  | 12 => c.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index.val
  | 13 => (get c.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root i).val
  | _ => (get (get c.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier k) i).val

/-- One arbitrary field/byte/word/frontier projection identifies the complete
nested common record. No unread positions are fixed to fixture values. -/
theorem common_ext (c d : Common)
    (point : ∀ slot i j k, value c slot i j k=value d slot i j k) : c=d := by
  have h0 : c.master_account=d.master_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h1 : c.checkpoint_account=d.checkpoint_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨1,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h2 : c.selected_lane_account=d.selected_lane_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨2,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h3 : c.output_lane=d.output_lane := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨3,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h4 : c.checkpoint_sequence=d.checkpoint_sequence := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨4,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h5 : c.historical_global_anchor=d.historical_global_anchor := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨5,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h6 : c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool=d.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨6,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h7 : c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain=d.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨7,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h8 : c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.sequence=d.lane_transition.live_snapshot.sequence := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨8,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h9 : c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index=d.lane_transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨9,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h10 : c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.current_root=d.lane_transition.live_snapshot.current_root := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨10,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h11 : c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.frontier=d.lane_transition.live_snapshot.frontier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro k
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨11,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ k
  have h12 : c.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index=d.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨12,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h13 : c.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root=d.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_root := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨13,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h14 : c.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier=d.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_frontier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro k
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨14,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ k
  cases c with
  | mk m0 ch0 sl0 l0 seq0 an0 lt0 =>
    cases lt0 with
    | mk live0 candidate0 =>
      cases live0
      cases candidate0
      cases d with
      | mk m1 ch1 sl1 l1 seq1 an1 lt1 =>
        cases lt1 with
        | mk live1 candidate1 =>
          cases live1
          cases candidate1
          simp_all only

import NEU_CommonProjections
import NEU_BoxDecodeModel
import NED_PaymentCohorts
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEU_DecoderProjections
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
abbrev Common := PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1
abbrev Transfer := NED_PaymentCohorts.T
abbrev Withdrawal := NED_PaymentCohorts.W

theorem common_ext (c d : Common)
    (point : ∀ slot i j k,
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) slot i j k =
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon d) slot i j k) : c=d := by
  have same := NEU_CommonProjections.common_ext _ _ point
  have back := congrArg NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRawCommon same
  simpa only [NED_ReconstructCarriers.common_roundtrip] using back

theorem transfer_ext (c d : Common) (p q : Transfer)
    (commonPoint : ∀ slot i j k,
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) slot i j k =
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon d) slot i j k)
    (publicPoint : ∀ slot i j,
      NEU_PublicProjections.transfer (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawTransfer p) slot i j =
      NEU_PublicProjections.transfer (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawTransfer q) slot i j) :
    (PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.PrivateTransfer c p) = .PrivateTransfer d q := by
  have hc := common_ext c d commonPoint
  have hp := NEU_PublicProjections.transfer_ext _ _ publicPoint
  have raw : NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw (.PrivateTransfer c p) =
      NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw (.PrivateTransfer d q) := by
    change AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.PrivateTransfer
      (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawTransfer p) =
      .PrivateTransfer (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon d) (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawTransfer q)
    rw [hc,hp]
  have back := congrArg NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw raw
  simpa only [NED_ReconstructCarriers.statement_roundtrip] using back

theorem withdrawal_ext (c d : Common) (p q : Withdrawal)
    (commonPoint : ∀ slot i j k,
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) slot i j k =
      NEU_CommonProjections.value (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon d) slot i j k)
    (publicPoint : ∀ slot i j,
      NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal p) slot i j =
      NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal q) slot i j) :
    (PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.Withdrawal c p) = .Withdrawal d q := by
  have hc := common_ext c d commonPoint
  have hp := NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal_ext _ _ publicPoint
  have raw : NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw (.Withdrawal c p) =
      NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw (.Withdrawal d q) := by
    change AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.Withdrawal
      (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal p) =
      .Withdrawal (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon d) (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal q)
    rw [hc,hp]
  have back := congrArg NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw raw
  simpa only [NED_ReconstructCarriers.statement_roundtrip] using back

theorem payment_packet (b : Array U8 216#usize) : b.to_slice.val.length=216 := b.property

#print axioms common_ext
#print axioms transfer_ext
#print axioms withdrawal_ext
#print axioms payment_packet
end NEU_DecoderProjections

import JHb_Emit
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEU_EmitModel
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
abbrev Statement := AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.Statement
abbrev Output := PoolV1PairForestTerminalResultV1
abbrev Error := PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
abbrev ProgramError := AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError
abbrev Bytes := Array U8 792#usize
abbrev derived := AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value

/-- One model execution with explicit full child Results and return-data state.
No arbitrary reply is assumed successful. This is not an op53 instance. -/
def run {A E : Type}
    (binding : Statement → Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes Error))
    (syscall : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E → List U8 →
      Result (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E))
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E) (s : Statement) :
    Result (core.result.Result (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E) ProgramError) := do
  let checked ← binding s (derived s)
  match checked with
  | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
  | .Ok () =>
    let encoded ← encode (derived s)
    match encoded with
    | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
    | .Ok bytes =>
      if bytes.val.length ≠ 792 then ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
      else if bytes.val.take 4 ≠ [65#u8,83#u8,82#u8,56#u8] then ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData)
      else do
        let state' ← syscall state bytes.val
        ok (.Ok state')

/-- The exact inner domains required at these two call sites, rather than a
uniform child bridge on unrelated records. They remain explicit hypotheses. -/
def BindingBridge (binding : Statement → Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error)) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, binding s (derived s) =
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1 s (derived s)
def EncoderBridge (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes Error)) : Prop :=
  ∀ s, encode (derived s) = encode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_v1 (derived s)

theorem result_state_effects {A E : Type}
    (binding : Statement → Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes Error))
    (bindingBridge : BindingBridge binding) (encoderBridge : EncoderBridge encode)
    (syscall : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E → List U8 →
      Result (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E))
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E) (s : Statement) :
    run binding encode syscall state s = AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source syscall state s := by
  unfold run AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source
  dsimp only
  rw [bindingBridge s, encoderBridge s]
  rfl

#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEU_EmitModel

import NEU_CallDomains
import NED_WindowExtensionality
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEU_PublicProjections
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation
abbrev Transfer := PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev Withdrawal := PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1

def get {α : Type} {n : Usize} (a : Array α n) (i : Fin n.val) : α :=
  a.val[i.val]'(by rw [a.property]; exact i.isLt)

def transfer (p : Transfer) (slot : Fin 8) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) : Nat :=
  match slot.val with
  | 0 => (get p.pool j).val
  | 1 => (get p.deployment_domain j).val
  | 2 => p.anchor_sequence.val
  | 3 => (get p.anchor_root i).val
  | 4 => (get p.nullifier i).val
  | 5 => p.asset_id.val
  | 6 => (get p.change_commitment i).val
  | _ => (get p.recipient_commitment i).val

def withdrawal (p : Withdrawal) (slot : Fin 9) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) : Nat :=
  match slot.val with
  | 0 => (get p.pool j).val
  | 1 => (get p.deployment_domain j).val
  | 2 => p.anchor_sequence.val
  | 3 => (get p.anchor_root i).val
  | 4 => (get p.nullifier i).val
  | 5 => p.asset_id.val
  | 6 => (get p.change_commitment i).val
  | 7 => p.amount.val
  | _ => (get p.destination_token_account j).val

/-- Arbitrary native scalar/byte/word observation identifies the ENTIRE public
record; no unobserved array positions are zeroed or assumed equal. -/
theorem transfer_ext (p q : Transfer)
    (point : ∀ slot i j, transfer p slot i j=transfer q slot i j) : p=q := by
  have pool : p.pool=q.pool := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  have deployment : p.deployment_domain=q.deployment_domain := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨1,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  have sequence : p.anchor_sequence=q.anchor_sequence := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨2,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have anchor : p.anchor_root=q.anchor_root := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨3,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have nullifier : p.nullifier=q.nullifier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨4,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have asset : p.asset_id=q.asset_id := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨5,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have change : p.change_commitment=q.change_commitment := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨6,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have recipient : p.recipient_commitment=q.recipient_commitment := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨7,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩
  cases p; cases q
  congr 1 <;> assumption

theorem withdrawal_ext (p q : Withdrawal)
    (point : ∀ slot i j, withdrawal p slot i j=withdrawal q slot i j) : p=q := by
  have pool : p.pool=q.pool := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  have deployment : p.deployment_domain=q.deployment_domain := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨1,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  have sequence : p.anchor_sequence=q.anchor_sequence := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨2,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have anchor : p.anchor_root=q.anchor_root := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨3,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have nullifier : p.nullifier=q.nullifier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨4,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have asset : p.asset_id=q.asset_id := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨5,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have change : p.change_commitment=q.change_commitment := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨6,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have amount : p.amount=q.amount := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨7,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have destination : p.destination_token_account=q.destination_token_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨8,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  cases p; cases q
  congr 1 <;> assumption

#print axioms transfer_ext
#print axioms withdrawal_ext
end NEU_PublicProjections

abbrev Auth := r1_pool_adapter.AuthenticatedAsq8Accounts
abbrev Candidate := NDM_CommonCarrier.Candidate

def run {State : Type} (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) (state : State) :=
  let observed := NEU_ReconstructCore.run (toRequest request)
    (toAuthenticatedAsq8Accounts a) (toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 c) state
  ((do let reply ← observed.1; ok (NDM_CohortStatement.transport reply)),observed.2.1,observed.2.2)

/-- Exact selected op52 source, full Result, external state and ordered child
trace. All constructor validator hypotheses are discharged in the model.
This needs the separate native certificates to become a composed root. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (request : Request) (a : Auth)
    (c : Candidate) (state : State) :
    run request a c state =
    (AspisR1.JHf_ReconstructionSlot.source request a c,state,
      NEU_ReconstructCore.trace (toRequest request) (toAuthenticatedAsq8Accounts a)
        (toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 c)) := by
  unfold run
  rw [NEU_ReconstructCore.result_state_effects]
  dsimp only
  unfold AspisR1.JHf_ReconstructionSlot.source
  cases call : AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.r1_pool_adapter.reconstruct_asq8_statement
    (toRequest request) (toAuthenticatedAsq8Accounts a) (toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 c) with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok reply => cases reply <;> rfl

#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEU_ReconstructAdopted

import NEU_BoxModel
import NDM_CohortReconstruction
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEU_ReconstructCore
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct aspis_statement.pool_v1
abbrev Request := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1
abbrev Auth := r1_pool_adapter.AuthenticatedAsq8Accounts
abbrev Candidate := pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1
abbrev Common := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1

def common (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) : Common :=
  { master_account := a.master_account, checkpoint_account := a.checkpoint_account,
    selected_lane_account := a.selected_lane_account, output_lane := a.selected_lane.lane_id,
    checkpoint_sequence := a.checkpoint.checkpoint_sequence,
    historical_global_anchor := a.checkpoint.global_root,
    lane_transition := {live_snapshot := a.live_snapshot, candidate_afterstate := c} }

theorem common_result (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) :
    r1_pool_adapter.asq8_common a c = ok (common a c) := rfl

def run {State : Type} (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) (state : State) :=
  if a.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val+1=c.next_pair_index.val then
    if a.master.identity.asset_id=NDM_CohortReconstruction.requested request then
      match request.public with
      | .PrivateTransfer p => NEU_BoxModel.run (.PrivateTransfer (common a c) p) state
      | .Withdrawal p => NEU_BoxModel.run (.Withdrawal (common a c) p) state
    else (ok (.Err solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidInstructionData),state,[])
  else (ok (.Err solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData),state,[])

def trace (request : Request) (a : Auth) (c : Candidate) :=
  if a.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val+1=c.next_pair_index.val then
    if a.master.identity.asset_id=NDM_CohortReconstruction.requested request then
      match request.public with
      | .PrivateTransfer p => (NED_ValidatorTrace.run
          (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.PrivateTransfer (common a c) p))).2
      | .Withdrawal p => (NED_ValidatorTrace.run
          (NED_ReconstructCarriers.fromRaw (.Withdrawal (common a c) p))).2
    else []
  else []

/-- Model composition at the exact source calls. Constructor child hypotheses
are discharged by NEU_BoxModel; native auth/common/Box associations remain
separate certificate obligations, never premises hidden in this theorem. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (request : Request) (a : Auth)
    (c : Candidate) (state : State) :
    run request a c state =
      (r1_pool_adapter.reconstruct_asq8_statement request a c,state,trace request a c) := by
  rw [NDM_CohortReconstruction.control]
  unfold run trace NDM_CohortReconstruction.direct
  by_cases gate : a.live_snapshot.next_pair_index.val+1=c.next_pair_index.val
  · simp only [if_pos gate]
    by_cases asset : a.master.identity.asset_id=NDM_CohortReconstruction.requested request
    · simp only [if_pos asset]
      unfold NDM_CohortReconstruction.finish
      rw [common_result,bind_tc_ok]
      cases h : request.public with
      | PrivateTransfer p => exact NEU_BoxModel.transfer_result_state_effects (common a c) p state
      | Withdrawal p => exact NEU_BoxModel.withdrawal_result_state_effects (common a c) p state
    · simp only [if_neg asset]
  · simp only [if_neg gate]

#print axioms common_result
#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEU_ReconstructCore

import NEU_EmitModel
import NEX_ReturnData
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEX_EmitRuntime
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open NEU_EmitModel
/-- Ruling (ab): this trace-bearing runtime instance adds RuntimeReturnData.
BindingBridge and EncoderBridge remain explicit native obligations. -/
theorem result_state_effects {A E : Type}
    (binding : Statement → Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit NEU_EmitModel.Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes NEU_EmitModel.Error))
    (bindingBridge : BindingBridge binding) (encoderBridge : EncoderBridge encode)
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E) (s : Statement) :
    run binding encode (fun st bytes => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st bytes)) state s =
    AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source (fun st bytes => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st bytes)) state s :=
  NEU_EmitModel.result_state_effects binding encode bindingBridge encoderBridge _ state s

/-- Exact event position and no later write in the successful modeled path.
The native root association and native children are not supplied by this law. -/
theorem success {A E : Type}
    (binding : Statement → Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit NEU_EmitModel.Error))
    (encode : Output → Result (core.result.Result Bytes NEU_EmitModel.Error))
    (state : AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.State A E) (s : Statement) (bytes : Bytes)
    (hb : binding s (derived s) = ok (.Ok ()))
    (he : encode (derived s) = ok (.Ok bytes))
    (header : bytes.val.take 4 = [65#u8,83#u8,82#u8,56#u8]) :
    run binding encode (fun st raw => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st raw)) state s =
    ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set state bytes.val)) := by
  unfold run
  rw [hb]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [he]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  have hlen : bytes.val.length = 792 := bytes.property
  simp only [hlen, header, ne_eq, not_true_eq_false, ite_false, bind_tc_ok]

#print axioms result_state_effects
#print axioms success
end NEX_EmitRuntime

    decode_transfer_statement_boxed_v1 decode_withdrawal_statement_boxed_v1
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes
  match reply with
  | .Ok value => ok (.Ok (AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 value))
  | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)

/-- Endpoint is the coherent installed codec (op47), not a fresh decoder model.
The terminal child and carrier laws are reused. Native forwarding/Box evidence
must independently supply the ruling-(y)/(aa) part of the hybrid certificate. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Slice U8) (state : State) :

  | div => simp only [run,AspisS6OuterNativeOps.resultMap,bind_tc_div]
  | ok reply => cases reply <;> simp only [run,AspisS6OuterNativeOps.resultMap,AspisS6CurrentCodecInstallation.mapBoth,bind_tc_ok]

import JHb_S2K_ResultBinding
import NBN_LateFactor
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEY_BindingContinuation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
open AspisR1.S2K
abbrev Statement := StatementAdmission.Statement
abbrev Output := ResultAdmission.Output
abbrev Error := PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1

def run (sv : Statement → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
    (rv : Output → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error)) (s : Statement) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit Error) := do
  let first ← sv s
  match first with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok () => rv (ResultAdmission.value s)

/-- Total continuation on the caller-derived result. Neither validator success
is a premise; the complete first and second Results are preserved in order. -/
theorem result (s : Statement) :
    run validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 validate_result s =
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1 s
      (ResultAdmission.value s) := by
  unfold run validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1
  apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
  intro first
  cases first with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok unit =>
    cases unit
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok]
    cases step : validate_result (ResultAdmission.value s) with
    | fail e => simp only [step,bind_tc_fail]
    | div => simp only [step,bind_tc_div]
    | ok second =>
      simp only [step,bind_tc_ok]
      cases second with
      | Err e => rfl
      | Ok unit =>
       cases unit
       simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok]
       cases s <;> simp [ResultAdmission.value,ResultAdmission.kind,
        StatementAdmission.common,StatementChecks.nullifier,
        PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common,
        PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.transition_kind,
        PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.nullifier,
        core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default,core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.default,
        pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqPoolV1TransitionKind.eq,
        ResultBinding.byte_array_ne_self,ResultBinding.digest_ne_self,ResultBinding.afterstate_self]

#print axioms result
end NEY_BindingContinuation

import NEY_BindingContinuation
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEY_BindingSuccess
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
open NEY_BindingContinuation

theorem first_success (s : Statement)
    (accepted : run validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 validate_result s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  unfold run at accepted
  cases first : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s with
  | fail e => simp only [first,bind_tc_fail] at accepted; cases accepted
  | div => simp only [first,bind_tc_div] at accepted; cases accepted
  | ok outcome =>
    cases outcome with
    | Err e => simp only [first,bind_tc_ok] at accepted; cases accepted
    | Ok unit => cases unit; rfl

/-- Successful binding certifies its statement child on the SAME root input.
This supplies the encoder's reached accepted-statement domain, never a stronger
unproved precondition on emit_result. -/
theorem binding_success (s : Statement)
    (accepted : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1 s
      (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.value s) = ok (.Ok ())) :
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  apply first_success s
  rw [NEY_BindingContinuation.result]
  exact accepted

#print axioms first_success
#print axioms binding_success
end NEY_BindingSuccess

import NEX_EmitRuntime
import NEY_BindingSuccess
import NEY_ResultEncoderOracle
import JHb_S2K_ResultPayload
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEY_EmitComposed
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal
open NEU_EmitModel

def encode (record : Output) : Result (core.result.Result Bytes NEU_EmitModel.Error) :=
  NEY_ResultEncoderOracle.run validate_result atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 record

theorem encoder_bridge : EncoderBridge encode := by
  intro s
  exact congrArg (fun value => value.1)
    (NEY_ResultEncoderOracle.result_state_effects (derived s) ())

/-- This reached path condition is derived from binding success on the SAME
statement. It is not a root precondition or a free callee-domain hypothesis. -/
theorem reached_encoder (s : Statement)
    (accepted : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1 s
      (derived s)=ok (.Ok ())) :
    validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s=ok (.Ok ()) ∧
    encode (derived s)=ok (.Ok (AspisR1.S2K.ResultPayload.bytes s)) := by
  have valid := NEY_BindingSuccess.binding_success s accepted
  refine ⟨valid,?_⟩

call domains and exact ordered return-data arguments require their independent
checked certificates. RuntimeReturnData is ADDED trust under ruling(ab). -/

    run validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_against_statement_v1 encode

    AspisR1.JHb_Emit.source (fun st bytes => ok (AspisR1.S2I.ReturnData.set st bytes)) state s :=
  NEX_EmitRuntime.result_state_effects _ encode (fun _ => rfl) encoder_bridge state s

import JHb_S2K_ResultWholeNative
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEY_ResultEncoderOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev Record := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalResultV1
abbrev Error := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
abbrev After := pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1
abbrev AfterError := pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifierTransportErrorV1
def run
  (validate : Record → Result (core.result.Result Unit Error))
  (digest : Array AspisR1TerminalDecoder.aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize → Result (Array U8 32#usize))
  (after : After → Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 688#usize) AfterError))
  (result : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalResultV1) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Array Std.U8 792#usize)
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
  := do
  let r ← validate result
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
    let output := Array.repeat 792#usize 0#u8
    let (s, index_mut_back) ←
      core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output
        { «end» := 4#usize }
    let s1 ←
      lift (Array.to_slice
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_RESULT_MAGIC)
    let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
    let output1 := index_mut_back s2
    let output2 ←
      Array.update output1 4#usize
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION
    let i := read_discriminant result.transition_kind
    let i1 ← lift (UScalar.cast .U8 i)
    let output3 ← Array.update output2 5#usize i1
    let output4 ←
      Array.update output3 6#usize
        pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
    let output5 ← Array.update output4 7#usize result.output_lane
    let (s3, index_mut_back1) ←
      core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output5
        {
          start := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.RESULT_MASTER_OFFSET,
          «end» := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.RESULT_SELECTED_LANE_OFFSET
        }
    let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice result.master_account)
    let s5 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s3 s4
    let output6 := index_mut_back1 s5
    let (s6, index_mut_back2) ←
      core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output6
        {
          start := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.RESULT_SELECTED_LANE_OFFSET,
          «end» := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.RESULT_NULLIFIER_OFFSET
        }
    let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice result.selected_lane_account)
    let s8 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s6 s7
    let output7 := index_mut_back2 s8
    let (s9, index_mut_back3) ←
      core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output7
        {
          start := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.RESULT_NULLIFIER_OFFSET,
          «end» := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.RESULT_AFTERSTATE_OFFSET
        }
    let a ← digest result.nullifier
    let s10 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
    let s11 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s9 s10
    let output8 := index_mut_back3 s11
    let (s12, index_mut_back4) ←
      core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output8
        { start := pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.RESULT_AFTERSTATE_OFFSET }
    let r1 ←
      after result.verified_afterstate
    let r2 ←
      core.result.Result.map_err
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_v1.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairVerifierTransportErrorV1PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
        r1 ()
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
      let s13 ← lift (Array.to_slice val)
      let s14 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s12 s13
      let output9 := index_mut_back4 s14
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok output9)
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        (Array Std.U8 792#usize) (core.convert.FromSame
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
        residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (Array Std.U8 792#usize) (core.convert.FromSame
      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
      residual

/-- Exact emitted-body substitution, including both error branches. Native
window/child-domain/frame certificates remain separate obligations. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (record : Record) (state : State) :
    (run pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_result
      atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical
      pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 record,
      state,([] : List Unit)) =
    (pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_result_v1 record,
      state,[]) := by rfl
#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEY_ResultEncoderOracle

NFD_EmitProjection.source:
import NEY_EmitComposed
import NEU_PublicProjections
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFD_EmitProjection
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open NEU_EmitModel
open NEU_PublicProjections (get)
def kindCode : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind → Nat
  | .PrivateTransfer => 1 | .Withdrawal => 2

def project (r : Output) (slot : Fin 8) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) : Nat :=
  match slot.val with
  | 0 => kindCode r.transition_kind
  | 1 => (get r.master_account j).val
  | 2 => (get r.selected_lane_account j).val
  | 3 => r.output_lane.val
  | 4 => (get r.nullifier i).val
  | 5 => r.verified_afterstate.next_pair_index.val
  | 6 => (get r.verified_afterstate.next_root i).val
  | _ => (get (get r.verified_afterstate.next_frontier k) i).val

theorem complete (a b : Output)
    (point : ∀ slot i j k, project a slot i j k=project b slot i j k) : a=b := by
  have h0 : a.transition_kind=b.transition_kind := by
    have h := point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
    cases ha : a.transition_kind <;> cases hb : b.transition_kind <;>
      simp_all [project,kindCode]
  have h1 : a.master_account=b.master_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨1,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h2 : a.selected_lane_account=b.selected_lane_account := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨2,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h3 : a.output_lane=b.output_lane := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨3,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h4 : a.nullifier=b.nullifier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨4,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h5 : a.verified_afterstate.next_pair_index=b.verified_afterstate.next_pair_index := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨5,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h6 : a.verified_afterstate.next_root=b.verified_afterstate.next_root := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨6,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
  have h7 : a.verified_afterstate.next_frontier=b.verified_afterstate.next_frontier := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro k
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro i
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨7,by decide⟩ i ⟨0,by decide⟩ k
  cases a with
  | mk ak am asl al an aa =>
    cases aa
    cases b with
    | mk bk bm bsl bl bn ba =>
      cases ba
      simp_all only

theorem alignment0 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨0,by decide⟩ i j k = kindCode (AspisR1.S2K.ResultAdmission.kind s) := rfl
theorem alignment1 (s : Statement) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) (k : Fin 20) :
    project (derived s) ⟨1,by decide⟩ i j k = (get (AspisR1.S2K.StatementAdmission.common s).master_account j).val := rfl

import NFD_RequestOracle
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFD_RequestDomains
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev Request := AspisR20Request.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1

theorem payment_length (bytes : Array U8 320#usize) :
    (bytes.val.drop 104).length = 216 := by
  rw [List.length_drop,bytes.property]
  rfl

theorem binding_fields (p : Request) :
    (AspisR1.JHd_RequestCarrier.request p).verifier_profile = p.verifier_profile ∧
    (AspisR1.JHd_RequestCarrier.request p).verifier_release = p.verifier_release ∧
    (AspisR1.JHd_RequestCarrier.request p).pool_program = p.pool_program ∧
    (AspisR1.JHd_RequestCarrier.request p).«public» =
      AspisR1.JHd_RequestCarrier.payment p.«public» := ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl⟩

/-- No canonical restriction is added at the parser boundary: a payment decoder
receives exactly the216-byte suffix and establishes its own validation. -/
theorem payment_window (bytes : Array U8 320#usize) :
    (do let s ← core.array.Array.index
          (core.ops.index.IndexSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
          bytes {start:=104#usize,«end»:=320#usize}
        core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from 216#usize core.marker.CopyU8 s) =
    ok (.Ok (NBP_Read.chunk (W:=216#usize) bytes 104 (by decide))) :=
  NED_RequestReadWindows.payment bytes

theorem wrong_length (bytes : Slice U8) (bad : bytes.val.length ≠ 320) :
    NFD_RequestOracle.runSlice bytes = ok (.Err AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongLength) := by
  simp [NFD_RequestOracle.runSlice,core.array.TryFromSharedArraySlice.try_from,Slice.len,Slice.length,bad]

#print axioms wrong_length
#print axioms payment_length
#print axioms binding_fields
#print axioms payment_window
end NFD_RequestDomains

import JHd_RequestNative
import NED_RequestReadWindows
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFD_RequestOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR20Request
def run
  (transfer : Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError))
  (withdrawal : Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError))
  (bytes : Array Std.U8 320#usize) :
  Result (core.result.Result
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalRequestV1
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
  := do
  let s ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
  let i := Slice.len s
  let i1 ←
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_REQUEST_BYTES
  if i != i1
  then
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongLength)
  else
    let s1 ←
      core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8)) bytes
        { «end» := 4#usize }
    let b ←
      Slice.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8 s1
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_REQUEST_MAGIC
    if b
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongMagic)
    else
      let i2 ← Array.index_usize bytes 4#usize
      if i2 !=
        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION
      then
        ok (core.result.Result.Err
          pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongVersion)
      else
        let i3 ← Array.index_usize bytes 5#usize
        let r ← pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.transition_kind i3
        let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
        match cf with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
          let i4 ← Array.index_usize bytes 6#usize
          if i4 != pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
          then
            ok (core.result.Result.Err
              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongDigestEncoding)
          else
            let i5 ← Array.index_usize bytes 7#usize
            if i5 != 0#u8
            then
              ok (core.result.Result.Err
                pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.NonZeroBinding)
            else
              match val with
              | pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind.PrivateTransfer
                =>
                let s2 ←
                  core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
                    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8))
                    bytes
                    {
                      start :=
                        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.REQUEST_PAYMENT_OFFSET
                    }
                let r1 ←
                  transfer
                    s2
                let r2 ←
                  core.result.Result.map_err
                    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_request_reference_v1.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PaymentStatementFormatErrorPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
                    r1 ()
                let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
                match cf1 with
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
                  let s3 ←
                    core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
                      (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8))
                      bytes
                      {
                        start :=
                          pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.REQUEST_PROFILE_OFFSET,
                        «end» :=
                          pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.REQUEST_RELEASE_OFFSET
                      }
                  let r3 ←
                    core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from 32#usize
                      core.marker.CopyU8 s3
                  let r4 ←
                    core.result.Result.map_err
                      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_request_reference_v1.closure_2.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleTryFromSliceErrorPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
                      r3 ()
                  let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
                  match cf2 with
                  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 =>
                    let s4 ←
                      core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
                        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8))
                        bytes
                        {
                          start :=
                            pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.REQUEST_RELEASE_OFFSET,
                          «end» :=
                            pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.REQUEST_POOL_PROGRAM_OFFSET
                        }
                    let r5 ←
                      core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from 32#usize
                        core.marker.CopyU8 s4
                    let r6 ←
                      core.result.Result.map_err
                        pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_request_reference_v1.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleTryFromSliceErrorPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
                        r5 ()
                    let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r6
                    match cf3 with
                    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val3 =>
                      let s5 ←
                        core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
                          (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8))
                          bytes
                          {
                            start :=
                              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.REQUEST_POOL_PROGRAM_OFFSET,
                            «end» :=
                              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.REQUEST_PAYMENT_OFFSET
                          }
                      let r7 ←
                        core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from 32#usize
                          core.marker.CopyU8 s5
                      let r8 ←
                        core.result.Result.map_err
                          pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_request_reference_v1.closure_4.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTupleTryFromSliceErrorPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
                          r7 ()
                      let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r8
                      match cf4 with
                      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val4 =>
                        let a := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
                        let b1 ←
                          core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq
                            core.cmp.PartialEqU8 val2 a
                        if b1
                        then
                          ok (core.result.Result.Err
                            pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.NonZeroBinding)
                        else
                          let a1 := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
                          let b2 ←
                            core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq
                              core.cmp.PartialEqU8 val3 a1
                          if b2
                          then
                            ok (core.result.Result.Err
                              pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.NonZeroBinding)
                          else
                            let a2 := Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8
                            let b3 ←

import NFD_RequestDomains
import NEU_PublicProjections
import JHf_Carrier2
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFD_RequestProjection
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open NEU_PublicProjections (get)
abbrev Request := NFD_RequestDomains.Request
abbrev T := AspisR20Request.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev W := AspisR20Request.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1

def toT (p : T) : NEU_PublicProjections.Transfer :=
  AspisR1.JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 (AspisR1.JHd_RequestCarrier.privateTransfer p)
def toW (p : W) : NEU_PublicProjections.Withdrawal :=
  AspisR1.JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 (AspisR1.JHd_RequestCarrier.withdrawal p)
def fromT (p : NEU_PublicProjections.Transfer) : T :=
  ⟨p.pool,p.deployment_domain,p.anchor_sequence,p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,p.asset_id,p.recipient_commitment,p.change_commitment⟩
def fromW (p : NEU_PublicProjections.Withdrawal) : W :=
  ⟨p.pool,p.deployment_domain,p.anchor_sequence,p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,p.asset_id,p.amount,p.destination_token_account,p.change_commitment⟩
theorem transfer_roundtrip (p : T) : fromT (toT p)=p := rfl
theorem withdrawal_roundtrip (p : W) : fromW (toW p)=p := rfl

def project (s : Request) (slot : Fin 14) (i : Fin 8) (j : Fin 32) : Nat :=
  if h0 : slot.val=0 then (get s.verifier_profile j).val else
  if h1 : slot.val=1 then (get s.verifier_release j).val else
  if h2 : slot.val=2 then (get s.pool_program j).val else
  match s.«public» with
  | .PrivateTransfer p =>
    if h3 : slot.val=3 then 1 else
    if h : slot.val<12 then NEU_PublicProjections.transfer (toT p) ⟨slot.val-4,by omega⟩ i j else 0
  | .Withdrawal p =>
    if h3 : slot.val=3 then 2 else
    if h : slot.val<11 then NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (toW p) ⟨slot.val-4,by omega⟩ i j else
    if slot.val=12 then NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (toW p) ⟨7,by decide⟩ i j else
    if slot.val=13 then NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal (toW p) ⟨8,by decide⟩ i j else 0

theorem complete (a b : Request)
    (point : ∀ slot i j, project a slot i j=project b slot i j) : a=b := by
  have hp : a.verifier_profile=b.verifier_profile := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  have hr : a.verifier_release=b.verifier_release := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨1,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  have hb : a.pool_program=b.pool_program := by
    apply NED_WindowExtensionality.array_ext
    intro j
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact point ⟨2,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ j
  have pub : a.«public»=b.«public» := by
    cases ha : a.«public» with
    | PrivateTransfer p =>
      cases hq : b.«public» with
      | PrivateTransfer q =>
        have raw : toT p=toT q := by
          apply NEU_PublicProjections.transfer_ext
          intro slot i j
          have h := point ⟨slot.val+4,by omega⟩ i j
          simpa [project,ha,hq,show slot.val+4≠0 by omega,show slot.val+4≠1 by omega,
            show slot.val+4≠2 by omega,show slot.val+4≠3 by omega,show slot.val+4<12 by omega] using h
        have same := congrArg fromT raw
        simpa only [transfer_roundtrip] using congrArg AspisR20Request.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalPaymentV1.PrivateTransfer same
      | Withdrawal q =>
        have h := point ⟨3,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
        simp [project,ha,hq] at h
    | Withdrawal p =>
      cases hq : b.«public» with
      | PrivateTransfer q =>
        have h := point ⟨3,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩ ⟨0,by decide⟩
        simp [project,ha,hq] at h
      | Withdrawal q =>
        have raw : toW p=toW q := by
          apply NEU_PublicProjections.withdrawal_ext
          intro slot i j
          by_cases small : slot.val<7
          · have h := point ⟨slot.val+4,by omega⟩ i j
            simpa [project,ha,hq,show slot.val+4≠0 by omega,show slot.val+4≠1 by omega,
              show slot.val+4≠2 by omega,show slot.val+4≠3 by omega,show slot.val+4<11 by omega] using h
          · by_cases seven : slot.val=7
            · have eq : slot=⟨7,by decide⟩ := Fin.ext seven
              subst slot
              simpa [project,ha,hq] using point ⟨12,by decide⟩ i j
            · have eq : slot=⟨8,by decide⟩ := Fin.ext (by change slot.val=8;omega)
              subst slot
              simpa [project,ha,hq] using point ⟨13,by decide⟩ i j
        have same := congrArg fromW raw
        simpa only [withdrawal_roundtrip] using congrArg AspisR20Request.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalPaymentV1.Withdrawal same
  cases a;cases b
  congr 1 <;> assumption

#print axioms transfer_roundtrip
#print axioms withdrawal_roundtrip
#print axioms complete
end NFD_RequestProjection

import JHf_Scan
import NEU_EqualityLoop
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFD_ScanConditional
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder pool_v1.pair_terminal
/-- OPEN native/compiler/library obligation: the reached 688-byte comparison
must agree with bytewise equality on the SAME two live buffers. -/
def NativeEqualityAssociation (equality : List U8 → List U8 → Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ left right, equality left right = decide (left=right)

def run (equality : List U8 → List U8 → Bool) (bytes : Slice U8) : Result (core.result.Result
    AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.ScannedAsqaProof AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError) := do
  let expected ← lift (Usize.checked_add 688#usize 57607#usize)
  match expected with
  | none=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
  | some size=>
    if Slice.len bytes != size then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else do
      let header ← core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
        bytes {start:=0#usize,«end»:=688#usize}
      let decoded ← decode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 header
      match decoded with
      | .Err _=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
      | .Ok candidate=>
        let encoded ← encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 candidate
        match encoded with
        | .Err _=>ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)
        | .Ok encoded=>
          if equality encoded.val header.val = false then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else do
            let tag ← Slice.index_usize bytes 696#usize
            if tag != 2#u8 then ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData) else
              ok (.Ok ⟨AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.fromPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1 candidate,57607#usize⟩)

/-- Conditional root MODEL theorem. The named equality bridge is explicitly
retained, so this is not a CLOSED native root certificate. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Slice U8) (state : State)
    (equality : List U8 → List U8 → Bool)
    (nativeEqualityBridge : NativeEqualityAssociation equality) :
    (run equality bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =
    (AspisR1.JHf_Scan.source bytes,state,[]) := by
  unfold NativeEqualityAssociation at nativeEqualityBridge
  unfold run AspisR1.JHf_Scan.source
  simp only [nativeEqualityBridge,decide_eq_false_iff_not,bne_iff_ne]
  rfl

#print axioms result_state_effects
#print axioms NEU_EqualityLoop.prefix_exact
#print axioms NEU_EqualityLoop.step_invariant
end NFD_ScanConditional
