import NFH_ComparisonBoundary
import NFD_ScanConditional
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFH_ComparisonDomain
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std
open NFH_ComparisonBoundary

/-- Only the reached688-byte domain is proposed for runtime certification. -/
def At688Law (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ left right, left.length = 688 → right.length = 688 →
    ZeroLaw left right (reply left right)

/-- Mathematical completion outside the native call domain. It has no native
credit: the caller must separately establish both actual buffer lengths. -/
def complete688 (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int) (left right : List U8) : Bool :=
  if left.length = 688 ∧ right.length = 688 then decide (reply left right = 0)
  else NEU_EqualityLoop.equalBytes left right

theorem complete688_on_domain (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int)
    (left right : List U8) (leftSize : left.length = 688)
    (rightSize : right.length = 688) :
    complete688 reply left right = decide (reply left right = 0) := by
  simp only [complete688,leftSize,rightSize,and_self,if_true]

/-- Conditional interface conversion, not discharge of At688Law and not a
scanner theorem. No runtime fact about other lengths is assumed. -/
theorem complete688_association (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int)
    (runtime688Law : At688Law reply) :
    NFD_ScanConditional.NativeEqualityAssociation (complete688 reply) := by
  intro left right
  have loop : NEU_EqualityLoop.equalBytes left right = decide (left = right) :=
    congrArg Prod.fst (NEU_EqualityLoop.prefix_frame left right ())
  unfold complete688
  split
  next sizes =>
    rw [reply_eq_loop left right (reply left right)
      (runtime688Law left right sizes.1 sizes.2)]
    exact loop
  next => exact loop

#print axioms complete688_on_domain
#print axioms complete688_association
end NFH_ComparisonDomain

namespace NFJ_Comparison

/-- RuntimeMemcmp (ac), ADDED trust, pending owner confirmation.
Only the zero law for the SAME two retained 688-byte ranges is consumed here.
Normal return, result-slot identity and the observable frame are the separate
native forwarding certificate and the explicitly named runtime row. -/
abbrev RuntimeMemcmp := NFH_ComparisonDomain.At688Law

def header (bytes : List U8) : List U8 := bytes.take 688

theorem header_length (bytes : List U8) (acceptedLength : bytes.length = 58295) :
    (header bytes).length = 688 := by
  simp only [header,List.length_take,acceptedLength]

theorem same_buffer_lengths (bytes : List U8) (acceptedLength : bytes.length = 58295)
    (encoded : Array U8 688#usize) :

  ⟨encoded.property,header_length bytes acceptedLength⟩

/-- This applies the 688-only law AFTER establishing both SAME buffer lengths;
it never asserts a runtime law for another length. -/
theorem nativeEqualityBridge (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int)
    (runtimeMemcmp : RuntimeMemcmp reply) (bytes : List U8)
    (acceptedLength : bytes.length = 58295) (encoded : Array U8 688#usize) :
    decide (reply encoded.val (header bytes) = 0) =
      NFH_ComparisonDomain.complete688 reply encoded.val (header bytes) := by
  exact (NFH_ComparisonDomain.complete688_on_domain reply encoded.val (header bytes)
    (same_buffer_lengths bytes acceptedLength encoded).1
    (same_buffer_lengths bytes acceptedLength encoded).2).symm

/-- Equal and unequal branches use exactly the slot's zero observation. -/
theorem slot_zero_iff (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int)
    (runtimeMemcmp : RuntimeMemcmp reply) (bytes : List U8)
    (acceptedLength : bytes.length = 58295) (encoded : Array U8 688#usize) :
    reply encoded.val (header bytes) = 0 ↔ encoded.val = header bytes := by
  exact runtimeMemcmp encoded.val (header bytes) encoded.property
    (header_length bytes acceptedLength)

/-- The mathematical completion supplies the old universal MODEL interface;
only nativeEqualityBridge above licenses native use on the reached domain. -/
theorem completion (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int)
    (runtimeMemcmp : RuntimeMemcmp reply) :
    NFD_ScanConditional.NativeEqualityAssociation
      (NFH_ComparisonDomain.complete688 reply) :=
  NFH_ComparisonDomain.complete688_association reply runtimeMemcmp

#print axioms header_length
#print axioms same_buffer_lengths
#print axioms nativeEqualityBridge
#print axioms slot_zero_iff
#print axioms completion
end NFJ_Comparison

import NFJ_Comparison
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NFJ_Scanner
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Mathematical execution model; completion is used only off the native
688-byte call domain. RuntimeMemcmp(ac) is explicitly retained as ADDED trust. -/
def run (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int) (bytes : Slice U8) :=
  NFD_ScanConditional.run (NFH_ComparisonDomain.complete688 reply) bytes

/-- Scanner root MODEL theorem. Native forwarding and CLOSED callee packets
supply the separate ruling-(y) hybrid source link. No inner callee bridge,
PacketDomain or PhysicalInterpretation hypothesis is introduced here. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Slice U8) (state : State)
    (reply : List U8 → List U8 → Int)
    (runtimeMemcmp : NFJ_Comparison.RuntimeMemcmp reply) :
    (run reply bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =
    (AspisR1.JHf_Scan.source bytes,state,[]) :=
  NFD_ScanConditional.result_state_effects bytes state _
    (NFJ_Comparison.completion reply runtimeMemcmp)

/-- The successful encode carrier, including arbitrary error replies before
it is reached, has exactly the native fixed-array width. -/
theorem encode_domain (encoded : Array U8 688#usize) :
    encoded.to_slice.val.length = 688 := encoded.property

/-- Same reached decode range: no independent bytes or success witness. -/
theorem decode_domain (bytes : List U8) (length : bytes.length = 58295) :
    (NFJ_Comparison.header bytes).length = 688 :=
  NFJ_Comparison.header_length bytes length

/-- The only tag call is S2; the adopted source continuation tests byte696
against2. The native callsite uses the CLOSED Variant::tag packet. -/
theorem tag_domain (tag : U8) :
    (tag != 2#u8) = false ↔ tag = 2#u8 := by
  simp

#print axioms result_state_effects
#print axioms encode_domain
#print axioms decode_domain
#print axioms tag_domain
end NFJ_Scanner

import ClaimsUnrolledFinish

/-! Safe owned-reference std interpretation. The reserve result is the existing
allocator outcome, not an assumption of successful Claims. This module proves
value content laws only; P6 must connect shipped unsafe construction to this
reference before any native ledger row can be removed. -/

def calls (reservation : Reservation) : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls where
  reserve := fun _ before _ => ok (reservation,before)
  intoBox := fun _ before => ok before.deref

theorem reserve_contents (reservation : Reservation) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (n : Usize) (result : Reservation)
    (after : alloc.vec.Vec T)
    (returned : (calls reservation).reserve A before n = ok (result,after)) :
    after = before ∧ result = reservation := by
  cases returned
  exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

theorem box_contents (reservation : Reservation) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (after : Slice T)
    (returned : (calls reservation).intoBox A before = ok after) :
    after.val = before.val := by
  cases returned
  rfl

theorem returning_nonvacuity {T : Type} (A : Type) (before : alloc.vec.Vec T)
    (n : Usize) :
    (calls (.Ok ())).reserve A before n = ok (.Ok (),before) ∧
    (calls (.Ok ())).intoBox A before = ok before.deref := ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

theorem error_contents (error : ReserveError) {T : Type} (A : Type)
    (before : alloc.vec.Vec T) (n : Usize) :
    (calls (.Err error)).reserve A before n = ok (.Err error,before) := rfl

#print axioms returning_nonvacuity

no separate returned Variant; this names its successful S2 header component. -/
def frozenHeader (stored : AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames.Bytes) : Option transport.Variant :=
  if OraclePortHeader.accepts stored then some .S2 else none

/-- The same f,s and stored proof carrier from accepted_pair_claims. No second
execution, newly selected cut or whole-parser success is a premise. -/
theorem same_cut_header (adapterOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (ops : Ops)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    (std : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls)
    (accounts1 accounts2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (f : FirstCut) (s : SecondCut)
    (cuts : SourceCuts (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps adapterOps (install ops) B std)
      accounts1 accounts2 saved f s) :
    (RowShape_InstalledSlots.verifierOps (install ops) B std).op3 f.proof = ok (.Ok .S2) ∧
    sourceBody f.proof = ok (.Ok .S2) ∧
    OraclePortHeader.accepts (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf f.proof.val) = true ∧
    frozenHeader (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf f.proof.val) = some .S2 := by
  have tx := AspisS6CurrentFirstInstallation.current_success
    (RowShape_InstalledSlots.verifierOps (install ops) B std) _
    f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split () saved
    (AspisS6CurrentStage1CodecJoin.first_success
      (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps adapterOps (install ops) B std)
      f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split saved cuts.first)
  obtain ⟨_,variant,zero,prepared,scratch,shape,_⟩ :=
    Tx1Reachability.tx1_success _ _ _ f.pub f.proof f.split () saved tx
  have call : sourceBody f.proof = ok (.Ok variant) := shape
  obtain ⟨rfl,header⟩ := header_of_success f.proof variant call
  exact ⟨shape,call,header,by simp only [frozenHeader,header,if_true]⟩

lemma proves no source scan/op4, semanticRows or transcript alignment law. -/

    (headerCall : sourceBody proof = ok (.Ok variant))

    (scan : OraclePortCompactDraft.scan (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf proof.val))
    (rows : OraclePortCompactDraft.semanticRows 27 0
      (OraclePortCompactDraft.slice (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf proof.val) 48 6983) = some semantic)
    (aligned : OraclePortCompactDraft.Aligned
      ⟨MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf proof.val,semantic⟩ tr) :
    OraclePortStoredParserC4.parseReached (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf proof.val) tr =
      some ⟨MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf proof.val,semantic⟩ :=
  OraclePortStoredParserC4.parse_of_parts _ _ _

import Op3I_ParseLaws

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.Op3I_Install
open AspisR1CurrentCaller

def currentVariant : Op3I_Source.transport.Variant → transport.Variant
  | .S1 => .S1 | .S2 => .S2 | .D => .D

def currentError : Op3I_Source.verifier.Error → verifier.Error
  | .Parse => .Parse | .Semantic => .Semantic | .Transcript => .Transcript
  | .Relation => .Relation | .Merkle => .Merkle | .Query => .Query
  | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint | .Allocation => .Allocation

/-- Concrete existing Aeneas emission, with total pure-library implementations
and nominal carrier transport only. No caller success is built into the body. -/
def sourceBody (proof : Slice U8) : Result (core.result.Result transport.Variant verifier.Error) := do
  let r ← Op3I_Source.verifier.candidate.parse_shape Op3I_Std.ops proof
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (currentError e))
  | .Ok v => ok (.Ok (currentVariant v))

def install (ops : Ops) : Ops := {ops with op3 := sourceBody}

theorem zero_tail (xs : List U8) (h : xs.any (fun x => x != 0#u8) = false) :
    xs = List.replicate xs.length 0#u8 := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp only [List.any_cons,Bool.or_eq_false_iff] at h
    have hx : x = 0#u8 := by simpa using h.1
    simpa only [List.length_cons,List.replicate_succ,hx] using
      congrArg (List.cons 0#u8) (ih h.2)

theorem header_of_success (proof : Slice U8) (variant : transport.Variant)
    (success : sourceBody proof = ok (.Ok variant)) :
    variant = .S2 ∧ OraclePortHeader.accepts (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf proof.val) = true := by
  unfold sourceBody at success
  obtain ⟨result,call,success⟩ := Op3I_ParseLaws.bind_success _ _ _ success
  cases result with
  | Err e => cases success
  | Ok v =>
    obtain ⟨variant2,length,magic,tag,tail⟩ := Op3I_ParseLaws.source_success proof v call
    subst v
    cases success
    refine ⟨rfl,(OraclePortHeader.accepts_iff _).mpr ?_⟩
    have zeros := zero_tail ((proof.val.drop 9).take 7) tail
    have tailLength : ((proof.val.drop 9).take 7).length = 7 := by
      simp only [List.length_take,List.length_drop,length]
      decide
    rw [tailLength] at zeros
    refine ⟨?_,?_,?_,?_⟩
    · simpa only [MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf,List.length_map] using length
    · unfold MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf
      rw [← List.map_take,magic]
      simp only [Op3I_Source.compact.MAGIC,OraclePortHeader.magic]
      rfl
    · unfold MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf
      rw [List.getElem?_map,tag]
      rfl
    · unfold MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf
      rw [← List.map_drop,← List.map_take,zeros,List.map_replicate]
      rfl

theorem installed_slot (ops : Ops)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    (std : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls) :
    (RowShape_InstalledSlots.verifierOps (install ops) B std).op3 = sourceBody := rfl

theorem other_slots (ops : Ops) :
    {install ops with op3 := ops.op3} = ops := by cases ops; rfl

#print axioms installed_slot
#print axioms other_slots
end AspisR1.Op3I_Install

/-- The specialized existing D188 premise is inhabited for every remaining
operation dictionary, semantic boundary and std Claims implementation. This is
consistency of the association, not certification of native deployment. -/
theorem extraction_satisfiable (adapterOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (ops : Ops)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    (std : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest) :
    ∃ native1 native2,
      S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction
        (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps
          {adapterOps with op43 := S2W_DigestExtraction.digest hashv} (install ops) B std)
        native1 native2 hashv := by
  let actual := ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps
    {adapterOps with op43 := S2W_DigestExtraction.digest hashv} (install ops) B std
  exact ⟨AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned actual,
    AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned actual,⟨by intros; rfl,by intros; rfl,by intros; rfl⟩⟩

theorem source_of_fields (proof : Slice U8)
    (length : proof.val.length = 57607)
    (magic : proof.val.take 8 = Op3I_Source.compact.MAGIC.val)
    (tag : proof.val[8]? = some 2#u8)
    (tail : (proof.val.drop 9).take 7 = List.replicate 7 0#u8) :
    sourceBody proof = ok (.Ok .S2) := by
  have len : Slice.len proof = 57607#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simpa using length
  have bound8 : 8#usize ≤ proof.length := by scalar_tac
  have bound16 : 9#usize ≤ 16#usize ∧ 16#usize ≤ proof.length := by scalar_tac
  have tagValue : proof.val[8]'(by omega) = 2#u8 := by
    exact Option.some.inj ((List.getElem?_eq_getElem (by omega)).symm.trans tag)
  have nozero := Op3I_Header.any_exact (List.replicate 7 0#u8)
  obtain ⟨n,hn⟩ := nozero
  have body : Op3I_Source.verifier.candidate.parse_shape Op3I_Std.ops proof = ok (.Ok .S2) := by
    simp only [Op3I_Source.verifier.candidate.parse_shape,Op3I_Header.proof_bytes,
      bind_tc_ok,len,bne_self_eq_false,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,
      core.slice.index.Slice.index,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index,
      bound8,if_true,core.cmp.impls.PartialEqShared.ne,Op3I_Std.ops,
      Op3I_Std.eqList_u8,List.slice,
      show (8#usize).val = 8 by scalar_tac, show (9#usize).val = 9 by scalar_tac,
      show (16#usize).val = 16 by scalar_tac, Nat.sub_zero,
      show 16-9 = 7 by decide, List.drop_zero,magic,decide_true,
      Bool.not_true,Slice.index_usize,tag,Op3I_Source.transport.Variant.tag,
      core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index,bound16,
      core.slice.Slice.iter,tail,hn,List.any_replicate]
    simp [Slice.length,length,tagValue,Op3I_Std.anyList,
      Op3I_Source.verifier.candidate.parse_shape.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedU8Bool,
      Op3I_Source.verifier.candidate.parse_shape.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnMutTupleSharedU8Bool.call_mut]
  simp only [sourceBody,body,bind_tc_ok,currentVariant]

#print axioms extraction_satisfiable

import OraclePortAdmission

/-! HCHECKS composition on the generalized compiled rows. The typedAccepted
argument is the precise remaining byte/opening-to-reader binding frontier;
it is not an established property of the admitted multiproof kernel. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortChecks
open FS FS2
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw
open RawCutProverCompiler (Prover)
open OraclePortExperiment (Decision original recorded)
open OraclePortAdmission
open LiteralAcceptanceTerminal
open RecordedBinaryExperimentBin (SourceInputs)

theorem hchecks (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover)
    (H : Bytes → State) (i : SourceInputs)
    (instanceFields : InstanceFields D dO P H i)
    (typedAccepted : D0TypedChecks.verify (compiledRows D dO P H) i = true) :
    Nonempty (Checks (compiledPublic D dO P H) (compiledRows D dO P H)) := by
  have queryValid := QueryScanRow31SourcePlacement.transcript_row31_shape D H
    (compiledPublic D dO P H) (annotatedRun D dO P H).2.1.2 33 (by decide)
    i.m31 i.queryBytes i.state31 instanceFields.2.1 instanceFields.2.2.2.1
  obtain ⟨publicParsed, row31, row32, valid31, valid32⟩ := instanceFields
  obtain ⟨pairing, accumulator⟩ := D0TypedChecks.accepted_backend _ i typedAccepted
  exact HchecksReaderComposition.hchecks_partial
    (compiledPublic D dO P H) (compiledRows D dO P H) i.decoded i.data publicParsed
    (D0TypedChecks.accepted_matching _ i typedAccepted) pairing
    i.m31 i.queryBytes i.state31 i.m32 i.rho i.state32 row31 row32 valid31 valid32
    queryValid (D0TypedChecks.accepted_writer _ i typedAccepted) accumulator
    (D0TypedChecks.accepted_semantic _ i typedAccepted)

/-- Exact outstanding obligation for the admitted canonical instance.
It includes the check/data transfer, not just Rust execution equality. -/
def TypedBinding (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (core : Decision) (P : Prover)
    (Q : Nat) (fallback : (Bytes → State) → SourceInputs) : Prop :=
  ∀ H : Bytes → State,
    ¬ RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.binaryCollision Q
      (eval H (recorded D (admit core) (R16CanonReduction.canon P))) →
    FS2.accepts (eval H (original D (admit core) (R16CanonReduction.canon P))) →
    D0TypedChecks.verify (compiledRows D (admit core) (R16CanonReduction.canon P) H)
      (source D core P fallback H) = true

def checked_acceptance (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (core : Decision)
    (P : Prover) (Q : Nat) (fallback : (Bytes → State) → SourceInputs)
    (binding : TypedBinding D core P Q fallback) :
    OraclePortConsumer.CheckedAcceptance D (admit core) (R16CanonReduction.canon P) Q := by
  intro H hout ha
  exact Classical.choice (hchecks D (admit core) (R16CanonReduction.canon P) H
    (source D core P fallback H) (h_R16_instance D core P fallback H ha)
    (binding H hout ha))

#print axioms hchecks
#print axioms checked_acceptance
end AspisR1.OraclePortChecks
end

private theorem valid_enrichMessage (w : CanonicalCutEnrichedTranscript.Words)
    (i : Nat) (m : LiteralTranscript.Message) :
    LiteralTranscript.valid i (enrichMessage w m) ↔ LiteralTranscript.valid i m := by
  cases m with
  | initial root word =>
      by_cases hi : i = 0
      · subst i; simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, enrichMessage]
      · simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, enrichMessage, hi]
  | payload bytes => simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, enrichMessage]
  | c2 bytes word =>
      by_cases hi : i = 2
      · subst i; simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, enrichMessage]
      · simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, enrichMessage, hi]
  | second bytes word =>
      by_cases hi : i = 30
      · subst i; simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, enrichMessage]
      · simp [LiteralTranscript.valid, enrichMessage, hi]

private theorem proof_idempotent (w : CanonicalCutEnrichedTranscript.Words)

      RawCutTranscriptRun.proof w pf := by
  funext i
  cases h : pf i <;> simp [RawCutTranscriptRun.proof, enrichMessage, h]

private theorem firstCell_map {I J A C : Type} [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A]
    (f : I → J) (s : Sampler I A C) :
    firstCell (ProgramSamplerMap.map f s) = (firstCell s).map f := by
  cases s <;> rfl

private theorem chains_read (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) :
    ChainsRead (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder) := by
  intro i P m hi
  change firstCell (ProgramSamplerMap.map Addr.toBytes
    (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m)) ≠ none
  rw [firstCell_map]
  have hn : firstCell (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m) ≠ none :=
    UnifiedSampler.firstCell_some _ _ _ _ _
  cases h : firstCell (LiteralTranscript.samp i P m) with
  | none => exact absurd h hn
  | some a => simp

private theorem firstCell_mem {I A C : Type} [DecidableEq I] [Inhabited A]
    (H : I → A) (s : Sampler I A C) (a : I)
    (ha : firstCell s = some a) :
    a ∈ (eval H s.toProgram).1.map Prod.fst := by
  cases s with
  | done c => cases ha
  | ask i k =>
      simp only [firstCell, Option.some.injEq] at ha
      subst i
      exact List.mem_cons_self ..
  | multi c cs nd k =>
      simp only [firstCell, Option.some.injEq] at ha
      subst c
      exact List.mem_cons_self ..

private theorem verifier_reads (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (d : Decision) :
    ReadsChains (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder) (verifier decoder d) := by
  intro H pub pf i a hi ha
  apply OraclePortReplay.sampler_reads decoder d H pub pf a
  apply FS2.verifier_reads (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder)
    (RawCutTranscriptRun.decisionOnBytes (fun _ _ => false)) H pub pf i hi a
  exact firstCell_mem H _ a ha

attribute [local irreducible] OracleDecisionFeasibilityCore.verifier LiteralByteProtocol.protocol

private theorem pair_eq_of_components {α β : Type} {a c : α} {b d : β}
    (h₁ : a = c) (h₂ : b = d) : (a, b) = (c, d) := by
  cases h₁
  cases h₂
  rfl

private theorem not_predicate_transport {α : Type} (P : α → Prop)
    {a b : α} (h : a = b) (hb : ¬ P b) : ¬ P a := by
  cases h
  exact hb

/-- The executable extractor recovers exactly the word metadata retained by
the binary compiler. Equality is total, including failed/missing recoveries. -/
theorem extractor_word_alignment
    (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (d : Decision)
    (P : Prover) (H : Bytes → State)
    (checks : let run := eval H (experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P) (verifier decoder d))
      LiteralAcceptanceTerminal.Checks run.2.1.1
        ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H run.2.1.1 run.2.1.2 33).rounds) :
    let orig := eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))
    let run := eval H (experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P) (verifier decoder d))
    wordsFromRun run = BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig ∧
      RawCutTranscriptRun.proof (wordsFromRun run) run.2.1.2 = run.2.1.2 := by
  let orig := eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))
  let run := eval H (experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P) (verifier decoder d))
  have hrunRaw : run = eval H (experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P) (verifier decoder d)) := rfl
  have hpf : run.2.1.2 = RawCutTranscriptRun.proof
      (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig) orig.2.1.2 := by
    dsimp only [run, orig]
    rw [compiled_experiment_eval]
  have hvalidOrig : ∀ j, j ≤ 30 → LiteralTranscript.valid j (orig.2.1.2 j) := by
    exact OraclePortSchedule.checks_force_original_constructor_schedule
      decoder d P H orig run rfl hrunRaw checks
  have hvalidRun : ∀ j, j ≤ 30 → LiteralTranscript.valid j (run.2.1.2 j) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hpf]
    exact (valid_enrichMessage (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig) j
      (orig.2.1.2 j)).2 (hvalidOrig j hj)
  have hvalidRunRaw : ∀ j, j ≤ 30 → LiteralTranscript.valid j
      ((eval H (RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
        (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
        (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 j) := by
    simpa only [← hrunRaw] using hvalidRun
  have hwordsRaw := (RawCutWordsFromRunExecutableBin.wordsFromRun_eq_buildWords
    decoder _ hvalidRunRaw).trans
    (OraclePortWords.wordsFromRun_compiled_eq_retainedBuildWords decoder d P H)
  have hwordsRun : wordsFromRun run =
      BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig := by
    simpa only [← hrunRaw] using hwordsRaw
  have hpfFixed : RawCutTranscriptRun.proof (wordsFromRun run) run.2.1.2 = run.2.1.2 := by
    rw [hwordsRun, hpf]
    exact proof_idempotent (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig) orig.2.1.2
  exact ⟨hwordsRun, hpfFixed⟩

/-- Checked acceptance plus absence of the actual lazy-injection collision and
decoded-chain events supplies the exact clean-model premise used by the
recorded shared-oracle failure theorem. Word recovery is aligned through the
compiled-run stability theorem; no fresh/shared-ROM identification is made. -/
theorem clean_model_of_checked_acceptance_no_hit
    (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (d : Decision)
    (P : Prover) (κ : Nat → ℚ) (Q : Nat)
    (inj : AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.LazyInj
      (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder)
      (RawAdaptiveLiteralDecoder.decode RawFullPublicSelection.select
        LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose)
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
      (verifier decoder d) κ Q)
    (hchecks : ∀ H : Bytes → State,
      ¬ inj.Coll (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
        (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
        (verifier decoder d))) →
      FS2.accepts (eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))) →
      LiteralAcceptanceTerminal.Checks
        (eval H (experiment
          (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
          (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1
        (((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H
          (eval H (experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1
          (eval H (experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 33).rounds))
    (exp : RawRecordedOracleExtractionMassBin.Experiment)
    (hexp : exp = AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
      (verifier decoder d))
    (hit : RawCutProverCompiler.RunView → Prop)
    (hHit : ∀ run, hit run ↔ inj.Coll run ∨ hitsChain3
      (RawAdaptiveLiteralDecoder.decode RawFullPublicSelection.select
        LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose)
      RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1) :
    CleanAcceptedModel decoder
      exp
      hit := by
  unfold RawRecordedOracleExtractionMassBin.CleanAcceptedModel
  intro H run ha hnot
  have hexpRaw : exp = RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
      (verifier decoder d) := by
    rw [hexp]
    unfold AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
    rfl
  have hrunAccepted : run = eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
      (verifier decoder d)) := by
    change eval H exp = _
    rw [hexp]
  let orig := eval H (experiment P (verifier decoder d))
  have hexpCompiler : AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
      (verifier decoder d) = RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
      (verifier decoder d) := by
    unfold AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
    rfl
  have hrunRaw : run = eval H (RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
      (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
      (verifier decoder d)) := by
    change eval H exp = _
    rw [hexpRaw]
  have hrun : run =
      let v := orig
      (v.1 ++ (eval H (verifier decoder d v.2.1.1 v.2.1.2)).1,
        ((v.2.1.1, RawCutTranscriptRun.proof
          (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder v) v.2.1.2), v.2.2)) := by
    calc
      run = eval H (RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
        (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
        (verifier decoder d)) := hrunRaw
      _ = _ := by
        simpa only [orig] using compiled_experiment_eval decoder d
          (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P H
  have hpub : run.2.1.1 = orig.2.1.1 := by rw [hrun]
  have hpf : run.2.1.2 = RawCutTranscriptRun.proof
      (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig) orig.2.1.2 := by rw [hrun]
  have haccOriginal : FS2.accepts orig := by
    change orig.2.2 = true
    have haccRun : run.2.2 = true := ha
    rw [hrun] at haccRun
    exact haccRun
  have checks : LiteralAcceptanceTerminal.Checks run.2.1.1
      ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H run.2.1.1 run.2.1.2 33).rounds := by
    simpa only [← hrunRaw] using hchecks H (fun hc =>
      hnot ((hHit run).2 (Or.inl (hrunAccepted.symm ▸ hc)))) haccOriginal
  have hvalidOrig : ∀ j, j ≤ 30 → LiteralTranscript.valid j (orig.2.1.2 j) := by
    exact OraclePortSchedule.checks_force_original_constructor_schedule
      decoder d P H orig run rfl hrunRaw checks
  have hvalidRun : ∀ j, j ≤ 30 → LiteralTranscript.valid j (run.2.1.2 j) := by
    intro j hj
    rw [hpf]
    exact (valid_enrichMessage (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig) j
      (orig.2.1.2 j)).2 (hvalidOrig j hj)
  have hvalidRunRaw : ∀ j, j ≤ 30 → LiteralTranscript.valid j
      ((eval H (RawCutProverCompiler.experiment
        (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
        (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 j) := by
    simpa only [← hrunRaw] using hvalidRun
  have hwordsRaw := (RawCutWordsFromRunExecutableBin.wordsFromRun_eq_buildWords
    decoder _ hvalidRunRaw).trans
    (OraclePortWords.wordsFromRun_compiled_eq_retainedBuildWords decoder d P H)
  have hwordsRun : wordsFromRun run =
      BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig := by
    simpa only [← hrunRaw] using hwordsRaw
  have hpfFixed : RawCutTranscriptRun.proof (wordsFromRun run) run.2.1.2 = run.2.1.2 := by
    rw [hwordsRun, hpf]
    exact proof_idempotent (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder orig) orig.2.1.2
  have hnoRaw : ¬ hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad run.2.1.1 []
      ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H run.2.1.1 run.2.1.2 33).rounds := by
    have hnotEvent : ¬ (inj.Coll run ∨ hitsChain3
        (RawAdaptiveLiteralDecoder.decode RawFullPublicSelection.select
          LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose)
        RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1) := by
      intro he
      exact hnot ((hHit run).2 he)
    have hcoll : ¬ inj.Coll run := by
      intro hc
      exact hnotEvent (Or.inl hc)
    have hchain : ¬ hitsChain3
        (RawAdaptiveLiteralDecoder.decode RawFullPublicSelection.select
          LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose)
        RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1 := by
      intro hc
      exact hnotEvent (Or.inr hc)
    have hchain' : ¬ hitsChain3
        (RawAdaptiveLiteralDecoder.decode RawFullPublicSelection.select
          LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose)
        (fun p m _T c => LiteralClassifier.bad p m c) emptyTable run.1 := by
      change ¬ hitsChain3
        (RawAdaptiveLiteralDecoder.decode RawFullPublicSelection.select
          LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose)
        (fun p m _T c => LiteralClassifier.bad p m c) emptyTable run.1 at hchain
      exact hchain
    have haccAccepted : FS2.accepts
        (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
          (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
          (verifier decoder d))) := by
      change (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
        (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
        (verifier decoder d))).2.2 = true
      rw [← hrunAccepted]
      exact ha
    have hnoRawAccepted : ¬ hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad
        (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
          (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
          (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1 []
        ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H
          (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1
          (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 33).rounds := by
      intro hraw
      have hcollAccepted : ¬ inj.Coll (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
          (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
          (verifier decoder d))) := by
        intro hh
        exact hcoll (hrunAccepted.symm ▸ hh)
      have hr : (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).r = 33 := by
        unfold LiteralByteProtocol.protocol
        rfl
      have hrawR : hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad
          (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1 []
          ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H
            (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
              (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
              (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1
            (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
              (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
              (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).r).rounds := by
        rw [hr]
        exact hraw
      have hc := AspisR1.LiteralAdaptiveClassifierHitToDecodedChain.accepted_hit_implies_decoded_chain
        (pr := LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder)
        (bad := LiteralClassifier.bad)
        (dec := RawAdaptiveLiteralDecoder.decode RawFullPublicSelection.select
          LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose)
        (P := compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
        (V := verifier decoder d) (κ := κ)
        (Qtot := Q) (inj := inj) (hreads := chains_read decoder)
        (hV := verifier_reads decoder d) (H := H) (hcoll := hcollAccepted)
        (hacc := haccAccepted) (hhit := hrawR)
      exact hchain' (hrunAccepted.symm ▸ hc)
    have hroundsRaw :
        ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H
          (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1
          (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.2 33).rounds =
        ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H run.2.1.1 run.2.1.2 33).rounds := by
      rw [← hrunAccepted]
    have hnoRunRaw : ¬ hitFrom LiteralClassifier.bad run.2.1.1 []
        ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol decoder).transcript H run.2.1.1 run.2.1.2 33).rounds := by
      intro hbad
      have hpubAccepted : run.2.1.1 =
          (eval H (AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.experiment
            (compiled decoder d (BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder) P)
            (verifier decoder d))).2.1.1 := by
        exact congrArg (fun z : RawCutProverCompiler.RunView => z.2.1.1) hrunAccepted
      have hmove := hitFrom_transport LiteralClassifier.bad hpubAccepted hroundsRaw.symm
      exact hnoRawAccepted (hmove.mp hbad)
    exact hnoRunRaw
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [hpfFixed]
    exact checks
  · rw [hpfFixed]
    exact hnoRaw

#print axioms proof_idempotent

#print axioms firstCell_mem
#print axioms verifier_reads
#print axioms pair_eq_of_components
#print axioms not_predicate_transport

end AspisR1.OraclePortCleanModel

import OraclePortHeader
import OraclePortChecks

/-! Strict compact byte parser. No decoded fields or tree schedules are supplied
by a caller. The terminal message is a stored-proof byte carrier; the frozen
caller must separately prove that it supplies these bytes. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortCompactDraft
open FS FS2
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open RawCutTranscriptRun (ErasedPrefix ErasedMessage)
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def slice (b : Bytes) (offset n : Nat) : Bytes := (b.drop offset).take n

def little (b : Bytes) : Nat := b.foldr (fun x n => x.val + 256*n) 0

def le32 (n : Nat) : Bytes := (List.range 4).map (fun i => ⟨n / 256^i % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩)

def canonical (b : Bytes) : Prop :=
  b.length % 4 = 0 ∧ ∀ j ∈ List.range (b.length / 4), little (slice b (4*j) 4) < 2147483647

def expand (n : Nat) (b : Bytes) : Bytes :=
  ((List.range n).map (fun j => slice b (16*j) 16 ++ List.replicate 16 0)).flatten

def rowShape (row : Nat) : Nat × Nat :=
  if row = 2 then (1,32) else if row = 14 then (3,32)
  else if 15 ≤ row ∧ row ≤ 24 then (2,896)
  else if row = 25 then (4,3712) else if row = 26 then (5,928) else (0,0)

/-- Recursive on the row count, never on a concrete recurrence value. -/
def semanticRows : Nat → Nat → Bytes → Option (List Bytes)
  | 0, _, b => if b = [] then some [] else none
  | fuel+1, row, b => do
      let (tag, size) := rowShape row
      let stored := if 14 ≤ row then size / 2 else size
      if b.length < 5 + stored then none else do
        if b.take 5 ≠ (⟨tag % 256, Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)⟩ :: le32 size) then none else do
          let payload := slice b 5 stored
          if 14 ≤ row ∧ ¬ canonical payload then none else do
            let logical := if 14 ≤ row then expand (size/32) payload else payload
            let tail ← semanticRows fuel (row+1) (b.drop (5+stored))
            pure ((b.take 5 ++ logical) :: tail)

structure Parsed where
  wire : Bytes
  semantic : List Bytes

/-- The compact opening's non-salt regions are all canonical M31 limbs.
This includes all four K fields and all eight C2 K fields. -/
def openingCanonical (q : Bytes) : Prop :=
  canonical (q.take 608) ∧ canonical (slice q 672 128)

def scan (b : Bytes) : Prop :=
  canonical (slice b 7031 464) ∧ canonical (slice b 7495 256) ∧
  canonical (slice b 7783 2272) ∧
  ∀ j ∈ List.range 22, openingCanonical (slice b (10055 + j*832) 832)

def parse (b : Bytes) : Option Parsed := do
  if OraclePortHeader.accepts b = false then none else do
    if ¬ scan b then none else do
      let rs ← semanticRows 27 0 (slice b 48 6983)
      pure ⟨b,rs⟩

def root0 (p : Parsed) : Bytes := slice p.wire 16 32
def root2 (p : Parsed) : Bytes := slice p.wire 7751 32

def framed (payload : Bytes) : Bytes := le32 payload.length ++ payload

/-- Message bytes through row 32. The root at row zero is handled separately. -/
def rowBytes (p : Parsed) (row : Nat) : Bytes :=
  if row < 27 then p.semantic[row]?.getD []
  else if row = 27 then framed (expand 29 (slice p.wire 7031 464))
  else if row = 28 then framed (slice p.wire 7495 32)
  else if row = 29 then framed (slice p.wire 7527 224)
  else if row = 30 then framed (slice p.wire 7751 256)
  else if row = 31 then framed (slice p.wire 8007 2048)
  else framed []

def Aligned (p : Parsed) (tr : ErasedPrefix) : Prop :=
  tr.statement.tag = (p.wire[8]?.getD 0) ∧
  (∃ decoded, SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic tr.statement.pubBytes = some decoded) ∧
  tr.rounds.length = 33 ∧
  (∃ root c, tr.rounds[0]? = some (.initial root,c) ∧ bytes root = root0 p) ∧
  ∀ row, 0 < row → row < 33 → ∃ b c,
    tr.rounds[row]? = some (.payload b,c) ∧ b.val = rowBytes p row

/-- The parser reads the whole stored compact proof from the erased terminal
payload. No separate proof argument can disagree with the reached message. -/
def terminalBytes : ErasedMessage → Bytes
  | .initial _ => []
  | .payload b => b.val

def parseTerminal (tr : ErasedPrefix) (m : ErasedMessage) : Option Parsed := do
  let p ← parse (terminalBytes m)
  if Aligned p tr then some p else none

theorem parse_header (b : Bytes) (p : Parsed) (h : parse b = some p) :
    OraclePortHeader.accepts b = true ∧ p.wire = b := by
  unfold parse at h
  split at h
  · contradiction
  · rename_i hh
    have hb : OraclePortHeader.accepts b = true := Bool.eq_true_of_not_eq_false hh
    split at h
    · contradiction
    · cases hs : semanticRows 27 0 (slice b 48 6983) <;> simp [hs] at h
      subst p
      exact ⟨hb,rfl⟩

theorem terminal_alignment (tr : ErasedPrefix) (m : ErasedMessage) (p : Parsed)
    (h : parseTerminal tr m = some p) :
    parse (terminalBytes m) = some p ∧ p.wire = terminalBytes m ∧ Aligned p tr := by
  unfold parseTerminal at h
  cases hp : parse (terminalBytes m) with
  | none => simp [hp] at h
  | some p' =>
    by_cases ha : Aligned p' tr
    · simp [hp, ha] at h
      subst p
      exact ⟨rfl, (parse_header _ _ hp).2, ha⟩
    · simp [hp, ha] at h

theorem physical_tag (tr : ErasedPrefix) (m : ErasedMessage) (p : Parsed)
    (h : parseTerminal tr m = some p) :
    tr.statement.tag = 2 ∧ (terminalBytes m)[8]? = some 2 := by
  obtain ⟨hp,same,aligned⟩ := terminal_alignment tr m p h
  have ht := ((OraclePortHeader.accepts_iff _).mp (parse_header _ _ hp).1).2.2.1
  refine ⟨?_,ht⟩
  have ha := aligned.1
  simpa only [same, ht, Option.getD_some] using ha

#print axioms parse_header
#print axioms terminal_alignment
#print axioms physical_tag
end AspisR1.OraclePortCompactDraft

import OraclePortCleanModel

/-! Generalized binary consumer. The remaining decoder-completion and
collision-conditioned checked-acceptance premises are displayed separately. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortConsumer
open FS FS2 R0C.V3
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open OraclePortExperiment
open RawCutProverCompiler (Prover RunView)
open RawRecordedOracleExtractionMassBin
abbrev dec := RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.dec
abbrev collision := RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.binaryCollision

abbrev compiledRows (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover)
    (H : Bytes → State) :=
  ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol D).transcript H
    (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.1 (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.2 33).rounds

/-- The exact LazyInj.decodes statement at the new program; no terminal
Merkle query is asserted to belong to the legacy address language. -/
def Completion (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover)
    (Q : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ H : Bytes → State, ¬ collision Q (eval H (recorded D dO P)) →
    FS2.accepts (eval H (recorded D dO P)) →
    ∀ n a, n < (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol D).r →
      firstCell ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol D).chain H
        (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.1 (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.2 n) = some a →
      ∃ own pend g, dec a (tableBefore emptyTable (eval H (recorded D dO P)).1 a) =
        some (own, pend, g) ∧
        bfollow g (traceFrom (eval H (recorded D dO P)).1 a) own pend
          (tableBefore emptyTable (eval H (recorded D dO P)).1 a) =
        some ((LiteralByteProtocol.protocol D).transcript H
            (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.1 (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.2 n,
          (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol D).msg (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.2 n,
          (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol D).chal H
            (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.1 (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.2 n)

/-- Data-producing checks, guarded by the same binary collision event. -/
def CheckedAcceptance (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover)
    (Q : Nat) : Type :=
  ∀ H : Bytes → State, ¬ collision Q (eval H (recorded D dO P)) →
    FS2.accepts (eval H (original D dO P)) →
    LiteralAcceptanceTerminal.Checks (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.1.1
      (compiledRows D dO P H)

def injection (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover)
    (Q : Nat) (hqueries : DecoderQueryAccounting.AdversaryQueries P Q)
    (hbudget : Budget dO) (hcompletion : Completion D dO P (Q + 1161)) :
    AcceptedAdaptiveFiatShamir.LazyInj (LiteralByteProtocol.protocol D) dec
      (compiled D dO P) (verifier D dO) BinCombinedMerkleCollision.kappa (Q + 1161) :=
  { Coll := collision (Q + 1161)
    mass := BinCombinedMerkleCollision.mass SelectedTranscriptParams.params.iv
      (Q + 1161) (recorded D dO P) (first_reads D dO hbudget P Q hqueries)
    decodes := hcompletion }

theorem clean_of_checks
    (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hqueries : DecoderQueryAccounting.AdversaryQueries P Q)
    (hbudget : Budget dO) (hcompletion : Completion D dO P (Q + 1161))
    (hchecks : CheckedAcceptance D dO P (Q + 1161)) :
    CleanAcceptedModel D (recorded D dO P) (fun run => collision (Q + 1161) run ∨
      hitsChain3 dec RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1) := by
  exact OraclePortCleanModel.clean_model_of_checked_acceptance_no_hit
    D dO P BinCombinedMerkleCollision.kappa (Q + 1161)
    (injection D dO P Q hqueries hbudget hcompletion) hchecks
    (recorded D dO P) rfl _ (fun _ => Iff.rfl)

#print axioms injection
#print axioms clean_of_checks
end AspisR1.OraclePortConsumer

import OraclePortConsumer
import OraclePortPool
import OracleDecisionMultiNumeric
import RawRecordedActualAdaptiveFailureBoundBin
import RawExtractorCostComposedBin

/-! Draft generic composition. CleanModel is an explicit remaining model
obligation, not a renamed claim that R3/R13--R16 have been discharged. The
subject is a logical recorded experiment; source and Pool transport are separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortHeadline
open FS FS2 R0C.V3
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open OraclePortExperiment
open RawCutProverCompiler (Prover RunView)
open RawRecordedOracleExtractionMassBin
open RawExtractorCostComposedV2 (Parameters Coins)
open RawExtractorCostComposedBin

abbrev totalBound (Q : Nat) := OracleDecisionPrereqNumeric.envelope Q 1080 1161
abbrev Qmax := OracleDecisionMultiNumeric.safeMax
abbrev collision := RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.binaryCollision
abbrev dec := RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.dec

def bad (Q : Nat) (run : RunView) : Prop := collision (Q + 1161) run ∨
  hitsChain3 dec RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1

/-- Exactly the extractor's existing clean-model interface, on the new program. -/
abbrev CleanModel (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover)
    (Q : Nat) : Prop := CleanAcceptedModel D (recorded D dO P) (bad Q)

/-- The conservative start coefficient and five-reader collision allowance
are charged once on the same generalized annotated experiment. -/
theorem recorded_failure_bound
    (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hqueries : DecoderQueryAccounting.AdversaryQueries P Q)
    (hbudget : Budget dO) (hclean : CleanModel D dO P Q) :
    lazyMean (recorded D dO P) emptyTable failureMass ≤
      BinCombinedMerkleCollision.kappa (Q + 1161) +
      ((Q + 1080 : Nat) : ℚ) * PerAttemptEnvelope.B + 1/(2:ℚ)^126 := by
  let exp := recorded D dO P
  have hc := BinCombinedMerkleCollision.mass SelectedTranscriptParams.params.iv
    (Q + 1161) exp (first_reads D dO hbudget P Q hqueries)
  have hs := RawAdaptiveClassifierStartBound.shared_hit_mass_le_starts
    RawFullPublicSelection.select LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose exp (Q + 1080)
    (starts D dO hbudget P Q hqueries)
  apply shared_oracle_failure_le_supplied_hit_bound D exp (bad Q) hclean
  calc
    lazyMean exp emptyTable (fun run => indicator (bad Q run)) ≤
        lazyMean exp emptyTable (fun run => indicator (collision (Q + 1161) run) +
          indicator (hitsChain3 dec RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1)) :=
      AllAddressFiatShamir.lazyMean_mono_of_eval exp _ _ (fun _ => indicator_or_le _ _)
    _ = lazyMean exp emptyTable (fun run => indicator (collision (Q + 1161) run)) +
        lazyMean exp emptyTable (fun run =>
          indicator (hitsChain3 dec RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1)) :=
      lazyMean_add _ _ _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hc hs

/-- Conditional draft endpoint. The shifted ledger is necessary on Q+2322;
no adequacy on that larger domain is inferred from the old ledger premise. -/
theorem final_soundness_of_clean
    (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hqueries : DecoderQueryAccounting.AdversaryQueries P Q)
    (hbudget : Budget dO) (hclean : CleanModel D dO P Q)
    (e : CostedExtractor) (p : Parameters)
    (h_M10_ledger : LedgerRefinement e p (Q + 1161)) :
    (∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.2 = true →
      AspisV8R19.OracleResampling.mean (fun coins : Coins =>
        ((e.eval (eval H (recorded D dO P)) coins).2.total : ℚ)) ≤ (p.attemptBudget : ℚ)) ∧
    (∀ run coins w, (e.eval run coins).1 = some w → LiteralProtocol.relation run.2.1.1 w) ∧
    (1/(2:ℚ)^126 + 1/(2:ℚ)^454 ≤ 1/(2:ℚ)^120) ∧
    (lazyMean (recorded D dO P) emptyTable failureMass +
      QueryScanModelFailure.failureProbability (2^18) ≤ totalBound Q) ∧
    (32 ≤ Q → Q ≤ Qmax →
      lazyMean (recorded D dO P) emptyTable failureMass +
        QueryScanModelFailure.failureProbability (2^18) ≤ (Q+1:ℚ)*(1/(2:ℚ)^100)) := by
  have hb := recorded_failure_bound D dO P Q hqueries hbudget hclean
  have ht : lazyMean (recorded D dO P) emptyTable failureMass +
      QueryScanModelFailure.failureProbability (2^18) ≤ totalBound Q := by
    apply (add_le_add hb QueryScanModelFailure.exhaustion_bound).trans_eq
    unfold totalBound OracleDecisionPrereqNumeric.envelope
    ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, R1FinalSoundnessNumeric.extractor_abort_allowance, ht, ?_⟩
  · intro H ha
    exact (accepted_attempt_cost e p (Q + 1161) h_M10_ledger _ ha
      (log_length D dO hbudget P Q hqueries H)).2
  · intro run coins w hw
    exact RawRecordedPublicSpendExtractorBin.returned_relation run coins w
      ((e.value run coins).symm.trans hw)
  · intro hlo hhi
    exact ht.trans (OracleDecisionMultiNumeric.safe_range Q hlo hhi)

/-- The model frontier is completion plus actual reader Checks, rather than
an opaque clean-model hypothesis. Neither frontier is called a source join. -/
theorem recorded_soundness
    (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hqueries : DecoderQueryAccounting.AdversaryQueries P Q)
    (hbudget : Budget dO)
    (hcompletion : OraclePortConsumer.Completion D dO P (Q + 1161))
    (hchecks : OraclePortConsumer.CheckedAcceptance D dO P (Q + 1161))
    (e : CostedExtractor) (p : Parameters)
    (h_M10_ledger : LedgerRefinement e p (Q + 1161)) :
    (∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.2 = true →
      AspisV8R19.OracleResampling.mean (fun coins : Coins =>
        ((e.eval (eval H (recorded D dO P)) coins).2.total : ℚ)) ≤ (p.attemptBudget : ℚ)) ∧
    (∀ run coins w, (e.eval run coins).1 = some w → LiteralProtocol.relation run.2.1.1 w) ∧
    (1/(2:ℚ)^126 + 1/(2:ℚ)^454 ≤ 1/(2:ℚ)^120) ∧
    (lazyMean (recorded D dO P) emptyTable failureMass +
      QueryScanModelFailure.failureProbability (2^18) ≤ totalBound Q) ∧
    (32 ≤ Q → Q ≤ Qmax →
      lazyMean (recorded D dO P) emptyTable failureMass +
        QueryScanModelFailure.failureProbability (2^18) ≤ (Q+1:ℚ)*(1/(2:ℚ)^100)) := by
  exact final_soundness_of_clean D dO P Q hqueries hbudget
    (OraclePortConsumer.clean_of_checks D dO P Q hqueries hbudget hcompletion hchecks)
    e p h_M10_ledger

/-- Draft headline at the constructed logical Pool instance. The two model
frontiers below remain additional to Rust equality and runtime assumptions. -/
theorem final_soundness
    (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (dO : Decision) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (tape : R9PoolConcreteExperiment.Tape) (policy : R9PoolConcreteExperiment.Policy)
    (hqueries : DecoderQueryAccounting.AdversaryQueries P Q)
    (hbudget : Budget dO)
    (hcompletion : OraclePortConsumer.Completion D dO P (Q + 1161))
    (hchecks : OraclePortConsumer.CheckedAcceptance D dO P (Q + 1161))
    (e : CostedExtractor) (p : Parameters)
    (h_M10_ledger : LedgerRefinement e p (Q + 1161)) :
    (∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H (recorded D dO P)).2.2 = true →
      AspisV8R19.OracleResampling.mean (fun coins : Coins =>
        ((e.eval (eval H (recorded D dO P)) coins).2.total : ℚ)) ≤ (p.attemptBudget : ℚ)) ∧
    (∀ run coins w, (e.eval run coins).1 = some w → LiteralProtocol.relation run.2.1.1 w) ∧
    (1/(2:ℚ)^126 + 1/(2:ℚ)^454 ≤ 1/(2:ℚ)^120) ∧
    (R9DeployedBinaryExperiment.deployedFailureModel (OraclePortPool.tx1 D P tape)
      (OraclePortPool.poolTx2 D dO P policy) ≤ totalBound Q) ∧
    (32 ≤ Q → Q ≤ Qmax →
      R9DeployedBinaryExperiment.deployedFailureModel (OraclePortPool.tx1 D P tape)
      (OraclePortPool.poolTx2 D dO P policy) ≤ (Q+1:ℚ)*(1/(2:ℚ)^100)) := by
  obtain ⟨hcost, hreturned, habort, hbound, _⟩ :=
    recorded_soundness D dO P Q hqueries hbudget hcompletion hchecks e p h_M10_ledger
  have ht := (OraclePortPool.deployed_transport D dO P tape policy).trans hbound
  exact ⟨hcost, hreturned, habort, ht,
    fun hlo hhi => ht.trans (OracleDecisionMultiNumeric.safe_range Q hlo hhi)⟩

#print axioms recorded_soundness
#print axioms final_soundness_of_clean
#print axioms recorded_failure_bound
#print axioms final_soundness
end AspisR1.OraclePortHeadline
end

import OraclePortRuntimeBindingC7

/-! Draft substitution interface. No frozen implementation or caller tree is
constructed here. The source and model must share the *ordered* caller tree,
including rejection branches, repeated calls, all call arguments and reads.
S10 is coverage of its call sites, not an executable verifier stage. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortJoinSplit
open FS FS2
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open OraclePortStoredExperimentC4 OraclePortStoredConsumerC7 OraclePortRuntimeBindingC7

inductive Cone where
  | s1 | s2 | s3 | s4 | s5 | s6 | s7 | s8 | s9
  | parserCodec | multiproof | checkpointAbi | poolCaller
  deriving DecidableEq

structure Site where
  owner : Cone
  declaration : String
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Arguments include the complete pre-state; values include the complete
post-state and ordinary Rust rejection. Hiding mutable state loses the join.
The instantiator must fix these carriers from the adopted source extraction. -/
structure Signature where
  Args : Site → Type
  Value : Site → Type

abbrev Implementation (σ : Signature) :=
  (site : Site) → σ.Args site → Program Bytes State (σ.Value site)

inductive Calls (σ : Signature) (α : Type) where
  | done (value : α)
  | invoke (site : Site) (args : σ.Args site) (next : σ.Value site → Calls σ α)
  | oracle (address : Bytes) (next : State → Calls σ α)

def interpret {σ : Signature} {α : Type} (impl : Implementation σ) :
    Calls σ α → Program Bytes State α
  | .done value => .done value
  | .invoke site args next => bind (impl site args) fun value => interpret impl (next value)
  | .oracle address next => .ask address fun value => interpret impl (next value)

/-- Total full-program equality: no acceptance, successful-call, canonicality
or oracle-world antecedent. Rejected inputs and read order are included. -/
def ConeJoin {σ : Signature} (source model : Implementation σ) (cone : Cone) : Prop :=
  ∀ site, site.owner = cone → ∀ args, source site args = model site args

structure PerConeJoins {σ : Signature} (source model : Implementation σ) : Prop where
  S1 : ConeJoin source model .s1
  S2 : ConeJoin source model .s2
  S3 : ConeJoin source model .s3
  S4 : ConeJoin source model .s4
  S5 : ConeJoin source model .s5
  S6 : ConeJoin source model .s6
  S7 : ConeJoin source model .s7
  S8 : ConeJoin source model .s8
  S9 : ConeJoin source model .s9
  parserCodec : ConeJoin source model .parserCodec
  multiproof : ConeJoin source model .multiproof
  checkpointAbi : ConeJoin source model .checkpointAbi
  poolCaller : ConeJoin source model .poolCaller

/-- S10 must cover *all* return continuations, including rejection paths.
Membership alone is not source pin validation: that remains P6/S10 evidence. -/
def Covered {σ : Signature} {α : Type} (inventory : List Site) : Calls σ α → Prop
  | .done _ => True
  | .invoke site _ next => site ∈ inventory ∧ ∀ value, Covered inventory (next value)
  | .oracle _ next => ∀ value, Covered inventory (next value)

def S10Join {σ : Signature} (inventory : List Site) (tree : Input → Calls σ Bool) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, Covered inventory (tree i)

theorem perCone_at {σ : Signature} {source model : Implementation σ}
    (joins : PerConeJoins source model) (site : Site) (args : σ.Args site) :
    source site args = model site args := by
  cases h : site.owner with
  | s1 => exact joins.S1 site h args
  | s2 => exact joins.S2 site h args
  | s3 => exact joins.S3 site h args
  | s4 => exact joins.S4 site h args
  | s5 => exact joins.S5 site h args
  | s6 => exact joins.S6 site h args
  | s7 => exact joins.S7 site h args
  | s8 => exact joins.S8 site h args
  | s9 => exact joins.S9 site h args
  | parserCodec => exact joins.parserCodec site h args
  | multiproof => exact joins.multiproof site h args
  | checkpointAbi => exact joins.checkpointAbi site h args
  | poolCaller => exact joins.poolCaller site h args

/-- Structural composition: branch-dependent continuations are preserved;
there is no permutation or acceptance-only extensionality step. -/
theorem interpret_eq {σ : Signature} {α : Type} {source model : Implementation σ}
    (joins : PerConeJoins source model) (tree : Calls σ α) :
    interpret source tree = interpret model tree := by
  induction tree with
  | done value => rfl
  | invoke site args next ih =>
      simp only [interpret, perCone_at joins site args]
      exact congrArg (bind (model site args)) (funext ih)
  | oracle address next ih =>
      exact congrArg (Program.ask address) (funext ih)

/-- These are the two independent caller proofs still owed: decompose the
actual frozen execution, and identify the fully substituted model with dV.
This is not a proof that a tree or either identity exists for frozen Rust. -/
structure CompositionOrderingJoin {σ : Signature} (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (rust : Verifier) (source model : Implementation σ) (tree : Input → Calls σ Bool) : Prop where
  source_order : ∀ i, rust i = interpret source (tree i)
  model_order : ∀ i, interpret model (tree i) = verifier D dV i

theorem executionJoin_of_cones {σ : Signature} (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (rust : Verifier) (source model : Implementation σ) (tree : Input → Calls σ Bool)
    (inventory : List Site) (h_cones : PerConeJoins source model)
    (_h_S10 : S10Join inventory tree)
    (h_order : CompositionOrderingJoin D rust source model tree) : ExecutionJoin D rust := by
  intro i
  exact (h_order.source_order i).trans ((interpret_eq h_cones (tree i)).trans
    (h_order.model_order i))

#print axioms perCone_at
#print axioms interpret_eq
#print axioms executionJoin_of_cones
end AspisR1.OraclePortJoinSplit
end

def ConeJoin {σ : Signature} (source model : Implementation σ) (cone : Cone) : Prop :=
structure PerConeJoins {σ : Signature} (source model : Implementation σ) : Prop where
def Covered {σ : Signature} {α : Type} (inventory : List Site) : Calls σ α → Prop
def S10Join {σ : Signature} (inventory : List Site) (tree : Input → Calls σ Bool) : Prop :=
theorem perCone_at {σ : Signature} {source model : Implementation σ}
theorem interpret_eq {σ : Signature} {α : Type} {source model : Implementation σ}

OraclePortRuntimeBindingC7.source:
import OraclePortStoredProbabilityC7

/-! Explicit unproved execution and runtime joins for the draft headline.
Full stored inputs survive in Runtime, through the probability experiment. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortRuntimeBindingC7
open FS FS2
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound AspisV8R19.OracleResampling
open OraclePortStoredExperimentC4 OraclePortStoredAdmissionC4 OraclePortStoredConsumerC7
open RawRecordedOracleExtractionMassBin

abbrev Verifier := Input → Program Bytes State Bool
abbrev Runtime := Program Bytes State (Option RunView)

def originalWith (rust : Verifier) (P : Prover) : Program Bytes State (Input × Bool) :=
  bind P fun i => bind (rust i) fun ok => .done (i,ok)

def annotatedWith (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (rust : Verifier) (P : Prover) :=
  originalWith rust (bind (OracleProgramRecording.record (originalWith rust P)) fun v =>
    .done (enrich (build D (view v)) v.2.1))

/-- Complete oracle-program equality, including every read, rejection and
returned Bool. This is the frozen Rust/source join, still a hypothesis. -/
def ExecutionJoin (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (rust : Verifier) : Prop :=
  ∀ i : Input, rust i = verifier D dV i

theorem annotatedWith_eq (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (rust : Verifier)
    (join : ExecutionJoin D rust) (P : Prover) :
    annotatedWith D rust P = annotated D dV P := by
  have hr : rust = verifier D dV := funext join
  rw [hr]
  rfl

/-- Runtime must bind the whole stored carrier and trace on every accepted
resumed run, in the same oracle world; this is stronger than a mass premise. -/
def StoredCarrierBinding (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (rust : Verifier)
    (P : Prover) (runtime : Runtime) : Prop :=
  ∀ H : Bytes → State, ∀ run : RunView,
    (eval H runtime).2 = some run → run.2.2 = true →
      run = eval H (annotatedWith D rust (canon P))

def runtimeMass (v : View Bytes State (Option RunView)) : ℚ :=
  match v.2 with
  | none => 0
  | some run => failureMass (view run)

def deployedFailure (runtime : Runtime) : ℚ := lazyMean runtime emptyTable runtimeMass

theorem failure_nonnegative (run : RawCutProverCompiler.RunView) : 0 ≤ failureMass run := by
  unfold failureMass
  have h := mean_mono (fun coins : GSConcreteByteDecoderBank.RawCoins =>
    indicator_nonneg (run.2.2 = true ∧ RawRecordedPublicSpendExtractorBin.extract run coins = none))
  simpa only [mean_const] using h

theorem transport (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (rust : Verifier) (P : Prover)
    (runtime : Runtime) (join : ExecutionJoin D rust)
    (binding : StoredCarrierBinding D rust P runtime) :
    deployedFailure runtime ≤ lazyMean (projected D P) emptyTable failureMass := by
  apply OracleProgramLawExt.lazyMean_le_of_eval
  intro H
  unfold runtimeMass
  cases hr : (eval H runtime).2 with
  | none => exact failure_nonnegative _
  | some run =>
      change failureMass (view run) ≤ failureMass (eval H (projected D P))
      by_cases accepted : run.2.2 = true
      · have same := binding H run hr accepted
        rw [annotatedWith_eq D rust join] at same
        rw [same,projected_eval]
      · have zero : failureMass (view run) = 0 := by
          unfold failureMass
          simp only [view] at *
          simp [accepted,indicator,mean_const]
        rw [zero]
        exact failure_nonnegative _

#print axioms annotatedWith_eq
#print axioms failure_nonnegative
#print axioms transport
end AspisR1.OraclePortRuntimeBindingC7
end

import OraclePortJoinSplitStd
import OraclePortStdBuilder
import OraclePortCkptAbi3OwnedIter

/-! Library-model boundary for allocation and owned Vec operations. The
reservation result is retained, including Allocation failure. These are
content semantics: capacity, physical allocation and Drop are not modeled by
Aeneas Vec. A source adopter must identify the actual reservation outcome;
this module never asserts allocator success for all frozen inputs. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortStdAllocation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open OraclePortCkptAbi2Vec OraclePortCkptAbi3OwnedIter

inductive AllocationError where
  | allocation
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Mutable Vec content and error are returned, rather than discarded. -/
def filled {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T)) :=
  if reserved then do
    let v ← appendModel (alloc.vec.Vec.new T) (List.replicate n.val value)
    ok (.ok v)
  else ok (.error .allocation)

def filledSpec {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T)) :=
  if reserved then ok (.ok ⟨List.replicate n.val value, by simp only [List.length_replicate]; scalar_tac⟩)
  else ok (.error .allocation)

theorem filled_exact {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    filled n value reserved = filledSpec n value reserved := by
  cases reserved with
  | false => rfl
  | true =>
    unfold filled filledSpec
    simp only [↓reduceIte]
    have bound : (alloc.vec.Vec.new T).val.length +
        (List.replicate n.val value).length ≤ Usize.max := by
      change 0 + (List.replicate n.val value).length ≤ Usize.max
      simp only [List.length_replicate, Nat.zero_add]
      scalar_tac
    rw [append_exact _ _ bound]
    rfl

theorem filled_failure {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) :
    filled n value false = ok (.error .allocation) := rfl

/-- Concrete declaration assignments, independent of the old owner labels. -/
def heapFilledSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "aspis_core::r0::heap::filled"⟩
def vecPushSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "alloc::vec::Vec::push"⟩
def vecAppendSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "alloc::vec::Vec::extend_from_slice"⟩
def ownedIterSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "alloc::vec::IntoIterator::into_iter/next"⟩
def fromFnSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "core::array::from_fn"⟩
def mapNextSite : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  ⟨.trustedStd, "core::iter::adapters::map::Map::next"⟩

def inventory : List OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Site :=
  [heapFilledSite, vecPushSite, vecAppendSite, ownedIterSite, fromFnSite, mapNextSite]

theorem inventory_std : ∀ s ∈ inventory, s.owner = .trustedStd := by
  intro s hs
  simp only [inventory, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hs
  rcases hs with h | h | h | h | h | h <;> subst s <;> rfl

/-- A concrete typed instance for the filled helper alone. Other declarations
are rejected, so the helper proof cannot grant trust to arbitrary std names. -/
def signature (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Signature :=
  ⟨fun _ => Usize × T × Bool,
   fun _ => Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T))⟩

def implementation (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Implementation (signature T) :=
  fun site args => .done (if site = heapFilledSite then
    filled args.1 args.2.1 args.2.2 else .fail .panic)

def specification (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Implementation (signature T) :=
  fun site args => .done (if site = heapFilledSite then
    filledSpec args.1 args.2.1 args.2.2 else .fail .panic)

theorem filled_cone_join (T : Type) : OraclePortJoinSplitStd.ConeJoin
    (implementation T) (specification T) .trustedStd := by
  intro site _ args
  simp only [implementation, specification, filled_exact]

/-- Coverage of the helper call includes both reservation outcomes, without
asserting that this one-call tree is the frozen verifier. -/
def helperTree {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Calls (signature T)
      (Result (Except AllocationError (alloc.vec.Vec T))) :=
  .invoke heapFilledSite (n,value,reserved) fun result => .done result

theorem helper_covered {T : Type} (n : Usize) (value : T) (reserved : Bool) :
    OraclePortJoinSplitStd.Covered inventory (helperTree n value reserved) := by
  exact ⟨by simp [inventory], fun _ => True.intro⟩

#print axioms filled_cone_join
#print axioms helper_covered

#print axioms filled_exact
#print axioms filled_failure
#print axioms inventory_std
#print axioms OraclePortCkptAbi2Vec.push_exact
#print axioms OraclePortCkptAbi2Vec.append_exact
#print axioms OraclePortCkptAbi3OwnedIter.owned_contents
end AspisR1.OraclePortStdAllocation

import OraclePortStoredConsumerC7
import OraclePortPureOutputC7
import OraclePortHeadline

/-! Stored-aware M9 consumer. Projection preserves every oracle read and
exactly the failure observable; kappa and B are inherited unchanged. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.OraclePortStoredProbabilityC7
open FS FS2 R0C.V3
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.OracleProgramOps
open AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound AspisV8R19.AdaptiveFirstReadLaw
open OraclePortStoredExperimentC4 OraclePortStoredAdmissionC4
open OraclePortStoredConsumerC7 RawRecordedOracleExtractionMassBin

/-- Equality under the actual memoized probability law, for every observable.
In particular failure, collision and chain-hit events are unchanged. -/
theorem mass_projection (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (P : Prover)
    (observe : RawCutProverCompiler.RunView → ℚ) :
    lazyMean (projected D P) emptyTable observe =
      lazyMean (annotated D dV (canon P)) emptyTable (fun v => observe (view v)) :=
  OraclePortPureOutputC7.lazyMean_map _ _ _ _

theorem first_reads (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H P).1.length ≤ Q) (H : Bytes → State) :
    firstReads emptyTable (eval H (projected D P)).1 ≤ Q+1161 := by
  rw [projected_eval]
  exact OraclePortStoredAccountingC4.distinct_bound D dV (build D) (canon P) Q
    (fun H => by rw [canon_eval]; exact hq H)
    OraclePortStoredDecisionDraftC4.decision_budget H

theorem starts (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H P).1.length ≤ Q) (H : Bytes → State) :
    DecodedFirstReadUnionBound.decoderFirstReads RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.dec emptyTable
      (eval H (projected D P)).1 ≤ Q+1080 := by
  rw [projected_eval]
  exact OraclePortStoredAccountingC4.starts_bound D dV (build D) (canon P) Q
    (fun H => by rw [canon_eval]; exact hq H)
    OraclePortStoredDecisionDraftC4.decision_budget H

theorem log_length (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H P).1.length ≤ Q) (H : Bytes → State) :
    (eval H (projected D P)).1.length ≤ Q+2322 := by
  rw [projected_eval]
  exact recorded_length D dV (build D) (canon P) Q
    (fun H => by rw [canon_eval]; exact hq H)
    OraclePortStoredDecisionDraftC4.decision_budget H

/-- The inherited binary union bound on the unchanged adaptive experiment. -/
theorem failure_bound (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H P).1.length ≤ Q) :
    lazyMean (projected D P) emptyTable failureMass ≤
      BinCombinedMerkleCollision.kappa (Q+1161) +
        ((Q+1080 : Nat) : ℚ)*PerAttemptEnvelope.B + 1/(2:ℚ)^126 := by
  have hc := BinCombinedMerkleCollision.mass SelectedTranscriptParams.params.iv
    (Q+1161) (projected D P) (first_reads D P Q hq)
  have hs := RawAdaptiveClassifierStartBound.shared_hit_mass_le_starts
    RawFullPublicSelection.select LiteralTableWordChoiceBin.choose (projected D P) (Q+1080)
    (starts D P Q hq)
  apply shared_oracle_failure_le_supplied_hit_bound D (projected D P) (bad Q) (clean D P Q hq)
  calc
    lazyMean (projected D P) emptyTable (fun run => indicator (bad Q run)) ≤
        lazyMean (projected D P) emptyTable (fun run =>
          indicator (RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.binaryCollision (Q+1161) run) +
          indicator (hitsChain3 RecordedBinaryExperimentBin.dec
            RawAdaptiveClassifierHitDensity.classifier emptyTable run.1)) :=
      AllAddressFiatShamir.lazyMean_mono_of_eval _ _ _ (fun _ => indicator_or_le _ _)
    _ = _ := lazyMean_add _ _ _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add hc hs

/-- The same bound stated directly on the stored carrier. -/
theorem stored_failure_bound (D : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder) (P : Prover) (Q : Nat)
    (hq : ∀ H : Bytes → State, (eval H P).1.length ≤ Q) :
    lazyMean (annotated D dV (canon P)) emptyTable (fun v => failureMass (view v)) ≤
      BinCombinedMerkleCollision.kappa (Q+1161) +
        ((Q+1080 : Nat) : ℚ)*PerAttemptEnvelope.B + 1/(2:ℚ)^126 := by
  rw [← mass_projection]
  exact failure_bound D P Q hq

#print axioms mass_projection
#print axioms first_reads
#print axioms starts
#print axioms log_length
#print axioms failure_bound
#print axioms stored_failure_bound
end AspisR1.OraclePortStoredProbabilityC7
end

Port3_CheckpointInstall.source:
import VTop_Checkpoint

/-! Concrete checkpoint REFERENCE installation. The selector writer is S2
specific. Native source adoption is the domain-sensitive P6 obligation; no
native equality or successful observation is a field of this construction. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port3_CheckpointInstall
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result VTop_Stages
open CheckpointBytes5Effect

/-- Converse of erasure, for the SAME Code execution and any initial log. -/
theorem erase_success_run {A H : Type}
    (D : AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (code : Code A) (a : A) (accepted : erase D hash code = ok a) (before : Log) :
    ∃ after, run D hash code before = ok (a,after) := by
  induction code generalizing before with
  | done value =>
    have eq := Result.ok.inj accepted
    subst value
    exact ⟨before,rfl⟩
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => cases accepted
    | div => cases accepted
    | ok b => exact ih b accepted before
  | read parts k ih =>
    cases call : D.digest hash parts with
    | fail e => simp only [erase,call,bind_tc_fail] at accepted; cases accepted
    | div => simp only [erase,call,bind_tc_div] at accepted; cases accepted
    | ok b =>
      simp only [erase,call,bind_tc_ok] at accepted
      obtain ⟨after,success⟩ := ih b accepted (before ++ [(parts,b)])
      exact ⟨after,by simpa only [run,call,bind_tc_ok] using success⟩

def writer {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (proof pub : Slice U8) (hash : H) : Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) := do
  let ck ← erase (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) hash
    (CheckpointBytes5Writer.writer (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared p)
      (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator a) proof pub)
  ok ⟨ck.val,ck.property⟩

def error : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.Error → verifier.Error
  | .Parse => .Parse | .Semantic => .Semantic | .Transcript => .Transcript
  | .Relation => .Relation | .Merkle => .Merkle | .Query => .Query
  | .Checkpoint => .Checkpoint | .Allocation => .Allocation

def reader (reserved : Bool) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (ck proof pub : Slice U8) (v : transport.Variant) (hash : H) :
    Result (core.result.Result (verifier.Prepared × verifier.Accumulator) verifier.Error) := do
  let out ← AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
    (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) ck proof pub v hash
  match out with
  | .Ok pair => ok (.Ok pair)
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (error e))

/-- Remaining operations are visibly unchanged and uninstalled. -/
def install (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) : Ops :=
  {base with op8 := writer, op18 := reader reserved}

theorem writer_run {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (proof pub : Slice U8) (hash : H) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : writer D p a proof pub hash = ok saved) (before : Log) :
    ∃ after, run (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) hash
      (CheckpointBytes5Writer.writer (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared p)
        (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator a) proof pub) before =
        ok (VTop_Checkpoint.checkpointSlice saved,after) := by
  unfold writer at accepted
  generalize h : erase (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) hash
    (CheckpointBytes5Writer.writer (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared p)
      (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator a) proof pub) = result at accepted
  cases result with
  | fail e => cases accepted
  | div => cases accepted
  | ok ck =>
    have eq := Result.ok.inj accepted
    subst saved
    exact erase_success_run _ _ _ ck h before

theorem reader_success (reserved : Bool) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (ck proof pub : Slice U8) (v : transport.Variant) (hash : H)
    (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (accepted : reader reserved D ck proof pub v hash = ok (.Ok (p,a))) :
    AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
      (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) ck proof pub v hash = ok (.Ok (p,a)) := by
  unfold reader at accepted
  generalize h : AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
    (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) ck proof pub v hash = result at accepted
  cases result with
  | fail e => cases accepted
  | div => cases accepted
  | ok r =>
    cases r with
    | Err e => cases accepted
    | Ok pair =>
      have eq := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj accepted)
      subst pair
      rfl

/-- Discharges the entire CheckpointSourceJoin for the reference installation.
State provenance and actual Rust-to-reference adoption remain separate. -/
theorem source_join (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) {H : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) :
    VTop_Checkpoint.CheckpointSourceJoin (install base reserved) D hash reserved := by
  constructor
  · intro semantic proof pub split p a saved _ accepted
    obtain ⟨after,success⟩ := writer_run D p a proof pub hash saved accepted []
    exact ⟨[],after,success⟩
  · intro ck proof pub p a accepted
    exact reader_success reserved D ck proof pub .S2 hash p a accepted

#print axioms erase_success_run
#print axioms writer_run
#print axioms reader_success
#print axioms source_join
end AspisR1.Port3_CheckpointInstall
end
