theorem reader_success (reserved : Bool) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)

Port3_CheckpointRows.source:
import Port3_CheckpointInstall

/-! Same-byte complete checkpoint composition for the fixed reference ops.
The only success observations are the actual installed writer return and the
actual installed reader on exactly that returned Vec with unchanged inputs. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port3_CheckpointRows
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result VTop_Stages
open CheckpointBytes5Effect CheckpointBytes5Inputs Port3_CheckpointInstall
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open MultiproofConeCanonical OraclePortCompactDraft

theorem combined_run (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) {H : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H)
    (wp : verifier.Prepared) (wa : verifier.Accumulator)
    (proof pub : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (wrote : (install base reserved).op8 D wp wa proof pub hash = ok saved)
    (resumed : (install base reserved).op18 D (VTop_Checkpoint.checkpointSlice saved)
      proof pub .S2 hash = ok (.Ok (p,a))) (before : Log) :
    ∃ after, run (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) hash
      (CheckpointBytes5Join.stage reserved (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared wp)
        (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator wa) proof pub) before = ok (.Ok (p,a),after) := by
  obtain ⟨middle,writerRun⟩ := writer_run D wp wa proof pub hash saved wrote before
  have readerSource := reader_success reserved D (VTop_Checkpoint.checkpointSlice saved)
    proof pub .S2 hash p a resumed
  have readerErase : erase (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) hash
      (CheckpointBytes5Resume.program (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
        (VTop_Checkpoint.checkpointSlice saved) proof pub .S2) = ok (.Ok (p,a)) := by
    rw [CheckpointBytes5Resume.source]
    exact readerSource
  obtain ⟨after,readerRun⟩ := erase_success_run _ _ _ _ readerErase middle
  refine ⟨after,?_⟩
  simp only [CheckpointBytes5Join.stage,run_bind,writerRun,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  exact readerRun

/-- All returned fields and all six reads, with the same source slices and
actual returned checkpoint; no independent checkpoint execution is assumed. -/
theorem fields_and_reads (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) {Hash : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (H : Bytes → State)
    (wp : verifier.Prepared) (wa : verifier.Accumulator)
    (proof pub : Slice U8) (stored publicBytes : Bytes)
    (pm : OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.Prepared)
    (am : QueryAccumulator.State OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.K OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.E)
    (caller : CheckpointBytes5Join.S2S10CallerBinding (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D)
      hash H proof pub stored publicBytes)
    (provenance : CheckpointBytes5Join.S1S7S8StateProvenance
      (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared wp) (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator wa) pm am)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (wrote : (install base reserved).op8 D wp wa proof pub hash = ok saved)
    (resumed : (install base reserved).op18 D (VTop_Checkpoint.checkpointSlice saved)
      proof pub .S2 hash = ok (.Ok (p,a))) (before : Log) :
    ∃ after,
      run (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) hash
        (CheckpointBytes5Join.stage reserved (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared wp)
          (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator wa) proof pub) before = ok (.Ok (p,a),after) ∧
      CheckpointBytes4SavedFields.BodyMatches p a pm am ∧ a.next.val = am.next ∧
      reserved = true ∧ observe after = observe before ++
        CheckpointBytes5Join.six H stored publicBytes
          (OraclePortPhysicalFrameDraft.domain ++ OraclePortCheckpointAbiC5.body pm am
            (H stored) (H publicBytes)) := by
  obtain ⟨after,success⟩ := combined_run base reserved D hash wp wa proof pub saved p a wrote resumed before
  exact ⟨after,success,CheckpointBytes5Join.successful_fields_and_reads
    (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) hash H reserved _ _ proof pub stored publicBytes pm am
    caller provenance p a before after success⟩

#print axioms combined_run
#print axioms fields_and_reads
end AspisR1.Port3_CheckpointRows
end

import Port4A_ReaderNormalize
import Port3_NativeWriterShape
import Port3_CheckpointRows
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.Port4A_ReaderInstall
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result VTop_Stages

theorem mul_value (x y : Usize) (h : x.val*y.val≤65536) :
    x*y=ok (Usize.ofNat (x.val*y.val) (by scalar_tac)) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.mul_spec (x:=x) (y:=y) (by scalar_tac))
  have same : z=Usize.ofNat (x.val*y.val) (by scalar_tac) := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simpa using hv
  simpa only [same] using hz

theorem add_value (x y : Usize) (h : x.val+y.val≤65536) :
    x+y=ok (Usize.ofNat (x.val+y.val) (by scalar_tac)) := by
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.add_spec (x:=x) (y:=y) (by scalar_tac))
  have same : z=Usize.ofNat (x.val+y.val) (by scalar_tac) := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    simpa using hv
  simpa only [same] using hz

theorem size_bound (reserved : Bool) (v : AspisR1Stage2.transport.Variant) (n : Usize)
    (h : (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved).checkpointSize v=ok n) : 32≤n.val := by
  cases v <;>
    simp only [CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops,CheckpointBytes4Ops.checkpointSize,
      CheckpointBytes4Ops.finalLen,bind_tc_ok] at h <;>
    rw [mul_value _ _ (by decide),bind_tc_ok,add_value _ _ (by decide)] at h <;>
    cases Result.ok.inj h <;> decide

def reader (reserved : Bool) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (ck proof pub : Slice U8) (v : transport.Variant) (hash : H) :
    Result (core.result.Result (verifier.Prepared × verifier.Accumulator) verifier.Error) := do
  let out ← Port4A_NativeReader.resume (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
    (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) ck proof pub v hash
  match out with
  | .Ok pair => ok (.Ok pair)
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (Port3_CheckpointInstall.error e))

theorem reference_eq (reserved : Bool) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H)
    (ck proof pub : Slice U8) (v : transport.Variant) (hash : H) :
    reader reserved D ck proof pub v hash =
      Port3_CheckpointInstall.reader reserved D ck proof pub v hash := by
  unfold reader Port3_CheckpointInstall.reader
  rw [Port4A_ReaderNormalize.source _ (size_bound reserved)]
  rfl

def install (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) : Ops :=
  {base with op18 := reader reserved}

theorem accepted_source (base : Ops) (reserved : Bool) {H : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (ck proof pub : Slice U8)
    (v : transport.Variant) (p : verifier.Prepared) (a : verifier.Accumulator)
    (h : (install base reserved).op18 D ck proof pub v hash=ok (.Ok (p,a))) :
    AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
      (VTop_Checkpoint.digest D) ck proof pub v hash=ok (.Ok (p,a)) := by
  change reader reserved D ck proof pub v hash=_ at h
  rw [reference_eq] at h
  exact Port3_CheckpointInstall.reader_success reserved D ck proof pub v hash p a h

#print axioms add_value
#print axioms size_bound
#print axioms reference_eq
#print axioms accepted_source
end AspisR1.Port4A_ReaderInstall

import R0P.MaskDensity
import R0P.MaskSource

/-! Duplex transfer of masked semantic/circle/opening root bounds. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace R0P.Mask
open FS FS2 FS2.Duplex R0C.SemStatement R0P.SemSource R0P.SemD3Glue
open AspisV8R19.MemoizedProgramLaw AspisV8R19.AdaptiveFirstReadLaw
open AspisV8R19.OracleResampling AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8PairedCommitment
open AspisR0.ChordGeometry R0C.SlackStatement AspisWideTower
noncomputable section
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
variable {Sfield : Fin 29 → Subfield WideExact} {F : Subfield WideExact} {L : Nat}
variable (maskClaims : (Fin 29 → WideExact) → (Fin 29 → WideExact) → (Fin 10 → WideExact) → WideExact) (B : PackBasis F) (budget : Nat → ℚ)

abbrev DP := FS.Prefix (TypedContext WideExact Sfield) (MsgZ WideExact) (Duplex.Chal (ChalZ WideExact))

theorem flipZ (P : DP (Sfield := Sfield)) (m : MsgZ WideExact) (c : Duplex.Chal (ChalZ WideExact))
    (T' T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (hd : (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed P T')
    (hn : ¬ (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed (P.ext m c) T) :
    roundBad (sourceDataZ maskClaims B) (valuePrefix P) m c.1 := by
  apply doomed_ext_roundBad (sourceDataZ maskClaims B) (valuePrefix P) m c.1 T' T hd
  have hn' : ¬ doomed (sourceDataZ maskClaims B) (valuePrefix (P.ext m c)) T := hn
  simpa only [valuePrefix_ext] using hn'

/-- The fresh absorb and advance answers disappear after pointwise containment. -/
theorem one_row_bound (p : Duplex.Params (MsgZ WideExact) (ChalZ WideExact) L)
    (i : Nat) (P : DP (Sfield := Sfield)) (m : MsgZ WideExact) (T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (bad : State → Prop) (e : ℚ)
    (hpoint : ∀ a b : State, ¬ (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed
      (P.ext m (p.σ i a, b)) T → bad a)
    (hmass : mean (fun a => indicator (bad a)) ≤ e) :
    independentMean (Duplex.samp p i P m).toProgram
      (fun w => indicator (¬ (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed (P.ext m w.2) T)) ≤ e := by
  rw [Duplex.samp_mean p i P m
    (fun c => ¬ (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed (P.ext m c) T)]
  apply le_trans _ hmass
  apply mean_mono
  intro a
  apply le_trans (mean_mono (fun b => indicator_mono (hpoint a b)))
  exact (mean_const _).le

theorem early_roundBadZ (Q : Prefix WideExact WideExact (TypedContext WideExact Sfield) (SemMsgZ WideExact))
    (m : MsgZ WideExact) (c : ChalZ WideExact) (hi : Q.round < 25)
    (h : roundBad (sourceDataZ maskClaims B) Q m c) :
    ∃ sm k, m = .semantic sm ∧ c = .semantic k ∧ semanticBadZ maskClaims B Q sm k := by
  simp only [roundBad, sourceDataZ, sourceDataWithFallbackZ] at h
  rcases h with hs | hz0 | hz1 | ho
  · obtain ⟨sm,k,_,hm,hc,hb⟩ := hs
    exact ⟨sm,k,hm,hc,hb⟩
  · obtain ⟨_,_,hr,_,_,_⟩ := hz0; omega
  · obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,hr,_,_,_,_⟩ := hz1; omega
  · obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,_,hr,_⟩ := ho; omega

def semanticMessageBadZ (Q : Prefix WideExact WideExact (TypedContext WideExact Sfield) (SemMsgZ WideExact))
    (m : MsgZ WideExact) (c : WideExact) : Prop :=
  match m with
  | .semantic sm => semanticBadZ maskClaims B Q sm c
  | _ => False

theorem combinedD2BudgetZ_nonneg (i : Nat) : 0 ≤ combinedD2BudgetZ i := by
  have hδ := deltaQ_nonneg
  have heps (j : Nat) : 0 ≤ epsilonSlack WideExact delta0 j :=
    R0C.SlackDensity.epsilonSlack_nonneg R0C.ConcreteSlack.delta0_nonneg j
  unfold combinedD2BudgetZ
  split_ifs
  · unfold combinedD2Budget
    split_ifs <;> first | positivity | exact heps _
  all_goals first | positivity | exact heps _

theorem semantic_rowZ_D2 (p : Duplex.Params (MsgZ WideExact) (ChalZ WideExact) L)
    (i : Nat) (P : DP (Sfield := Sfield)) (m : MsgZ WideExact) (T' T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (hr : P.round = i) (hi : i < 25)
    (hd : (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed P T')
    (hσ : ∀ a, p.σ i a = .semantic (semChal a)) :
    independentMean (Duplex.samp p i P m).toProgram
      (fun w => indicator (¬ (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed (P.ext m w.2) T)) ≤
      combinedD2BudgetZ i := by
  let Q := valuePrefix P
  have hQr : Q.round = i := (valuePrefix_round P).trans hr
  apply one_row_bound maskClaims B budget p i P m T
    (fun a => semanticMessageBadZ maskClaims B Q m (semChal a)) _
  · intro a b hf
    obtain ⟨sm,k,hm,hc,hb⟩ := early_roundBadZ maskClaims B Q m (p.σ i a)
      (by rw [hQr]; exact hi) (flipZ maskClaims B budget P m (p.σ i a,b) T' T hd hf)
    rw [hσ a] at hc
    have hk := Chal.semantic.inj hc
    rw [hm, hk]
    exact hb
  · cases m <;> simp only [semanticMessageBadZ, indicator_false, mean_const]
    · rename_i sm
      have h := semantic_round_densityZ maskClaims B Q sm (by change Q.round < 25; omega)
      simpa only [show Q.rounds.length = i from hQr] using h
    all_goals exact combinedD2BudgetZ_nonneg i

theorem circle0_roundBadZ (Q : Prefix WideExact WideExact (TypedContext WideExact Sfield) (SemMsgZ WideExact))
    (m : MsgZ WideExact) (c : ChalZ WideExact) (hr : Q.round = 25)
    (h : roundBad (sourceDataZ maskClaims B) Q m c) :
    ∃ (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → WideExact) (z : Point WideExact), m = .beforeZ0 y ∧ c = .circle z ∧ z0Bad' z := by
  simp only [roundBad, sourceDataZ, sourceDataWithFallbackZ] at h
  rcases h with hs | hz0 | hz1 | ho
  · obtain ⟨_,_,hlt,_,_,_⟩ := hs; omega
  · obtain ⟨y,z,_,hm,hc,hb⟩ := hz0; exact ⟨y,z,hm,hc,hb⟩
  · obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,he,_,_,_,_⟩ := hz1; omega
  · obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,_,he,_⟩ := ho; omega

theorem circle1_roundBadZ (Q : Prefix WideExact WideExact (TypedContext WideExact Sfield) (SemMsgZ WideExact))
    (m : MsgZ WideExact) (c : ChalZ WideExact) (hr : Q.round = 26)
    (h : roundBad (sourceDataZ maskClaims B) Q m c) :
    ∃ (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → WideExact) (y0 : Fin 29 → WideExact) (z0 z1 : Point WideExact), Q.rounds.getLast? = some (.beforeZ0 y, .circle z0) ∧
      m = .beforeZ1 y0 ∧ c = .circle z1 ∧ z1Bad z0 z1 := by
  simp only [roundBad, sourceDataZ, sourceDataWithFallbackZ] at h
  rcases h with hs | hz0 | hz1 | ho
  · obtain ⟨_,_,hlt,_,_,_⟩ := hs; omega
  · obtain ⟨_,_,he,_,_,_⟩ := hz0; omega
  · obtain ⟨y,y0,z0,z1,_,hp,hm,hc,hb⟩ := hz1; exact ⟨y,y0,z0,z1,hp,hm,hc,hb⟩
  · obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,_,he,_⟩ := ho; omega

theorem circle_slack_le_two : (1 + deltaQ) / (AspisCircleGroupOrder.P : ℚ)^4 ≤
    2 / (AspisCircleGroupOrder.P : ℚ)^4 := by
  apply div_le_div_of_nonneg_right _ (pow_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) _)
  have h : deltaQ ≤ 1 := deltaQ_small.trans (by norm_num)
  linarith

theorem circle_row25_D2 (p : Duplex.Params (MsgZ WideExact) (ChalZ WideExact) L)
    (P : DP (Sfield := Sfield)) (m : MsgZ WideExact) (T' T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (hr : P.round = 25) (hd : (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed P T')
    (hσ : ∀ a, p.σ 25 a = .circle (R0P.SemSource.circleSample0 a)) :
    independentMean (Duplex.samp p 25 P m).toProgram
      (fun w => indicator (¬ (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed (P.ext m w.2) T)) ≤
      2 / (AspisCircleGroupOrder.P : ℚ)^4 := by
  apply one_row_bound maskClaims B budget p 25 P m T (fun a => z0Bad' (R0P.SemSource.circleSample0 a)) _
  · intro a b hf
    obtain ⟨y,z,_,hc,hb⟩ := circle0_roundBadZ maskClaims B (valuePrefix P) m (p.σ 25 a)
      ((valuePrefix_round P).trans hr) (flipZ maskClaims B budget P m (p.σ 25 a,b) T' T hd hf)
    rw [hσ a] at hc
    exact (Chal.circle.inj hc).symm ▸ hb
  · apply le_trans _ circle_slack_le_two
    simpa only [R0P.SemSource.P_eq] using R0P.SemSource.circleSample0_mass

theorem no_hit_last_circle_ne_fallbackZ
    (Q : Prefix WideExact WideExact (TypedContext WideExact Sfield) (SemMsgZ WideExact))
    (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → WideExact) (z0 : Point WideExact) (hr : Q.round = 26)
    (hprev : Q.rounds.getLast? = some (.beforeZ0 y, .circle z0))
    (hno : ¬ hitFrom (sourceDataZ maskClaims B) Q.statement [] Q.rounds) : z0 ≠ R0P.SemSource.circleFallback1 := by
  obtain ⟨rs,hrs⟩ := List.getLast?_eq_some_iff.mp hprev
  have hlen : rs.length = 25 := by
    change Q.rounds.length = 26 at hr
    rw [hrs, List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at hr
    omega
  intro heq
  apply hno
  rw [hrs, hitFrom_append]
  apply Or.inr
  simp only [List.nil_append, hitFrom]
  apply Or.inl
  apply Or.inr
  apply Or.inl
  exact ⟨y,z0,hlen,rfl,rfl,Or.inr heq⟩

theorem circle_row26_D2 (p : Duplex.Params (MsgZ WideExact) (ChalZ WideExact) L)
    (P : DP (Sfield := Sfield)) (m : MsgZ WideExact) (T' T : Table (Addr L) State)
    (hr : P.round = 26) (hd : (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed P T')
    (hσ : ∀ a, p.σ 26 a = .circle (R0P.SemSource.circleSample1 a)) :
    independentMean (Duplex.samp p 26 P m).toProgram
      (fun w => indicator (¬ (duplexRowsZ maskClaims B budget).doomed (P.ext m w.2) T)) ≤
      2 / (AspisCircleGroupOrder.P : ℚ)^4 := by
  let Q := valuePrefix P
  have hQr : Q.round = 26 := (valuePrefix_round P).trans hr
  by_cases hp : ∃ (y : Fin 3 → Fin 29 → WideExact) (z0 : Point WideExact), Q.rounds.getLast? = some (.beforeZ0 y, .circle z0)
  · obtain ⟨y,z0,hprev⟩ := hp
    have hz0 := no_hit_last_circle_ne_fallbackZ maskClaims B Q y z0 hQr hprev hd.2
    apply one_row_bound maskClaims B budget p 26 P m T (fun a => z1Bad z0 (R0P.SemSource.circleSample1 a)) _
    · intro a b hf
      obtain ⟨y',y0,z0',z1,hprev',_,hc,hb⟩ := circle1_roundBadZ maskClaims B Q m (p.σ 26 a) hQr
        (flipZ maskClaims B budget P m (p.σ 26 a,b) T' T hd hf)
      have hz := Chal.circle.inj (congrArg Prod.snd (Option.some.inj (hprev.symm.trans hprev')))
      rw [hσ a] at hc
      rw [hz, Chal.circle.inj hc]
      exact hb
    · apply le_trans _ circle_slack_le_two
      simpa only [R0P.SemSource.P_eq] using R0P.SemSource.circleSample1_mass z0 hz0
  · apply one_row_bound maskClaims B budget p 26 P m T (fun _ => False) _
    · intro a b hf
      obtain ⟨y,y0,z0,z1,hprev,_,_,_⟩ := circle1_roundBadZ maskClaims B Q m (p.σ 26 a) hQr
        (flipZ maskClaims B budget P m (p.σ 26 a,b) T' T hd hf)
      exact hp ⟨y,z0,hprev⟩
    · simp only [indicator_false, mean_const]
      positivity

#print axioms flipZ
#print axioms one_row_bound
#print axioms semantic_rowZ_D2
#print axioms circle_row25_D2
#print axioms circle_row26_D2
end
end R0P.Mask

import R1LiteralSemanticPrefix
import R1SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts
import R1LiteralTypedContext
import R1PublicBaseMap
import R1ExactBaseProjection
import R0P.MaskD2Glue
import R0P.MaskValue

/-! Causal, table-free semantic views of literal-message prefixes. C1 is read
from row zero (the current message at round zero); C2 is read only from the
message carrying it. The old semantic density theorem is reused on this
view. This does not establish the later terminal or compiler implication. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.LiteralSemanticView

open FS R0P R0P.SemSource R0P.Mask
open AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase AspisWideTower
open AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep AspisV8R19.OracleResampling
open AspisV8R19.CausalFirstHitUnionBound

abbrev E := WideExact
def eK : QM31Exact →+* E := algebraMap QM31Exact E
abbrev F := ExactBaseProjection.embed.fieldRange
abbrev S := LiteralTypedWords.laneSubfield ExactBaseProjection.embed eK
abbrev Context := TypedContext E S

structure View (round : Nat) where
  context : Context
  rounds : List (SemMsgZ E × E)
  length_eq : rounds.length = round
  message : SemMsgZ E

def View.prefix {round : Nat} (v : View round) : FS.Prefix Context (MsgZ E) (ChalZ E) :=
  ⟨v.context, SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift v.rounds⟩

theorem View.prefix_length {round : Nat} (v : View round) :
    v.prefix.rounds.length = round := by
  simpa [View.prefix, SelectedSemanticPrefixFacts.lift] using v.length_eq

/-- The appended marker supplies only the current message. Its dummy challenge
is never consumed by the semantic-prefix reader. -/
def read (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix) (m : LiteralTranscript.Message) :
    Option (View P.round) :=
  if hrow : P.round < 25 then do
    let pub ← SemanticPublicWire.parsePublic P.statement.pubBytes
    let c1 ← LiteralTranscript.c1At
      (P.rounds ++ [(m, (TranscriptView.Value.ordinary 0, 0))])
    match hread : LiteralSemanticPrefix.read eK 0 P.rounds with
    | none => none
    | some rounds => do
        let current ← LiteralSemanticPrefix.parseMessage eK ⟨P.round, hrow⟩ m
        pure ⟨LiteralTypedContext.context ExactBaseProjection.embed eK
          (SpendDataMap.mapPublic ExactBaseProjection.embed pub)
          (PublicBaseMap.mapPublic_base ExactBaseProjection.embed pub) c1 (fun _ => 0),
          rounds, LiteralSemanticPrefix.read_length eK 0 P.rounds rounds hread, current⟩
  else none

/-- Only a successfully parsed, fixed semantic view contributes a bad event. -/
def bad (B : PackBasis F) (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix)
    (m : LiteralTranscript.Message) (c : E) : Prop :=
  match read P m with
  | none => False
  | some v => semanticBadZ (maskClaimsR0 B) B v.prefix v.message c

theorem density (B : PackBasis F) (P : LiteralTranscript.Prefix)
    (m : LiteralTranscript.Message) (hi : P.round < 25) :
    mean (fun s : State => indicator (bad B P m (semChal s))) ≤
      combinedD2BudgetZ P.round := by
  classical
  cases h : read P m with
  | none =>
      simp only [bad, h, indicator_false, mean_const]
      exact combinedD2BudgetZ_nonneg P.round
  | some v =>
      have hlen := v.prefix_length
      have hd := semantic_round_densityZ (maskClaimsR0 B) B v.prefix v.message
        (by rw [hlen]; exact hi)
      simpa only [bad, h, hlen] using hd

#print axioms View.prefix_length
#print axioms density

end AspisR1.LiteralSemanticView
end

import BinCompiledRunWordStability
import BinThreeCommitmentTypedOpening
import BinRecordedRecoveryWitness
import SharedBinaryRecordGrammar
import RawCutRecordedWordsExecutableBin
import RawCommitmentFrameReplay
import RawCommitmentFrameReplayCorrect
import RawCutWordsFromView
import GSByteJointSpendExtractor
import R1ExactBaseProjection
import R1LiteralSemanticView
import R1LiteralTypedWords
import RawCutProverCompiler

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.RawCutWordsFromRunExecutableBin

open AspisR1.CanonicalCutEnrichedTranscript
open AspisR1.RawCutRecordedWordsExecutable
open AspisR1.RawCommitmentFrameReplay
open AspisR1.RawCutProverCompiler
open AspisR1.GSByteJointSpendExtractor
open AspisR1.LiteralTranscript
open AspisPool.AlgorithmicCircleDecoderV7 AspisV8R15.ExactTowerBase SpendRelation

abbrev RunView := RawCutProverCompiler.RunView
abbrev Words := CanonicalCutEnrichedTranscript.Words

/-- Binary recovery at the actual replayed commitment cuts. The maps use
strict two-child nodes and eighteen binary slots; typed projections are shared. -/
def wordsFromRun (run : RunView) : Words :=
  let f0 := RawCommitmentFrameReplay.frameFromView run 0
  let f2 := RawCommitmentFrameReplay.frameFromView run 2
  let f30 := RawCommitmentFrameReplay.frameFromView run 30
  RawCutRecordedWordsExecutableBin.wordsFromRecordedCutsExec run.1 f0 f2 f30
    (RawCutWordsFromView.rootFrom 8 f0) (RawCutWordsFromView.rootFrom 8 f2)
    (RawCutWordsFromView.rootFrom 9 f30)

/-- The 29 fixed initial words that the maintained byte-GS extractor consumes,
constructed from the recovered typed C1/C2 maps. -/
def initialWordsFromRun (run : RunView) : Fin 29 → InitialWord AspisWideTower.WideExact :=
  LiteralTypedWords.word ExactBaseProjection.embed
    (algebraMap QM31Exact AspisWideTower.WideExact)
    (wordsFromRun run).c1 (wordsFromRun run).c2

/-- The fixed final word consumed by the same extractor is the recovered
folded commitment word. -/
def finalWordFromRun (run : RunView) : FinalWord AspisWideTower.WideExact :=
  (wordsFromRun run).final

/-- Actual fixed-word extractor caller on the words recovered from this run.
This definition does not assert that those words are already the generated
prover inputs; that is supplied by the checked frame-replay theorem below. -/
def extractFromRun (pub : R0P.Public M31Exact) (run : RunView)
    (coins : GSConcreteByteDecoderBank.RawCoins) : Option Wspend :=
  GSByteJointSpendExtractor.extract pub (initialWordsFromRun run)
    (fun _ => finalWordFromRun run) coins

/-- Validity is stated on the real proof rows through the final commitment
cut and is the sole premise needed by the checked frame-replay theorem. -/
def ValidPrefix (run : RunView) : Prop :=
  ∀ row, row ≤ 30 → LiteralTranscript.valid row (run.2.1.2 row)

/-- The checked transcript replay supplies the frame bytes at rows 0, 2, and
30, so the executable raw-word construction is exactly the recorded-cut
constructor. No frame-compatibility hypothesis is postulated. -/
theorem wordsFromRun_eq_buildWords (decoder : LiteralByteProtocol.Decoder)
    (run : RunView) (hvalid : ValidPrefix run) :
    wordsFromRun run = BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun decoder run := by
  unfold wordsFromRun BinCompiledRunWordStability.wordsFromRun
  rw [RawCutRecordedWordsExecutableBin.wordsFromRecordedCutsExec_eq_wordsFromRawCuts]
  obtain ⟨h0, h2, h30⟩ :=
    RawCommitmentFrameReplayCorrect.frameFromView_commitments_eq decoder run hvalid
  simp only [RawCutWordsFromView.frameFromView] at h0 h2 h30
  rw [h0, h2, h30]
  rfl

#print axioms wordsFromRun
#print axioms initialWordsFromRun
#print axioms finalWordFromRun
#print axioms extractFromRun
#print axioms wordsFromRun_eq_buildWords
end AspisR1.RawCutWordsFromRunExecutableBin

RepinS6First.source:
import ExtractedFirstCallerReachability

/-! Complete emitted frozen first/first_decoded control flow, interpreted with
the checked decoder and selector of PreparationBinding and explicit downstream
functions. No SDK/runtime or downstream tx1 refinement is asserted here.
The frozen release observer is None; original byte slices are retained. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.RepinS6First
open PreparationBinding FirstCaller

/-- The emitted observer body for the release feature set. -/
def observer : Result (Option (Phase → Result Unit)) := do
  ok none

def first_decoded {E F : Type}
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E)
    (public1 : Public) (public_bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) E) := do
  let o ← observer
  let r ← tx1 public1 public_bytes proof k () o
  core.result.Result.map_err (BuiltinFnOnce F E) r error

def first {E F : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E)
    (public_bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) :
    Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) E) := do
  let r ← decode public_bytes
  let r1 ← core.result.Result.map_err (decodeErrorClosure invalidAccountData) r ()
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let p ← pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public val
    first_decoded tx1 error p public_bytes proof k
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (alloc.vec.Vec U8) (core.convert.FromSame E) residual

/-- Full-result equality, including failure, divergence and mapped errors.
The historical observer argument is discarded by the explicit continuation;
the actual downstream call receives the frozen release observer None. -/
theorem first_eq_historical {E F : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E) (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) :
    first invalidAccountData tx1 error bytes proof k =
      FirstCaller.first invalidAccountData
        (fun p b pr n digest _ => tx1 p b pr n digest none)
        (fun _ => ok ()) error bytes proof k := by
  rfl

/-- No decoder or chosen-public hypothesis is required: caller success
produces the decoder witness and the exact public supplied to tx1. -/
theorem first_success {E F : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E) (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : first invalidAccountData tx1 error bytes proof k = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ (s : DecoderStatement) (supplied : Public),
      AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
        bytes = ok (.Ok s) ∧ supplied = preparationPublic s ∧
      tx1 supplied bytes proof k () none = ok (.Ok out) := by
  rw [first_eq_historical] at h
  exact FirstCaller.first_success invalidAccountData
    (fun p b pr n digest _ => tx1 p b pr n digest none)
    (fun _ => ok ()) error bytes proof k out h

/-- The adapter can reuse an already decoded statement without changing
public bytes, proof bytes, k or the result/error boundary. Its separate
same-byte decoder binding must be supplied by the adapter execution proof. -/
theorem reuse_decoded {E F : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E) (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) (s : DecoderStatement)
    (hd : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      bytes = ok (.Ok s)) :
    first invalidAccountData tx1 error bytes proof k =
      first_decoded tx1 error (preparationPublic s) bytes proof k := by
  unfold first decode
  rw [hd]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.map_err,
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch, actual_selector_eq]

#print axioms observer
#print axioms first_decoded
#print axioms first

#print axioms first_success
#print axioms reuse_decoded
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.RepinS6First

import S126SdkSizedAccountExportV1
import S2SdkFixedImageFirstV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter
open ProofGate.FixedLinked

/-- Same full installed caller execution supplies fixed original inputs,
source-current-first, the sized final-account checkpoint, all metadata, and
exactly one update of the complete byte-vector heap. ACCEPTED-ONLY reference
closure; native/source/runtime/oracle and cross-TX transport remain. -/
theorem borrowed_stage1_sized_account_image (ops : Ops)
    (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops) (program : Array U8 32#usize)
    (initial out : OwnedSdk) (instruction : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program initial instruction=ok (.Ok (),out)) :
    ∃ (proofAccount publicBytes proofSuffix : Slice U8)
      (decoded : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding.Statement)
      (split : Usize) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8),
      inputBytes initial 0#usize=ok proofAccount ∧
      inputBytes initial 1#usize=ok publicBytes ∧
      proofAccount.val.length=58295 ∧
      proofSuffix.val=(proofAccount.val.drop 688).take 57607 ∧
      proofSuffix.val.length=57607 ∧
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1.decodeActual publicBytes=ok (.Ok decoded) ∧
      AspisR1CurrentCaller.FirstComposition.firstCurrent
        solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData verifierOps
        (SourceInstallation.currentDigest
          (SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)))
        (fun e => ops.op11 (SourceInstallation.freshError e))
        publicBytes proofSuffix split=ok (.Ok checkpoint) ∧
      inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref checkpoint) ∧
      checkpoint.val.length=1768 ∧
      out.accounts=initial.accounts ∧ out.lamports_cells=initial.lamports_cells ∧
      ∃ account : OwnedAccount,
        alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
          initial.accounts 2#usize=ok account ∧
        BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers out=
          (BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers initial).set account.data_slot.val checkpoint := by
  obtain ⟨proof,pub,suffix,decoded,k,cp,hproof,hpub,length,range,suffixLength,
    hdecode,hcurrent,saved,size,accounts,lamports⟩ :=
      borrowed_stage1_sized_saved_account ops verifierOps program initial out instruction accepted
  obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,_,_,cp2,account,accountRead,_,_,_,_,_,_,_,stored,image⟩ :=
    borrowed_stage1_fixed_image_first ops verifierOps program initial out instruction accepted
  have actual : inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref cp2) := by
    simp only [inputBytes,accounts,accountRead,stored,bind_tc_ok]
  have sameSlice := Result.ok.inj (actual.symm.trans saved)
  have same : cp2=cp := by
    apply Subtype.ext
    have values := congrArg (fun s : Slice U8 => s.val) sameSlice
    simpa only [FrameOperationsTotal.deref_val] using values
  subst cp2
  exact ⟨proof,pub,suffix,decoded,k,cp,hproof,hpub,length,range,suffixLength,
    hdecode,hcurrent,saved,size,accounts,lamports,account,accountRead,image⟩

#print axioms borrowed_stage1_sized_account_image
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter

import S126SdkSavedAccountExportV1
import S2SdkSizedSavedFirstV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter
open ProofGate.FixedLinked

/-- Any successful final account2 view has the caller-derived S2 size1768.
No checkpoint size, writer or child-success premise is added to the run. -/
theorem borrowed_stage1_checkpoint_length (ops : Ops) (program : Array U8 32#usize)
    (initial out : OwnedSdk) (data : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (accepted : BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program initial data=ok (.Ok (),out))
    (bytes : Slice U8) (read : inputBytes out 2#usize=ok bytes) : bytes.val.length=1768 := by
  obtain ⟨_,_,_,_,cp,account,accountRead,_,saved,length⟩ :=
    borrowed_stage1_sized_saved_first ops verifierOps program initial out data accepted
  have accounts := MetadataFrame.borrowed_accounts_preserved
    (Installation.install ops verifierOps) program initial out data (.Ok ()) accepted
  have actual : inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref cp) := by
    simp only [inputBytes,accounts,accountRead,saved,bind_tc_ok]
  have same := congrArg (fun s : Slice U8 => s.val.length) (Result.ok.inj (actual.symm.trans read))
  simpa only [FrameOperationsTotal.deref_val,length] using same.symm

/-- Complete reference-layer fixed-input/current-first/writer/size/metadata
join. The single complete accepted installed caller is its only premise.
Actual SDK/source/runtime and cross-transaction transport remain separate. -/
theorem borrowed_stage1_sized_saved_account (ops : Ops)
    (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops) (program : Array U8 32#usize)
    (initial out : OwnedSdk) (instruction : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program initial instruction=ok (.Ok (),out)) :
    ∃ (proofAccount publicBytes proofSuffix : Slice U8)
      (decoded : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding.Statement)
      (split : Usize) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8),
      inputBytes initial 0#usize=ok proofAccount ∧
      inputBytes initial 1#usize=ok publicBytes ∧
      proofAccount.val.length=58295 ∧
      proofSuffix.val=(proofAccount.val.drop 688).take 57607 ∧
      proofSuffix.val.length=57607 ∧
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1.decodeActual publicBytes=ok (.Ok decoded) ∧
      AspisR1CurrentCaller.FirstComposition.firstCurrent
        solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData verifierOps
        (SourceInstallation.currentDigest
          (SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)))
        (fun e => ops.op11 (SourceInstallation.freshError e))
        publicBytes proofSuffix split=ok (.Ok checkpoint) ∧
      inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref checkpoint) ∧
      checkpoint.val.length=1768 ∧
      out.accounts=initial.accounts ∧ out.lamports_cells=initial.lamports_cells := by
  obtain ⟨proof,pub,suffix,decoded,k,cp,hproof,hpub,length,range,suffixLength,
    hdecode,hcurrent,saved,accounts,lamports⟩ :=
      borrowed_stage1_saved_account ops verifierOps program initial out instruction accepted
  have size := borrowed_stage1_checkpoint_length ops program initial out instruction verifierOps
    accepted (alloc.vec.Vec.deref cp) saved
  exact ⟨proof,pub,suffix,decoded,k,cp,hproof,hpub,length,range,suffixLength,
    hdecode,hcurrent,saved,(FrameOperationsTotal.deref_val cp ▸ size),accounts,lamports⟩

#print axioms borrowed_stage1_checkpoint_length
#print axioms borrowed_stage1_sized_saved_account
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter

import S1SemanticFinishModelV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds

private theorem bind_success {α β : Type} (m : Result α) (k : α → Result β) (v : β)
    (h : (do let x ← m; k x) = ok v) :
    ∃ x, m = ok x ∧ k x = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok x => exact ⟨x,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
private theorem pair_success {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (k : α → β → Result γ) (v : γ)
    (h : (do let (a,b) ← m; k a b) = ok v) :
    ∃ a b, m = ok (a,b) ∧ k a b = ok v := by
  cases m with
  | ok p => cases p with | mk a b => exact ⟨a,b,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

/-- Actual complete finish success reaches its fixed actual rounds and both
source circle steps; returned alpha/challenges/state/transcript are those same
values. No rounds/circle/terminal child-success premise is assumed. -/
theorem finish_success (R : RoundModel.Boundaries) (B : FinishModel.Boundaries)
    {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (pub : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public) (pre : r1_wire.Prefix)
    (before : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H) (challenges : r1_wire.Challenges)
    (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) (out : r1_semantic.Verified H)
    (h : FinishModel.finish R B D pub pre before challenges obs = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ running t25 record25 record26 z0 t26 z1 t27,
      RoundModel.rounds R D pre before = ok (.Ok (running,out.alpha,t25)) ∧
      out.challenges = challenges ∧ out.state_before_z0 = t25.state ∧ out.transcript = t27 ∧
      B.claims pre = ok (.Ok out.claims) ∧
      r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record pre 25#u8 = ok (.Ok record25) ∧
      R.decode 29#usize record25 87#usize = ok (.Ok out.extra) ∧
      FinishModel.circle_validated B D t25 record25 = ok (.Ok z0,t26) ∧
      r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record pre 26#u8 = ok (.Ok record26) ∧
      R.decode 29#usize record26 0#usize = ok (.Ok out.before_z1) ∧
      FinishModel.circle_validated B D t26 record26 = ok (.Ok z1,t27) ∧
      out.z = Array.make 2#usize [z0,z1] := by
  unfold FinishModel.finish at h
  obtain ⟨roundsResult, hrounds, h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases roundsResult with
  | Err e =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
    cases h
  | Ok val =>
    rcases val with ⟨running,alpha,t25⟩
    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
    obtain ⟨claimsResult,hclaims,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
    cases claimsResult with
    | Err e =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
      cases h
    | Ok claims =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
      obtain ⟨terminalResult,hterminal,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
      cases terminalResult with
      | Err e =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,FinishModel.closureFn11,FinishModel.closureFn10,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
          core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
        cases h
      | Ok terminal =>
        simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
          bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
        obtain ⟨mask16,hm16,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨mask10,hm10,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨claim0,hc0,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨claim27,hc27,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨mask,hm,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        obtain ⟨record25Result,hr25,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
        cases record25Result with
        | Err e =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
            core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
          cases h
        | Ok record25 =>
          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
          obtain ⟨extraResult,hextra,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
          cases extraResult with
          | Err e =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
              core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
            cases h
          | Ok extra =>
            simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
            obtain ⟨etaTerminal,het,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨masked,hmasked,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨extra28,he28,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨maskedTerminal,hmt,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            obtain ⟨different,hdiff,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
            cases different with
            | true => cases h
            | false =>
              simp only [VerifyPrefix.mark,r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state,
                core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
              obtain ⟨circle0Result,t26,hz0,h⟩ := pair_success _ _ _ h
              cases circle0Result with
              | Err e =>
                simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                  core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                  core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                cases h
              | Ok z0 =>
                simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                obtain ⟨record26Result,hr26,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                cases record26Result with
                | Err e =>
                  simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                    core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                  cases h
                | Ok record26 =>
                  simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                  obtain ⟨beforeZ1Result,hbeforeZ1,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                  cases beforeZ1Result with
                  | Err e =>
                    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                      core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                    cases h
                  | Ok beforeZ1 =>
                    simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                    obtain ⟨circle1Result,t27,hz1,h⟩ := pair_success _ _ _ h
                    cases circle1Result with
                    | Err e =>
                      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                        core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                      cases h
                    | Ok z1 =>
                      simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok,VerifyPrefix.mark] at h
                      obtain ⟨equal,hequal,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                      cases equal with
                      | true => cases h
                      | false =>
                        obtain ⟨rootResult,hroot,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                        cases rootResult with
                        | Err e =>
                          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
                            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
                            core.convert.FromSame.from,bind_tc_ok] at h
                          cases h
                        | Ok rootPayload =>
                          simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok] at h
                          obtain ⟨copied,hcopy,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                          obtain ⟨root2,hroot2,h⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ h
                          have he := core.result.Result.Ok.inj (Result.ok.inj h)
                          cases he
                          exact ⟨running,t25,record25,record26,z0,t26,z1,t27,
                            hrounds,rfl,rfl,rfl,hclaims,hr25,hextra,hz0,hr26,hbeforeZ1,hz1,rfl⟩

#print axioms finish_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.S1SemanticFinishBounds

structure FinishModel.Boundaries where
  fromFn : {T F : Type} → (N : Usize) → core.ops.function.FnMut F Usize T → F → Result (Array T N)
  mask : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 16#usize → Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize →
    aspis_core.field.QM31 → Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize → Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  add : aspis_core.field.QM31 → aspis_core.field.QM31 → Result aspis_core.field.QM31

    r1_wire.Challenges → Result (core.result.Result aspis_core.field.QM31 aspis_core.state_only_prefix.r0.Error)
  circle : Array U8 32#usize → FinishModel.CircleRow → Result aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint
  unwrapRoot : core.result.Result (Array U8 32#usize) core.array.TryFromSliceError → Result (Array U8 32#usize)
  claims : r1_wire.Prefix → Result (core.result.Result (Array (Array aspis_core.field.QM31 29#usize) 3#usize) r1_wire.Error)
def FinishModel.payload
  (self : r1_wire.Prefix) (row : Std.U8) :
  Result (core.result.Result (Slice Std.U8) r1_wire.Error)
  := do
  let r ← r1_wire.Prefix.record self row
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let s ←
      core.slice.index.Slice.index
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) val
        { start := 5#usize }
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok s)
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (Slice Std.U8) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error) residual

  FinishModel.pointEq

          aspis_core.circle.SecureCirclePoint (core.convert.FromSame
          r1_wire.Error) residual

  | 26#uscalar =>
    let s ← r1_wire.ValidatedRecord.impl.framed record1
    let (r, self1) ←
      r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.sample_block_validated aspis_coreDigest32Inst
        self 26#u8 s

def FinishModel.finish (R : RoundModel.Boundaries) (B : FinishModel.Boundaries)
  {H : Type} (aspis_coreDigest32Inst : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
  (public1 : pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
  (prefix1 : r1_wire.Prefix) (transcript : r1_wire.SemanticTranscript H)
  (challenges : r1_wire.Challenges)
  (obs : Option (verifier.Phase → Result Unit)) :
  Result (core.result.Result (r1_semantic.Verified H) r1_wire.Error)
  := do
  let r ←
    RoundModel.rounds R aspis_coreDigest32Inst prefix1 transcript
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    let (running, alpha, transcript1) := val
    VerifyPrefix.mark obs 2#u8
    let r1 ← B.claims prefix1
    let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
    match cf1 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
      let r2 ←
        B.terminal public1
          val1 alpha challenges
      let r3 ←
        core.result.Result.map_err
          (FinishModel.closureFn11
          aspis_coreDigest32Inst) r2 ()
      let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 =>
        VerifyPrefix.mark obs 3#u8
        let a ←
          B.fromFn 16#usize
            (FinishModel.closureFn9
            aspis_coreDigest32Inst) val1
        let a1 ←
          B.fromFn 10#usize
            (FinishModel.closureFn5
            aspis_coreDigest32Inst) val1
        let a2 ← Array.index_usize val1 0#usize
        let q ← Array.index_usize a2 27#usize
        let mask ←
          B.mask a a1 q
            alpha
        let r4 ← r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record prefix1 25#u8
        let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
        match cf3 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue vr =>
          let r5 ← R.decode 29#usize vr 87#usize
          let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r5
          match cf4 with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val3 =>
            let q1 ← B.mul challenges.eta val2
            let q2 ← B.add mask q1
            let q3 ← Array.index_usize val3 28#usize
            let masked_terminal ← B.add q2 q3
            let b ←
              core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default
                aspis_core.field.QM31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqQM31 running
                masked_terminal
            if b
            then ok (core.result.Result.Err r1_wire.Error.Terminal)
            else
              VerifyPrefix.mark obs 4#u8
              let state_before_z0 ←
                r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state aspis_coreDigest32Inst
                  transcript1
              let cf5 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r4
              match cf5 with
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue vr1 =>
                let (r6, transcript2) ←
                  FinishModel.circle_validated B
                    aspis_coreDigest32Inst transcript1 vr1
                let cf6 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r6
                match cf6 with
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val4 =>
                  let r7 ← r1_wire.Prefix.validated_record prefix1 26#u8
                  let cf7 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r7
                  match cf7 with
                  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue vr2 =>
                    let r8 ←
                      R.decode 29#usize vr2 0#usize
                    let cf8 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r8
                    match cf8 with
                    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val5 =>
                      let cf9 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r7
                      match cf9 with
                      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue vr3 =>
                        let (r9, transcript3) ←
                          FinishModel.circle_validated B
                            aspis_coreDigest32Inst transcript2 vr3
                        let cf10 ←
                          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r9
                        match cf10 with
                        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val6 =>
                          VerifyPrefix.mark obs 5#u8
                          let b1 ←
                            FinishModel.pointEq
                              val4 val6
                          if b1
                          then
                            ok (core.result.Result.Err
                              r1_wire.Error.EqualCirclePoints)
                          else
                            let r10 ← FinishModel.payload prefix1 2#u8
                            let cf11 ←
                              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r10
                            match cf11 with
                            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val7
                              =>
                              let r11 ←
                                core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from
                                  32#usize core.marker.CopyU8 val7
                              let a3 ←
                                B.unwrapRoot r11
                              ok (core.result.Result.Ok
                                {
                                  roots :=
                                    (Array.make 2#usize [
                                      prefix1.c1_root, a3
                                      ]),
                                  challenges,
                                  alpha,
                                  claims := val1,
                                  extra := val3,
                                  before_z1 := val5,
                                  state_before_z0,
                                  z := (Array.make 2#usize [ val4, val6 ]),
                                  transcript := transcript3
                                })
                            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual
                              =>
                              core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                                (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame
                                r1_wire.Error) residual
                        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                            (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame
                            r1_wire.Error) residual
                      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                          (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame
                          r1_wire.Error) residual
                    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                        (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame
                        r1_wire.Error) residual
                  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                      (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame
                      r1_wire.Error) residual
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                  core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                    (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame
                    r1_wire.Error) residual
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                  (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame
                  r1_wire.Error) residual
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error)
              residual
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
            (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error)
            residual
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error)
          residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error) residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      (r1_semantic.Verified H) (core.convert.FromSame r1_wire.Error) residual

S2A_InstalledCuts.source:
import S2SdkReadyRawInputsV1

/-! Concrete installed child carriers at ONE caller cut. These theorems consume
an observation of that cut, not an independently existential successful run.
They do not produce the observation from native adapter acceptance. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2A.InstalledCuts
open AspisS2OwnedStage1 AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference
open ReadyStatement

/-- Same complete returned statement, same input slice, and the validator that
was actually executed inside the installed decoder. No successful validator
observation needs to be independently supplied. -/
theorem decoded (ops : SdkReference.Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (originalPublic : Slice U8) (statement : Statement)
    (observed : SdkReference.decode_public_statement_box
      (Installation.install ops verifierOps) originalPublic = ok (.Ok statement)) :
    ∃ decoded : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding.Statement,
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1.decodeActual originalPublic = ok (.Ok decoded) ∧
      statement = CurrentCarrier.fromDecoderStatement decoded ∧
      originalPublic.val.length = 1880 ∧
      (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op5 statement = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  rw [Installation.boxed_eq] at observed
  have actual : SourceInstallation.actualDecoder originalPublic = ok (.Ok statement) :=
    SourceInstallation.boxed_success _ originalPublic statement observed
  obtain ⟨value, success, same⟩ := SourceInstallation.decoder_success originalPublic statement actual
  exact ⟨value, success, same,
    (AspisR1TerminalDecoder.DecoderSuccess.decode_success originalPublic value success).2.1,
    SourceInstallation.decoder_validated originalPublic statement actual⟩

private theorem bind_success {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (out : B)
    (h : (do let a ← m; f a) = ok out) : ∃ a, m = ok a ∧ f a = ok out := by
  cases m with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a, rfl, h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

/-- Invert the installed encoder on the candidate-afterstate of the very same
full statement. The successful output is the identical 688-byte Array carrier,
with no independently chosen common/public witness or encoder output. -/
theorem encoded (ops : SdkReference.Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (statement : Statement) (candidate : Array U8 688#usize)
    (observed : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op8
      (commonOf statement).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate = ok (.Ok candidate)) :
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1
      (CurrentCarrier.toDecoderAfterstate (commonOf statement).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate) =
        ok (.Ok candidate) := by
  change SourceInstallation.actualEncoder _ = ok (.Ok candidate) at observed
  unfold SourceInstallation.actualEncoder at observed
  obtain ⟨reply, returned, observed⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ observed
  cases reply with
  | Err e => cases observed
  | Ok value => cases observed; exact returned

#print axioms decoded
#print axioms bind_success
#print axioms encoded
end AspisR1.S2A.InstalledCuts

S2G_InstalledValues.source:
import S2A_InstalledCuts
import S2B_Syscalls

/-! Installed PURE value contracts. This module supplies neither native allocation
semantics nor a native state/effect frame. Outer fail/div are retained. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2G
open AspisS2OwnedStage1 AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference
abbrev Statement := ReadyStatement.Statement
abbrev Afterstate := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.PoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1
abbrev PE := solana_program_error.ProgramError

/-- The actual caller's format-error map, retaining outer failure/divergence. -/
def mapFormat {A E : Type} (r : Result (core.result.Result A E)) :
    Result (core.result.Result A PE) := do
  let reply ← r
  match reply with
  | .Ok a => ok (.Ok a)
  | .Err _ => ok (.Err .InvalidAccountData)

theorem mapFormat_success {A E : Type} (r : Result (core.result.Result A E)) (a : A)
    (h : mapFormat r = ok (.Ok a)) : r = ok (.Ok a) := by
  cases r with
  | fail e => cases h
  | div => cases h
  | ok reply => cases reply with
    | Err e => cases h
    | Ok b => cases h; rfl

def decode (ops : SdkReference.Ops) (vops : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops) (b : Slice U8) :=
  SdkReference.decode_public_statement_box (Installation.install ops vops) b

def validate (s : Statement) := mapFormat (SourceInstallation.actualValidator s)
def candidate (a : Afterstate) := mapFormat (SourceInstallation.actualEncoder a)

def first (ops : SdkReference.Ops) (vops : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (s : Statement) (publicInput proof : Slice U8) (split : Usize) :=
  SdkReference.first_decoded (Installation.install ops vops)
    (ReadyStatement.publicOf s) publicInput proof split

/-- No success/length premise for the later validator is added. -/
theorem decode_contract (ops : SdkReference.Ops) (vops : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (b : Slice U8) (s : Statement) (h : decode ops vops b = ok (.Ok s)) :
    b.val.length = 1880 ∧ validate s = ok (.Ok ()) ∧
    ∃ decoded : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.PublicBinding.Statement,
      AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1.decodeActual b = ok (.Ok decoded) ∧
      s = CurrentCarrier.fromDecoderStatement decoded := by
  obtain ⟨decoded,actual,same,length,validated⟩ := S2A.InstalledCuts.decoded ops vops b s h
  refine ⟨length,?_,decoded,actual,same⟩
  change SourceInstallation.actualValidator s = ok (.Ok ()) at validated
  simp only [validate,mapFormat,validated,bind_tc_ok]

/-- Exact existing validator observation; no extra validity predicate assumed. -/
theorem validate_contract (s : Statement) (h : validate s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    SourceInstallation.actualValidator s = ok (.Ok ()) := mapFormat_success _ _ h

/-- Exact encoder return on the field-preserving carrier. Array width is 688;
no unproved canonicality, totality or native frame is appended. -/
theorem candidate_contract (a : Afterstate) (bytes : Array U8 688#usize)
    (h : candidate a = ok (.Ok bytes)) :

/-! Symbolic byte equality for the actual digest loop. Words stay arbitrary;
no concrete recurrence or output array is kernel-normalized. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
namespace AspisR1.S2K.AfterstateBytes
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder LoopStep
abbrev Rows := AfterstateLoop.Rows

def fold : List Digest → Nat → Array U8 6820#usize → Array U8 6820#usize
  | [], _, out => out
  | node::rest, k, out => fold rest (k+1) (out.setSlice! (48+32*k) (DigestBytes.bytes node).val)

def Inv (rows : Rows) (target : Array U8 6820#usize) (s : Iter × Array U8 6820#usize) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : Usize, k.val ≤ 20 ∧ s.1 = Iterator.cursor rows k ∧ fold (rows.val.drop k.val) k.val s.2 = target

theorem loop_exact (rows : Rows) (count : Usize) (bound : count.val ≤ 20)
    (output : Array U8 6820#usize) :
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1_loop (Iterator.cursor rows count) output =
      ok (fold (rows.val.drop count.val) count.val output) := by
  let target := fold (rows.val.drop count.val) count.val output
  have h : WP.spec (pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1_loop (Iterator.cursor rows count) output)
      (fun out => out = target) := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1_loop
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat
      (fun s : Iter × Array U8 6820#usize => 20-s.1.count.val)
      (Inv rows target) (fun out : Array U8 6820#usize => out=target)
      (fun s : Iter × Array U8 6820#usize => body s.1 s.2)
      (Iterator.cursor rows count,output) ?_ ⟨count,bound,rfl,rfl⟩
    rintro ⟨iter,out⟩ ⟨k,hk,same,rest⟩
    change iter = Iterator.cursor rows k at same
    simp only [same]
    by_cases more : k.val < 20
    · have valid : k.val < rows.val.length := by rw [rows.property]; exact more
      have dropped := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons valid
      rw [body_write _ _ out k _ (DigestBytes.bytes (rows.val[k.val]'valid))
        (Iterator.next_row rows k more) more (DigestBytes.exact (rows.val[k.val]'valid))]
      change (Inv rows target (_,_) ∧ (20-(Usize.ofNatCore (k.val+1) _).val) < 20-k.val)
      refine ⟨⟨Usize.ofNatCore (k.val+1) (by scalar_tac),?_,rfl,?_⟩,?_⟩
      · change k.val+1 ≤ 20; omega
      · change fold (rows.val.drop (k.val+1)) (k.val+1) _ = target
        simpa only [dropped,fold] using rest
      · change 20-(k.val+1) < 20-k.val; omega
    · have eqk : k=20#usize := by scalar_tac
      subst k
      have stopped := body_done _ _ out (Iterator.exhausted rows)
      rw [stopped]
      change out=target
      have ending : rows.val.drop (20#usize).val = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by
        change rows.val.length ≤ 20
        have := rows.property
        change rows.val.length=20 at this
        omega)
      simpa only [ending,fold] using rest
  cases run : pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1_loop (Iterator.cursor rows count) output with
  | fail e => simp only [run,WP.spec,WP.theta] at h
  | div => simp only [run,WP.spec,WP.theta] at h
  | ok out =>
    simp only [run,WP.spec,WP.theta,WP.wp_return] at h
    change out=target at h
    rw [h]

namespace AspisR1.S2K.AfterstateEncoding

def header (a : Afterstate) (out : Array U8 688#usize) : Array U8 688#usize :=
  let out := out.setSlice! 0 POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_MAGIC.val
  let out := out.set 4#usize POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIER_TRANSPORT_VERSION
  let out := out.set 5#usize pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_TREE_STORAGE_FORMAT_VERSION
  let out := out.set 6#usize pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
  let out := out.set 7#usize 1#u8
  let out := out.setSlice! 8 (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes a.next_pair_index).val
  out.setSlice! 16 (DigestBytes.bytes a.next_root).val

def bytes (a : Afterstate) : Array U8 688#usize :=
  AfterstateBytes.fold a.next_frontier.val 0 (header a (Array.repeat 688#usize 0#u8))

    encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 a = ok (.Ok (bytes a)) := by
  unfold bytes
  simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1,validated,
    bind_tc_ok,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
  generalize Array.repeat 688#usize 0#u8 = output
  simp only [DigestBytes.exact,bind_tc_ok,lift]
  simp [core.array.Array.index_mut, core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut, core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice, Array.from_slice, core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,
    Slice.length, Slice.len, Array.update, output.property, List.slice,
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_MAGIC,
    core.slice.Slice.iter, core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default,
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.default,
    header, Array.set, Array.setSlice!]
  change (do
    let out ← encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1_loop (Iterator.cursor a.next_frontier 0#usize) (header a output)
    ok (core.result.Result.Ok out)) = _
  rw [AfterstateBytes.loop_exact a.next_frontier 0#usize (by decide)]
  rfl

def prefix (afterstate : Afterstate) (output : Array U8 688#usize) :
    Result (LoopStep.Iter × Array U8 688#usize) := do
    let (s, index_mut_back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output { «end» := 4#usize }
    let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_MAGIC)
    let s2 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s s1
    let output1 := index_mut_back s2
    let output2 ← Array.update output1 4#usize pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIER_TRANSPORT_VERSION
    let output3 ← Array.update output2 5#usize pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_TREE_STORAGE_FORMAT_VERSION
    let output4 ← Array.update output3 6#usize pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
    let output5 ← Array.update output4 7#usize 1#u8
    let (s3, index_mut_back1) ← core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output5 { start := 8#usize, «end» := 16#usize }
    let a ← lift (core.num.U64.to_le_bytes afterstate.next_pair_index)
    let s4 ← lift (Array.to_slice a)
    let s5 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s3 s4
    let output6 := index_mut_back1 s5
    let (s6, index_mut_back2) ← core.array.Array.index_mut (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) output6 { start := 16#usize, «end» := 48#usize }
    let a1 ← atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical afterstate.next_root
    let s7 ← lift (Array.to_slice a1)
    let s8 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s6 s7
    let s9 ← lift (Array.to_slice afterstate.next_frontier)
    let i ← core.slice.Slice.iter s9
    let iter ← core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter (Array aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize)) i
    let output7 := index_mut_back2 s8
    ok (iter, output7)

theorem total (afterstate : Afterstate) (output : Array U8 688#usize) :
    ∃ out, prefix afterstate output = ok (Iterator.cursor afterstate.next_frontier 0#usize,out) := by
  obtain ⟨root,encoded⟩ := DigestTotal.total afterstate.next_root
  unfold prefix
  simp only [encoded,bind_tc_ok,lift]
  simp [core.array.Array.index_mut, core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut, core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice, Array.from_slice, core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,
    Slice.length, Slice.len, Array.update, output.property, List.slice,
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_MAGIC,
    core.slice.Slice.iter, core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default,
    Iterator.cursor]

#print axioms total
end AspisR1.S2K.AfterstatePrefix

  simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1, validated,
    bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]

  simp only [bind_tc_ok,finish,rows]

    (validated : validate_verified_afterstate a = ok (.Err e)) :

  simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1, validated,
    bind_tc_ok, core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]

    · have valid : k.val < rows.val.length := by rw [rows.property]; exact more
      have dropped := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons valid
      rw [body_word rows k more out]
      change (Inv rows target (_,_) ∧ (8-(Usize.ofNatCore (k.val+1) _).val) < 8-k.val)
      refine ⟨⟨Usize.ofNatCore (k.val+1) (by scalar_tac),?_,rfl,?_⟩,?_⟩
      · change k.val+1 ≤ 8; omega
      · change fold (rows.val.drop (k.val+1)) (k.val+1) _ = target
        simpa only [dropped,fold] using rest
      · change 8-(k.val+1) < 8-k.val; omega
    · have eqk : k=8#usize := by scalar_tac
      subst k
      have stopped : body (cursor rows 8#usize) out = ok (done out) := by
        simp only [body, atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop.body,
          exhausted rows, bind_tc_ok]
        rfl
      rw [stopped]
      change out=target
      simpa only [List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by rw [rows.property]; decide),fold] using rest
  cases run : atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop (cursor rows count) output with
  | fail e => simp only [run,WP.spec,WP.theta] at h
  | div => simp only [run,WP.spec,WP.theta] at h
  | ok out =>
    change out=target at h
    rw [h]

def bytes (rows : Digest) : Array U8 32#usize := fold rows.val 0 (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)

theorem exact (rows : Digest) : atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical rows = ok (bytes rows) := by
  have h := loop_exact rows 0#usize (by decide) (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)
  change atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop (cursor rows 0#usize) (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) = _
  simpa only [List.drop_zero,bytes] using h

#print axioms loop_exact
#print axioms exact

import S2K_Iterator

/-! Totality of the actual eight-word digest encoder by a decreasing iterator
invariant. No canonicality assumption is needed for byte serialization. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
namespace AspisR1.S2K.DigestTotal
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev Word := aspis_core.field.M31
abbrev Digest := Array Word 8#usize
abbrev Iter := core.iter.adapters.enumerate.Enumerate (core.slice.iter.Iter Word)
def cursor (rows : Digest) (count : Usize) : Iter := ⟨⟨rows.to_slice,count.val⟩,count⟩
abbrev next := core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next
  (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorSliceIter Word)
abbrev body := atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop.body

private theorem mk (n : Nat) (h : UScalar.inBounds .Usize n) :
    UScalar.tryMk .Usize n = ok (Usize.ofNatCore n h) := by
  simp only [UScalar.tryMk, UScalar.tryMkOpt,
    dif_pos ((UScalar.check_bounds_eq_inBounds .Usize n).mpr h), Result.ofOption]
  rfl

theorem next_row (rows : Digest) (count : Usize) (range : count.val < 8) :
    next (cursor rows count) = ok
      (some (count,rows.val[count.val]'(by have := rows.property; change rows.val.length = 8 at this; omega)),
       cursor rows (Usize.ofNatCore (count.val+1) (by scalar_tac))) := by
  have inc : count + 1#usize = ok (Usize.ofNatCore (count.val+1) (by scalar_tac)) := by
    change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (count.val+1) = _
    exact mk _ _
  have valid : count.val < rows.to_slice.len.val := by
    simp only [Array.to_slice, Slice.len_val, rows.property]
    exact range
  simp only [next, cursor, core.iter.adapters.enumerate.IteratorEnumerate.next,
    core.slice.iter.IteratorSliceIter.next, dif_pos valid, bind_tc_ok, inc]
  rfl

theorem body_word (rows : Digest) (count : Usize) (range : count.val < 8)
    (output : Array U8 32#usize) :
    body (cursor rows count) output = ok (cont
      (cursor rows (Usize.ofNatCore (count.val+1) (by scalar_tac)),
       output.setSlice! (4*count.val)
         (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes rows.val[count.val]'(by have := rows.property; change rows.val.length = 8 at this; omega)).val)) := by
  have mul : count * 4#usize = ok (Usize.ofNatCore (4*count.val) (by scalar_tac)) := by
    change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (count.val*4) = _
    have hn : count.val*4 = 4*count.val := by omega
    simp only [hn]
    exact mk _ _
  have stop : Usize.ofNatCore (4*count.val) (by scalar_tac) + 4#usize =
      ok (Usize.ofNatCore (4*count.val+4) (by scalar_tac)) := by
    change UScalar.tryMk .Usize (4*count.val+4) = _
    exact mk _ _
  simp only [body, atomic_statement.encode_digest_canonical_loop.body, next_row rows count range, bind_tc_ok]
  change (do
    let i ← count * 4#usize
    let stop ← i + 4#usize
    let (s, back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)) output {start := i, «end» := stop}
    let a ← aspis_core.field.M31.to_le_bytes rows.val[count.val]'_
    let src ← lift a.to_slice
    let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
    ok (cont (_,back copied))) = _
  simp only [mul, stop, bind_tc_ok, aspis_core.field.M31.to_le_bytes]
  have room : 4 ≤ 32-4*count.val := by omega
  simp only [core.array.Array.index_mut, core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut, core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut, Array.to_slice]
  simp [Slice.length, Slice.len, output.property, core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,
    List.slice, Array.from_slice, lift, Nat.min_eq_left room]
  rfl

#print axioms mk
#print axioms next_row
#print axioms body_word
end AspisR1.S2K.DigestTotal

/-! All twenty range-write interpretation ports, on the exact extracted
slice/copy/back operation. Digest encoding and iterator scheduling are separate
from this byte-source port. No external Kani fact is assumed. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.SourcePorts
open FrontierCases SourceStore

def bufferArray (b : Buffer) : Array U8 688#usize := ⟨List.ofFn b, by simp⟩
def nodeArray (b : Node) : Array U8 32#usize := ⟨List.ofFn b, by simp⟩
def observe (a : Array U8 688#usize) : Buffer := fun i => a.val[i.val]!

def step (level : Nat) (before : Buffer) (node : Node) : Buffer :=
  if h : level < 20 then
    let start := Usize.ofNatCore (48 + 32 * level) (by scalar_tac)
    let stop := Usize.ofNatCore (80 + 32 * level) (by scalar_tac)
    match store (bufferArray before) start stop (nodeArray node) with
    | .ok a => observe a
    | _ => before
  else before

theorem port (level : Nat) (range : level < 20) : Contract step level := by
  intro before node i
  have run := store_exact (bufferArray before)
    (Usize.ofNatCore (48 + 32 * level) (by scalar_tac))
    (Usize.ofNatCore (80 + 32 * level) (by scalar_tac)) (nodeArray node)
    (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega) (by simp; omega)
  simp only [step, dif_pos range, run, observe]
  split
  next h =>
    have mid := Array.setSlice!_getElem!_middle (bufferArray before)
      (nodeArray node).val (48 + 32 * level) i.val (by simp [nodeArray]; omega)
    simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, bufferArray, nodeArray] using mid
  next h =>
    by_cases early : i.val < 48 + 32 * level
    · have pre := Array.setSlice!_getElem!_prefix (bufferArray before)
        (nodeArray node).val (48 + 32 * level) i.val early
      simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, bufferArray, nodeArray] using pre
    · have post := Array.setSlice!_getElem!_suffix (bufferArray before)
        (nodeArray node).val (48 + 32 * level) i.val (by simp [nodeArray]; omega)
      simpa [Array.getElem!_Nat_eq, bufferArray, nodeArray] using post
