/-! The exact Array.index_mut / slice copy / index_mut_back sequence used
by the afterstate encoder. Symbolic buffers only; no native certificate is
converted into a Lean premise. The iterator and digest call remain separate. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.SourceStore

def store (output : Array U8 688#usize) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) : Result (Array U8 688#usize) := do
  let (s, back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
    (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
    output { start, «end» := stop }
  let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
  ok (back copied)

theorem store_exact (output : Array U8 688#usize) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 32#usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ 688)
    (width : stop.val - start.val = 32) :
    store output start stop bytes = ok (output.setSlice! start.val bytes.val) := by
  have size := output.hList_length
  have bs := bytes.hList_length
  simp only [store, core.array.Array.index_mut, core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut, core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut, Array.to_slice]
  simp [Slice.length, Slice.len, order, bound, size, core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,
    List.length_slice, width, bs, Array.from_slice, Array.setSlice!]

import S2SdkFixedInputCallerV1
import S2SdkCheckpointSizeTotalV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter
open ProofGate.FixedLinked

private theorem len_bind_success {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (out : B)
    (h : (do let a ← m; f a)=ok out) : ∃ a,m=ok a ∧ f a=ok out := by
  cases m with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h;cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h;cases h

/-- Successful actual length read exposes its actual input bytes, without an
independent slot-validity, borrow-success or length premise. -/
theorem data_len_bytes (sdk : OwnedSdk) (slot : Usize) (n : Usize)
    (h : owned_data_len sdk slot=ok (.Ok n)) :
    ∃ bytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8,
      BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes sdk slot=ok bytes ∧ alloc.vec.Vec.len bytes=n := by
  unfold owned_data_len at h
  obtain ⟨cell,read,h⟩ := len_bind_success _ _ _ h
  obtain ⟨allowed,_,h⟩ := len_bind_success _ _ _ h
  cases allowed
  · cases h
  · cases h
    exact ⟨cell.bytes,by simp only [BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes,read,bind_tc_ok],rfl⟩

/-- A reached caller's original checkpoint size, same-byte reread and actual
successful output length check imply1768. All arithmetic reuses the existing
TOTAL S2 checkpoint-size theorem; the enclosing source supplies these facts. -/
theorem checkpoint_length_from_calls (initial : OwnedSdk) (account : OwnedAccount)
    (beforeWrite checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (header size : Usize)
    (accountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      initial.accounts 2#usize=ok account)
    (origin : inputBytes initial 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref beforeWrite))
    (headerRead : owned_data_len initial account.data_slot=ok (.Ok header))
    (sizeRead : aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.checkpoint_size .S2=ok size)
    (sameHeader : header=size)
    (sameLength : alloc.vec.Vec.len checkpoint=alloc.vec.Vec.len beforeWrite) :
    checkpoint.val.length=1768 := by
  obtain ⟨original,read,length⟩ := data_len_bytes initial account.data_slot header headerRead
  have input : inputBytes initial 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref original) := by
    simp only [inputBytes,accountRead,read,bind_tc_ok]
  have views := Result.ok.inj (input.symm.trans origin)
  have byteLengths := congrArg (fun s : Slice U8 => s.val.length) views
  simp only [FrameOperationsTotal.deref_val] at byteLengths
  have sizeEq := Result.ok.inj (sizeRead.symm.trans CheckpointSizeTotal.checkpoint_size_S2)
  have headerValue := congrArg UScalar.val (sameHeader.trans sizeEq)
  have originalValue := congrArg UScalar.val length
  have checkpointValue := congrArg UScalar.val sameLength
  change header.val=1768 at headerValue
  change original.val.length=header.val at originalValue
  change checkpoint.val.length=beforeWrite.val.length at checkpointValue
  omega

#print axioms data_len_bytes
#print axioms checkpoint_length_from_calls
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter

import S2SdkReadyCallerV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyBody
open ReadyState ReadyCaller
abbrev Statement := AspisS2OwnedStage1.Reachability.Statement
abbrev Common := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1
abbrev Public := AspisS2OwnedStage1.Reachability.Public

private theorem zero_allowed : shared_allowed 0#isize=ok true := by
  apply (PrimitivesTotal.shared_allowed_true 0#isize).mpr
  constructor <;> scalar_tac

private theorem add_end : (688#usize+57607#usize : Result Usize)=ok 58295#usize := by
  apply AspisR1CurrentCaller.UsizeArithmetic.add_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac

private theorem checked_end : Usize.checked_add 688#usize 57607#usize=some 58295#usize := by
  unfold Usize.checked_add core.num.checked_add_UScalar
  rw [add_end]
  rfl

private theorem tag_offset : (688#usize+8#usize : Result Usize)=ok 696#usize := by
  apply AspisR1CurrentCaller.UsizeArithmetic.add_eq_ok <;> scalar_tac

/-- Forward constructor for the complete installed source reference in the
necessary accepted-native metadata class. All bytes and retained SDK fields
are the supplied initial values. No reference/body/acquire/write/release
success is a premise. Actual native observation/representation transport is
still required; the retained child observations are not silently discharged. -/
theorem construct (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (program : Array U8 32#usize) (pa ua ca : OwnedAccount)
    (lamports : alloc.vec.Vec OwnedLamportsCell) (p u c : OwnedDataCell) (ten : Bool)
    (statement : Statement) (common : Common) (pub : Public)
    (candidate : Array U8 688#usize) (checkpointBytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (distinctPU : pa.key≠ua.key) (distinctPC : pa.key≠ca.key) (distinctUC : ua.key≠ca.key)
    (proofLength : p.bytes.val.length=58295)
    (checkpointLength : c.bytes.val.length=1768)
    (outputLength : checkpointBytes.val.length=1768)
    (proofAllowed : shared_allowed p.borrowed=ok true)
    (publicAllowed : shared_allowed u.borrowed=ok true)
    (scanned : owned_checkpoint_nonzero c.bytes=ok false)
    (decoded : decode_public_statement_box (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)=ok (.Ok statement))
    (validated : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op5 statement=ok (.Ok ()))
    (commonRead :
      aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common statement=ok common)
    (encoded : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op8 common.lane_transition.candidate_afterstate=
      ok (.Ok candidate))
    (compared : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op0 core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 0#usize 688#usize) candidate=ok false)
    (tagRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8)
      p.bytes 696#usize=ok 2#u8)
    (projected :
      aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public statement=ok pub)
    (firstReturned : first_decoded (Installation.install ops verifierOps) pub
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
      (splitIndex ten)=ok (.Ok checkpointBytes)) :
    ∃ out, BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) (instruction ten)=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes out 2#usize=ok checkpointBytes ∧
      BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers out=
        (BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c)).set 2 checkpointBytes := by
  let accs := accounts3 program pa ua ca
  let liveC : OwnedDataCell := {c with borrowed:=(-1)#isize}
  have cpAcquire := ReadyState.checkpoint accs lamports p u {c with borrowed:=0#isize}
    GuardAcquire.noGuards rfl
  obtain ⟨nextU,nextUValue,pubAcquire⟩ := ReadyState.public_acquire accs lamports p u liveC publicAllowed
  obtain ⟨nextP,nextPValue,proofAcquire⟩ := ReadyState.proof_acquire accs lamports p
    {u with borrowed:=nextU} liveC proofAllowed
  let finalSdk := state accs lamports {p with borrowed:=nextP} {u with borrowed:=nextU} liveC
  have cpRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedDataCell)
      finalSdk.data_cells 2#usize=ok liveC := read_two _ _ _
  have valid : (2#usize).val<finalSdk.data_cells.val.length := by simp [finalSdk,state,triple]
  obtain ⟨actual,_,actualRead,mutableRead⟩ := BorrowTotal.cell_operations_total finalSdk 2#usize valid
  have same : actual=liveC := Result.ok.inj (actualRead.symm.trans cpRead)
  cases same
  have cpLen : alloc.vec.Vec.len c.bytes=1768#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact checkpointLength
  have pLen : alloc.vec.Vec.len p.bytes=58295#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact proofLength
  have outLen : alloc.vec.Vec.len checkpointBytes=1768#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    exact outputLength
  have baseCpRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedDataCell)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).data_cells 2#usize=ok {c with borrowed:=0#isize} := read_two _ _ _
  have cpHeader : owned_data_len (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) 2#usize=
      ok (.Ok 1768#usize) := by
    simp only [owned_data_len,baseCpRead,bind_tc_ok]
    simp [zero_allowed,cpLen]
  have accountLength : alloc.vec.Vec.len (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).accounts=3#usize := by
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    rfl
  have proofAccountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).accounts 0#usize=ok (readonlyMeta pa 0#usize) := read_zero _ _ _
  have publicAccountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).accounts 1#usize=ok (readonlyMeta ua 1#usize) := read_one _ _ _
  have checkpointAccountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).accounts 2#usize=ok (checkpointMeta program ca) := read_two _ _ _
  have cpAcquireN : owned_acquire_checkpoint (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c)
      GuardAcquire.noGuards 2#usize=ok (.Ok (),state accs lamports p u liveC,
        {GuardAcquire.noGuards with checkpoint:=some 2#usize}) := cpAcquire
  have liveCpRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedDataCell)
      (state accs lamports p u liveC).data_cells 2#usize=ok liveC := read_two _ _ _
  have publicCellRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedDataCell)
      (state accs lamports p {u with borrowed:=nextU} liveC).data_cells 1#usize=
        ok {u with borrowed:=nextU} := read_one _ _ _
  have proofCellRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedDataCell)
      finalSdk.data_cells 0#usize=ok {p with borrowed:=nextP} := read_zero _ _ _
  have pref := FrameOperationsTotal.prefix_range_total p.bytes 688#usize (by simp only [proofLength];decide)
  have suff := FrameOperationsTotal.range_total p.bytes 688#usize 58295#usize
    (by decide) (by simp only [proofLength];decide)
  have i10 : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op1 core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (instruction ten)) (Array.make 2#usize [3#u8,10#u8])=ok ten := instruction_ten ten
  have i11 : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op1 core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (instruction ten)) (Array.make 2#usize [3#u8,11#u8])=ok (!ten) := instruction_eleven ten
  have constants4 : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op4=ok 57607#usize := rfl
  have constants7 : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op7=ok 688#usize := rfl
  have optionEnd : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op2 (some 58295#usize)
      solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData=ok (.Ok 58295#usize) := rfl
  have liveCBytes : liveC.bytes=c.bytes := rfl
  dsimp only [finalSdk] at proofCellRead cpRead mutableRead
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index] at liveCpRead publicCellRead proofCellRead cpRead
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.index_mut_slice_index] at mutableRead
  simp only [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index] at tagRead
  have castValue : UScalar.cast .Usize (splitByte ten)=splitIndex ten := by
    have castRun := instruction_cast ten
    change ok (UScalar.cast .Usize (splitByte ten))=ok (splitIndex ten) at castRun
    exact Result.ok.inj castRun
  let savedSdk : OwnedSdk := {finalSdk with data_cells:=(alloc.vec.Vec.set finalSdk.data_cells 2#usize {liveC with bytes:=checkpointBytes})}
  let savedGuards : LiveGuards := {checkpoint:=some 2#usize,«public»:=some 1#usize,proof:=some 0#usize}
  have bodyRun : owned_stage1_body (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (instruction ten)) GuardAcquire.noGuards=ok (.Ok (),savedSdk,savedGuards) := by
    cases ten <;>
      simp [owned_stage1_body,i10,i11,accountLength,proofAccountRead,publicAccountRead,
        checkpointAccountRead,readonlyMeta,checkpointMeta,
        key_eq_false _ _ distinctPU,key_eq_false _ _ distinctPC,
        key_eq_false _ _ distinctUC,owner_ne_self,cpHeader,CheckpointSizeTotal.checkpoint_size_S2,
        cpAcquireN,liveCpRead,pubAcquire,publicCellRead,proofAcquire,proofCellRead,
        PrimitivesTotal.bytes_clone_total,scanned,decoded,validated,commonRead,encoded,
        constants4,constants7,checked_end,optionEnd,pLen,pref,compared,tag_offset,tagRead,
        aspis_r1_cost_probe.transport.Variant.tag,projected,suff,instruction_read,instruction_cast,
        firstReturned,outLen,cpLen,cpRead,mutableRead,liveCBytes,castValue,
        proofLength,checkpointLength,outputLength,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,core.result.Result.map_err,lift,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,
        savedSdk,savedGuards,finalSdk,GuardAcquire.noGuards]
  have held := GuardBody.body_live_invariant (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
    program (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) savedSdk
    (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (instruction ten)) (.Ok ()) savedGuards bodyRun
  obtain ⟨out,released⟩ := GuardRelease.release_total savedSdk savedGuards held
  have run : owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps) program
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) (instruction ten)=ok (.Ok (),out) := by
    simp only [owned_stage1,bodyRun,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,released]
  have releaseFrame := ErrorBufferFrame.release_buffers savedSdk out savedGuards released
  have written : BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes savedSdk 2#usize=ok checkpointBytes := by
    simp [BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes,savedSdk,finalSdk,state,triple,alloc.vec.Vec.set,
      alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index,alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize]
  have image : BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers savedSdk=
      (BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c)).set 2 checkpointBytes := by
    simp [BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers,savedSdk,finalSdk,initialSdk,state,triple,alloc.vec.Vec.set,liveC]
  refine ⟨out,?_,?_,releaseFrame.trans image⟩
  · rw [BorrowedEquivalence.stage1_eq]
    exact run
  · exact (BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes_eq savedSdk out 2#usize releaseFrame).trans written

#print axioms construct
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyBody

/-- Necessary accepted-native metadata class, on the SAME full record types.
Keys, owners of readonly inputs, rent and lamports slots are unchanged. -/
def readonlyMeta (account : OwnedAccount) (slot : Usize) : OwnedAccount :=
  {account with is_signer:=false,is_writable:=false,executable:=false,data_slot:=slot}

def checkpointMeta (program : Array U8 32#usize) (account : OwnedAccount) : OwnedAccount :=
  {account with owner:=program,is_signer:=false,is_writable:=true,executable:=false,data_slot:=2#usize}

def accounts3 (program : Array U8 32#usize) (p u c : OwnedAccount) : alloc.vec.Vec OwnedAccount :=
  triple (readonlyMeta p 0#usize) (readonlyMeta u 1#usize) (checkpointMeta program c)

def initialSdk (program : Array U8 32#usize) (p u c : OwnedAccount)
    (lamports : alloc.vec.Vec OwnedLamportsCell) (proof pubCell cpCell : OwnedDataCell) : OwnedSdk :=
  state (accounts3 program p u c) lamports proof pubCell {cpCell with borrowed:=0#isize}

def splitByte (ten : Bool) : U8 := if ten then 10#u8 else 11#u8

def splitIndex (ten : Bool) : Usize := if ten then 10#usize else 11#usize

def instruction (ten : Bool) : alloc.vec.Vec U8 :=
  ⟨[3#u8,splitByte ten],by scalar_tac⟩

theorem instruction_ten (ten : Bool) :

    Installation.stdSliceArrayEq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (instruction ten))
      (Array.make 2#usize [3#u8,11#u8])=ok (!ten) := by
  cases ten <;> rfl

theorem instruction_read (ten : Bool) :
    Slice.index_usize (alloc.vec.Vec.deref (instruction ten)) 1#usize=ok (splitByte ten) := by
  simp [instruction,alloc.vec.Vec.deref,Slice.index_usize]

theorem instruction_cast (ten : Bool) :
    (lift (UScalar.cast .Usize (splitByte ten)) : Result Usize)=ok (splitIndex ten) := by
  simp only [lift]
  congr 1
  apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
  rw [U8.cast_Usize_val_eq]
  cases ten <;> rfl

  rw [AspisS2SdkKeyEquality.array_eq_value core.cmp.PartialEqU8
    AspisS2SdkKeyEquality.u8_ne_spec]
  simp only [different,decide_false]

    AspisS2SdkKeyEquality.u8_ne_spec]

import S2SdkReadyStatementV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyOriginal
open ReadyState ReadyCaller ReadyStatement

theorem readonly_identity (account : OwnedAccount) (slot : Usize)
    (fields : account.is_signer=false ∧ account.is_writable=false ∧ account.executable=false ∧ account.data_slot=slot) :
    readonlyMeta account slot=account := by
  cases account
  simp_all [readonlyMeta]

theorem checkpoint_identity (program : Array U8 32#usize) (account : OwnedAccount)
    (fields : account.owner=program ∧ account.is_signer=false ∧ account.is_writable=true ∧ account.executable=false ∧ account.data_slot=2#usize) :
    checkpointMeta program account=account := by
  cases account
  simp_all [checkpointMeta]

/-- Accepted-native metadata parametrization is an identity on the full
original SDK values. No original byte, owner, flag, rent, slot, counter or Rc
value is silently changed in the enclosing reference constructor. -/
theorem initial_identity (program : Array U8 32#usize) (pa ua ca : OwnedAccount)
    (lamports : alloc.vec.Vec OwnedLamportsCell) (p u c : OwnedDataCell)
    (pMeta : pa.is_signer=false ∧ pa.is_writable=false ∧ pa.executable=false ∧ pa.data_slot=0#usize)
    (uMeta : ua.is_signer=false ∧ ua.is_writable=false ∧ ua.executable=false ∧ ua.data_slot=1#usize)
    (cMeta : ca.owner=program ∧ ca.is_signer=false ∧ ca.is_writable=true ∧ ca.executable=false ∧ ca.data_slot=2#usize)
    (cFree : c.borrowed=0#isize) :
    initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c=state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c := by
  have sameCell : {c with borrowed:=0#isize}=c := by
    cases c
    simp_all
  simp only [initialSdk,accounts3,readonly_identity pa 0#usize pMeta,
    readonly_identity ua 1#usize uMeta,checkpoint_identity program ca cMeta,sameCell]

/-- COMPLETE installed caller and saved-output/source-current-first interface,
now on the original three account/data records, without a whole-reference
success or state-equality premise. Guard/child observations remain explicit;
actual SDK representation/accepted-call/oracle/TX2 correspondence is still owed. -/
theorem construct (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (program : Array U8 32#usize) (pa ua ca : OwnedAccount)
    (lamports : alloc.vec.Vec OwnedLamportsCell) (p u c : OwnedDataCell) (ten : Bool)
    (statement : Statement) (candidate : Array U8 688#usize) (checkpointBytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (pMeta : pa.is_signer=false ∧ pa.is_writable=false ∧ pa.executable=false ∧ pa.data_slot=0#usize)
    (uMeta : ua.is_signer=false ∧ ua.is_writable=false ∧ ua.executable=false ∧ ua.data_slot=1#usize)
    (cMeta : ca.owner=program ∧ ca.is_signer=false ∧ ca.is_writable=true ∧ ca.executable=false ∧ ca.data_slot=2#usize)
    (cFree : c.borrowed=0#isize)
    (distinctPU : pa.key≠ua.key) (distinctPC : pa.key≠ca.key) (distinctUC : ua.key≠ca.key)
    (proofLength : p.bytes.val.length=58295)
    (checkpointLength : c.bytes.val.length=1768)
    (outputLength : checkpointBytes.val.length=1768)
    (proofAllowed : shared_allowed p.borrowed=ok true)
    (publicAllowed : shared_allowed u.borrowed=ok true)
    (scanned : owned_checkpoint_nonzero c.bytes=ok false)
    (decoded : decode_public_statement_box (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)=ok (.Ok statement))
    (validated : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op5 statement=ok (.Ok ()))
    (encoded : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op8 (commonOf statement).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate=
      ok (.Ok candidate))
    (compared : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op0 core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 0#usize 688#usize) candidate=ok false)
    (tagRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8)
      p.bytes 696#usize=ok 2#u8)
    (firstReturned : first_decoded (Installation.install ops verifierOps) (publicOf statement)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
      (splitIndex ten)=ok (.Ok checkpointBytes)) :
    ∃ out, BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c) (instruction ten)=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c) 0#usize=
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c) 1#usize=
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref checkpointBytes) ∧
      BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers out=
        (BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c)).set 2 checkpointBytes ∧
      out.accounts=(state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c).accounts ∧
      out.lamports_cells=lamports ∧
      AspisR1CurrentCaller.verifier.candidate.tx1 verifierOps
        (SourceInstallation.currentDigest
          (SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)))
        (CurrentCarrier.toCurrentPublic (publicOf statement)) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
        (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
        (splitIndex ten) () none=ok (.Ok checkpointBytes) := by
  have same := initial_identity program pa ua ca lamports p u c pMeta uMeta cMeta cFree
  have result := ReadyStatement.construct ops verifierOps program pa ua ca lamports p u c ten
    statement candidate checkpointBytes distinctPU distinctPC distinctUC proofLength checkpointLength
    outputLength proofAllowed publicAllowed scanned decoded validated encoded compared tagRead firstReturned
  simpa only [same] using result

#print axioms readonly_identity
#print axioms checkpoint_identity
#print axioms initial_identity
#print axioms construct
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyOriginal

import S2CheckpointGuardTransportV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyRawInputs
open ReadyState ReadyCaller ReadyStatement

theorem scan_zero (bytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (zero : ∀ byte ∈ bytes.val,byte=0#u8) :
    owned_checkpoint_nonzero bytes=ok false := by
  rw [ScanTotal.scan_eq,CheckpointGuardTransport.owned_eq_std,
    (CheckpointGuardTransport.stdAny_false bytes.val).mpr zero]

theorem prefix_equal (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (bytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (candidate : Array U8 688#usize)
    (same : bytes.val.take 688=candidate.val) :
    (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op0 core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes) 0#usize 688#usize) candidate=ok false := by
  change core.slice.cmp.PartialEqSlice.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8
    (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes) 0#usize 688#usize)
    (Array.to_slice candidate)=ok false
  rw [ProofGate.standard_ne]
  simp [FrameOperationsTotal.segment,FrameOperationsTotal.deref_val,Array.to_slice,same]

theorem tag_value (bytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (tag : bytes.val[696]?=some 2#u8) :
    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8) bytes 696#usize=ok 2#u8 := by
  simp [alloc.vec.Vec.index_slice_index,alloc.vec.Vec.index_usize,tag]

/-- COMPLETE original-state installed caller from byte/scalar guard facts.
No caller, SDK acquisition, scan/comparison/index operation, write, release or
independent projection success is a premise. Only the actual decode, validator,
encoder and first return observations remain, plus raw admission facts. This
is not a native SDK/SBF or cross-transaction correspondence assertion. -/
theorem construct (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (program : Array U8 32#usize) (pa ua ca : OwnedAccount)
    (lamports : alloc.vec.Vec OwnedLamportsCell) (p u c : OwnedDataCell) (ten : Bool)
    (statement : Statement) (candidate : Array U8 688#usize) (checkpointBytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (pMeta : pa.is_signer=false ∧ pa.is_writable=false ∧ pa.executable=false ∧ pa.data_slot=0#usize)
    (uMeta : ua.is_signer=false ∧ ua.is_writable=false ∧ ua.executable=false ∧ ua.data_slot=1#usize)
    (cMeta : ca.owner=program ∧ ca.is_signer=false ∧ ca.is_writable=true ∧ ca.executable=false ∧ ca.data_slot=2#usize)
    (cFree : c.borrowed=0#isize)
    (distinctPU : pa.key≠ua.key) (distinctPC : pa.key≠ca.key) (distinctUC : ua.key≠ca.key)
    (proofLength : p.bytes.val.length=58295)
    (checkpointLength : c.bytes.val.length=1768)
    (outputLength : checkpointBytes.val.length=1768)
    (proofCounter : p.borrowed≥0#isize ∧ p.borrowed<core.num.Isize.MAX)
    (publicCounter : u.borrowed≥0#isize ∧ u.borrowed<core.num.Isize.MAX)
    (checkpointZero : ∀ byte ∈ c.bytes.val,byte=0#u8)
    (decoded : decode_public_statement_box (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)=ok (.Ok statement))
    (validated : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op5 statement=ok (.Ok ()))
    (encoded : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op8 (commonOf statement).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate=
      ok (.Ok candidate))
    (prefixBytes : p.bytes.val.take 688=candidate.val)
    (tagByte : p.bytes.val[696]?=some 2#u8)
    (firstReturned : first_decoded (Installation.install ops verifierOps) (publicOf statement)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
      (splitIndex ten)=ok (.Ok checkpointBytes)) :
    ∃ out, BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c) (instruction ten)=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c) 0#usize=
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c) 1#usize=
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref checkpointBytes) ∧
      BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers out=
        (BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers (state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c)).set 2 checkpointBytes ∧
      out.accounts=(state (triple pa ua ca) lamports p u c).accounts ∧
      out.lamports_cells=lamports ∧
      AspisR1CurrentCaller.verifier.candidate.tx1 verifierOps
        (SourceInstallation.currentDigest
          (SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)))
        (CurrentCarrier.toCurrentPublic (publicOf statement)) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
        (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
        (splitIndex ten) () none=ok (.Ok checkpointBytes) := by
  have proofAllowed := (PrimitivesTotal.shared_allowed_true p.borrowed).mpr proofCounter
  have publicAllowed := (PrimitivesTotal.shared_allowed_true u.borrowed).mpr publicCounter
  exact ReadyOriginal.construct ops verifierOps program pa ua ca lamports p u c ten
    statement candidate checkpointBytes pMeta uMeta cMeta cFree distinctPU distinctPC distinctUC
    proofLength checkpointLength outputLength proofAllowed publicAllowed (scan_zero c.bytes checkpointZero)
    decoded validated encoded (prefix_equal ops verifierOps p.bytes candidate prefixBytes)
    (tag_value p.bytes tagByte) firstReturned

#print axioms scan_zero
#print axioms prefix_equal
#print axioms tag_value
#print axioms construct
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyRawInputs

import S2SdkReadyBodyV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyStatement
open ReadyState ReadyCaller
abbrev Statement := ReadyBody.Statement
abbrev Common := ReadyBody.Common
abbrev Public := ReadyBody.Public

def commonOf : Statement → Common
  | .PrivateTransfer common _ => common
  | .Withdrawal common _ => common

def publicOf : Statement → Public
  | .PrivateTransfer common pub => .Transfer pub common.lane_transition
  | .Withdrawal common pub => .Withdrawal pub common.lane_transition

/-- TOTAL actual emitted getters: public and encoder inputs come from the
SAME decoded statement, with no independent projection-success premise. -/
theorem common_total (statement : Statement) :
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common statement=
      ok (commonOf statement) := by
  cases statement <;> rfl

theorem public_total (statement : Statement) :
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public statement=
      ok (publicOf statement) := by
  cases statement <;> rfl

/-- Complete installed reference, same original proof/public vectors, exact
supplied first output in account2, full byte heap effect, unchanged account and
lamport metadata, and its current verifier call with observer None. Whole caller
success and independent common/public witnesses have been removed as premises.
Native SDK observation/representation/oracle/TX2 transport remains separate. -/
theorem construct (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (program : Array U8 32#usize) (pa ua ca : OwnedAccount)
    (lamports : alloc.vec.Vec OwnedLamportsCell) (p u c : OwnedDataCell) (ten : Bool)
    (statement : Statement) (candidate : Array U8 688#usize) (checkpointBytes : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (distinctPU : pa.key≠ua.key) (distinctPC : pa.key≠ca.key) (distinctUC : ua.key≠ca.key)
    (proofLength : p.bytes.val.length=58295)
    (checkpointLength : c.bytes.val.length=1768)
    (outputLength : checkpointBytes.val.length=1768)
    (proofAllowed : shared_allowed p.borrowed=ok true)
    (publicAllowed : shared_allowed u.borrowed=ok true)
    (scanned : owned_checkpoint_nonzero c.bytes=ok false)
    (decoded : decode_public_statement_box (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)=ok (.Ok statement))
    (validated : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op5 statement=ok (.Ok ()))
    (encoded : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op8 (commonOf statement).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate=
      ok (.Ok candidate))
    (compared : (Installation.install ops verifierOps).op0 core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 0#usize 688#usize) candidate=ok false)
    (tagRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice U8)
      p.bytes 696#usize=ok 2#u8)
    (firstReturned : first_decoded (Installation.install ops verifierOps) (publicOf statement)
      (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
      (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
      (splitIndex ten)=ok (.Ok checkpointBytes)) :
    ∃ out, BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) (instruction ten)=ok (.Ok (),out) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) 0#usize=
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) 1#usize=
        ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes) ∧
      ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref checkpointBytes) ∧
      BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers out=
        (BorrowedBufferFrame.buffers (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c)).set 2 checkpointBytes ∧
      out.accounts=(initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).accounts ∧
      out.lamports_cells=lamports ∧
      AspisR1CurrentCaller.verifier.candidate.tx1 verifierOps
        (SourceInstallation.currentDigest
          (SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)))
        (CurrentCarrier.toCurrentPublic (publicOf statement)) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
        (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
        (splitIndex ten) () none=ok (.Ok checkpointBytes) := by
  obtain ⟨out,run,saved,image⟩ := ReadyBody.construct ops verifierOps program pa ua ca lamports
    p u c ten statement (commonOf statement) (publicOf statement) candidate checkpointBytes
    distinctPU distinctPC distinctUC proofLength checkpointLength outputLength proofAllowed publicAllowed
    scanned decoded validated (common_total statement) encoded compared tagRead (public_total statement) firstReturned
  have accounts := MetadataFrame.borrowed_accounts_preserved (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
    program (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) out (instruction ten) (.Ok ()) run
  have lamportsFrame := MetadataFrame.borrowed_lamports_preserved (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
    program (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) out (instruction ten) (.Ok ()) run
  have pAccountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).accounts 0#usize=ok (readonlyMeta pa 0#usize) := read_zero _ _ _
  have uAccountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).accounts 1#usize=ok (readonlyMeta ua 1#usize) := read_one _ _ _
  have pCellRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedDataCell)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).data_cells 0#usize=ok p := read_zero _ _ _
  have uCellRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedDataCell)
      (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c).data_cells 1#usize=ok u := read_one _ _ _
  have pRead : ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) 0#usize=
      ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) := by
    simp only [ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes,pAccountRead,bind_tc_ok,readonlyMeta,
      BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes,pCellRead]
  have uRead : ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes (initialSdk program pa ua ca lamports p u c) 1#usize=
      ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes) := by
    simp only [ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes,uAccountRead,bind_tc_ok,readonlyMeta,
      BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes,uCellRead]
  have cAccountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      out.accounts 2#usize=ok (checkpointMeta program ca) := by
    rw [accounts]
    exact read_two _ _ _
  have cRead : ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes out 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref checkpointBytes) := by
    simp only [ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes,cAccountRead,bind_tc_ok,checkpointMeta,saved]
  refine ⟨out,run,pRead,uRead,cRead,image,accounts,lamportsFrame,?_⟩
  exact Installation.first_success ops verifierOps (publicOf statement) (alloc.vec.Vec.deref u.bytes)
    (FrameOperationsTotal.segment (alloc.vec.Vec.deref p.bytes) 688#usize 58295#usize)
    (splitIndex ten) checkpointBytes firstReturned

#print axioms common_total
#print axioms public_total
#print axioms construct
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.ReadyStatement

S2SdkSizedSavedFirstV1.source:
import S2SdkCheckpointWriterV1
import S2SdkCheckpointLengthV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open Lean Elab Tactic Meta
namespace AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter

/-- One reached first call and the same returned checkpoint, in the original
account2 slot after complete finalization. No separately selected saved value. -/
def SizedSavedCall (initial out : OwnedSdk) (ops : Ops) : Prop :=
  ∃ (pub : AspisS2OwnedStage1.Reachability.Public) (publicBytes proofBytes : Slice U8)
    (split : Usize) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (account : OwnedAccount),
    alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      initial.accounts 2#usize=ok account ∧
    first_decoded ops pub publicBytes proofBytes split=ok (.Ok checkpoint) ∧
    BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes out account.data_slot=ok checkpoint ∧ checkpoint.val.length=1768

private theorem bind_success {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (out : B)
    (h : (do let a ← m; f a)=ok out) : ∃ a,m=ok a ∧ f a=ok out := by
  cases m with
  | ok a => exact ⟨a,rfl,h⟩
  | fail e => simp only [bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [bind_tc_div] at h; cases h

private theorem sized_intro (initial out : OwnedSdk) (ops : Ops)
    (pub : AspisS2OwnedStage1.Reachability.Public) (publicBytes proofBytes : Slice U8)
    (split : Usize) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (account : OwnedAccount)
    (beforeWrite : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (header size : Usize)
    (accountRead : alloc.vec.Vec.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexUsizeSlice OwnedAccount)
      initial.accounts 2#usize=ok account)
    (first : first_decoded ops pub publicBytes proofBytes split=ok (.Ok checkpoint))
    (headerRead : owned_data_len initial account.data_slot=ok (.Ok header))
    (sizeRead : aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.checkpoint_size .S2=ok size)
    (sameHeader : header=size)
    (sameLength : alloc.vec.Vec.len checkpoint=alloc.vec.Vec.len beforeWrite)
    (origin : ProofGate.FixedLinked.inputBytes initial 2#usize=ok (alloc.vec.Vec.deref beforeWrite))
    (saved : BorrowedBufferFrame.readBytes out account.data_slot=ok checkpoint) :
    SizedSavedCall initial out ops :=
  ⟨pub,publicBytes,proofBytes,split,checkpoint,account,accountRead,first,saved,
    checkpoint_length_from_calls initial account beforeWrite checkpoint header size
      accountRead origin headerRead sizeRead sameHeader sameLength⟩

elab "sdk_sized_saved_finish" : tactic => withMainContext do
  let target := (← getMainTarget).consumeMData
  unless target.getAppFn.isConstOf ``SizedSavedCall do throwError m!"Expected SizedSavedCall, found {target}"
  let args := target.getAppArgs
  let initial := args[0]!
  let out := args[1]!
  let ops := args[2]!
  let context ← getLCtx
  let mut diagnostic : MessageData := m!"No source first success"
  for first in context do
    unless first.type.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do continue
    let fa := first.type.getAppArgs
    unless fa[1]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``first_decoded do continue
    unless fa[2]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Result.ok do continue
    let inner := fa[2]!.getAppArgs.back!
    unless inner.getAppFn.isConstOf ``core.result.Result.Ok do continue
    diagnostic := m!"First found; no original account2 read"
    let cp := inner.getAppArgs.back!
    let call := fa[1]!.getAppArgs
    for accountRead in context do
      unless accountRead.type.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do continue
      let ar := accountRead.type.getAppArgs
      unless ar[1]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``alloc.vec.Vec.index do continue
      unless ar[2]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Result.ok do continue
      let account := ar[2]!.getAppArgs.back!
      unless ← isDefEq (← inferType account) (mkConst ``OwnedAccount) do continue
      let acall := ar[1]!.getAppArgs
      unless ← withTransparency .reducible <| isDefEq acall[acall.size-2]! (mkProj ``OwnedSdk 0 initial) do continue
      for headerRead in context do
        unless headerRead.type.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do continue
        let ha := headerRead.type.getAppArgs
        unless ha[1]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``owned_data_len do continue
        unless ha[2]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Result.ok do continue
        let inner := ha[2]!.getAppArgs.back!
        unless inner.getAppFn.isConstOf ``core.result.Result.Ok do continue
        let header := inner.getAppArgs.back!
        for sizeRead in context do
          unless sizeRead.type.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do continue
          let sa := sizeRead.type.getAppArgs
          unless sa[1]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.checkpoint_size do continue
          unless sa[2]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Result.ok do continue
          let size := sa[2]!.getAppArgs.back!
          for cellRead in context do
            unless cellRead.type.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do continue
            let ca := cellRead.type.getAppArgs
            unless ca[1]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``alloc.vec.Vec.index do continue
            unless ca[2]!.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Result.ok do continue
            let cell := ca[2]!.getAppArgs.back!
            unless ← isDefEq (← inferType cell) (mkConst ``OwnedDataCell) do continue
            let saved ← saveState
            try
              let intro ← mkAppM ``sized_intro #[initial,out,ops,call[1]!,call[2]!,call[3]!,call[4]!,cp,account,
                mkProj ``OwnedDataCell 0 cell,header,size,mkFVar accountRead.fvarId,mkFVar first.fvarId,
                mkFVar headerRead.fvarId,mkFVar sizeRead.fvarId]
              let term ← Term.exprToSyntax intro
              evalTactic (← `(tactic| refine $term ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_))
              let goals ← getGoals
              unless goals.length==4 do throwError "Expected header/length/origin/saved goals"
              for goal in goals.take 2 do
                setGoals [goal];evalTactic (← `(tactic| assumption))
              setGoals [goals[2]!]
              evalTactic (← `(tactic| sdk_input_origin))
              setGoals [goals[3]!]
              evalTactic (← `(tactic| apply released_written_bytes <;> assumption))
              return
            catch err => saved.restore;diagnostic := err.toMessageData
  throwError m!"No complete source first/write/release witness: {diagnostic}"

elab "sdk_sized_saved_return" h:ident : tactic => withMainContext do
  let decl ← getLocalDeclFromUserName h.getId
  unless decl.type.isAppOfArity ``Eq 3 do throwError "Expected body equation"
  let lhs ← whnf decl.type.getAppArgs[1]!
  unless lhs.getAppFn.isConstOf ``Result.ok do throwError "Not the body return"
  let ty ← Term.exprToSyntax (← mkEq lhs decl.type.getAppArgs[2]!)
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| change $ty at $h:ident))
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| cases $h:ident))
  evalTactic (← `(tactic| sdk_sized_saved_finish))

/-- ACCEPTED-ONLY full caller: checkpoint retention after release is derived
from the same first_decoded result, not a writer or child-success premise. -/
theorem stage1_sized_saved_first (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (program : Array U8 32#usize) (initial out : OwnedSdk) (data : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : ProofPrefixParent.stage1 ops verifierOps program initial data=ok (.Ok (),out)) :
    SizedSavedCall initial out (Installation.install ops verifierOps) := by
  unfold ProofPrefixParent.stage1 at accepted
  obtain ⟨body,hbody,accepted⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ accepted
  rcases body with ⟨status,sdkBody,guards⟩
  obtain ⟨finalSdk,hrelease,accepted⟩ := bind_success _ _ _ accepted
  have hs : status=core.result.Result.Ok () := (Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj accepted)).1
  have ho : finalSdk=out := (Prod.mk.inj (Result.ok.inj accepted)).2
  subst status
  subst finalSdk
  unfold ProofPrefixParent.bodyWithPrefixCmp at hbody
  repeat' first
    | sdk_input_clone
    | sdk_buffer_facts
    | sdk_guard_condition
    | sdk_guard_scalar
    | sdk_linked_map
    | sdk_constructor_evidence
    | sdk_sized_saved_return hbody
    | solve | cases hbody
    | sdk_case_evidence
    | sdk_peel hbody
    | sdk_split hbody
    | sdk_reduce hbody

theorem owned_stage1_sized_saved_first (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (program : Array U8 32#usize) (initial out : OwnedSdk) (data : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps) program initial data=ok (.Ok (),out)) :
    SizedSavedCall initial out (Installation.install ops verifierOps) := by
  apply stage1_sized_saved_first ops verifierOps program initial out data
  rw [ProofPrefixParent.stage1_eq]
  exact accepted

theorem borrowed_stage1_sized_saved_first (ops : Ops) (verifierOps : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (program : Array U8 32#usize) (initial out : OwnedSdk) (data : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : BorrowedReference.owned_stage1 (Installation.install ops verifierOps)
      program initial data=ok (.Ok (),out)) :
    SizedSavedCall initial out (Installation.install ops verifierOps) := by
  apply owned_stage1_sized_saved_first ops verifierOps program initial out data
  rw [←BorrowedEquivalence.stage1_eq]
  exact accepted

#print axioms stage1_sized_saved_first
#print axioms owned_stage1_sized_saved_first
#print axioms borrowed_stage1_sized_saved_first
end AspisS2OwnedStage1.SdkReference.CheckpointWriter

declarations.text: def SizedSavedCall (initial out : OwnedSdk) (ops : Ops) : Prop :=
private theorem bind_success {A B : Type} (m : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (out : B)
private theorem sized_intro (initial out : OwnedSdk) (ops : Ops)

S2W_AuthenticatedInputs.source:
import S2W_ExtractionBoundary

/-! Fixed-invocation child joins. Checkpoint authentication yields the two
hash comparisons; P2-prime yields the same proof/public buffers. In particular
neither sameStoredProof nor reconstructed-statement identity is a premise. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_AuthenticatedInputs
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.AdapterRw MultiproofConeCanonical OraclePortCompactDraft
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
abbrev Header := State × State
abbrev HeaderDecode := Bytes → Option Header
abbrev Public := AdapterRw.LeadInputs.Public

/-- A checkpoint writer CHILD theorem, conditional on its actual successful
invocation. HeaderDecode is the concrete child header parser port, shared with
the reader. The fields concern its serialization, not retained caller sites,
account writes, cross-TX identity, S2 Inputs or S2CallerFacts. -/
structure CheckpointWriterConeJoin (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (semantic : Public) (pub proof : Slice U8)
    (split : Usize) : Prop where
  header : ∀ checkpoint, AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub proof split = ok (.Ok checkpoint) →
    decode (bytesOf checkpoint.val) = some (H (bytesOf proof.val), H (bytesOf pub.val))
  size : ∀ checkpoint, AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub proof split = ok (.Ok checkpoint) →
    checkpoint.val.length = 1768

/-- Reader CHILD: successful verification checks the SAME parsed stored
header against its actual proof/public digest inputs. This is two digest
comparisons, not proof/public equality, account persistence or S2CallerFacts. -/
structure CheckpointReaderConeJoin (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (pub proof checkpoint : Slice U8) : Prop where
  checkedHeader : ops.op11 (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops)
      pub proof checkpoint () none = ok (.Ok ()) →
    decode (bytesOf checkpoint.val) = some (H (bytesOf proof.val), H (bytesOf pub.val))

/-- Existing runtime P2-prime, indexed to THIS writer/reader pair. -/
structure P2Prime (H : Bytes → State) (proof1 pub1 proof2 pub2 : Slice U8) : Prop where
  binding : R9PoolRuntimeBinding.P2Prime H
    ⟨bytesOf proof1.val,bytesOf pub1.val⟩ ⟨bytesOf proof2.val,bytesOf pub2.val⟩

/-- Existing protected-version history, with no change of its domain. -/
structure CheckpointVersionBinding (saved loaded : Bytes) where
  history : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding saved loaded

/-- Authentication composition. savedAtWrite and save/load byte identity are
not assumptions: saved is the actual returned vector; protected history binds
its committed version; reader/writer child headers yield digestMatches.
No full-forest reconstruction equality or universal ChildInputRetention. -/
theorem authenticated_inputs (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (semantic : Public) (pub1 proof1 pub2 proof2 loaded : Slice U8)
    (split : Usize) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (first : AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub1 proof1 split = ok (.Ok saved))
    (second : ops.op11 (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops)
      pub2 proof2 loaded () none = ok (.Ok ()))
    (writer : CheckpointWriterConeJoin ops decode H semantic pub1 proof1 split)
    (reader : CheckpointReaderConeJoin ops decode H pub2 proof2 loaded)
    (version : CheckpointVersionBinding (bytesOf saved.val) (bytesOf loaded.val))
    (p2prime : P2Prime H proof1 pub1 proof2 pub2) :
    bytesOf proof2.val = bytesOf proof1.val ∧
    bytesOf pub2.val = bytesOf pub1.val ∧
    bytesOf loaded.val = bytesOf saved.val ∧
    (bytesOf saved.val).length = 1768 := by
  have persisted := S2X.checkpoint_persistence _ _ version.history
  have wrote := writer.header saved first
  have read := reader.checkedHeader second
  rw [persisted,wrote] at read
  have pairs := Option.some.inj read
  have matched : R9PoolRuntimeBinding.digestMatches H
      ⟨bytesOf proof1.val,bytesOf pub1.val⟩ ⟨bytesOf proof2.val,bytesOf pub2.val⟩ :=
    ⟨(congrArg Prod.fst pairs).symm,(congrArg Prod.snd pairs).symm⟩
  obtain ⟨proof,pub⟩ := p2prime.binding matched
  refine ⟨proof,pub,persisted,?_⟩
  simpa only [bytesOf,List.length_map] using writer.size saved first

/-- Consume the two authenticated byte identities on the SAME child geometry
ports. All four source-internal obligations are named per-child hypotheses;
there is no additional sameStoredProof or tx1ProofObservation premise. -/
theorem authenticated_geometry (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (decode : HeaderDecode)
    (H : Bytes → State) (semantic : Public) (pub1 proof1 pub2 proof2 loaded y1 : Slice U8)
    (nodes : Nat → Nat → Slice U8) (split : Usize) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (first : AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic pub1 proof1 split = ok (.Ok saved))
    (second : ops.op11 (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops)
      pub2 proof2 loaded () none = ok (.Ok ()))
    (writer : CheckpointWriterConeJoin ops decode H semantic pub1 proof1 split)
    (reader : CheckpointReaderConeJoin ops decode H pub2 proof2 loaded)
    (version : CheckpointVersionBinding (bytesOf saved.val) (bytesOf loaded.val))
    (p2prime : P2Prime H proof1 pub1 proof2 pub2)
    (entry : S2W_ChildJoins.FirstEntryVerifierConeJoin proof1)
    (multiproof : S2W_ChildJoins.MultiproofConeJoin proof1 proof2 nodes)
    (scan : S2W_ChildJoins.S8StageConeJoin proof1 y1) :
    bytesOf proof2.val = bytesOf proof1.val ∧
    bytesOf pub2.val = bytesOf pub1.val ∧
    bytesOf loaded.val = bytesOf saved.val ∧
    (bytesOf saved.val).length = 1768 ∧
    ∃ tr p, OraclePortStoredParserC4.parseReached (bytesOf proof1.val) tr = some p ∧
      (∀ b k, b < 2 → k < 3 → bytesOf (nodes b k).val =
        slice p.wire (OraclePortSelectedDraft.slotStart (3*b+k))
          (32*OraclePortSelectedDraft.capacity (3*b+k))) ∧
      y1 = S8JoinFrozenScan.segment proof1 7031 464 ∧
      S8OwnedP6.check_values_owned y1 = ok (.Ok ()) := by
  obtain ⟨proof,pub,cp,size⟩ := authenticated_inputs ops decode H semantic pub1 proof1 pub2 proof2
    loaded split saved first second writer reader version p2prime
  exact ⟨proof,pub,cp,size,S2W_ChildJoins.internal_geometry proof1 proof2 y1 nodes
    entry multiproof scan proof⟩

#print axioms authenticated_inputs
#print axioms authenticated_geometry
#print CheckpointWriterConeJoin
#print CheckpointReaderConeJoin
#print P2Prime
#print CheckpointVersionBinding
end AspisR1.S2W_AuthenticatedInputs

import S2W_D189Wrappers
import S2W_ScheduledConsolidation

/-! Full Required14 for every accepted two-transaction wrapper execution in
the D189 SDK/std/runtime interpretation. Primitive interpretation and owned
extraction are the existing trust items; no caller cut or account-frame
conclusion occurs in a premise. Child ports remain separately named. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_D189Consolidation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2Trust S2LeadInterface
open S2W_D189Entry S2W_D189Wrappers S2W_TrustedStd S2W_WrapperLaws
open S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint S2W_EntryWriteHistory S2W_CommittedCheckpoint
open S2W_NativeConsolidation S2W_AuthenticatedInputs S2W_InputSchedule
open S2W_ExpandedChildren S2W_TraceSplice MultiproofConeCanonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

/-- Existing runtime entry premise instantiated with the native metadata/cell
interpretation. These are initial-state eligibility facts, universally local;
no accepted execution or postcondition occurs in either field. -/
structure RuntimeEntrypointAdmission {W : Type} (L : Library W (Nat → Record))
    (e : Entry) (w : W) (n : Nat) : Prop where
  entry : AdapterRw.RuntimeEntrypointAdmission e.heap
    (fun a => (e.records (e.handles a).1).owned.key.val.map nativeByte) n
  related : L.related w e.heap

def before (e1 e2 : Entry) (site : Site) : Nat → Account :=
  if site.rank ≤ 3 then S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap
  else S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e2.metadata 7 e2.heap

def after (e1 e2 : Entry) (post1 : Heap (Nat → Record)) (site : Site) : Nat → Account :=
  if site = .tx1 then S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 post1
  else before e1 e2 site

/-- Compute the full native account frame from the accepted wrapper heap,
source-derived privileges, and runtime alias interpretation. -/
theorem wrapper_frames (e1 e2 : Entry) (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e1.first data = ok (.Ok saved))
    (post1 : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (written : post1 = writeBracket e1.heap 2 0 0 (source (nativeBytes saved))) :
    (∀ site a, dataWrite site a = false → after e1 e2 post1 site a = before e1 e2 site a) ∧
    {after e1 e2 post1 .tx1 2 with data := (before e1 e2 .tx1 2).data} = before e1 e2 .tx1 2 := by
  have disjoint := first_disjoint e1 ops program data saved accepted
  constructor
  · intro site a notWritten
    by_cases tx1 : site = .tx1
    · subst site
      have other : a ≠ 2 := by
        intro same; subst a; simp [dataWrite] at notWritten
      change S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 post1 a =
        S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap a
      rw [written]
      exact S2W_AccountObservations.write_frame encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap 2 0 0
        (source (nativeBytes saved)) rfl rfl a (fun within => disjoint a within other)
    · simp only [after,if_neg tx1]
  · change {S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 post1 2 with
        data := (S2W_AccountObservations.observe encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap 2).data} = _
    rw [written]
    exact S2W_AccountObservations.write_metadata encode e1.metadata 3 e1.heap 2 0 0
      (source (nativeBytes saved)) rfl rfl

/-- Every accepted native wrapper pair has one expanded execution-indexed
observation satisfying ALL fourteen fields. The history premise is indexed
to its actual returned post-write payload. Input proof/public retention uses
writer/reader authentication plus P2Prime; FullForestAcceptedRoundtrip is
therefore not needed by this stronger authentication route.

Accepted executions are equations for the composed wrappers themselves.
SourceCuts, savedAtWrite, sameStoredProof, NativeBinding, entrySize, range/site
cuts, and the two account-frame fields are all outputs, never hypotheses. -/
theorem accepted_run {W A E : Type}
    (L : Library W (Nat → Record)) (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (allocator : Allocator A)
    (e1 e2 : Entry) (w1 w2 : W)
    (admission1 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e1 w1 3)
    (admission2 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e2 w2 7)
    (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First) (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.P1 sha256 H)
    (syscall : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state1 state2 final1 final2 : A)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (post1 post2 : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted1 : S2W_D189Wrappers.first native1 copy allocator e1 program data1 state1 =
      ok (.Ok (saved,post1,final1)))
    (accepted2 : S2W_D189Wrappers.second native2 allocator e2 program data2 slot state2 =
      ok (.Ok (post2,final2)))
    (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) (firstMarks : FirstMarks port) (secondMarks : SecondMarks port) :
    ∃ f s outer pre middle fs ss,
      SourceCuts ops e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) saved f s ∧
      S2W_ExpandedTrace.runExpanded ops (children port)
        (S2W_Observation.two ops program e1.first data1 (e2.second secondSizes) data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,S2W_ExpandedTrace.full (children port) outer) ∧
      S2W_D189Interpretation.runOwned ops
        (S2W_Observation.two ops program e1.first data1 (e2.second secondSizes) data2 slot) [] e1.heap =
        ok (.Ok saved,outer,e1.heap) ∧
      projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline pre middle fs ss ∧
      post2 = e2.heap ∧
      before e1 e2 .tx1 = S2W_D189Interpretation.nativeObserve L encode e1.metadata 3 w1 e1.heap.ambient ∧
      before e1 e2 .tx2 = S2W_D189Interpretation.nativeObserve L encode e2.metadata 7 w2 e2.heap.ambient ∧
      ∀ (decode : HeaderDecode) (nodes : Nat → Nat → Slice U8) (y1 : Slice U8),
      CheckpointWriterConeJoin ops decode H f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split →
      CheckpointReaderConeJoin ops decode H s.pub s.proof s.checkpoint →
      S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
        (payloadBytes encode (post1.payload (e1.heap.accounts 2).1) 1768) (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val) →
      P2Prime H f.proof f.pub s.proof s.pub →
      S2W_ChildJoins.FirstEntryVerifierConeJoin f.proof →
      S2W_ChildJoins.MultiproofConeJoin f.proof s.proof nodes →
      S2W_ChildJoins.S8StageConeJoin f.proof y1 →
      ∃ parsed,
        S2W_LeadInterface.S2CallerFacts
          (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1))
          (S2Z.Oracle.leadDigest ops) () H (bytesOf f.proof.val) (bytesOf f.pub.val)
          (bytesOf saved.val) parsed ∧
        (∀ site, (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1)).reached site ↔
          S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site site ∈ projected port outer) := by
  obtain ⟨owned1,written⟩ := first_accepted native1 copy std allocator e1 program data1 state1 final1 saved post1 accepted1
  obtain ⟨owned2,unchanged⟩ := second_accepted native2 allocator e2 program data2 slot state2 final2 post2 accepted2
  let boundary := S2W_DigestExtraction.sourceBoundary ops native1 native2 hashv extraction
  have source1 : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program e1.first data1 = ok (.Ok saved) :=
    (boundary.stage1 program e1.first data1).symm.trans owned1
  obtain ⟨f,s,outer,pre,middle,fs,ss,cuts,execution,expanded,layout,projectedInputs⟩ :=
    S2W_ScheduledConsolidation.accepted_run ops native1 native2 hashv extraction sha256 H p1 syscall
      program e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) data1 data2 slot saved owned1 owned2 port firstMarks secondMarks
  refine ⟨f,s,outer,pre,middle,fs,ss,cuts,expanded,
    S2W_D189Interpretation.accepted_owned_frame ops _ [] outer (core.result.Result.Ok saved : core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) AdapterRw.Cuts.PE) e1.heap execution,
    layout,unchanged,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · exact (S2W_D189Interpretation.native_observation L sdk encode e1.metadata 3 w1 e1.heap
      admission1.related admission1.entry.valid).symm
  · exact (S2W_D189Interpretation.native_observation L sdk encode e2.metadata 7 w2 e2.heap
      admission2.related admission2.entry.valid).symm
  intro decode nodes y1 writer reader history p2prime entry multiproof scan
  have destinationSize := checkpoint_size e1 ops program data1 saved source1
  have versionAtWrite : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
      (payloadBytes encode ((writeBracket e1.heap 2 0 0 (source (nativeBytes saved))).payload
        (e1.heap.accounts 2).1) 1768) (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val) := by
    rw [← written]; exact history
  obtain ⟨_,⟨version⟩⟩ := returned_committed e1.heap 2 0 0 saved (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val)
    rfl rfl destinationSize (writer.size saved cuts.first) versionAtWrite
  obtain ⟨parsed,partialFacts,sites⟩ := projectedInputs decode nodes y1 writer reader version p2prime
    entry multiproof scan (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1)
  have frames := wrapper_frames e1 e2 ops program data1 saved source1 post1 written
  refine ⟨parsed,?_,sites⟩
  apply (S2W_TwoFieldAudit.full_fields_iff _ ops H _ _ _ parsed partialFacts).2
  exact ⟨fun site _ a allowed => frames.1 site a allowed,fun _ => frames.2⟩

#print axioms wrapper_frames
#print axioms accepted_run
#print RuntimeEntrypointAdmission
#print accepted_run
end AspisR1.S2W_D189Consolidation
end

S2W_ExtractionBoundary.source:
import S2W_FinalAudit
import S2X_SecondCut

/-! D188: correspondence of the owned Rust functions to the extracted source
semantics is a named project trust item. It is not an S2 source-proof goal.
Non-extracted AccountInfo wrappers are deliberately outside this record. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_ExtractionBoundary
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.AdapterRw MultiproofConeCanonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
abbrev Accounts := Slice Cuts.Account
abbrev Program := AdapterRw.solana_pubkey.Pubkey
abbrev Slot := core.result.Result U64 Cuts.PE
abbrev First := Program → Accounts → Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) Cuts.PE)
abbrev Second := Program → Accounts → Slice U8 → Slot → Result (core.result.Result Unit Cuts.PE)

/-- Exactly the project extraction boundary, including the extracted digest
installation. No account frame, site observation, accepted result, input-buffer
identity, checkpoint persistence, or caller-facts proposition is a field.
Binary correspondence remains rustc/P7 and S10, outside this source theorem. -/
structure AeneasExtraction (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest) : Prop where
  stage1 : ∀ program accounts data,
    native1 program accounts data = AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program accounts data
  stage2 : ∀ program accounts data slot,
    native2 program accounts data slot = AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program accounts data slot
  digest : ∀ self parts, ops.op43 self parts = hashv parts

/-- P1 and RuntimeSyscall are separately named records; neither assumes the
caller's oracle field, source acceptance, or a returning-domain restriction. -/
structure P1 (sha256 H : Bytes → State) : Prop where
  realization : S2Z.Oracle.P1Realization sha256 H
structure RuntimeSyscall (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (sha256 : Bytes → State) : Prop where
  returningValue : S2Z.Oracle.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256

/-- Every accepted pair of the native owned entry functions has ONE exact
ordered source observation, with the actual typed calls/arguments/returns.
Both accepted executions use the SAME Ops. Internal child events are still
provided by the separately named child cone joins, as D188 requires. -/
theorem accepted_native_observation (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (program : Program) (accounts1 accounts2 : Accounts) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : Slot) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted1 : native1 program accounts1 data1 = ok (.Ok checkpoint))
    (accepted2 : native2 program accounts2 data2 slot = ok (.Ok ())) :
    ∃ firstLog finalLog suffix,
      S2W_Trace.run ops (S2W_Outer.stage1_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts1 data1)
        [] = ok (.Ok checkpoint,firstLog) ∧
      S2W_Trace.run ops (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts2 data2 slot)
        firstLog = ok (.Ok (),finalLog) ∧
      S2W_Trace.run ops (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok checkpoint,finalLog) ∧
      finalLog = firstLog ++ suffix ∧
      (∀ e ∈ finalLog, S2W_TraceFacts.ValidEvent ops e) := by
  rw [extraction.stage1] at accepted1
  rw [extraction.stage2] at accepted2
  obtain ⟨firstLog,finalLog,suffix,first,second,both,extension⟩ :=
    S2W_Observation.accepted_segments ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot checkpoint
      accepted1 accepted2
  exact ⟨firstLog,finalLog,suffix,first,second,both,extension,
    S2W_TraceFacts.run_valid ops _ [] finalLog _ (by simp) both⟩

/-- NativeBinding is discharged by the named extraction boundary, not retained
as another S2 premise. No totality is introduced, including for multiproof. -/
theorem native_oracle (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : P1 sha256 H) (runtime : RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256) :
    CheckpointBytes5Inputs.Oracle (S2Z.Oracle.leadDigest ops) () H :=
  S2W_SuccessOracle.native_success_field ops hashv sha256 H extraction.digest
    runtime.returningValue p1.realization

/-- Actual native TX1 call arguments, proofLength and proofSuffix, now with
no residual owned-native association obligation. The nine-site projection is
not identified with an independently supplied Inputs record. -/
theorem native_first_fields (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : First) (native2 : Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (program : Program) (accounts : Accounts) (data : Slice U8)
    (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted : native1 program accounts data = ok (.Ok checkpoint)) :
    ∃ proofAccount publicAccount publicInput raw statement semantic proof split,
      Slice.index_usize accounts 0#usize = ok proofAccount ∧
      Slice.index_usize accounts 1#usize = ok publicAccount ∧
      AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops proofAccount = ok (.Ok raw) ∧
      AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops publicAccount = ok (.Ok publicInput) ∧
      ops.op47 publicInput = ok (.Ok statement) ∧
      AdapterRw.first_decoded ops semantic publicInput proof split = ok (.Ok checkpoint) ∧
      (bytesOf proof.val).length = 57607 ∧
      bytesOf raw.val = (bytesOf raw.val).take 688 ++ bytesOf proof.val := by
  rw [extraction.stage1] at accepted
  exact LeadInputs.first_byte_fields ops program accounts data checkpoint accepted

#print axioms accepted_native_observation
#print axioms native_oracle
#print axioms native_first_fields
#print AeneasExtraction
#print P1
#print RuntimeSyscall
end AspisR1.S2W_ExtractionBoundary
end

import S2W_OuterOccurrences
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_FirstOccurrence
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2W_Trace _root_.AdapterRw AspisR1.AdapterRw S2W_OuterOccurrences

attribute [local irreducible] _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_distinct_accounts
  _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_readonly_buffer _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_verifier_checkpoint
  _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_zero
  _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.validate_asq8

theorem first_occurrence (ops : Ops) (program : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts : Slice Cuts.Account) (data : Slice U8) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (log : Log)
    (execution : run ops (S2W_Outer.stage1_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts data)
      [] = ok (.Ok saved,log)) : tags log = [false] := by
  simp only [S2W_Outer.stage1_owned,S2W_TraceFacts.run_bind,run_pure,run_lift,run_liftM,
    S2W_Outer.traceEffects,run_perform,S2W_Outer.mapError,S2W_Outer.first_decoded,then_assoc,then_ok, S2W_Trace.bind] at execution
  repeat' first
  | (solve | cases execution)
  | (fail_if_no_progress simp only [S2W_TraceFacts.run_bind,run_pure,run_lift,run_liftM,run_perform,S2W_Outer.mapError,S2W_Outer.first_decoded,then_assoc,then_ok, S2W_Trace.bind] at execution)
  | uncase_result
  | head_reduce execution
  | split at execution
  all_goals have logs := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj execution)
  all_goals dsimp only at logs
  all_goals rw [← logs]
  all_goals simp [tags,mark]

#print axioms first_occurrence
end AspisR1.S2W_FirstOccurrence

import S2W_TraceSplice

/-! Accepted native source schedule on the expanded actual outer execution.
Only the named child erasure/source-mark theorems supply internal events. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_NativeSchedule
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2W_Trace S2W_OuterOccurrences S2W_ExpandedTrace S2W_ExpandedChildren S2W_TraceSplice

theorem accepted_run {E : Type}
    (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First)
    (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (accounts1 accounts2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted1 : native1 program accounts1 data1 = ok (.Ok saved))
    (accepted2 : native2 program accounts2 data2 slot = ok (.Ok ()))
    (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) (firstMarks : FirstMarks port) (secondMarks : SecondMarks port) :
    ∃ outer pre middle fs ss,
      run ops (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,outer) ∧
      runExpanded ops (children port)
        (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,full (children port) outer) ∧
      tags outer = [false,true] ∧
      projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline pre middle fs ss ∧
      (∀ a b : S2LeadInterface.Site, a.rank < b.rank →
        S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site b ∈ projected port outer →
        S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site a ∈ projected port outer) ∧
      (∀ a b : S2LeadInterface.Site, a.rank < b.rank →
        S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site a ∈ projected port outer →
        S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site b ∈ projected port outer →
        S2W_SiteSchedule.clock pre middle fs ss a < S2W_SiteSchedule.clock pre middle fs ss b) ∧
      (∀ a, projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.before pre middle fs ss a ++
        [.site a] ++ S2W_SiteSchedule.after middle fs ss a) := by
  let boundary := S2W_DigestExtraction.sourceBoundary ops native1 native2 hashv extraction
  obtain ⟨firstLog,outer,_,firstRun,secondRun,execution,_,_⟩ :=
    S2W_ExtractionBoundary.accepted_native_observation ops native1 native2 hashv boundary
      program accounts1 accounts2 data1 data2 slot saved accepted1 accepted2
  have secondOwned : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program accounts2 data2 slot =
      ok (.Ok ()) := (boundary.stage2 program accounts2 data2 slot).symm.trans accepted2
  obtain ⟨secondLog,secondEmpty⟩ := S2W_TraceFacts.success_exists ops
    (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts2 data2 slot) [] (.Ok ())
    ((S2W_OuterErasure.stage2_erasure ops program accounts2 data2 slot).trans secondOwned)
  have shifted := run_shift ops
    (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts2 data2 slot) firstLog []
  rw [List.append_nil,secondEmpty] at shifted
  have joined : outer = firstLog ++ secondLog :=
    congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj (secondRun.symm.trans shifted))
  have shape : tags outer = [false,true] := by
    rw [joined]
    change (firstLog ++ secondLog).filterMap mark = _
    rw [List.filterMap_append]
    change tags firstLog ++ tags secondLog = _
    rw [S2W_FirstOccurrence.first_occurrence ops program accounts1 data1 saved firstLog firstRun,
      second_occurrence ops program accounts2 data2 slot secondLog secondEmpty]
    rfl
  obtain ⟨pre,middle,fs,ss,layout⟩ := expanded_schedule port firstMarks secondMarks outer shape
  refine ⟨outer,pre,middle,fs,ss,execution,execution_flatMap ops (children port) _ [] outer _ execution,
    shape,layout,?_,?_,?_⟩
  · intro a b _ _
    rw [layout]
    exact S2W_SiteSchedule.reached pre middle fs ss a
  · intro a b order _ _
    exact S2W_SiteSchedule.ordered pre middle fs ss a b order
  · intro a
    exact layout.trans (S2W_SiteSchedule.located pre middle fs ss a)

#print axioms accepted_run
#print accepted_run
end AspisR1.S2W_NativeSchedule

S2W_Observation.source:
import S2W_OuterErasure
import S2W_TraceFacts
/-! One ordered execution of the fixed extracted owned outer callers.
The snapshot/native-write association and opaque helpers' internal events
are intentionally not inferred from their returned values. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_Observation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AdapterRw S2W_Trace S2W_TraceFacts S2W_OuterErasure
abbrev Account := r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount
abbrev PE := solana_program_error.ProgramError
abbrev Answer := core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) PE

def two (ops : Ops) (program_id : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts1 : Slice Account) (data1 : Slice U8)
    (accounts2 : Slice Account) (data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : core.result.Result U64 PE) : Code Answer := do
  let first ← S2W_Outer.stage1_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program_id accounts1 data1
  match first with
  | .Err e => pure (.Err e)
  | .Ok checkpoint =>
    let second ← S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program_id accounts2 data2 slot
    match second with
    | .Err e => pure (.Err e)
    | .Ok _ => pure (.Ok checkpoint)

def untraced (ops : Ops) (program_id : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts1 : Slice Account) (data1 : Slice U8)
    (accounts2 : Slice Account) (data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : core.result.Result U64 PE) : Result Answer := do
  let first ← r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program_id accounts1 data1
  match first with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
  | .Ok checkpoint =>
    let second ← r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program_id accounts2 data2 slot
    match second with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err e)
    | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok checkpoint)

theorem erasure (ops : Ops) (program_id : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts1 : Slice Account) (data1 : Slice U8)
    (accounts2 : Slice Account) (data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : core.result.Result U64 PE) :
    erase ops (two ops program_id accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) =
      untraced ops program_id accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot := by
  simp only [two,untraced,erase_bind,stage1_erasure]
  apply congrArg (fun k => r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program_id accounts1 data1 >>= k)
  funext first
  cases first with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok cp =>
    simp only [erase_bind,stage2_erasure]
    apply congrArg (fun k => r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program_id accounts2 data2 slot >>= k)
    funext second
    cases second <;> rfl

theorem accepted_observation (ops : Ops) (program_id : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts1 : Slice Account) (data1 : Slice U8)
    (accounts2 : Slice Account) (data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : core.result.Result U64 PE) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted1 : r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program_id accounts1 data1 =
      ok (.Ok checkpoint))
    (accepted2 : r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program_id accounts2 data2 slot =
      ok (.Ok ())) :
    ∃ log, run ops (two ops program_id accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
      ok (.Ok checkpoint,log) ∧ ∀ e ∈ log, ValidEvent ops e := by
  have success : erase ops (two ops program_id accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) =
      ok (.Ok checkpoint) := by
    rw [erasure]
    simp only [untraced,accepted1,accepted2,bind_tc_ok]
  obtain ⟨log,observed⟩ := success_exists ops _ [] _ success
  exact ⟨log,observed,run_valid ops _ [] log _ (by simp) observed⟩

theorem accepted_segments (ops : Ops) (program_id : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts1 : Slice Account) (data1 : Slice U8)
    (accounts2 : Slice Account) (data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : core.result.Result U64 PE) (checkpoint : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted1 : r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program_id accounts1 data1 =
      ok (.Ok checkpoint))
    (accepted2 : r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program_id accounts2 data2 slot =
      ok (.Ok ())) :
    ∃ firstLog finalLog suffix,
      run ops (S2W_Outer.stage1_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program_id accounts1 data1)
        [] = ok (.Ok checkpoint,firstLog) ∧
      run ops (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program_id accounts2 data2 slot)
        firstLog = ok (.Ok (),finalLog) ∧
      run ops (two ops program_id accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok checkpoint,finalLog) ∧
      finalLog = firstLog ++ suffix := by
  obtain ⟨firstLog,first⟩ := success_exists ops
    (S2W_Outer.stage1_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program_id accounts1 data1) []
    (.Ok checkpoint) ((stage1_erasure ops program_id accounts1 data1).trans accepted1)
  obtain ⟨finalLog,second⟩ := success_exists ops
    (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program_id accounts2 data2 slot)
    firstLog (.Ok ()) ((stage2_erasure ops program_id accounts2 data2 slot).trans accepted2)
  obtain ⟨suffix,extension⟩ := run_prefix ops
    (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program_id accounts2 data2 slot)
    firstLog finalLog (.Ok ()) second
  refine ⟨firstLog,finalLog,suffix,first,second,?_,extension⟩
  simp only [two,S2W_TraceFacts.run_bind,first,second,thenResult]
  rfl

#print axioms accepted_segments
#print axioms erasure
#print axioms accepted_observation
end AspisR1.S2W_Observation
