import S2W_Outer
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_OuterErasure
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AdapterRw S2W_Trace S2W_Outer

theorem erase_pure (ops : Ops) {A : Type} (a : A) :
    erase ops (pure a) = ok a := rfl

theorem erase_liftM (ops : Ops) {A : Type} (r : Result A) :
    erase ops (monadLift r : Code A) = r := erase_lift ops r

theorem erase_if (ops : Ops) {A : Type} (p : Prop) [Decidable p]
    (yes no : Code A) : erase ops (if p then yes else no) =
      if p then erase ops yes else erase ops no := by split <;> rfl

private theorem bind_congr {A B : Type} (r : Result A) (f g : A → Result B)
    (h : ∀ a, f a = g a) : (r >>= f) = (r >>= g) :=
  congrArg (fun k => r >>= k) (funext h)

theorem erase_mapError (ops : Ops) {A : Type}
    (r : core.result.Result A aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.Error) :
    erase ops (mapError (fun e => perform (.op44 e)) r) =
      AdapterRw.core.result.Result.map_err
        (BuiltinFnOnce aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.Error solana_program_error.ProgramError)
        r ops.op44 := by cases r <;> rfl

theorem first_erasure (ops : Ops)
    (public1 : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (public_bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize) :
    erase ops (S2W_Outer.first_decoded ops traceEffects public1 public_bytes proof k) =
      AdapterRw.first_decoded ops public1 public_bytes proof k := by
  simp only [S2W_Outer.first_decoded, AdapterRw.first_decoded, erase_bind,
    erase_liftM, erase_mapError, traceEffects, erase_perform, invoke]

-- Congruence follows each actual branch. No accepted-run cut is a premise.
theorem stage1_erasure (ops : Ops) (program_id : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts : Slice r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount) (data : Slice U8) :
    erase ops (stage1_owned ops traceEffects program_id accounts data) =
      r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned ops program_id accounts data := by
  simp only [stage1_owned, r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage1_owned, traceEffects,
    erase_bind, erase_liftM, erase_pure, erase_perform, invoke, erase_if, S2W_Outer.first_decoded, AdapterRw.first_decoded, erase_mapError]
  all_goals repeat' first
    | (with_reducible rfl)
    | (fail_if_no_progress simp only [erase_bind, erase_liftM,
        erase_pure, erase_perform, invoke, erase_if, S2W_Outer.first_decoded, AdapterRw.first_decoded, erase_mapError])
    | (apply bind_congr; intro x)
    | split

theorem stage2_erasure (ops : Ops) (program_id : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts : Slice r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount) (data : Slice U8)
    (slot : core.result.Result U64 solana_program_error.ProgramError) :
    erase ops (stage2_owned ops traceEffects program_id accounts data slot) =
      r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program_id accounts data slot := by
  simp only [stage2_owned, r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned, traceEffects,
    erase_bind, erase_liftM, erase_pure, erase_perform, invoke, erase_if, S2W_Outer.first_decoded, AdapterRw.first_decoded, erase_mapError]
  all_goals repeat' first
    | (with_reducible rfl)
    | (fail_if_no_progress simp only [erase_bind, erase_liftM,
        erase_pure, erase_perform, invoke, erase_if, S2W_Outer.first_decoded, AdapterRw.first_decoded, erase_mapError])
    | (apply bind_congr; intro x)
    | split

import S2W_Observation
import AdapterRwCuts

/-! Actual outer source occurrence inventory; children remain opaque. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_OuterOccurrences
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2W_Trace _root_.AdapterRw AspisR1.AdapterRw

def mark : S2W_Trace.Event → Option Bool
  | .returned (.op10 _ _ _ _ _ _ _) _ => some false
  | .returned (.op11 _ _ _ _ _ _) _ => some true
  | _ => none

def tags (log : Log) : List Bool := log.filterMap mark

attribute [local irreducible] _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_distinct_accounts
  _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_readonly_buffer _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_verifier_checkpoint
  _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.require_zero
  _root_.AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.validate_asq8

theorem run_pure (ops : Ops) {A : Type} (a : A) (log : Log) :
    run ops (pure a) log = ok (a,log) := rfl

theorem run_lift (ops : Ops) {A : Type} (r : Result A) (log : Log) :
    run ops (monadLift r : Code A) log = thenResult r (fun a => ok (a,log)) := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem run_liftM (ops : Ops) {A : Type} (r : Result A) (log : Log) :
    run ops (liftM r : Code A) log = thenResult r (fun a => ok (a,log)) := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem run_perform (ops : Ops) {A : Type} (call : Call A) (log : Log) :
    run ops (perform call) log = thenResult (invoke ops call) (fun a =>
      ok (a,log ++ [.returned call a])) := rfl

universe u v w
theorem then_assoc {A : Type u} {B : Type v} {C : Type w}
    (r : Result A) (f : A → Result B) (g : B → Result C) :
    thenResult (thenResult r f) g = thenResult r (fun a => thenResult (f a) g) := by
  cases r <;> rfl

theorem then_ok {A : Type u} {B : Type v} (a : A) (f : A → Result B) :
    thenResult (ok a) f = f a := rfl

theorem second_occurrence (ops : Ops) (program : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts : Slice Cuts.Account) (data : Slice U8)
    (slot : core.result.Result U64 Cuts.PE) (log : Log)
    (execution : run ops (S2W_Outer.stage2_owned ops S2W_Outer.traceEffects program accounts data slot)
      [] = ok (.Ok (),log)) : tags log = [true] := by
  simp only [S2W_Outer.stage2_owned,S2W_TraceFacts.run_bind,run_pure,run_lift,run_liftM,
    S2W_Outer.traceEffects,run_perform,S2W_Outer.mapError,then_assoc,then_ok, S2W_Trace.bind] at execution
  repeat' first
  | (solve | cases execution)
  | (fail_if_no_progress simp only [S2W_TraceFacts.run_bind,run_pure,run_lift,run_liftM,run_perform,S2W_Outer.mapError,then_assoc,then_ok, S2W_Trace.bind] at execution)
  | uncase_result
  | head_reduce execution
  | split at execution
  all_goals have logs := congrArg Prod.snd (Result.ok.inj execution)
  all_goals dsimp only at logs
  all_goals rw [← logs]
  all_goals simp [tags,mark]

#print axioms run_lift
#print axioms run_liftM
#print axioms run_perform
#print axioms then_assoc
#print axioms then_ok
#print axioms second_occurrence
end AspisR1.S2W_OuterOccurrences

import S2W_NativeSchedule
import S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint

/-! Consolidation on the actual expanded source schedule. Twelve fields only:
account observations still require the native wrapper source/heap port. No
logical commit post-state is substituted for a native observed account. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.S2W_ScheduledConsolidation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result MultiproofConeCanonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open S2W_NativeConsolidation S2W_AuthenticatedInputs S2W_InputSchedule
open S2W_ExpandedChildren S2W_TraceSplice

theorem accepted_run {E : Type}
    (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First) (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction ops native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.P1 sha256 H)
    (runtime : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program)
    (accounts1 accounts2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (accepted1 : native1 program accounts1 data1 = ok (.Ok saved))
    (accepted2 : native2 program accounts2 data2 slot = ok (.Ok ()))
    (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) (firstMarks : FirstMarks port) (secondMarks : SecondMarks port) :
    ∃ f s outer pre middle fs ss,
      SourceCuts ops accounts1 accounts2 saved f s ∧
      S2W_Trace.run ops (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,outer) ∧
      S2W_ExpandedTrace.runExpanded ops (children port)
        (S2W_Observation.two ops program accounts1 data1 accounts2 data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,S2W_ExpandedTrace.full (children port) outer) ∧
      projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline pre middle fs ss ∧
      ∀ (decode : HeaderDecode) (nodes : Nat → Nat → Slice U8) (y1 : Slice U8),
      CheckpointWriterConeJoin ops decode H f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split →
      CheckpointReaderConeJoin ops decode H s.pub s.proof s.checkpoint →
      CheckpointVersionBinding (bytesOf saved.val) (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val) →
      P2Prime H f.proof f.pub s.proof s.pub →
      S2W_ChildJoins.FirstEntryVerifierConeJoin f.proof →
      S2W_ChildJoins.MultiproofConeJoin f.proof s.proof nodes →
      S2W_ChildJoins.S8StageConeJoin f.proof y1 →
      ∀ (before after : S2LeadInterface.Site → Nat → S2LeadInterface.Account),
      ∃ parsed,
        InputScheduleFacts (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss before after)
          ops H (bytesOf f.proof.val) (bytesOf f.pub.val) (bytesOf saved.val) parsed ∧
        (∀ site, (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss before after).reached site ↔
          S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site site ∈ projected port outer) := by
  let boundary := S2W_DigestExtraction.sourceBoundary ops native1 native2 hashv extraction
  obtain ⟨f,s,cuts⟩ := cuts_of_acceptance ops native1 native2 hashv boundary
    program accounts1 accounts2 data1 data2 slot saved accepted1 accepted2
  obtain ⟨outer,pre,middle,fs,ss,execution,expanded,_,layout,_,_,_⟩ :=
    S2W_NativeSchedule.accepted_run ops native1 native2 hashv extraction program accounts1 accounts2
      data1 data2 slot saved accepted1 accepted2 port firstMarks secondMarks
  refine ⟨f,s,outer,pre,middle,fs,ss,cuts,execution,expanded,layout,?_⟩
  intro decode nodes y1 writer reader version p2prime entry multiproof scan before after
  obtain ⟨parsed,facts⟩ := input_schedule ops H accounts1 accounts2 f s saved cuts decode nodes y1
    writer reader version p2prime entry multiproof scan
    (S2W_DigestExtraction.native_oracle ops native1 native2 hashv extraction sha256 H p1 runtime)
    pre middle fs ss before after
  exact ⟨parsed,facts,fun site => by rw [layout]; rfl⟩

#print axioms accepted_run
#print axioms S2W_NativeSchedule.accepted_run
#print axioms S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint.returned_committed
#print axioms S2W_AccountObservations.snapshot_frame
#print axioms S2W_AccountObservations.admitted_write_frame
#print axioms S2W_AccountObservations.write_metadata
#print axioms S2W_TwoFieldAudit.full_fields_iff
#print axioms S2W_TwoFieldAudit.changed_metadata_excludes_facts
#print accepted_run
end AspisR1.S2W_ScheduledConsolidation
end

S2W_TraceSplice.source:
import S2W_ExpandedChildren
import S2W_FirstOccurrence

/-! Full native outer trace occurrence selection and child substitution.
Only local source-mark layouts are supplied by the two child cones. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2W_TraceSplice
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result S2W_Trace S2W_OuterOccurrences S2W_ExpandedTrace S2W_ExpandedChildren

theorem run_shift (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) {A : Type} (code : Code A) (headLog log : Log) :
    run ops code (headLog ++ log) = thenResult (run ops code log)
      (fun answer => ok (answer.1,headLog ++ answer.2)) := by
  induction code generalizing log with
  | done a => rfl
  | step r k ih =>
    cases r with
    | fail e => rfl
    | div => rfl
    | ok b => exact ih b log
  | call call k ih =>
    cases invoked : invoke ops call with
    | fail e => simp only [run,invoked,thenResult]
    | div => simp only [run,invoked,thenResult]
    | ok b =>
      simpa only [run,invoked,thenResult,List.append_assoc] using
        (ih b (log ++ [.returned call b]))

/-- Select a real occurrence from the log; headLog/suffix are computed by list
induction. The same typed event, including arguments and result, is retained. -/
theorem split_tag (log : Log) (tag : Bool) (rest : List Bool)
    (shape : tags log = tag :: rest) :
    ∃ pre event post, log = pre ++ event :: post ∧ tags pre = [] ∧
      mark event = some tag ∧ tags post = rest := by
  induction log with
  | nil => cases shape
  | cons event tail ih =>
    cases marked : mark event with
    | none =>
      have next : tags tail = tag :: rest := by simpa [tags,marked] using shape
      obtain ⟨pre,chosen,post,same,empty,first,last⟩ := ih next
      exact ⟨event :: pre,chosen,post,by simp [same],by simp [tags,marked] at empty ⊢; exact empty,first,last⟩
    | some value =>
      have next : value :: tags tail = tag :: rest := by simpa [tags,marked] using shape
      have same := List.cons.inj next
      exact ⟨[],event,tail,rfl,rfl,same.1 ▸ marked,same.2⟩

def project {E : Type} : S2W_ExpandedTrace.Event E → S2W_SiteSchedule.Event (Option E)
  | .outer _ => .source none
  | .child event => .source (some event)
  | .site site => .site site

def projected {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) (log : Log) :=
  (full (children port) log).map project

/-- Independently named CHILD layout theorems about their own source runs.
No full caller schedule, account observation, input identity or caller field. -/
structure FirstMarks {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) : Prop where
  source : ∀ event, mark event = some false → ∃ fs : S2W_SiteSchedule.FirstSegments (Option E),
    (events port event).map project = S2W_SiteSchedule.firstTrace fs
structure SecondMarks {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops) : Prop where
  source : ∀ event, mark event = some true → ∃ ss : S2W_SiteSchedule.SecondSegments (Option E),
    (events port event).map project = S2W_SiteSchedule.secondTrace ss

theorem invocation_first {E : Type} (event : S2W_Trace.Event) (marked : mark event = some false) :
    invocation (E := E) event = [.site .tx1] := by
  cases event with
  | returned call value => cases call <;> simp_all [mark,invocation]
theorem invocation_second {E : Type} (event : S2W_Trace.Event) (marked : mark event = some true) :
    invocation (E := E) event = [.site .tx2] := by
  cases event with
  | returned call value => cases call <;> simp_all [mark,invocation]

/-- The schedule is a projection of the expanded outer log, including the
post-TX2 outer suffix. Prefix/middle are DERIVED occurrence segments. -/
theorem expanded_schedule {E : Type} {ops : AdapterRw.Ops} (port : ChildConeJoin E ops)
    (first : FirstMarks port) (second : SecondMarks port) (outer : Log)
    (shape : tags outer = [false,true]) :
    ∃ pre middle fs ss,
      projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline pre middle fs ss := by
  obtain ⟨pre,e1,rest,same,_,m1,remaining⟩ := split_tag outer false [true] shape
  obtain ⟨middle,e2,post,same2,_,m2,_⟩ := split_tag rest true [] remaining
  obtain ⟨fs,layout1⟩ := first.source e1 m1
  obtain ⟨ss,layout2⟩ := second.source e2 m2
  let headLog := projected port pre ++ [.source none]
  let interval := projected port middle ++ [.source none]
  let ss' := {ss with afterFinish := ss.afterFinish ++ projected port post}
  refine ⟨headLog,interval,fs,ss',?_⟩
  have splice := S2W_ExpandedTrace.splice (children port) outer pre middle post e1 e2
    (by simp only [same,same2,List.append_assoc,List.cons_append,List.nil_append])
  unfold projected
  rw [splice]
  simp only [List.map_append,expand,children,invocation_first e1 m1,invocation_second e2 m2,
    List.map_cons,List.map_nil,project,layout1,layout2]
  simp only [headLog,interval,ss',S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline,S2W_SiteSchedule.secondTrace,
    projected,List.append_assoc,List.cons_append,List.nil_append]

#print axioms expanded_schedule
#print FirstMarks
#print SecondMarks
end AspisR1.S2W_TraceSplice

import S2X_RuntimeRetention

set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.S2X
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AdapterRw.Cuts

attribute [local irreducible] AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.validate_asq8
  AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data

/-- The actual accepted owned TX2 selects from byte 688 through the end of
its raw proof account and passes that SAME selection to the second child. -/
theorem second_fixed_range (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (program : AdapterRw.solana_pubkey.Pubkey) (accounts : Slice Account)
    (data : Slice U8) (slot : core.result.Result U64 PE)
    (accepted : AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program accounts data slot =
      ok (.Ok ())) :
    ∃ validated proofAccount checkpointAccount raw checkpointInput publicArray selected finish,
      AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.validate_asq8 ops program accounts data slot = ok (.Ok validated) ∧
      Slice.index_usize accounts 0#usize = ok proofAccount ∧
      Slice.index_usize accounts 6#usize = ok checkpointAccount ∧
      AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops proofAccount = ok (.Ok raw) ∧
      AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops checkpointAccount = ok (.Ok checkpointInput) ∧
      ops.op22 validated.statement = ok (.Ok publicArray) ∧
      core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
        raw {start := 688#usize, «end» := finish} = ok selected ∧
      ops.op11 (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops)
        (Array.to_slice publicArray) selected checkpointInput () none = ok (.Ok ()) ∧
      raw.val.length = finish.val := by
  unfold AdapterRw.r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned at accepted
  simp only [AdapterRw.core.result.Result.map_err,
    AdapterRw.Constants.constant_aspis_statement_pool_v1_pair_terminal_POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES] at accepted
  repeat' first
  | (solve | cases accepted)
  | uncase_result
  | head_reduce accepted
  | split at accepted
  all_goals try simp only [error_bind_ne_ok] at *
  all_goals aesop (add simp [bne_iff_ne])

/-- Checked range success includes ordering; no scanner honesty assumption is
needed for this property. No concrete proof contents are reduced. -/
theorem successful_range_ordered (raw selected : Slice U8) (start finish : Usize)
    (range : core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
      raw {start := start, «end» := finish} = ok selected) : start.val ≤ finish.val := by
  by_contra unordered
  simp [core.slice.index.Slice.index, core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index, unordered] at range

#print axioms second_fixed_range
#print axioms successful_range_ordered
end AspisR1.S2X

/-! Contextual reuse under the checked *actual* decoder. This removes the
independent decoder-success hypothesis from the context equality. The arbitrary
continuation retains validators, proof guards, error paths and writes; it is
not asserted to be a translated AccountInfo stage1. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1
open PreparationBinding FirstCaller
open RepinS6First

abbrev decodeActual :=
  AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1

/-- No success or totality assumption: the statement comes from this very
same decoder on bytes, and both sides retain exactly the same continuation.
Failure, divergence, ordinary decoder rejection and downstream errors agree. -/
theorem decoder_scoped_reuse {E F A : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E) (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize)
    (reject : DecodeError → Result A)
    (tail : DecoderStatement → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) E) → Result A) :
    (do
      let r ← decodeActual bytes
      match r with
      | .Err e => reject e
      | .Ok s => tail s (RepinS6First.first invalidAccountData tx1 error bytes proof k)) =
    (do
      let r ← decodeActual bytes
      match r with
      | .Err e => reject e
      | .Ok s => tail s (first_decoded tx1 error (preparationPublic s) bytes proof k)) := by
  cases hd : decodeActual bytes with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok r =>
    cases r with
    | Err e => rfl
    | Ok s =>
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [reuse_decoded invalidAccountData tx1 error bytes proof k s hd]

/-- Success of first_decoded already forces the *actual* child to return the
same checkpoint with None. Error mapping cannot turn Rust Err into Rust Ok. -/
theorem first_decoded_success {E F : Type}
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E) (pub : Public) (bytes proof : Slice U8)
    (k : Usize) (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : first_decoded tx1 error pub bytes proof k = ok (.Ok out)) :
    tx1 pub bytes proof k () none = ok (.Ok out) := by
  unfold first_decoded observer at h
  simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
  cases ht : tx1 pub bytes proof k () none with
  | fail e => simp only [ht, bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [ht, bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
  | ok r =>
    rw [ht] at h
    simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
    cases r with
    | Ok v =>
      simp only [core.result.Result.map_err] at h
      cases h
      rfl
    | Err e =>
      change (do let mapped ← error e; ok (core.result.Result.Err mapped)) = ok (.Ok out) at h
      cases he : error e with
      | fail e' => simp only [he, bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
      | div => simp only [he, bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
      | ok e' => simp only [he, bind_tc_ok] at h; cases h

/-- A concrete decode-then-call scope derives its own decoder equation,
semantic selection, exact bytes/proof/k and observer-off child success. -/
theorem decoded_scope_success {E F : Type} (invalidAccountData : E)
    (tx1 : Public → Slice U8 → Slice U8 → Usize → Unit →
      Option (Phase → Result Unit) → Result (core.result.Result (alloc.vec.Vec U8) F))
    (error : F → Result E) (bytes proof : Slice U8) (k : Usize)
    (out : alloc.vec.Vec U8)
    (h : (do
      let r ← decodeActual bytes
      match r with
      | .Err _ => ok (core.result.Result.Err invalidAccountData)
      | .Ok s => first_decoded tx1 error (preparationPublic s) bytes proof k)
      = ok (.Ok out)) :
    ∃ s : DecoderStatement,
      decodeActual bytes = ok (.Ok s) ∧
      RepinS6First.first invalidAccountData tx1 error bytes proof k =
        first_decoded tx1 error (preparationPublic s) bytes proof k ∧
      tx1 (preparationPublic s) bytes proof k () none = ok (.Ok out) := by
  cases hd : decodeActual bytes with
  | fail e => simp only [hd, bind_tc_fail] at h; cases h
  | div => simp only [hd, bind_tc_div] at h; cases h
  | ok r =>
    rw [hd] at h
    simp only [bind_tc_ok] at h
    cases r with
    | Err e => cases h
    | Ok s => exact ⟨s,rfl,reuse_decoded invalidAccountData tx1 error bytes proof k s hd,
        first_decoded_success tx1 error (preparationPublic s) bytes proof k out h⟩

#print axioms decoder_scoped_reuse
#print axioms first_decoded_success
#print axioms decoded_scope_success
end AspisR1PublicPreparation.S6DecoderScopedReuseV1

      POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION
      AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
    rfl
  rw [same]
  exact AspisS6NativeForestDecode.common_prefix_contents bytes statement common raw raw_bytes header fields

theorem late_contents (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok statement))
    (common : PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1)
    (common_run : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common statement=ok common)
    (initial updated : Slice U8) (size : initial.length=1520)
    (run : nativeOps.late (fromPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1 common.lane_transition) initial=ok (.Ok (),updated)) :
    updated.val=List.slice 144 1664 bytes.val := by
  obtain ⟨reached,correct,reached_run,correct_run,contents⟩ :=
    AspisS6OuterAcceptedCallees.late_from_decode bytes statement accepted initial size
  rw [common_run] at reached_run
  cases reached_run
  rw [run] at correct_run
  cases correct_run
  exact contents

theorem transfer_contents (bytes : Slice U8) (common : PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1)
    (value : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok (.PrivateTransfer common value)))
    (encoded : Array U8 216#usize)
    (run : nativeOps.transfer (fromPoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 value)=ok (.Ok encoded)) :
    encoded.val=bytes.val.drop 1664 := by
  obtain ⟨correct,correct_run,contents⟩ := AspisS6OuterAcceptedCallees.payment_from_decode bytes (.PrivateTransfer common value) accepted
  rw [run] at correct_run
  cases correct_run
  exact contents

theorem withdrawal_contents (bytes : Slice U8) (common : PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1)
    (value : AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok (.Withdrawal common value)))
    (encoded : Array U8 216#usize)
    (run : nativeOps.withdrawal (fromPoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 value)=ok (.Ok encoded)) :
    encoded.val=bytes.val.drop 1664 := by
  obtain ⟨correct,correct_run,contents⟩ := AspisS6OuterAcceptedCallees.payment_from_decode bytes (.Withdrawal common value) accepted
  rw [run] at correct_run
  cases correct_run
  exact contents

#print axioms common_contents
#print axioms late_contents
#print axioms transfer_contents
#print axioms withdrawal_contents
end AspisS6OuterAcceptedByteJoin

import S6OuterNativeInstalledV1
import S6NativeForestAcceptedFramesV1
import S6NativeLateCodecV1
import S6NativePaymentRoundtripV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisS6OuterAcceptedCallees
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder AspisS6OuterCarrierBridge AspisS6OuterNativeOps
open pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal

/-- Actual installed payment call succeeds and reproduces the reached suffix.
No independent child success or canonicality premise is supplied. -/
def payment (bytes : Slice U8) : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 → Prop
  | .PrivateTransfer _ value => ∃ encoded : Array U8 216#usize,
      nativeOps.transfer (fromPoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 value)=ok (.Ok encoded) ∧
      encoded.val=bytes.val.drop 1664
  | .Withdrawal _ value => ∃ encoded : Array U8 216#usize,
      nativeOps.withdrawal (fromPoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 value)=ok (.Ok encoded) ∧
      encoded.val=bytes.val.drop 1664

theorem payment_from_decode (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok statement)) :
    payment bytes statement := by
  have frame := (AspisS6NativeForestDecode.accepted_frames bytes statement accepted).2.2.1
  cases statement with
  | PrivateTransfer common value =>
    obtain ⟨input,input_bytes,decoded⟩ := frame
    obtain ⟨encoded,contents,run⟩ := AspisS6NativePaymentContents.transfer_accepted_inverse input value decoded
    refine ⟨encoded,?_,contents.trans input_bytes⟩
    rw [transfer_call,run]
    rfl
  | Withdrawal common value =>
    obtain ⟨input,input_bytes,decoded⟩ := frame
    obtain ⟨encoded,contents,run⟩ := AspisS6NativePaymentContents.withdrawal_accepted_inverse input value decoded
    refine ⟨encoded,?_,contents.trans input_bytes⟩
    rw [withdrawal_call,run]
    rfl

theorem validate_from_decode (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok statement)) :
    nativeOps.validate (fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 statement)=ok (.Ok ()) := by
  rw [validate_call,(AspisS6NativeForestDecode.accepted_frames bytes statement accepted).2.2.2]
  rfl

/-- The reached common selector and installed mutable transition call are
connected to the same accepted outer statement, retaining its caller buffer. -/
theorem late_from_decode (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok statement))
    (output : Slice U8) (size : output.length=1520) :
    ∃ common updated,
      PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common statement=ok common ∧
      nativeOps.late (fromPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementV1 common.lane_transition) output=
        ok (.Ok (),updated) ∧ updated.val=List.slice 144 1664 bytes.val := by
  obtain ⟨common,common_run,fields⟩ :=
    (AspisS6NativeForestDecode.accepted_frames bytes statement accepted).2.1
  obtain ⟨input,input_bytes,decoded⟩ := fields.2.2.2.2.2.2
  obtain ⟨updated,run,contents⟩ := AspisS6NativeLateCodec.accepted_inverse input common.lane_transition decoded output size
  refine ⟨common,updated,common_run,?_,contents.trans input_bytes⟩
  rw [late_call,run]
  rfl

#print axioms payment_from_decode
#print axioms validate_from_decode
#print axioms late_from_decode
end AspisS6OuterAcceptedCallees

S6OuterNativeCodecV1.source:
import S6OuterEncoderContentsV1
import S6OuterAcceptedByteJoinV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
namespace AspisS6OuterNativeCodec
open AspisS6OuterCarrierBridge AspisS6OuterNativeOps
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal

/-- Complete outer1880 inverse at the concrete installed original encoder cut.
The only input premise is original native decoder acceptance. -/
theorem accepted_inverse (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok statement)) :
    ∃ encoded : Array U8 1880#usize,
      AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode statement=ok (.Ok encoded) ∧ encoded.val=bytes.val := by
  have valid := AspisS6OuterAcceptedCallees.validate_from_decode bytes statement accepted
  have pay := AspisS6OuterAcceptedCallees.payment_from_decode bytes statement accepted
  cases statement with
  | PrivateTransfer common payload =>
    have late := AspisS6OuterEncodeFromDecode.late_ready_from_decode bytes (.PrivateTransfer common payload) accepted common rfl
    obtain ⟨payment,payment_run,_⟩ := pay
    have good := AspisS6OuterEncoderContents.private_contents
      (fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 common) (fromPoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 payload)
      valid late ⟨payment,payment_run⟩
    obtain ⟨result,run,encoded,initial,updated,payment,success,size,len,late_run,pay_run,layout⟩ := spec_imp_exists good
    cases success
    simp only [AspisS6OuterEncoderContents.common_prefix] at layout
    have common_bytes := AspisS6OuterAcceptedByteJoin.common_contents bytes (.PrivateTransfer common payload) accepted common rfl
    simp only [AspisS6NativeForestDecode.statement_tag] at common_bytes
    have late_bytes := AspisS6OuterAcceptedByteJoin.late_contents bytes (.PrivateTransfer common payload) accepted common rfl initial updated size late_run
    have payment_bytes := AspisS6OuterAcceptedByteJoin.transfer_contents bytes common payload accepted payment pay_run
    refine ⟨encoded,?_,?_⟩
    · unfold AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode
      rw [show fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (.PrivateTransfer common payload)=
        .PrivateTransfer (fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 common) (fromPoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1 payload) from rfl,run]
      rfl
    · rw [layout,common_bytes,late_bytes,payment_bytes]
      rw [AspisS6SliceFrame.take_append_slice bytes.val 144 1664 (by decide),List.take_append_drop]
  | Withdrawal common payload =>
    have late := AspisS6OuterEncodeFromDecode.late_ready_from_decode bytes (.Withdrawal common payload) accepted common rfl
    obtain ⟨payment,payment_run,_⟩ := pay
    have good := AspisS6OuterEncoderContents.withdrawal_contents
      (fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 common) (fromPoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 payload)
      valid late ⟨payment,payment_run⟩
    obtain ⟨result,run,encoded,initial,updated,payment,success,size,len,late_run,pay_run,layout⟩ := spec_imp_exists good
    cases success
    simp only [AspisS6OuterEncoderContents.common_prefix] at layout
    have common_bytes := AspisS6OuterAcceptedByteJoin.common_contents bytes (.Withdrawal common payload) accepted common rfl
    simp only [AspisS6NativeForestDecode.statement_tag] at common_bytes
    have late_bytes := AspisS6OuterAcceptedByteJoin.late_contents bytes (.Withdrawal common payload) accepted common rfl initial updated size late_run
    have payment_bytes := AspisS6OuterAcceptedByteJoin.withdrawal_contents bytes common payload accepted payment pay_run
    refine ⟨encoded,?_,?_⟩
    · unfold AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode
      rw [show fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (.Withdrawal common payload)=
        .Withdrawal (fromPoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 common) (fromPoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1 payload) from rfl,run]
      rfl
    · rw [layout,common_bytes,late_bytes,payment_bytes]
      rw [AspisS6SliceFrame.take_append_slice bytes.val 144 1664 (by decide),List.take_append_drop]

theorem accepted_roundtrip (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1)
    (encoded : Array U8 1880#usize)
    (accepted : decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes=ok (.Ok statement))
    (encoded_actual : AspisS6OuterNativeInstalled.encode statement=ok (.Ok encoded)) :
    encoded.val=bytes.val := by
  obtain ⟨correct,run,contents⟩ := accepted_inverse bytes statement accepted
  rw [encoded_actual] at run
  cases run
  exact contents

#print axioms accepted_inverse
#print axioms accepted_roundtrip
end AspisS6OuterNativeCodec

import SInt2_ClaimsUnrolledSdk
import S2W_D189Consolidation
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledSdk
open AspisR1CurrentCaller InstalledPreparation BorrowedClaimPrepared
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.InstalledMeaning
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete OriginalSerializerInstallation
open AspisS1ValuesOwnedInstallation AspisS1NativeBufferClaimTrace
open S2Trust S2LeadInterface S2W_D189Entry S2W_D189Wrappers S2W_TrustedStd
open S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint S2W_EntryWriteHistory S2W_CommittedCheckpoint
open S2W_D189Consolidation S2W_NativeConsolidation S2W_AuthenticatedInputs S2W_InputSchedule
open S2W_ExpandedChildren S2W_TraceSplice MultiproofConeCanonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

def sdkOps (adapterOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (ops : Ops)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    (claimsStd : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls) : AdapterRw.Ops :=
  AspisS6CurrentFirstInstallation.install adapterOps
    (NativeBuffers.install (withValues ops) nativeValues AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren.children
      (ClaimsUnrolledFinish.install claimsStd B))

/-- Reuse the established D189 conditional boundary, including ALL fourteen
caller facts and the exact f,s it produces. This actual pair's same proof,
public and semantic source call supply the Claims result; SourceCuts is an
output, never a new premise. No native/extraction/crypto/effect/adoption
obligation is discharged by pretending this candidate is the frozen source. -/
theorem accepted_pair_claims {W A E M Cv : Type} {N : Nat}
    (L : Library W (Nat → Record)) (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (allocator : Allocator A)
    (e1 e2 : Entry) (w1 w2 : W)
    (admission1 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e1 w1 3)
    (admission2 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e2 w2 7)
    (adapterOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (ops : Ops)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    (claimsStd : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls) (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First) (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.P1 sha256 H)
    (syscall : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state1 state2 final1 final2 : A)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (post1 post2 : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted1 : S2W_D189Wrappers.first native1 copy allocator e1 program data1 state1 =
      ok (.Ok (saved,post1,final1)))
    (accepted2 : S2W_D189Wrappers.second native2 allocator e2 program data2 slot state2 =
      ok (.Ok (post2,final2)))
    (p : FS2.Duplex.Params M Cv N) (root : Array U8 32#usize) (length : U32)
    (port : ChildConeJoin E (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd)) (firstMarks : FirstMarks port) (secondMarks : SecondMarks port) :
    ∃ f s outer pre middle fs ss,
      SourceCuts (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) saved f s ∧
      S2W_ExpandedTrace.runExpanded (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) (children port)
        (S2W_Observation.two (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) program e1.first data1 (e2.second secondSizes) data2 slot) [] =
        ok (.Ok saved,S2W_ExpandedTrace.full (children port) outer) ∧
      S2W_D189Interpretation.runOwned (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd)
        (S2W_Observation.two (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) program e1.first data1 (e2.second secondSizes) data2 slot) [] e1.heap =
        ok (.Ok saved,outer,e1.heap) ∧
      projected port outer = S2W_SiteSchedule.timeline pre middle fs ss ∧
      post2 = e2.heap ∧
      before e1 e2 .tx1 = S2W_D189Interpretation.nativeObserve L encode e1.metadata 3 w1 e1.heap.ambient ∧
      before e1 e2 .tx2 = S2W_D189Interpretation.nativeObserve L encode e2.metadata 7 w2 e2.heap.ambient ∧
      (∃ selectedPublic,
        AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public
          f.statement = ok selectedPublic ∧
        SourceCuts (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) saved
          {f with semantic := selectedPublic} s ∧
        ∃ (semantic y1 : Slice U8) (v : AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.verifier.View)
          (sem : r1_semantic.Verified Unit) (claimsPrefix : AspisR1PublicPreparation.r1_wire.Prefix),
          AspisR1SelectedWideViewV1.verifier.candidate.wide_view f.proof semantic y1 = ok (.Ok v) ∧
          (semanticBase ops (ClaimsUnrolledFinish.install claimsStd B)).op9
            (NativeBuffers.callerDigest adapterOps (withValues ops) nativeValues
              AspisS1ExtractedRoundChildren.children (ClaimsUnrolledFinish.install claimsStd B))
            (FirstComposition.toCurrentPublic
              (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic
                (AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.toPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 f.statement)))
            v.semantic () none = ok (.Ok sem) ∧
          AspisR1PublicPreparation.PrefixAdapter.parseAccepted v.semantic = ok (.Ok claimsPrefix) ∧
          ClaimsUnrolledFinish.reference claimsStd claimsPrefix = ok (.Ok (retainedSem sem).claims)) ∧
      ∀ (decode : HeaderDecode) (nodes : Nat → Nat → Slice U8) (y1 : Slice U8),
      CheckpointWriterConeJoin (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) decode H f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split →
      CheckpointReaderConeJoin (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd) decode H s.pub s.proof s.checkpoint →
      S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
        (payloadBytes encode (post1.payload (e1.heap.accounts 2).1) 1768) (bytesOf s.checkpoint.val) →
      P2Prime H f.proof f.pub s.proof s.pub →
      S2W_ChildJoins.FirstEntryVerifierConeJoin f.proof →
      S2W_ChildJoins.MultiproofConeJoin f.proof s.proof nodes →
      S2W_ChildJoins.S8StageConeJoin f.proof y1 →
      ∃ parsed,
        S2W_LeadInterface.S2CallerFacts
          (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1))
          (S2Z.Oracle.leadDigest (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd)) () H (bytesOf f.proof.val) (bytesOf f.pub.val)
          (bytesOf saved.val) parsed ∧
        (∀ site, (observation f s saved nodes y1 pre middle fs ss (before e1 e2) (after e1 e2 post1)).reached site ↔
          S2W_SiteSchedule.Event.site site ∈ projected port outer) := by
  have original := S2W_D189Consolidation.accepted_run L sdk copy std allocator
    e1 e2 w1 w2 admission1 admission2 (sdkOps adapterOps ops B claimsStd)
    native1 native2 hashv extraction sha256 H p1 syscall program data1 data2 slot
    state1 state2 final1 final2 saved post1 post2 accepted1 accepted2
    port firstMarks secondMarks
  obtain ⟨f, s, outer, pre, middle, fs, ss, cuts, expanded, owned, layout,
    unchanged, before1, before2, caller⟩ := original
  have originalAccepted : AspisS6SdkFirstObjectEquivalence.originalFirst native1 copy
      allocator e1 program data1 state1 = ok (.Ok (saved,post1,final1)) := by
    rw [← AspisS6SdkFirstObjectEquivalence.first_eq_original]
    exact accepted1
  have sdkSource := candidate_sdk_selected_semantic_trace L sdk copy std allocator
    e1 w1 admission1 adapterOps ops B claimsStd native1 native2 hashv extraction
    p root length program data1 saved state1 final1 post1 originalAccepted
  obtain ⟨written, observed, steps⟩ := sdkSource
  obtain ⟨selectedPublic, publicSemantic, selectedCut, publicBytes, publicLength,
    payload, decoded, split, zero, semantic, y1, v, sem, prepared, scratch,
    viewCall, variant, semanticCall, prepareCall, powers, claimPowers, claim,
    numeric, challengesNumeric, seeds, meaning, eachPower, trace, queries,
    ⟨claimsPrefix, parsed, normalizedClaims⟩, tail⟩ := steps (e2.second secondSizes) f s cuts
  exact ⟨f, s, outer, pre, middle, fs, ss, cuts, expanded, owned, layout,
    unchanged, before1, before2,
    ⟨selectedPublic, publicSemantic, selectedCut, semantic, y1, v, sem, claimsPrefix,
      viewCall, semanticCall, parsed, normalizedClaims⟩, caller⟩

#print axioms accepted_pair_claims
end AspisR1.ClaimsUnrolledSdk
end

import SdkD_Inner

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.SdkD_Accepted
open scoped BigOperators
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open ClaimsUnrolledSdk
open AspisR1CurrentCaller InstalledPreparation BorrowedClaimPrepared
open AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge.InstalledMeaning
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete OriginalSerializerInstallation
open AspisS1ValuesOwnedInstallation AspisS1NativeBufferClaimTrace

open S2W_WrapperLaws S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint S2W_EntryWriteHistory S2W_CommittedCheckpoint
open S2W_D189Consolidation S2W_NativeConsolidation S2W_AuthenticatedInputs S2W_InputSchedule
open S2W_ExpandedChildren S2W_TraceSplice MultiproofConeCanonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep

/-- The union of Op4P, Tx2I, Op5T and Tx1Q conclusions on one f,s,cuts.
Success-conditioned marks retain rejected-prefix effect obligations. -/
theorem accepted_pair_unified {W A M Cv F CoreError : Type} {N : Nat}
    (L : Library W (Nat → Record)) (sdk : S2TrustedSdkBorrow L)
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (std : TrustedStd copy) (allocator : Allocator A)
    (e1 e2 : Entry) (w1 w2 : W)
    (admission1 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e1 w1 3)
    (admission2 : RuntimeEntrypointAdmission L e2 w2 7)
    (adapterOps : AdapterRw.Ops) (ops : Ops)
    (reserved : Bool) (queryOps : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops)
    (geoOps : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.Ops CoreError)
    (stageBase : VTop_Stages.Ops) (finishOps : AspisR1Stage2.Stage2Finish.FinishOps F)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries)
    (claimsStd : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls) (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First) (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction (sdkOps (Tx2I_Install.install adapterOps (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stageBase reserved queryOps geoOps)) finishOps) (Uni_Install.current ops reserved queryOps geoOps) B claimsStd) native1 native2 hashv)
    (sha256 H : Bytes → State) (p1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.P1 sha256 H)
    (syscall : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.RuntimeSyscall hashv sha256)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data1 data2 : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot) (state1 state2 final1 final2 : A)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (post1 post2 : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted1 : S2W_D189Wrappers.first native1 copy allocator e1 program data1 state1 =
      ok (.Ok (saved,post1,final1)))
    (accepted2 : S2W_D189Wrappers.second native2 allocator e2 program data2 slot state2 =
      ok (.Ok (post2,final2)))
    (p : FS2.Duplex.Params M Cv N) (root : Array U8 32#usize) (length : U32)
    :
    let port := SdkD_Child.port adapterOps (Uni_Install.current ops reserved queryOps geoOps) (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stageBase reserved queryOps geoOps)) finishOps B claimsStd
    ∃ f s outer pre middle fs ss,
      SourceCuts (sdkOps (Tx2I_Install.install adapterOps (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stageBase reserved queryOps geoOps)) finishOps) (Uni_Install.current ops reserved queryOps geoOps) B claimsStd) e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) saved f s ∧
      ((RowShape_InstalledSlots.verifierOps (Uni_Install.current ops reserved queryOps geoOps) B claimsStd).op4 f.proof = ok (.Ok ()) ∧
        Op4P_Install.sourceBody f.proof = ok (.Ok ()) ∧
        OraclePortCompactDraft.scan (bytesOf f.proof.val)) ∧
      (∃ run : Tx1Q_Execution.Run (Tx1Q_Execution.actual (Op5T_Concrete.current ops) reserved queryOps geoOps B claimsStd)
        reserved queryOps geoOps (Tx1Q_SameCut.callerDigest (Tx2I_Install.install adapterOps (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stageBase reserved queryOps geoOps)) finishOps) (Op5T_Concrete.current ops) reserved queryOps geoOps B claimsStd) ()
        (AspisS6CurrentVerifierCarrier.toPublic f.semantic) f.pub f.proof f.split saved,
        reserved = true ∧ f.split = 10#usize ∧ run.out.next.val = 10 ∧ run.flushed.val.length = 64 ∧

theorem same_pair {A F CoreError : Type}
    (copy : Heap (Nat → Record) → Nat → Payload → Outcome (Nat → Record))
    (stdCopy : TrustedStd copy) (allocator : Allocator A) (e1 e2 : Entry)
    (adapter : AdapterRw.Ops) (ops : AspisR1CurrentCaller.Ops)
    (stage : VTop_Stages.Ops) (finish : AspisR1Stage2.Stage2Finish.FinishOps F)
    (reserved : Bool) (query : Port3_NativeQueryBody.Ops) (geo : Port3_NativeGeometryBody.Ops CoreError)
    (B : AspisR1PublicPreparation.FinishModel.Boundaries) (std : ClaimsUnrolledFinish.StdCalls)
    (native1 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.First) (native2 : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Second)
    (hashv : S2Z.Oracle.Parts → Result S2Z.Oracle.Digest)
    (extraction : S2W_DigestExtraction.AeneasExtraction
      (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps
        (Tx2I_Install.install adapter (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stage reserved query geo)) finish)
        (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std) native1 native2 hashv)
    (program : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Program) (data1 : Slice U8) (state1 final1 : A)
    (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (post1 : Heap (Nat → Record))
    (accepted1 : first native1 copy allocator e1 program data1 state1 = .ok (.Ok (saved,post1,final1)))
    (f : FirstCut) (s : SecondCut)
    (cuts : SourceCuts (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps
        (Tx2I_Install.install adapter (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stage reserved query geo)) finish)
        (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std) e1.first (e2.second secondSizes) saved f s)
    (decode : HeaderDecode) (H : Bytes → State)
    (writer : CheckpointWriterConeJoin (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps
        (Tx2I_Install.install adapter (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stage reserved query geo)) finish)
        (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std) decode H f.semantic f.pub f.proof f.split)
    (reader : CheckpointReaderConeJoin (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps
        (Tx2I_Install.install adapter (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stage reserved query geo)) finish)
        (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std) decode H s.pub s.proof s.checkpoint)
    (runtime : S2X.CheckpointVersionBinding
      (S2W_EntryWriteHistory.payloadBytes S2W_ReturnedCheckpoint.encode (post1.payload (e1.heap.accounts 2).1) 1768)
      (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf s.checkpoint.val))
    (p2prime : P2Prime H f.proof f.pub s.proof s.pub)
    (queryLeaves : Port5Q1_QueryPorts.SessionAPrimitives query)
    (geoLeaves : Port5Q1_GeometryCanonical.SessionAPrimitives geo)
    (domain : Port5Q1_Domain.SessionADomain geo)
    (multiply : geo.op9 = AspisR1Qm31ArithmeticProbe.field.M31.mul)
    (one : geo.op7 = ok 1#u32) (inverse : geo.op11 = Port4C_InverseExecution.inverse_owned) :
    Tx2N_Finish.Outcome finish reserved query
      (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32
        (ClaimsUnrolledSdk.sdkOps
          (Tx2I_Install.install adapter (Op5T_Concrete.stage (Tx2N_Execution.control stage reserved query geo)) finish)
          (Uni_Install.current ops reserved query geo) B std)) () s.pub s.proof s.checkpoint saved H
      (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf f.proof.val) (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf f.pub.val) := by
  obtain ⟨version,key,ledger,events,checkpoint,proof,pub,size⟩ :=
    RowOrder_History.on_d189_cuts copy stdCopy allocator e1 e2 _ native1 native2 hashv
      extraction program data1 state1 final1 saved post1 accepted1 f s cuts decode H
      writer reader runtime p2prime
  apply Tx2N_Finish.accepted (Op5T_Concrete.stage stage) finish reserved query queryLeaves geo
    geoLeaves domain multiply one inverse _ () s.pub s.proof s.checkpoint saved H
    (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf f.proof.val) (MultiproofConeCanonical.bytesOf f.pub.val) checkpoint
  exact cuts.second

import ExtractedTx1Reachability
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
namespace Tx1FinalLenBoundV6
private theorem small_max (n : Nat) (hn : n < 2048) : n ≤ Usize.max := by
  have hpow : n < 2 ^ UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    rw [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, ← Usize.max_succ_eq_pow]
    have hmax := Usize.cMax_bound_concrete.1
    omega
  have hsucc : n < Usize.max + 1 := by
    simpa only [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq, Usize.max_succ_eq_pow] using hpow
  omega
private theorem mul21 : (2#usize * 1#usize : Result Usize) = .ok (2#usize) := by
  have hs : (2#usize * 1#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = 2⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.mul_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using small_max 2 (by omega)
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs
  have heq : z = 2#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by simpa using hv)
  simpa [heq] using hz
private theorem mul22 : (2#usize * 2#usize : Result Usize) = .ok (4#usize) := by
  have hs : (2#usize * 2#usize : Result Usize) ⦃z => z.val = 4⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.mul_spec
    simpa only [UScalar.max_USize_eq, UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using small_max 4 (by omega)
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs
  have heq : z = 4#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq (by simpa using hv)
  simpa [heq] using hz
private theorem shift2 : (1024#usize >>> 2#usize : Result Usize) = .ok (256#usize) := by
  have hlevel : (2#usize).val < UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    rw [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq]
    rcases System.Platform.numBits_eq with h32 | h64
    · rw [h32]; norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    · rw [h64]; norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec (1024#usize) (2#usize) hlevel)
  have hv' : z.val = (256#usize).val := by
    rw [hv.1]
    norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have heq : z = 256#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hv'
  simpa [heq] using hz
private theorem shift4 : (1024#usize >>> 4#usize : Result Usize) = .ok (64#usize) := by
  have hlevel : (4#usize).val < UScalarTy.Usize.numBits := by
    rw [UScalarTy.Usize_numBits_eq]
    rcases System.Platform.numBits_eq with h32 | h64
    · rw [h32]; norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
    · rw [h64]; norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq]
  obtain ⟨z,hz,hv⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.ShiftRight_spec (1024#usize) (4#usize) hlevel)
  have hv' : z.val = (64#usize).val := by
    rw [hv.1]
    norm_num [UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq, Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow]
  have heq : z = 64#usize := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hv'
  simpa [heq] using hz

theorem final_len_cases (v : AspisR1PublicPreparation.transport.Variant) :
  AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1Model.final_len v =
    match v with
    | .S1 => .ok 256#usize
    | .S2 => .ok 64#usize
    | .D => .ok 64#usize := by
  cases v <;> simp [AspisR1PublicPreparation.Tx1Model.final_len,
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.transport.Variant.folds,
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.transport.Variant.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqVariant.eq,
    AspisR1PublicPreparation.transport.Variant.read_discriminant,
    mul21, mul22, shift2, shift4]
#print axioms final_len_cases
end Tx1FinalLenBoundV6

import VTop_Cuts

set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.VTop_Checkpoint
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result VTop_Stages
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames AspisV8R19.SourceDuplexStep
open MultiproofConeCanonical OraclePortCompactDraft
open CheckpointBytes5Effect

def digest {Hash : Type} (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) :
    AspisR1Stage2.aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash := ⟨D.coremarkerCopyInst,D.digest⟩

def checkpointSlice (saved : alloc.vec.Vec U8) : Slice U8 := saved.deref

/-- Exact checkpoint child source transport. Neither field states a header,
size, caller acceptance, byte persistence or a Required14 conclusion. -/
structure CheckpointSourceJoin (stage : Ops) {Hash : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (reserved : Bool) : Prop where
  writer : ∀ p a proof pub saved, stage.op8 D p a proof pub hash = ok saved →
    ∃ before after, run (digest D) hash
      (CheckpointBytes5Writer.writer (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared p)
        (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator a) proof pub) before =
          ok (checkpointSlice saved,after)
  reader : ∀ ck proof pub p a,
    stage.op18 D ck proof pub .S2 hash = ok (.Ok (p,a)) →
    AspisR1Stage2.verifier.resumeWithOps (CheckpointBytes4Ops.ops reserved)
      (digest D) ck proof pub .S2 hash = ok (.Ok (p,a))

/-- The original prepared/accumulator provenance obligation, restricted to
writer calls actually reached by this TX1; it is not folded into source identity. -/
def WriterProvenance (stage : Ops) {Hash : Type}
    (D : aspis_core.digest.Digest32 Hash) (hash : Hash) (proof pub : Slice U8) : Prop :=
  ∀ p a saved, stage.op8 D p a proof pub hash = ok saved →
    ∃ pm am, CheckpointBytes5Join.S1S7S8StateProvenance
      (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toPrepared p) (CheckpointBytes3Namespaces.toAccumulator a) pm am

theorem writer_join (adapter : AdapterRw.Ops) (stage : Ops)
    (H : Bytes → State) (semantic : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public)
    (pub proof : Slice U8) (split : Usize) (reserved : Bool)
    (source : CheckpointSourceJoin stage
      (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage)) () reserved)
    (oracle : CheckpointBytes5Inputs.Oracle
      (digest (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage))) () H)
    (provenance : WriterProvenance stage
      (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage)) () proof pub) :
    S2W_AuthenticatedInputs.CheckpointWriterConeJoin (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage)
      ChildJoin_Decoder.checkpointHeader H semantic pub proof split := by
  have both : ∀ saved, AdapterRw.first_decoded (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage)
      semantic pub proof split = ok (.Ok saved) →
      ChildJoin_Decoder.checkpointHeader (bytesOf saved.val) =
        some (H (bytesOf proof.val),H (bytesOf pub.val)) ∧ saved.val.length = 1768 := by
    intro saved accepted
    have entry := VTop_Entry.first_accepted adapter stage semantic pub proof split saved accepted
    obtain ⟨p,a,wrote⟩ := VTop_Cuts.writer_reached stage _ () semantic pub proof split none saved entry
    obtain ⟨before,after,success⟩ := source.writer p a proof pub saved wrote
    obtain ⟨pm,am,prov⟩ := provenance p a saved wrote
    exact ChildJoin_Checkpoint.writer_header _ () H oracle _ _ pm am prov proof pub
      (checkpointSlice saved) before after success
  exact ⟨fun saved accepted => (both saved accepted).1,fun saved accepted => (both saved accepted).2⟩

theorem reader_join (adapter : AdapterRw.Ops) (stage : Ops)
    (H : Bytes → State) (pub proof ck : Slice U8) (reserved : Bool)
    (source : CheckpointSourceJoin stage
      (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage)) () reserved)
    (oracle : CheckpointBytes5Inputs.Oracle
      (digest (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage))) () H) :
    S2W_AuthenticatedInputs.CheckpointReaderConeJoin (VTop_Entry.install adapter stage)
      ChildJoin_Decoder.checkpointHeader H pub proof ck := by
  constructor
  intro accepted
  obtain ⟨p,a,resumed⟩ := VTop_Cuts.resume_reached stage _ () pub proof ck none accepted
  exact ChildJoin_Checkpoint.reader_header reserved _ () H oracle ck proof pub p a
    (source.reader ck proof pub p a resumed)

#print axioms writer_join
#print axioms reader_join
end AspisR1.VTop_Checkpoint
end

import Std
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace KMX_CopyMeaning
/-- Value-level semantics for explicit indexed writes. Pointer validity,
non-overlap, lengths and allocation remain caller obligations. -/
def write {α : Type} (dst : Nat → α) (i : Nat) (v : α) : Nat → α :=
  fun k => if k = i then v else dst k

def loop {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (start : Nat) : Nat → Nat → α
  | 0 => dst
  | n+1 => loop src (write dst start (src start)) (start+1) n

theorem loop_spec {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (start count k : Nat) :
    loop src dst start count k =
      if start ≤ k ∧ k < start + count then src k else dst k := by
  induction count generalizing dst start with
  | zero =>
    have h : ¬ (start ≤ k ∧ k < start + 0) := by omega
    simp only [loop, if_neg h]
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [loop, ih]
    by_cases hk : k = start
    · subst k
      have hn : ¬ (start + 1 ≤ start ∧ start < start + 1 + n) := by omega
      have hy : start ≤ start ∧ start < start + (n + 1) := by omega
      simp [hn, hy, write]
    · by_cases h : start + 1 ≤ k ∧ k < start + 1 + n
      · have hy : start ≤ k ∧ k < start + (n + 1) := by omega
        simp [h, hy]
      · have hn : ¬ (start ≤ k ∧ k < start + (n + 1)) := by omega
        simp [h, hn, write, hk]

theorem copy_prefix {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (count k : Nat) :
    loop src dst 0 count k = if k < count then src k else dst k := by
  simpa using loop_spec src dst 0 count k

theorem copy_frame {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (start count k : Nat)
    (outside : k < start ∨ start + count ≤ k) :
    loop src dst start count k = dst k := by
  rw [loop_spec, if_neg]; omega

/-- Vector append value law. This says nothing about allocation failure,
capacity, pointer identity, or the allocator's reallocation implementation. -/
def appendLoop {α : Type} (dst : List α) : List α → List α
  | [] => dst
  | x::xs => appendLoop (dst ++ [x]) xs

theorem append_spec {α : Type} (dst src : List α) :
    appendLoop dst src = dst ++ src := by
  induction src generalizing dst with
  | nil => simp [appendLoop]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [appendLoop, ih, List.append_assoc]

/-- Successful reallocation preserves the overlapping byte prefix. Allocation
success, ownership and uninitialized-byte validity are external obligations. -/
theorem realloc_prefix {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (oldSize newSize k : Nat) :
    loop src dst 0 (min oldSize newSize) k =
      if k < min oldSize newSize then src k else dst k :=
  copy_prefix src dst (min oldSize newSize) k

#print axioms realloc_prefix
#print axioms loop_spec
#print axioms copy_prefix
#print axioms copy_frame
#print axioms append_spec
end KMX_CopyMeaning

import AspisR1TerminalDecoder.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBD_DigestInduction
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def Canonical (d : Array U32 8#usize) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 8, (d.val[j.val]'(by have := d.property; scalar_tac)).val < 2147483647

def Suffix (d : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 8, i ≤ j.val → (d.val[j.val]'(by have := d.property; scalar_tac)).val < 2147483647

/-- The two native digest scanners have identical emitted bodies, including rejection. -/
theorem same_scanner (d : Array U32 8#usize) :
    pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical d =
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical d := by
  unfold pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical
    pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop
    pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical_loop.body
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop.body
  rfl

/-- Full Boolean result, with no canonicality precondition. -/
theorem source (d : Array U32 8#usize) :
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical d = ok (decide (Canonical d)) := by
  have spec : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical d
      ⦃ b => b = decide (Canonical d) ⦄ := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical
      pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat (fun i : Usize => 8-i.val)
      (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ 8 ∧ (Canonical d ↔ Suffix d i.val))
      (fun b : Bool => b = decide (Canonical d))
      (fun i => pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop.body d i) 0#usize ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      rcases hi with ⟨bound,eqv⟩
      unfold pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical_loop.body
      step*
      all_goals try unfold aspis_core.field.P at *
      all_goals simp_all [Canonical, Suffix]
      all_goals first | scalar_tac | skip
      · refine ⟨⟨i.val, by scalar_tac⟩, Nat.le_refl _, ?_⟩
        assumption
      · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
        constructor
        · intro h j hj
          exact h j (by omega)
        · intro h j hj
          by_cases same : j.val = i.val
          · simpa only [same] using (show (d.val[i.val]'(by have := d.property; scalar_tac)).val < 2147483647 from by assumption)
          · exact h j (by omega)
    · constructor
      · scalar_tac
      · simp [Canonical, Suffix]
  obtain ⟨b,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

#print axioms same_scanner
#print axioms source
end NBD_DigestInduction

import NBD_DigestInduction
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBD_DigestTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open NBD_DigestInduction
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Native one-iteration relation: no precondition on the words. -/
inductive Trace (word : Nat → Nat) : Nat → Nat → Bool → Prop where
  | done (i : Nat) : Trace word i 0 true
  | reject (i n : Nat) (bad : 2147483647 ≤ word i) : Trace word i (n+1) false
  | advance (i n : Nat) (b : Bool) (good : word i < 2147483647)
      (rest : Trace word (i+1) n b) : Trace word i (n+1) b

theorem exact (word : Nat → Nat) (i n : Nat) (b : Bool) (trace : Trace word i n b) :
    b = true ↔ ∀ j, i ≤ j → j < i+n → word j < 2147483647 := by
  induction trace with
  | done i => simp; omega
  | reject i n bad =>
    constructor
    · intro h; cases h
    · intro h
      have := h i (by omega) (by omega)
      omega
  | advance i n b good rest ih =>
    constructor
    · intro hb j lo hi
      by_cases same : j = i
      · simpa [same] using good
      · exact ih.mp hb j (by omega) (by omega)
    · intro h
      apply ih.mpr
      intro j lo hi
      exact h j (by omega) (by omega)

theorem total (word : Nat → Nat) (i n : Nat) : ∃ b, Trace word i n b := by
  induction n generalizing i with
  | zero => exact ⟨true, .done i⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases good : word i < 2147483647
    · obtain ⟨b,rest⟩ := ih (i+1)
      exact ⟨b,.advance i n b good rest⟩
    · exact ⟨false,.reject i n (by omega)⟩

def word (d : Array U32 8#usize) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : i < 8 then (d.val[i]'(by have := d.property; scalar_tac)).val else 0

theorem word_eq (d : Array U32 8#usize) (j : Nat) (hj : j < 8) :
    word d j = (d.val[j]'(by have := d.property; scalar_tac)).val := by
  simp only [word, dif_pos hj]

/-- Native step induction associated with the actual emitted Result, including rejection. -/
theorem native_result (d : Array U32 8#usize) (b : Bool)
    (trace : Trace (word d) 0 8 b) :
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical d = ok b ∧
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical d = ok b := by
  have assoc : (∀ j, 0 ≤ j → j < 0+8 → word d j < 2147483647) ↔ Canonical d := by
    constructor
    · intro h j
      have := h j.val (by omega) j.isLt
      simpa only [word_eq d j.val j.isLt] using this
    · intro h j _ hj
      rw [word_eq d j hj]
      exact h ⟨j,hj⟩
  have same : b = decide (Canonical d) := by
    have h := (exact _ _ _ _ trace).trans assoc
    cases b <;> simp_all
  have first := NBD_DigestInduction.source d
  rw [←same] at first
  exact ⟨first,(same_scanner d).trans first⟩

theorem unique (w : Nat → Nat) (i n : Nat) (a b : Bool)
    (left : Trace w i n a) (right : Trace w i n b) : a = b := by
  have h := (exact w i n a left).trans (exact w i n b right).symm
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp_all

theorem construct (d : Array U32 8#usize) : ∃ b,
    Trace (word d) 0 8 b ∧
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical d = ok b ∧
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.digest_is_canonical d = ok b := by
  obtain ⟨b,trace⟩ := total (word d) 0 8
  exact ⟨b,trace,native_result d b trace⟩

#print axioms unique
#print axioms construct
#print axioms exact
#print axioms total
#print axioms word_eq
#print axioms native_result
end NBD_DigestTrace

  | .PrivateTransfer c _ => c
  | .Withdrawal c _ => c

  | .PrivateTransfer _ p => (p.pool,p.deployment_domain,p.anchor_sequence,p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,p.asset_id)
  | .Withdrawal _ p => (p.pool,p.deployment_domain,p.anchor_sequence,p.anchor_root,p.nullifier,p.asset_id)

  if b = 1#u8 then .Ok .PrivateTransfer
  else if b = 2#u8 then .Ok .Withdrawal
  else .Err .InvalidTransitionKind

/-- Arbitrary fields and both variants; no validation success is assumed. -/
theorem source_common (s : Statement) : s.common = ok (common s) := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem source_parts (s : Statement) : statement_public_common s = ok (parts s) := by
  cases s <;> rfl

theorem source_kind (b : U8) : transition_kind b = ok (kind b) := by
  have spec : transition_kind b ⦃ out => out = kind b ⦄ := by
    unfold transition_kind
    step*
    all_goals simp_all [kind]
    all_goals scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨out,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

    (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 = match s with
      | .PrivateTransfer _ p => p.nullifier
      | .Withdrawal _ p => p.nullifier := by
  cases s <;> rfl

canonicality or valid-statement precondition is required. -/

    pool_v1.payment_relation.transfer_common p = ok
      ({pool := p.pool, deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain,
        anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence, anchor_root := p.anchor_root,
        nullifier := p.nullifier, asset_id := p.asset_id} :

    pool_v1.payment_relation.withdrawal_common p = ok

        nullifier := p.nullifier, asset_id := p.asset_id} :

canonical-input assumption. The eight checks keep source short-circuit order. -/
theorem digest_canonical (a b c d e f g h : U32) :

      (Array.make 8#usize [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]) =
    ok (if a < 2147483647#u32 then
      if b < 2147483647#u32 then
        if c < 2147483647#u32 then
          if d < 2147483647#u32 then
            if e < 2147483647#u32 then
              if f < 2147483647#u32 then
                if g < 2147483647#u32 then
                  if h < 2147483647#u32 then true else false
                else false
              else false
            else false
          else false
        else false
      else false
    else false) := by
  simp [pool_v1.payment_relation.digest_is_canonical, Array.index_usize,
    Array.make, aspis_core.field.P]
  repeat' split

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev K := pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind

def tag : K → U8 | .PrivateTransfer => 1#u8 | .Withdrawal => 2#u8

theorem tag_result (kind : K) :
    UScalar.cast .U8 (read_discriminant kind : U8) = tag kind := by
  cases kind <;> rfl

theorem slice_equal (a b : Slice U8) (width : a.val.length = b.val.length) :
    core.slice.cmp.PartialEqSlice.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 a b =
      ok (decide (a.val = b.val)) := by

  rw [if_pos width]

  else if bytes.val[4]! ≠ 1#u8 then .Err .WrongVersion
  else if bytes.val[5]! ≠ tag kind then .Err .WrongTransitionKind
  else if bytes.val[6]! ≠ 1#u8 then .Err .WrongDigestEncoding

    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.Slice.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqSlice,slice_equal,

    pool_v1.payment_relation.POOL_V1_PAYMENT_STATEMENT_VERSION,
    pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION,expected]

  all_goals simp_all

import NBG_Atomic
import NBG_Utilities
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBG_PaymentChecks
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
abbrev C := pool_v1.payment_relation.CommonPublicV1
abbrev E := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError

def canonical (d : Array U32 8#usize) : Bool :=
  d.val.all (fun x => decide (x.val < 2147483647))

theorem canonical_result (d : Array U32 8#usize) :
    pool_v1.payment_relation.digest_is_canonical d = ok (canonical d) := by
  obtain ⟨a,b,c,e,f,g,h,i,same⟩ := NBG_Utilities.shape d
  subst d
  unfold NBG_Utilities.pack
  rw [NBG_Atomic.digest_canonical]
  simp [canonical,NBG_Utilities.pack,Array.make]

def zero (a : Array U8 32#usize) : Bool := decide (a.val = List.replicate 32 0#u8)

theorem zero_result (a : Array U8 32#usize) :
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 a
      (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) = ok (zero a) := by
  unfold core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq
  rw [if_pos (a.property.trans (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8).property.symm)]
  rw [NBG_Utilities.lists a.val (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8).val
    (a.property.trans (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8).property.symm)]
  rfl

theorem capacity_result : pool_v1.incremental_merkle.POOL_V1_LEAF_CAPACITY =
    ok 1048576#u64 := by
  unfold pool_v1.incremental_merkle.POOL_V1_LEAF_CAPACITY pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
  rfl

def common (c : C) : core.result.Result Unit E :=
  if zero c.pool || zero c.deployment_domain then .Err .ZeroRequiredBinding
  else if c.anchor_sequence.val > 1048576 then .Err .InvalidAnchorSequence
  else if !canonical c.anchor_root || !canonical c.nullifier then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
  else if c.asset_id.val >= 2147483647 then .Err .NonCanonicalAssetId
  else .Ok ()

theorem common_result (c : C) :
    pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_common c = ok (common c) := by
  simp [pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_common,zero_result,capacity_result,
    canonical_result,common,aspis_core.field.P]
  repeat' split
  all_goals simp_all

#print axioms canonical_result
#print axioms zero_result
#print axioms capacity_result
#print axioms common_result
end NBG_PaymentChecks

import NBG_PaymentChecks
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBG_PaymentValidators
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open NBG_PaymentChecks
abbrev T := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev W := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1

def tc (p : T) : C :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id }
def wc (p : W) : C :=
  { pool := p.pool
    deployment_domain := p.deployment_domain
    anchor_sequence := p.anchor_sequence
    anchor_root := p.anchor_root
    nullifier := p.nullifier
    asset_id := p.asset_id }

def transfer (p : T) : core.result.Result Unit E :=
  match common (tc p) with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () => if !canonical p.recipient_commitment || !canonical p.change_commitment
      then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest else .Ok ()

theorem transfer_result (p : T) :
    pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1 p =
      ok (transfer p) := by
  have projected : pool_v1.payment_relation.transfer_common p = ok (tc p) :=
    NBG_Atomic.transfer_projection p
  unfold pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1
  rw [projected,bind_tc_ok,common_result,bind_tc_ok]
  cases h : common (tc p) with
  | Err e => simp [transfer,h,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame]
  | Ok value => cases value; simp [transfer,h,canonical_result,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
                repeat' split
                all_goals simp_all

theorem value_limit : spend.VALUE_LIMIT = ok 1073741824#u32 := by
  unfold spend.VALUE_LIMIT
  rfl

def withdrawal (p : W) : core.result.Result Unit E :=
  match common (wc p) with
  | .Err e => .Err e
  | .Ok () => if p.amount.val = 0 ∨ p.amount.val >= 1073741824
      then .Err .InvalidWithdrawalAmount
      else if zero p.destination_token_account then .Err .InvalidDestination
      else if !canonical p.change_commitment then .Err .NonCanonicalDigest
      else .Ok ()

theorem withdrawal_result (p : W) :
    pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1 p =
      ok (withdrawal p) := by
  have projected : pool_v1.payment_relation.withdrawal_common p = ok (wc p) :=
    NBG_Atomic.withdrawal_projection p
  unfold pool_v1.payment_relation.validate_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1
  rw [projected,bind_tc_ok,common_result,bind_tc_ok]
  cases h : common (wc p) with
  | Err e => simp [withdrawal,h,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame]
  | Ok value => cases value; simp [withdrawal,h,canonical_result,zero_result,value_limit,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
                repeat' split
                all_goals simp_all <;> scalar_tac

#print axioms transfer_result
#print axioms value_limit
#print axioms withdrawal_result
end NBG_PaymentValidators

import NBD_Audit
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBH_Frontier
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open NBD_DigestInduction
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Frontier := Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize

def CanonicalFrom (a : Frontier) (i : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ j : Fin 20, i ≤ j.val → Canonical (a.val[j.val]'(by have := a.property; scalar_tac))

theorem afterstate_loop (a : Frontier) :
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop a 0#usize =
    ok (if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalAfterstate) := by
  have spec : pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop a 0#usize
      ⦃ r => r = if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalAfterstate ⦄ := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat (fun i : Usize => 20-i.val)
      (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ 20 ∧ (CanonicalFrom a 0 ↔ CanonicalFrom a i.val))
      (fun r => r = if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalAfterstate)
      (fun i => pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop.body a i) 0#usize ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      rcases hi with ⟨bound,eqv⟩
      unfold pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop.body
      simp only [NBD_DigestInduction.source]
      step*
      all_goals simp_all [CanonicalFrom]
      all_goals first | scalar_tac | skip
      · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
        constructor
        · intro h j hj; exact h j (by omega)
        · intro h j hj
          by_cases same : j.val = i.val
          · simpa only [same] using (show Canonical (a.val[i.val]'(by have := a.property; scalar_tac)) from by assumption)
          · exact h j (by omega)
      · refine ⟨⟨i.val, by scalar_tac⟩, Nat.le_refl _, ?_⟩
        assumption
    · exact ⟨by scalar_tac, Iff.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

#print axioms afterstate_loop
end NBH_Frontier

import NBH_NativeFrontier
import NBH_NativeLiveFrontier
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBH_FrontierTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open NBH_Frontier NBD_DigestInduction
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def word (a : Frontier) (i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : i<20 then if Canonical (a.val[i]'(by have := a.property; scalar_tac)) then 0 else 2147483647 else 0

theorem good (a : Frontier) (i : Nat) (hi : i<20) :
    word a i < 2147483647 ↔ Canonical (a.val[i]'(by have := a.property; scalar_tac)) := by
  simp only [word,dif_pos hi]
  split <;> simp_all

theorem result (a : Frontier) (b : Bool) (trace : NBD_DigestTrace.Trace (word a) 0 20 b) :
    (b=true ↔ CanonicalFrom a 0) := by
  have exact := NBD_DigestTrace.exact _ _ _ _ trace
  rw [exact]
  constructor
  · intro h j _
    exact (good a j.val j.isLt).mp (h j.val (by omega) j.isLt)
  · intro h j _ hj
    exact (good a j hj).mpr (h ⟨j,hj⟩ (by omega))

theorem afterstate (a : Frontier) (b : Bool) (trace : NBD_DigestTrace.Trace (word a) 0 20 b) :
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop a 0#usize =
    ok (if b then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalAfterstate) := by
  rw [NBH_Frontier.afterstate_loop]
  have same := result a b trace
  cases b <;> simp_all

theorem live (a : Frontier) (b : Bool) (trace : NBD_DigestTrace.Trace (word a) 0 20 b) :
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop a 0#usize =
    ok (if b then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalDigest) := by
  rw [NBH_LiveFrontier.live_loop]
  have same := result a b trace
  cases b <;> simp_all

theorem total (a : Frontier) : ∃ b, NBD_DigestTrace.Trace (word a) 0 20 b :=
  NBD_DigestTrace.total _ _ _

#print axioms good
#print axioms result
#print axioms afterstate
#print axioms live
#print axioms total
end NBH_FrontierTrace
