import NBH_Audit
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace NBK_Fill

theorem loop (xs acc : List U8) (v : U8) :
    List.mapM.loop (fun _ : U8 => ok v) xs acc =
      ok (acc.reverse ++ List.replicate xs.length v) := by
  induction xs generalizing acc with
  | nil => simp [List.mapM.loop,pure]
  | cons x xs ih => simp [List.mapM.loop,ih,pure,List.reverse_cons,List.replicate_succ,List.append_assoc]

theorem constant (xs : List U8) (v : U8) :
    List.mapM (fun _ => ok v) xs = ok (List.replicate xs.length v) := by
  simpa only [List.mapM,List.reverse_nil,List.nil_append] using loop xs [] v

def value (s : Slice U8) (v : U8) : Slice U8 :=
  ⟨List.replicate s.length v, by simpa only [List.length_replicate,Slice.length] using s.property⟩

theorem source (s : Slice U8) (v : U8) :
    core.slice.Slice.fill core.clone.CloneU8 s v = ok (value s v) := by
  unfold core.slice.Slice.fill
  simp only [core.clone.CloneU8,liftFun1,core.clone.impls.CloneU8.clone,lift]
  split
  next out hm =>
    have fact := constant s.val v
    rw [hm] at fact
    have same := Result.ok.inj fact
    subst out
    rfl
  next e hm =>
    have fact := constant s.val v
    rw [hm] at fact
    cases fact
  next hm =>
    have fact := constant s.val v
    rw [hm] at fact
    cases fact

#print axioms loop
#print axioms constant
#print axioms source
end NBK_Fill

theorem afterstate (a : NBH_Validators.Afterstate)
    (valid : NBH_Validators.afterResult a = .Ok ()) :
    0 < a.next_pair_index.val ∧ a.next_pair_index.val ≤ 1048576 ∧
    Canonical a.next_root ∧ CanonicalFrom a.next_frontier 0 := by
  unfold NBH_Validators.afterResult at valid
  split at valid
  · cases valid
  · rename_i index
    split at valid
    · rename_i digest
      exact ⟨by omega,by omega,digest⟩
    · cases valid

theorem live (s : NBH_LiveValidator.Snapshot)
    (valid : NBH_LiveValidator.result s = .Ok ()) :
    s.pool ≠ Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 ∧
    s.deployment_domain ≠ Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 ∧
    s.sequence = s.next_pair_index ∧ s.next_pair_index.val < 1048576 ∧
    Canonical s.current_root ∧ CanonicalFrom s.frontier 0 := by
  unfold NBH_LiveValidator.result at valid
  split at valid
  · cases valid
  · rename_i bindings
    split at valid
    · cases valid
    · rename_i sequence
      split at valid
      · cases valid
      · rename_i capacity
        split at valid
        · rename_i digests
          exact ⟨fun h => bindings (Or.inl h),fun h => bindings (Or.inr h),
            not_not.mp sequence,by omega,digests⟩
        · cases valid

theorem after_row (a : NBH_Validators.Afterstate)
    (valid : NBH_Validators.afterResult a = .Ok ()) (j : Fin 20) :
    Canonical (a.next_frontier.val[j.val]'(by have := a.next_frontier.property; scalar_tac)) :=
  (afterstate a valid).2.2.2 j (by omega)

theorem live_row (s : NBH_LiveValidator.Snapshot)
    (valid : NBH_LiveValidator.result s = .Ok ()) (j : Fin 20) :
    Canonical (s.frontier.val[j.val]'(by have := s.frontier.property; scalar_tac)) :=
  (live s valid).2.2.2.2.2 j (by omega)

#print axioms afterstate
#print axioms live
#print axioms after_row
#print axioms live_row
end NBN_ValidatorDomains

def chunk {N W : Usize} (bytes : Array U8 N) (start : Nat)
    (bound : start+W.val ≤ N.val) : Array U8 W :=
  ⟨(bytes.val.drop start).take W.val, by
    simp only [List.length_take,List.length_drop,bytes.property]
    omega⟩

theorem copy {N W : Usize} (bytes : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    (do
      let s ← core.array.Array.index
        (core.ops.index.IndexSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
        bytes {start,«end»:=stop}
      let r ← core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from W core.marker.CopyU8 s
      atomic_statement.unwrap_fixed_slice (Array.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy W core.marker.CopyU8) r) =
      ok (chunk bytes start.val (by omega)) := by
  have room : W.val ≤ N.val-start.val := by omega
  simp [room,core.array.Array.index,core.ops.index.IndexSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index,Array.to_slice,
    Slice.length,Slice.len,order,bound,bytes.property,
    core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from,NBG_Atomic.unwrap_ok,
    List.slice,List.length_take,List.length_drop,width,chunk]
#print axioms copy
end NBP_Read

import NBP_Store
import NEJ_CommonFrame
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEJ_ArrayFrame
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem list_frame {α : Type} (dst src : List α) (start k : Nat)
    (fits : start + src.length ≤ dst.length)
    (outside : k < start ∨ start + src.length ≤ k) :
    (dst.setSlice! start src)[k]? = dst[k]? := by
  have hs : start ≤ dst.length := by omega
  have hroom : min src.length (dst.length-start) = src.length := Nat.min_eq_left (by omega)
  simp only [List.setSlice!, hroom, List.take_length]
  rw [List.append_assoc]
  have hlen : (dst.take start).length = start := by
    exact (List.length_take).trans (Nat.min_eq_left hs)
  rcases outside with before | after
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_left (by rw [hlen]; exact before)]
    exact List.getElem?_take_of_lt before
  · rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
    rw [List.getElem?_append_right (by rw [hlen]; omega)]
    rw [List.getElem?_drop, hlen]
    congr 1
    omega

/-- Concrete emitted back-write frame, independent of the allocation's values. -/
theorem array_frame {N : Usize} (dst : Array U8 N) (src : List U8) (start k : Nat)
    (fits : start + src.length ≤ N.val)
    (outside : k < start ∨ start + src.length ≤ k) :
    (dst.setSlice! start src).val[k]? = dst.val[k]? := by
  change (dst.val.setSlice! start src)[k]? = dst.val[k]?
  exact list_frame dst.val src start k (by simpa only [dst.property] using fits) outside

#print axioms list_frame
#print axioms array_frame
end NEJ_ArrayFrame

import KMX_CopyMeaning
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEJ_CommonFrame
open KMX_CopyMeaning

/-- Source-order write windows of frozen payment_relation::encode_common.
Digest computations precede their respective copy windows and are separate
child obligations. This describes byte writes only. -/
def windows : List (Nat × Nat) :=
  [(0,4),(4,1),(5,1),(6,1),(8,32),(40,32),(72,8),(80,32),(112,32),(144,4)]

def touched (ws : List (Nat × Nat)) (k : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ w ∈ ws, w.1 ≤ k ∧ k < w.1 + w.2

instance (ws : List (Nat × Nat)) (k : Nat) : Decidable (touched ws k) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (∃ w ∈ ws, w.1 ≤ k ∧ k < w.1 + w.2))

def run {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) : List (Nat × Nat) → Nat → α
  | [] => dst
  | w :: ws => run src (loop src dst w.1 w.2) ws

/-- Arbitrary indexed prestate; no whole-buffer reduction or native unwinding. -/
theorem run_spec {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (ws : List (Nat × Nat)) (k : Nat) :
    run src dst ws k = if touched ws k then src k else dst k := by
  induction ws generalizing dst with
  | nil => simp [run, touched]
  | cons w ws ih =>
    rw [run, ih, loop_spec]
    by_cases ht : touched ws k
    · have h : touched (w :: ws) k := by
        obtain ⟨v,hv,h⟩ := ht
        exact ⟨v,List.mem_cons_of_mem w hv,h⟩
      simp [ht,h]
    · by_cases hw : w.1 ≤ k ∧ k < w.1 + w.2
      · have h : touched (w :: ws) k := ⟨w,List.mem_cons_self,hw⟩
        simp [ht,hw,h]
      · have h : ¬ touched (w :: ws) k := by
          rintro ⟨v,hv,hv'⟩
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hv with heq | hm
          · subst v; exact hw hv'
          · exact ht ⟨v,hm,hv'⟩
        simp [ht,hw,h]

/-- Exact union of the ten frozen write ranges, including reserved-byte gaps. -/
theorem touched_windows (k : Nat) :
    touched windows k ↔ k < 7 ∨ (8 ≤ k ∧ k < 148) := by
  simp only [touched, windows, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨w,hw,hr⟩
    rcases hw with h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h | h
    all_goals subst w; dsimp at hr; omega
  · intro h
    rcases h with h | h
    · by_cases h0 : k < 4
      · exact ⟨(0,4),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
      · by_cases h4 : k = 4
        · exact ⟨(4,1),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
        · by_cases h5 : k = 5
          · exact ⟨(5,1),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
          · exact ⟨(6,1),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
    · by_cases h40 : k < 40
      · exact ⟨(8,32),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
      · by_cases h72 : k < 72
        · exact ⟨(40,32),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
        · by_cases h80 : k < 80
          · exact ⟨(72,8),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
          · by_cases h112 : k < 112
            · exact ⟨(80,32),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
            · by_cases h144 : k < 144
              · exact ⟨(112,32),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩
              · exact ⟨(144,4),by simp,by dsimp; omega⟩

theorem common_bytes {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (k : Nat) :
    run src dst windows k =
      if k < 7 ∨ (8 ≤ k ∧ k < 148) then src k else dst k := by
  simp only [run_spec, touched_windows]

/-- Byte 7 and the entire suffix from 148 survive arbitrary child reply bytes. -/
theorem reserved_frame {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (k : Nat)
    (outside : k = 7 ∨ 148 ≤ k) : run src dst windows k = dst k := by
  rw [common_bytes, if_neg]
  omega

/-- Distinct windows can be joined without assuming their initial bytes zero. -/
theorem window_disjoint {α : Type} (src dst : Nat → α) (a n b m k : Nat)
    (inside : b ≤ k ∧ k < b + m) (disjoint : a+n ≤ b ∨ b+m ≤ a) :
    loop src dst a n k = dst k := by
  apply copy_frame
  omega

#print axioms run_spec
#print axioms touched_windows
#print axioms common_bytes
#print axioms reserved_frame
#print axioms window_disjoint
end NEJ_CommonFrame

theorem ok_result_state_effects {T State : Type} (copy : core.marker.Copy T)
    (value : T) (state : State) :
    (atomic_statement.unwrap_fixed_slice copy (.Ok value),state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (ok value,state,[]) :=
  congrArg (fun x => (x,state,([] : List Unit))) (NBG_Atomic.unwrap_ok copy value)

theorem err_result_state_effects {T State : Type} (copy : core.marker.Copy T)
    (error : core.array.TryFromSliceError) (state : State) :
    (atomic_statement.unwrap_fixed_slice copy (.Err error),state,([] : List Unit)) =
      (fail .panic,state,[]) :=
  congrArg (fun x => (x,state,([] : List Unit))) (NBG_Atomic.unwrap_err copy error)

/-- Actual fixed-width callers derive Ok conversion from geometry, not success. -/
theorem fixed_read_packet {N W : Usize} (bytes : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    (do
      let s ← core.array.Array.index
        (core.ops.index.IndexSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
        bytes {start,«end»:=stop}
      let r ← core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from W core.marker.CopyU8 s
      atomic_statement.unwrap_fixed_slice (Array.Insts.CoreMarkerCopy W core.marker.CopyU8) r) =
      ok (NBP_Read.chunk bytes start.val (by omega)) :=
  NBP_Read.copy bytes start stop order bound width

end NEQ_UnwrapDomains

import AspisR1TerminalDecoder.Funs
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEX_TerminalOracle
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1TerminalDecoder
def run (common : Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)) (transfer : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 → Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)) (withdrawal : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1 → Slice U8 → Result (core.result.Result pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)) (validate : pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 → Result (core.result.Result Unit pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)) (bytes : Slice Std.U8) : Result (core.result.Result pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1) := do
  let i := Slice.len bytes
  let i1 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_BYTES
  if i != i1
  then ok (core.result.Result.Err pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongLength)
  else
    let s ← core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes { «end» := 4#usize }
    let s1 ← core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)) pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_MAGIC { start := 0#usize, «end» := 4#usize }
    let b ← core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default (Slice.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqSlice core.cmp.PartialEqU8) s s1
    if b
    then ok (core.result.Result.Err pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongMagic)
    else
      let i2 ← Slice.index_usize bytes 4#usize
      if i2 != pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_VERSION
      then ok (core.result.Result.Err pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongVersion)
      else
        let i3 ← Slice.index_usize bytes 5#usize
        let r ← pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.transition_kind i3
        let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
        match cf with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
          let i4 ← Slice.index_usize bytes 6#usize
          if i4 != pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_DIGEST_ENCODING_VERSION
          then ok (core.result.Result.Err pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.WrongDigestEncoding)
          else
            let r1 ← common bytes
            let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
            match cf1 with
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
              match val with
              | pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind.PrivateTransfer =>
                let i5 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PAYMENT_STATEMENT_OFFSET
                let s2 ← core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes { start := i5 }
                let r2 ← transfer val1 s2
                let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
                match cf2 with
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 => let r3 ← validate val2
                                                                     let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
                                                                     match cf3 with
                                                                     | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ => ok (core.result.Result.Ok val2)
                                                                     | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1) residual
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1) residual
              | pool_v1.historical_anchor.PoolV1TransitionKind.Withdrawal =>
                let i5 ← pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PAYMENT_STATEMENT_OFFSET
                let s2 ← core.slice.index.Slice.index (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) bytes { start := i5 }
                let r2 ← withdrawal val1 s2
                let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
                match cf2 with
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 => let r3 ← validate val2
                                                                     let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
                                                                     match cf3 with
                                                                     | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ => ok (core.result.Result.Ok val2)
                                                                     | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1) residual
                | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1) residual
            | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1) residual
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1) residual

/-- Model continuation substitution only. Native certificates and reached
child domains are separate checked obligations; no native root is assumed. -/
theorem result_state_effects {State : Type} (bytes : Slice U8) (state : State) :
    (run pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_terminal_common_boxed_v1 pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_transfer_statement_boxed_v1 pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_withdrawal_statement_boxed_v1 pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes,state,([] : List Unit)) =
    (pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes,state,[]) := by rfl
#print axioms result_state_effects
end NEX_TerminalOracle

import NBA_Installed
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.NBA_Transcript
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation
abbrev Bytes32 := Array U8 32#usize

def absorbParts (state : Bytes32) (tag : U8) (payload : Slice U8) : Slice (Slice U8) :=
  Array.to_slice (Array.make 4#usize [Array.to_slice state,
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [0#u8,tag]),
    Array.to_slice (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes (UScalar.cast .U32 (Slice.len payload))),payload])

def readParts (state : Bytes32) (tag : U8) : Slice (Slice U8) :=
  Array.to_slice (Array.make 2#usize [Array.to_slice state,
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [tag])])

theorem absorb {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (before : transcript.Transcript H)
    (row tag : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (state : Bytes32)
    (htag : (160#u8+row : Result U8)=ok tag)
    (call : D.digest before.hash (absorbParts before.state tag payload)=ok state) :
    transcript.Transcript.absorb D before row payload=ok {before with state:=state} := by
  unfold transcript.Transcript.absorb
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok,htag,absorbParts] at call ⊢
  rw [call,bind_tc_ok]

theorem block {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (before : transcript.Transcript H)
    (row tag : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (absorbed value final : Bytes32)
    (htag : (160#u8+row : Result U8)=ok tag)
    (first : D.digest before.hash (absorbParts before.state tag payload)=ok absorbed)
    (second : D.digest before.hash (readParts absorbed 1#u8)=ok value)
    (third : D.digest before.hash (readParts absorbed 2#u8)=ok final) :
    transcript.Transcript.block D before row payload=ok (value,{before with state:=final}) := by
  have start := absorb D before row tag payload absorbed htag first
  unfold transcript.Transcript.block
  rw [start,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok,readParts] at second third ⊢
  rw [second,bind_tc_ok,third,bind_tc_ok]

def domain : Array U8 29#usize := Array.make 29#usize [
    85#u8,78#u8,80#u8,82#u8,79#u8,86#u8,69#u8,68#u8,58#u8,82#u8,
    49#u8,58#u8,80#u8,82#u8,73#u8,86#u8,65#u8,84#u8,69#u8,45#u8,
    83#u8,65#u8,76#u8,84#u8,69#u8,68#u8,58#u8,80#u8,51#u8]

def seedParts (state : Bytes32) : Slice (Slice U8) := Array.to_slice
  (Array.make 3#usize [Array.to_slice domain,
    Array.to_slice (Array.make 1#usize [2#u8]),Array.to_slice state])

theorem seed {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (hash : H) (state reply : Bytes32)
    (call : D.digest hash (seedParts state)=ok reply) :
    transcript.Transcript.new D hash state .S2=ok (⟨reply,hash⟩ : transcript.Transcript H) := by
  unfold transcript.Transcript.new
  simp only [transport.Variant.tag,lift,bind_tc_ok,seedParts,domain] at call ⊢
  rw [call,bind_tc_ok]

import GammaCandidateDecodedFieldRank
import IndexedCandidateOuterByteOutputSuccessV5

set_option autoImplicit false

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP

namespace AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel

open AspisR1
open AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds
open AspisR1.SamplerNatModel
open AspisR1.SamplerAddDigits
open AspisR1.SamplerAddBridge
open AspisR1.SourceSamplerByteRank
open AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedOutputSuccessV5
open AspisR1.ExtractedIndexedAddSmallWrapperNatModelV1
open AspisR1.ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1
open AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedDecode8RetainedBridgeV3
open AspisR1Post25Sampler

private abbrev Pn : Nat := AspisR1.SamplerMachineBounds.P
private def gammaOfDecoded (v : AspisR1Post25Sampler.field.WideExact) : GammaWide :=
  ⟨⟨⟨v.c0.c0.a, v.c0.c0.b⟩, ⟨v.c0.c1.a, v.c0.c1.b⟩⟩,
    ⟨⟨v.c1.c0.a, v.c1.c0.b⟩, ⟨v.c1.c1.a, v.c1.c1.b⟩⟩⟩

private def digitAt (digits : Digits) (i : Fin 8) : U32 :=
  digits.val[i.val]'(by
    have hd := digits.property
    change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hd
    have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
    omega)

private theorem canonical_fin (digits : Digits) (hcanonical : Canonical digits) :
    ∀ i : Fin 8, (digitAt digits i).val < Pn := by
  intro i
  have hmem : (digitAt digits i).val ∈ values digits := by
    unfold digitAt values
    rw [List.mem_map]
    exact ⟨digits.val[i.val]'(by
      have hd := digits.property
      change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hd
      have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
      omega), List.getElem_mem _, rfl⟩
  exact hcanonical _ hmem

private theorem candidate_decode_total (digits : Digits)
    (hcanonical : Canonical digits) :
    ∃ out : GammaWide, candidateGammaHelpers.decode digits = .ok out := by
  have hcanonicalFin := canonical_fin digits hcanonical
  obtain ⟨decoded, hdecoded, _⟩ := decode8_candidate_eq_retained digits hcanonicalFin
  refine ⟨gammaOfDecoded decoded, ?_⟩
  change (do
      let value ← AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.decode8 digits
      .ok (gammaOfDecoded value)) = .ok (gammaOfDecoded decoded)
  rw [hdecoded]
  rfl

private theorem increment_success (q : U32) (hq : q.val ≤ 256) :
    ∃ n : U32, (q + 1#u32 : Result U32) = .ok n ∧ n.val = q.val + 1 := by
  have hs : (q + 1#u32 : Result U32) ⦃z => z.val = q.val + 1⦄ := by
    apply UScalar.add_spec
    change q.val + 1 ≤ UScalar.max UScalarTy.U32
    have hc : 257 ≤ UScalar.max UScalarTy.U32 := by
      rw [UScalar.max_UScalarTy_U32_eq]
      norm_num [U32.max, U32.numBits]
    omega
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists hs
  exact ⟨n, hn, hval⟩

private theorem pair_bind_success_intro {α β γ : Type} (m : Result (α × β))
    (a : α) (b : β) (hm : m = .ok (a,b)) (k : α → β → Result γ)
    (out : γ) (hk : k a b = .ok out) :
    (do let (x,y) ← m; k x y) = .ok out := by
  rw [hm]
  exact hk

private theorem pair_let {α β γ : Type} (a : α) (b : β)
    (k : α → β → γ) :
    (let (x,y) := (a,b); k x y) = k a b := by
  rfl

private theorem bind_pair_ok {α β γ : Type} (a : α) (b : β)
    (k : α → β → Result γ) :
    (do let (x,y) ← (Result.ok (a,b) : Result (α × β)); k x y) = k a b := by
  rfl

private theorem values_length_eight (digits : Digits) : (values digits).length = 8 := by
  simp only [values, List.length_map]
  have hd := digits.property
  change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hd
  have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
  omega

private theorem canonical_for_indexed (digits : Digits) (hcanonical : Canonical digits) :
    AspisR1.ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1.Canonical digits := by
  intro j hj
  have hlen : j < digits.val.length := by
    have hd := digits.property
    change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hd
    have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
    omega
  have hmem : (digits.val[j]'hlen).val ∈ values digits := by
    rw [values]
    exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨digits.val[j]'hlen, List.getElem_mem hlen, rfl⟩
  have h := hcanonical _ hmem
  change (digits.val[j]'(by
    have hd := digits.property
    change digits.val.length = (8#usize).val at hd
    have h8 : (8#usize).val = 8 := by decide
    omega)).val < Pn at h
  exact h

private theorem second_carry_zero
    (block : Bytes32) (digits : Digits) (q n carry1 : U32)
    (hvalues : values digits = ordinaryDigits (rank block))
    (hq : q.val = rank block / Pn^8)
    (hn : n.val = q.val + 1)
    (hcarry1 : carry1.val = (addDigits Pn n.val (values digits)).2)
    (hcarry1pos : 0 < carry1.val) :
    (addDigits Pn 1 (addDigits Pn n.val (values digits)).1).2 = 0 := by
  have hlen : (values digits).length = 8 := values_length_eight digits
  have hfirst := addDigits_mod_div (p := Pn) P_pos n.val (values digits)
  rw [hlen] at hfirst
  have hr : digitsValue Pn (values digits) = rank block % Pn^8 := by
    rw [hvalues, ordinaryDigits_value]
  have hNpos : 0 < Pn^8 := by
    have hN : 2 ≤ Pn^8 := by simpa [Pn] using two_le_P8
    omega
  have hrlt : rank block % Pn^8 < Pn^8 := Nat.mod_lt _ hNpos
  have hqsmall : q.val < Pn^8 - 1 := by
    rw [hq]
    exact rank_div_P8_lt_P8_sub_one (rank_lt block)
  have hsumlt : rank block % Pn^8 + q.val + 1 < 2 * Pn^8 := by
    omega
  have hfirstcarry : (addDigits Pn n.val (values digits)).2 > 0 := by
    rw [← hcarry1]
    exact hcarry1pos
  have hdivpos :
      0 < (rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) / Pn^8 := by
    have hf := hfirstcarry
    rw [hfirst.2, hr, hn] at hf
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hf
  have hge : Pn^8 ≤ rank block % Pn^8 + q.val + 1 := by
    have hone : 1 ≤ (rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) / Pn^8 := by omega
    have hprod : Pn^8 ≤ Pn^8 *
        ((rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) / Pn^8) :=
      by simpa using Nat.mul_le_mul_left (Pn^8) hone
    have hdecomp :
        (rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) % Pn^8 +
          Pn^8 * ((rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) / Pn^8) =
        rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1) := by
      exact Nat.mod_add_div _ _
    have hle : Pn^8 *
        ((rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) / Pn^8) ≤
        (rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) % Pn^8 +
          Pn^8 * ((rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) / Pn^8) := by
      exact Nat.le_add_left
        (Pn^8 * ((rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) / Pn^8))
        ((rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) % Pn^8)
    have hge' : Pn^8 ≤ rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1) :=
      le_trans hprod (le_trans hle (by rw [hdecomp]))
    omega
  have hrem : (rank block % Pn^8 + q.val + 1) % Pn^8 =
      rank block % Pn^8 + q.val + 1 - Pn^8 := by
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hge]
    exact Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
  have hlast : rank block % Pn^8 + q.val + 1 - Pn^8 + 1 < Pn^8 :=
    AspisR1.SamplerCarry.wrapped_result_lt (by simpa [Pn] using two_le_P8)
      hqsmall hrlt hge
  have hsecond := addDigits_mod_div (p := Pn) P_pos 1
    (addDigits Pn n.val (values digits)).1
  rw [addDigits_length, hlen] at hsecond
  have hrem' :
      (rank block % Pn^8 + (q.val + 1)) % Pn^8 =
        rank block % Pn^8 + q.val + 1 - Pn^8 := by
    simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hrem
  have hsecondCarry := hsecond.2
  rw [hfirst.1, hr, hn, hrem'] at hsecondCarry
  rw [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hlast] at hsecondCarry
  simpa [hn] using hsecondCarry

theorem candidate_gamma_total (block : Bytes32) :
    ∃ out : GammaWide,
      AspisR1GammaCaller.sampler.gamma_sample candidateGammaHelpers block = .ok out := by
  obtain ⟨_, lowDigits, q, hlow, _, _, _⟩ := low_base_p_digits_success block
  have hlowModel := low_candidate_refines block lowDigits q hlow
  have hq : q.val = rank block / Pn^8 := hlowModel.2
  have hq256 : q.val ≤ 256 := by
    rw [hq]
    exact rank_div_P8_le_256 (rank_lt block)
  obtain ⟨n, hn, hnval⟩ := increment_success q hq256
  have hcanonical : Canonical lowDigits := by
    unfold Canonical
    rw [hlowModel.1]
    exact lowDigits_canonical P_pos 8 (rank block)
  have hnBound : n.val ≤ 257 := by omega
  have hcanonicalIndexed := canonical_for_indexed lowDigits hcanonical
  obtain ⟨carry1, digits1, hadd1, hvalues1, hcarry1⟩ :=
    add_small_base_p_refines_addDigits lowDigits n hcanonicalIndexed hnBound
  have hvalues1' : values digits1 =
      (addDigits Pn n.val (values lowDigits)).1 := by
    change ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1.values digits1 =
      (addDigits Pn n.val (ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1.values lowDigits)).1
    exact hvalues1
  have hcarry1' : carry1.val =
      (addDigits Pn n.val (values lowDigits)).2 := by
    change carry1.val =
      (addDigits Pn n.val (ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1.values lowDigits)).2
    exact hcarry1
  have hcanonical1 : Canonical digits1 := by
    unfold Canonical
    rw [hvalues1']
    exact addDigits_output_digits_lt Pn n.val (values lowDigits) P_pos
  by_cases hzero : carry1 = 0#u32
  · have hbool : (carry1 != 0#u32) = false := by simp [hzero]
    obtain ⟨out, hdecode⟩ := candidate_decode_total digits1 hcanonical1
    have hlow' : candidateGammaHelpers.low block = .ok (lowDigits, q) := by
      change AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block = .ok (lowDigits, q)
      exact hlow
    have hadd1' : candidateGammaHelpers.add lowDigits n =
        .ok (carry1 != 0#u32, digits1) := by
      change AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p
        lowDigits n = .ok (carry1 != 0#u32, digits1)
      exact hadd1
    refine ⟨out, ?_⟩
    unfold AspisR1GammaCaller.sampler.gamma_sample
    simp only [hlow',bind_tc_ok,hn,hadd1',hbool,Bool.false_eq_true,if_false,hdecode]
  · have hcarry1pos : 0 < carry1.val := by
      have hne : carry1.val ≠ 0 := by
        intro hz
        exact hzero (UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hz)
      omega
    have hbool : (carry1 != 0#u32) = true := by simp [hzero]
    have hcanonical1Indexed := canonical_for_indexed digits1 hcanonical1
    obtain ⟨carry2, digits2, hadd2, hvalues2, hcarry2⟩ :=
      add_small_base_p_refines_addDigits digits1 1#u32 hcanonical1Indexed (by decide)
    have hcarry2zero := second_carry_zero block lowDigits q n carry1
      hlowModel.1 hlowModel.2 hnval hcarry1' hcarry1pos
    have hcarry2' : carry2.val =
        (addDigits Pn 1 (values digits1)).2 := by
      change carry2.val =
        (addDigits Pn (1#u32).val (ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1.values digits1)).2
      rw [show (1#u32).val = 1 by rfl]
      exact hcarry2
    have hcarry2val : carry2.val = 0 := by
      rw [hcarry2', hvalues1', hcarry2zero]
    have hcarry2zeroU : carry2 = 0#u32 := UScalar.eq_of_val_eq hcarry2val
    have hcanonical2 : Canonical digits2 := by
      unfold Canonical
      have hvalues2' : values digits2 =
          (addDigits Pn 1 (values digits1)).1 := by
        change ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1.values digits2 =
          (addDigits Pn (1#u32).val
            (ExtractedIndexedAddSmallNatModelV1.values digits1)).1
        rw [show (1#u32).val = 1 by rfl]
        exact hvalues2
      rw [hvalues2']
      exact addDigits_output_digits_lt Pn 1 (values digits1) P_pos
    obtain ⟨out, hdecode⟩ := candidate_decode_total digits2 hcanonical2
    have hlow' : candidateGammaHelpers.low block = .ok (lowDigits, q) := by
      change AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.low_base_p_digits block = .ok (lowDigits, q)
      exact hlow
    have hadd1' : candidateGammaHelpers.add lowDigits n =
        .ok (carry1 != 0#u32, digits1) := by
      change AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p
        lowDigits n = .ok (carry1 != 0#u32, digits1)
      exact hadd1
    have hadd2' : candidateGammaHelpers.add digits1 1#u32 =
        .ok (carry2 != 0#u32, digits2) := by
      change AspisR1Post25SamplerIndexedAddSmallCandidate.sampler.add_small_base_p
        digits1 1#u32 = .ok (carry2 != 0#u32, digits2)
      exact hadd2
    refine ⟨out, ?_⟩
    unfold AspisR1GammaCaller.sampler.gamma_sample
    simp only [hlow',bind_tc_ok,hn,hadd1',hbool,if_true,hadd2',hdecode]


#print axioms candidate_gamma_total

end AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel

import NBA_Scalars
import GammaCandidateTotalityV14
import IndexedCandidateOrdinaryRetainedBridgeV5
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NBA_SamplerValues
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation AspisR1ClaimPreparedBridge
open AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.Concrete

theorem gamma (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
    ∃ out, NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.gamma block=ok out ∧
      Canonical (toClaimE out) ∧ GammaRankMeaning block out := by
  obtain ⟨raw,call⟩ := AspisR1GammaCaller.DigitsModel.candidate_gamma_total block
  have mapped : candidateGammaPublic block=ok (gammaToPublic raw) := by
    unfold candidateGammaPublic
    rw [call,bind_tc_ok]
  exact ⟨gammaToPublic raw,mapped,candidateGammaPublic_success_canonical _ _ mapped,
    candidateGammaPublic_success_rank _ _ mapped⟩

/-- Ordinary output is the actual returned candidate carrier, with all words
preserved by its public port; canonicality follows from that producing call. -/
theorem ordinary (block : Array U8 32#usize) :
    ∃ raw, AspisR1Post25Sampler.sampler.ordinary_sample block=ok raw ∧
      NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.ordinary block=
        ok (AspisR1Post25SamplerPreparedCarrier.candidateToPE raw) ∧
      Canonical (toClaimE (AspisR1Post25SamplerPreparedCarrier.candidateToPE raw)) := by
  obtain ⟨raw,call,rank⟩ :=
    AspisR1.ExtractedQM31SamplerIndexedOrdinaryRetainedBridgeV5.ordinary_sample_candidate_eq_fieldRank block
  have mapped : AspisR1Post25SamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2.candidateOrdinaryPublic block=
      ok (AspisR1Post25SamplerPreparedCarrier.candidateToPE raw) := by
    unfold AspisR1Post25SamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2.candidateOrdinaryPublic
    rw [call,bind_tc_ok]
  exact ⟨raw,call,mapped,
    AspisR1Post25SamplerOrdinaryCallbackV2.candidateOrdinaryPublic_success_canonical _ _ mapped⟩

/-- Exact scalar-call replay after its three linked digest observations. -/
theorem scalar {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before after : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (block : Array U8 32#usize) (out : PE) (nonzero : Bool)
    (call : transcript.Transcript.block D before row payload=ok (block,after))
    (sample : (if nonzero then NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.gamma block
      else NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.ordinary block)=ok out) :
    PreparedModel.scalar NBA_Installed.actual.sampling D before row payload nonzero=ok (out,after) := by
  unfold PreparedModel.scalar
  rw [call,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  rw [sample,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl

#print axioms gamma
#print axioms ordinary
#print axioms scalar
end AspisR1.NBA_SamplerValues
end

NBL_BlockTrace.source:
import NBA_Transcript
import NBA_SamplerValues
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NBL_BlockTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation
abbrev Bytes32 := Array U8 32#usize
abbrev Log := List (Slice (Slice U8) × Bytes32)

/-- Three ordered native digest observations. The advanced state is derived
from the third reply, not an independently chosen scalar post-state. -/
structure Block {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) where
  tag : U8
  tagCall : (160#u8+row : Result U8)=ok tag
  absorbed : Bytes32
  value : Bytes32
  final : Bytes32
  absorbCall : D.digest before.hash (NBA_Transcript.absorbParts before.state tag payload)=ok absorbed
  readCall : D.digest before.hash (NBA_Transcript.readParts absorbed 1#u8)=ok value
  advanceCall : D.digest before.hash (NBA_Transcript.readParts absorbed 2#u8)=ok final

def Block.after {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H}
    {before : transcript.Transcript H} {row : U8} {payload : Slice U8}
    (b : Block D before row payload) : transcript.Transcript H := {before with state:=b.final}

def Block.log {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H}
    {before : transcript.Transcript H} {row : U8} {payload : Slice U8}
    (b : Block D before row payload) : Log :=
  [(NBA_Transcript.absorbParts before.state b.tag payload,b.absorbed),
   (NBA_Transcript.readParts b.absorbed 1#u8,b.value),
   (NBA_Transcript.readParts b.absorbed 2#u8,b.final)]

theorem block_result {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (b : Block D before row payload) :
    transcript.Transcript.block D before row payload=ok (b.value,b.after) :=
  NBA_Transcript.block D before row b.tag payload b.absorbed b.value b.final
    b.tagCall b.absorbCall b.readCall b.advanceCall

theorem block_log {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (b : Block D before row payload) :
    b.log.length=3 ∧ ∀ event ∈ b.log, D.digest before.hash event.1=ok event.2 := by
  refine ⟨rfl,?_⟩
  intro event member
  simp only [Block.log,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false] at member
  rcases member with rfl | rfl | rfl
  · exact b.absorbCall
  · exact b.readCall
  · exact b.advanceCall

/-- Sampling observation is at the SAME block emitted by the digest trace.
Its native sampler association remains a separately discharged child port. -/
structure Scalar {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (nonzero : Bool) where
  block : Block D before row payload
  value : aspis_core.field.WideExact
  sample : (if nonzero then NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.gamma block.value
    else NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.ordinary block.value)=ok value

theorem scalar_result {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8) (nonzero : Bool)
    (s : Scalar D before row payload nonzero) :
    PreparedModel.scalar NBA_Installed.actual.sampling D before row payload nonzero=
      ok (s.value,s.block.after) :=
  NBA_SamplerValues.scalar D before s.block.after row payload s.block.value s.value nonzero
    (block_result D before row payload s.block) s.sample

#print axioms block_result
#print axioms block_log
#print axioms scalar_result
end AspisR1.NBL_BlockTrace
end

import NBL_BlockTrace

namespace AspisR1.NBL_ScalarConstruct

/-- Once ONE native block trace is linked, the installed scalar output is
constructed. A chosen successful sampler result is not a hypothesis. -/
theorem source {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (nonzero : Bool) (b : NBL_BlockTrace.Block D before row payload) :
    ∃ s : NBL_BlockTrace.Scalar D before row payload nonzero,
      s.block=b := by
  cases nonzero with
  | true =>
    obtain ⟨out,call,canonical,rank⟩ := NBA_SamplerValues.gamma b.value
    exact ⟨⟨b,out,call⟩,rfl⟩
  | false =>
    obtain ⟨raw,call,mapped,canonical⟩ := NBA_SamplerValues.ordinary b.value
    exact ⟨⟨b,_,mapped⟩,rfl⟩

end AspisR1.NBL_ScalarConstruct

NBR_BlockConstruct.source:
import NBL_ScalarConstruct
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NBR_BlockConstruct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation NBL_BlockTrace

/-- The infallible native Digest32 interface, expressed on the SAME digest
handle and ordered parts. It does not select outputs or a preparation run. -/
def Total {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) : Prop :=
  ∀ (hash : H) (parts : Slice (Slice U8)), ∃ reply, D.digest hash parts=ok reply

/-- Construct the three chronological observations from infallibility. -/
theorem block {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (total : Total D)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (bound : row.val≤95) : Nonempty (Block D before row payload) := by
  obtain ⟨tag,tagCall,tagValue⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
    (UScalar.add_spec (x:=160#u8) (y:=row) (by scalar_tac))
  obtain ⟨absorbed,absorbCall⟩ := total before.hash (NBA_Transcript.absorbParts before.state tag payload)
  obtain ⟨value,readCall⟩ := total before.hash (NBA_Transcript.readParts absorbed 1#u8)
  obtain ⟨final,advanceCall⟩ := total before.hash (NBA_Transcript.readParts absorbed 2#u8)
  exact ⟨⟨tag,tagCall,absorbed,value,final,absorbCall,readCall,advanceCall⟩⟩

/-- No successful scalar result or preselected block trace is an input. -/
theorem scalar {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (total : Total D)
    (before : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (nonzero : Bool) (bound : row.val≤95) :
    Nonempty (Scalar D before row payload nonzero) := by
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := block D total before row payload bound
  obtain ⟨s,_⟩ := NBL_ScalarConstruct.source D before row payload nonzero b
  exact ⟨s⟩

/-- Determinism identifies every later returned block with THIS construction. -/
theorem returned {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H) (total : Total D)
    (before after : transcript.Transcript H) (row : U8) (payload : Slice U8)
    (value : Bytes32) (bound : row.val≤95)
    (call : transcript.Transcript.block D before row payload=ok (value,after)) :
    ∃ b : Block D before row payload, b.value=value ∧ b.after=after := by
  obtain ⟨b⟩ := block D total before row payload bound
  have same := Result.ok.inj ((block_result D before row payload b).symm.trans call)
  exact ⟨b,(Prod.mk.inj same).1,(Prod.mk.inj same).2⟩

#print axioms block
#print axioms scalar
#print axioms returned
end AspisR1.NBR_BlockConstruct
end

import NBA_Installed
import CurrentPreparedScratchReachability
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NBA_TraceReplay
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation
open PreparedScratchReachability

/-- Replay of the locally linked calls, in source order. This is a cohort
replay theorem; constructing these observations from native calls is separate. -/
theorem source {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (out : verifier.Prepared) (scratch old : Array aspis_core.field.WideExact 29#usize)
    (trace : Reachable NBA_Installed.actual D sem v hash out scratch) :
    PreparedScratchModel.prepare NBA_Installed.actual D sem v hash old=ok (.Ok out,scratch) := by
  rcases trace with ⟨start,t1,t2,t3,bytes,gamma,kappa,alpha0,hseed,hg,hbytes,hk,ha,tail⟩
  have add_exact {ty : UScalarTy} (a b c : UScalar ty)
      (hc : c.val=a.val+b.val) : a+b=ok c := by
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (UScalar.add_spec (x:=a) (y:=b) (by scalar_tac))
    have he : z=c := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [he] using hz
  have cap : (32#usize + 224#usize : Result Usize)=ok 256#usize := add_exact _ _ _ (by scalar_tac)
  have single : (30#u8 + 1#u8 : Result U8)=ok 31#u8 := add_exact _ _ _ (by scalar_tac)
  have double : (31#u8 + 1#u8 : Result U8)=ok 32#u8 := add_exact _ _ _ (by scalar_tac)
  unfold PreparedScratchModel.prepare
  simp only [r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state,hseed,bind_tc_ok,hg,hbytes,lift,hk,ha]
  dsimp! only
  simp only [hk,bind_tc_ok]
  dsimp! only
  simp only [ha,bind_tc_ok]
  dsimp! only
  cases tail with
  | single hf rest =>
    obtain ⟨qs,afterQueries,last,rho,claim,hq,hr,hp,hc,he⟩ := rest
    have row : (if 30#u8=30#u8 then 31#u8 else 32#u8)=31#u8 := if_pos rfl
    rw [row] at hr
    simp only [emptyPayload] at hr
    rw [he]
    repeat' first
      | dsimp! only
      | simp only [hf,bind_tc_ok,show ¬(1#usize=2#usize) by decide,↓reduceIte,hq,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,single,lift,hr,hp,hc,output]
  | double hf root b1 b2 alpha1 afterAlpha hroot hb1 hb2 halpha rest =>
    obtain ⟨qs,afterQueries,last,rho,claim,hq,hr,hp,hc,he⟩ := rest
    have row : (if 31#u8=30#u8 then 31#u8 else 32#u8)=32#u8 := if_neg (by decide)
    rw [row] at hr
    simp only [emptyPayload] at hr
    rw [he]
    repeat' first
      | dsimp! only
      | simp only [hf,bind_tc_ok,↓reduceIte,cap,lift,hroot,hb1,hb2,halpha,hq,
          core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,double,hr,hp,hc,output]

theorem unique {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (left right : verifier.Prepared) (gleft gright old : Array aspis_core.field.WideExact 29#usize)
    (lt : Reachable NBA_Installed.actual D sem v hash left gleft)
    (rt : Reachable NBA_Installed.actual D sem v hash right gright) :
    left=right ∧ gleft=gright := by
  have same := Result.ok.inj ((source D sem v hash left gleft old lt).symm.trans
    (source D sem v hash right gright old rt))
  exact ⟨core.result.Result.Ok.inj (congrArg Prod.fst same),congrArg Prod.snd same⟩

#print axioms source
#print axioms unique
end AspisR1.NBA_TraceReplay
end

      aspis_coreDigest32Inst) r ()

    let (q, state7) := val

    let u16 ← Array.index_usize q 16#usize

NBL_PrepareControl.source:
import NBA_TraceReplay
import NBA_QueryJoin
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NBL_PrepareControl
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation
open PreparedScratchReachability
abbrev PE := aspis_core.field.WideExact
abbrev Scratch := Array PE 29#usize
abbrev Out := core.result.Result verifier.Prepared verifier.Error × Scratch

structure Opening (H : Type) where
  gamma : PE
  kappa : PE
  alpha : Array PE 2#usize
  transcript : transcript.Transcript H
  row : U8

/-- Source-order opening prefix; its output is the sole carrier into the
query/rho/powers/claim continuation. This is a cohort factor, not a native law. -/
def opening (B : PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H) : Result (Opening H) := do
  let state ← r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state D sem.transcript
  let start ← transcript.Transcript.new D hash state v.variant
  let (gamma,t1) ← PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D start 27#u8 v.y1 true
  let bytes ← B.sampling.toBytes v.inactive
  let payload ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
  let (kappa,t2) ← PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D t1 28#u8 payload false
  let (alpha0,t3) ← PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D t2 29#u8 v.round0 false
  let folds ← transport.Variant.folds v.variant
  if folds=2#usize then
    let capacity ← 32#usize+224#usize
    let root ← core.option.Option.unwrap v.folded_root
    let payload ← lift (Array.to_slice root)
    let b1 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 (alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity U8 capacity) payload
    let b2 ← alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 b1 v.round1
    let (alpha1,t4) ← PreparedModel.scalar B.sampling D t3 30#u8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref b2) false
    ok ⟨gamma,kappa,Array.make 2#usize [alpha0,alpha1],t4,31#u8⟩
  else
    ok ⟨gamma,kappa,Array.make 2#usize [alpha0,aspis_core.field.WideExact.ZERO],t3,30#u8⟩

/-- Full continuation, including both Rust Result errors and scratch writes. -/
def continuation (B : PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (old : Scratch) (o : Opening H) : Result Out := do
  let (r,t1) ← B.sampling.queries D o.transcript o.row v.final_message
  let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
  match cf with
  | .Continue queries =>
    let row ← o.row+1#u8
    let payload ← lift (Array.to_slice (Std.Array.empty U8))
    let (rho,t2) ← PreparedModel.scalar_k B.sampling D t1 row payload
    let g ← B.powers 29#usize o.gamma
    let r ← B.claim D sem v.y1 v.inactive g o.kappa
    let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r
    match cf with
    | .Continue claim => ok (.Ok (output sem v o.gamma o.kappa o.alpha rho queries claim t2),g)
    | .Break residual =>
      let r ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
      ok (r,g)
  | .Break residual =>
    let r ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      verifier.Prepared (core.convert.FromSame verifier.Error) residual
    ok (r,old)

def run (B : PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H) (old : Scratch) : Result Out := do
  let o ← opening B D sem v hash
  continuation B D sem v old o

/-- Full Result equality, universally quantified over boundaries and inputs.
No successful child observations or native/model equality is a hypothesis. -/
theorem source (B : PreparedScratchModel.Boundaries) {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H) (old : Scratch) :
    PreparedScratchModel.prepare B D sem v hash old=run B D sem v hash old := by
  unfold PreparedScratchModel.prepare run opening
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq]
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; intro state
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; intro start
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; rintro ⟨gamma,t1⟩
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; intro bytes
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; intro payload
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; rintro ⟨kappa,t2⟩
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; rintro ⟨alpha0,t3⟩
  simp only [bind_assoc_eq,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; intro folds
  split <;> simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok,continuation,output,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
  all_goals repeat' (apply NBA_QueryJoin.bind_same; intro x; try dsimp! only; try simp only [bind_assoc_eq,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry])
  all_goals rfl

#print axioms source
end AspisR1.NBL_PrepareControl
end

import NBL_BlockTrace
import NBL_PrepareControl
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.NBL_OpeningTrace
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1PublicPreparation NBL_PrepareControl NBL_BlockTrace

/-- One source-order S2 opening. Every succeeding call consumes the actual
preceding returned carrier, including root||round1 and serialized inactive.
There is no complete opening/prepare output equation in this record. -/
structure Trace {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H) where
  variant : v.variant=.S2
  seed : Bytes32
  seedCall : D.digest hash (NBA_Transcript.seedParts sem.transcript.state)=ok seed
  gamma : Scalar D (⟨seed,hash⟩ : transcript.Transcript H) 27#u8 v.y1 true
  inactiveBytes : Bytes32
  serialize : NBA_Installed.actual.sampling.toBytes v.inactive=ok inactiveBytes
  kappa : Scalar D gamma.block.after 28#u8 (Array.to_slice inactiveBytes) false
  alpha0 : Scalar D kappa.block.after 29#u8 v.round0 false
  root : Bytes32
  rootCall : v.folded_root=some root
  bytes1 : alloc.vec.Vec U8
  bytes2 : alloc.vec.Vec U8
  appendRoot : alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8
    (alloc.vec.Vec.with_capacity U8 256#usize) (Array.to_slice root)=ok bytes1
  appendRound : alloc.vec.Vec.extend_from_slice core.clone.CloneU8 bytes1 v.round1=ok bytes2
  alpha1 : Scalar D alpha0.block.after 30#u8 (alloc.vec.Vec.deref bytes2) false

def Trace.output {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H}
    {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {v : verifier.View} {hash : H}
    (t : Trace D sem v hash) : Opening H :=
  ⟨t.gamma.value,t.kappa.value,Array.make 2#usize [t.alpha0.value,t.alpha1.value],
    t.alpha1.block.after,31#u8⟩

def Trace.log {H : Type} {D : aspis_core.Digest32 H}
    {sem : r1_semantic.Verified H} {v : verifier.View} {hash : H}
    (t : Trace D sem v hash) : Log :=
  [(NBA_Transcript.seedParts sem.transcript.state,t.seed)] ++ t.gamma.block.log ++
    t.kappa.block.log ++ t.alpha0.block.log ++ t.alpha1.block.log

theorem source {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (t : Trace D sem v hash) : opening NBA_Installed.actual D sem v hash=ok t.output := by
  have seed : transcript.Transcript.new D hash sem.transcript.state v.variant=
      ok (⟨t.seed,hash⟩ : transcript.Transcript H) := by
    rw [t.variant]
    exact NBA_Transcript.seed D hash sem.transcript.state t.seed t.seedCall
  have folds : transport.Variant.folds v.variant=ok 2#usize := by
    rw [t.variant]
    simp [transport.Variant.folds,transport.Variant.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqVariant.eq,read_discriminant,transport.Variant.read_discriminant]
  have capacity : (32#usize+224#usize : Result Usize)=ok 256#usize := by
    obtain ⟨z,hz,hval⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists
      (UScalar.add_spec (x:=32#usize) (y:=224#usize) (by scalar_tac))
    have he : z=256#usize := by scalar_tac
    simpa only [he] using hz
  have root : core.option.Option.unwrap v.folded_root=ok t.root := by rw [t.rootCall]; rfl
  unfold opening
  simp only [r1_wire.SemanticTranscript.impl.state,seed,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry,
    scalar_result D _ _ _ _ t.gamma,t.serialize,lift,
    scalar_result D _ _ _ _ t.kappa,scalar_result D _ _ _ _ t.alpha0,
    folds,↓reduceIte,capacity,root,t.appendRoot,t.appendRound,
    scalar_result D _ _ _ _ t.alpha1,Trace.output]

/-- All thirteen chronological replies are constrained by the SAME digest
instance. No query suffix is included or erased by this opening trace. -/
theorem log_length {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (t : Trace D sem v hash) : t.log.length=13 := rfl

theorem log_sound {H : Type} (D : aspis_core.Digest32 H)
    (sem : r1_semantic.Verified H) (v : verifier.View) (hash : H)
    (t : Trace D sem v hash) : ∀ event ∈ t.log, D.digest hash event.1=ok event.2 := by
  intro event member
  simp only [Trace.log,List.mem_append,List.mem_cons,List.not_mem_nil,or_false,or_assoc] at member
  rcases member with rfl | hg | hk | ha | hb
  · exact t.seedCall
  · exact (block_log D _ _ _ t.gamma.block).2 _ hg
  · exact (block_log D _ _ _ t.kappa.block).2 _ hk
  · exact (block_log D _ _ _ t.alpha0.block).2 _ ha
  · exact (block_log D _ _ _ t.alpha1.block).2 _ hb

#print axioms source
#print axioms log_length
#print axioms log_sound
end AspisR1.NBL_OpeningTrace
end

import AdapterRwModel
import CurrentCompactCallerModelV1
import CurrentClaimSumModel
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBC_ReleaseLeaves
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Every release caller obtains precisely None; no observer hypothesis. -/
theorem observer (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) : AdapterRw.observer ops = ok none := rfl

/-- Release mark has no callback and no effect, for every actual phase. -/
theorem mark (phase : AspisR1CurrentCaller.verifier.Phase) :
    AspisR1CurrentCaller.verifier.mark none phase = ok () := rfl

/-- The retained release trace definition ignores all of its arguments. -/
theorem value (tag : U16) (index : Usize)
    (x : AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.aspis_core.field.WideExact) :
    AspisR1CurrentPreparedClaim.trace.value tag index x = ok () := rfl

abbrev Parts := Slice (Slice U8)
abbrev Digest := Array U8 32#usize

/-- The exact emitted to_bytes body; the hash value is an arbitrary reply. -/
def toBytes (digest : Digest) : Result Digest := ok digest

/-- Frozen three-line source wrapper, with only the runtime hashv call external. -/
def sourceDigest (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) (_self : AdapterRw.SolanaDigest)
    (parts : Parts) : Result Digest := do
  let digest ← hashv parts
  toBytes digest

/-- All Result paths and the SAME ordered parts are preserved. -/
theorem digest_result (hashv : Parts → Result Digest)
    (self : AdapterRw.SolanaDigest) (parts : Parts) :
    sourceDigest hashv self parts = hashv parts := by
  cases h : hashv parts <;> simp only [sourceDigest, h, toBytes,
    bind_tc_ok, bind_tc_fail, bind_tc_div]

/-- Local dictionary installation only. This does not identify the adopted
headline dictionary with the concrete source wrapper. -/
def digestOps (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (hashv : Parts → Result Digest) : AdapterRw.Ops :=
  {ops with op43 := sourceDigest hashv}

theorem digest_installed (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) (hashv : Parts → Result Digest)
    (self : AdapterRw.SolanaDigest) (parts : Parts) :
    (AdapterRw.SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 (digestOps ops hashv)).digest self parts =
      hashv parts := digest_result hashv self parts

/-- Program error VALUE port only. The actual msg! runtime effect is retained
as an open native obligation; enum conversions in NBI2 are not this wrapper. -/
def errorValue (_e : AdapterRw.aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.Error) :
    Result AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError :=
  ok .InvalidInstructionData

def errorOps (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) : AdapterRw.Ops := {ops with op44 := errorValue}

theorem error_installed (ops : AdapterRw.Ops)
    (e : AdapterRw.aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.Error) :
    (errorOps ops).op44 e = ok .InvalidInstructionData := rfl

#print axioms observer
#print axioms mark
#print axioms value
#print axioms digest_result
#print axioms digest_installed
#print axioms error_installed
end NBC_ReleaseLeaves

namespace NBC_Filled

/-- Reuse the complete existing pure std value law, retaining allocation
failure and deriving contents rather than assuming successful filled output.
Native std/allocator/ownership association is expressly outside this theorem. -/
theorem result (reservation : Reservation) {T : Type}
    (copy : core.marker.Copy T) (n : Usize) (value : T)

    aspis_core.r0.heap.filled (ClaimsUnrolledFinish.external (calls reservation)) copy n value =

      | .Err _ => ok (.Err .Allocation)
      | .Ok () => ok (.Ok (⟨List.replicate n.val value, by simp; scalar_tac⟩ : alloc.vec.Vec T)) :=
  AspisR1.NP6_ClaimsModel.filled_contents reservation copy n value cloned

import LPf_ReductionWord
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_CoreReduction
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- The two frozen source reducers place the u32 cast on opposite sides of
subtraction. Their twice-folded bounds make those placements equivalent. -/
theorem same (x : U64) :
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x =
    FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce x := by
  let m := FIo_ReduceBounds.fold (FIo_ReduceBounds.fold x)
  have small : m.val < 4294967294 := by
    rw [LPf_ReductionWord.twice_value]
    apply LPe_MersenneReduction.fold_twice_lt
    scalar_tac
  have cv : (UScalar.cast .U32 m).val = m.val := by scalar_tac
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.reduce
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P, FIo_Native.fast_pairing.canonical.P,
    lift, bind_tc_ok]
  change (if UScalar.cast .U32 m ≥ 2147483647#u32
    then ok (U32.wrapping_sub (UScalar.cast .U32 m) 2147483647#u32)
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m)) =
    (if m ≥ 2147483647#u64
    then ok (UScalar.cast .U32 (U64.wrapping_sub m 2147483647#u64))
    else ok (UScalar.cast .U32 m))
  split
  · rename_i h
    have hm : m ≥ 2147483647#u64 := by scalar_tac
    rw [if_pos hm]
    congr 1
    apply UScalar.eq_of_val_eq
    unfold U32.wrapping_sub U64.wrapping_sub
    rw [UScalar.cast_val_eq, UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq,
      UScalar.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
    norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits,U32.size,U32.numBits]
    omega
  · rename_i h
    have hm : ¬m ≥ 2147483647#u64 := by scalar_tac
    rw [if_neg hm]

/-- Total exact base-field reduction on every source word. -/
theorem source (x : U64) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.reduce_u64 x = ok z ∧
    z.val = x.val % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  rw [same]
  exact LPf_ReductionWord.native_reduce x

import LPf_CoreReduction
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPf_BaseMultiply
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

/-- Full u32 operands, without a canonical-input restriction. -/
theorem product_bound (x y : U32) : x.val * y.val < 18446744073709551616 := by
  have hx : x.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have hy : y.val ≤ 4294967295 := by scalar_tac
  have bound := Nat.mul_le_mul hx hy
  omega

theorem word_product (x y : U32) :
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y)).val = x.val*y.val := by
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq]
  have cx : (UScalar.cast .U64 x).val = x.val := by scalar_tac
  have cy : (UScalar.cast .U64 y).val = y.val := by scalar_tac
  rw [cx, cy]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits]
  exact product_bound x y

/-- The actual extracted frozen M31 multiplication is total and equals
natural multiplication modulo P. This is a Lean source theorem, not a claim
that the timed-out Kani exact contract passed. -/
theorem source (x y : U32) : ∃ z,
    FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val*y.val) % 2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  obtain ⟨z, run, val, canonical⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source
    (U64.wrapping_mul (UScalar.cast .U64 x) (UScalar.cast .U64 y))
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, canonical⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul,lift,bind_tc_ok,run]
  · rw [word_product] at val
    exact val

#print axioms product_bound
#print axioms word_product
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPf_BaseMultiply

import LPf_BaseMultiply
import FIo_NativeFuns
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_Total
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev NC := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31
abbrev NQ := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31
abbrev NE := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact

def Total {α : Type} (r : Result α) : Prop := ∃ z, r = ok z

theorem bind_total {α β : Type} {r : Result α} {k : α → Result β}
    (hr : Total r) (hk : ∀ x, Total (k x)) : Total (r >>= k) := by
  obtain ⟨x,hx⟩ := hr
  rw [hx,bind_tc_ok]
  exact hk x

theorem m31_mul (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.mul x y) := by
  obtain ⟨z,h,_,_⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x y
  exact ⟨z,h⟩

theorem reduce (x : U64) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 x) := by
  obtain ⟨z,h,_,_⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source x
  exact ⟨z,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64,h,bind_tc_ok]⟩

theorem m31_add (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add x y) := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem m31_sub (x y : U32) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y) := by
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  split <;> exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem cm_add (x y : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem cm_sub (x y : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.sub x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.sub
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem cm_mul (x y : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul
  apply bind_total (m31_mul _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_mul _ _); intro b
  simp only [lift,bind_tc_ok]
  apply bind_total (reduce _); intro c
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro d
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro e
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro f
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem by_r (x : NC) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r x) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.double
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (m31_sub _ _); intro b
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro c
  apply bind_total (m31_add _ _); intro d
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem qm_add (x y : NQ) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.add x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.add
  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem qm_sub (x y : NQ) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.sub x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.sub
  apply bind_total (cm_sub _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (cm_sub _ _); intro b
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem qm_mul (x y : NQ) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.mul x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.mul
  apply bind_total (cm_mul _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (cm_mul _ _); intro b
  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro c
  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro d
  apply bind_total (cm_mul _ _); intro e
  apply bind_total (by_r _); intro f
  apply bind_total (cm_add _ _); intro g
  apply bind_total (cm_sub _ _); intro h
  apply bind_total (cm_sub _ _); intro i
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem mul_u (x : NQ) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.mul_u x) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.mul_u
  apply bind_total (by_r _); intro a
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

theorem wide_mul (x y : NE) : Total (FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul x y) := by
  unfold FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul
  apply bind_total (qm_mul _ _); intro a
  apply bind_total (qm_mul _ _); intro b
  apply bind_total (qm_add _ _); intro c
  apply bind_total (qm_add _ _); intro d
  apply bind_total (qm_mul _ _); intro e
  apply bind_total (mul_u _); intro f
  apply bind_total (qm_add _ _); intro g
  apply bind_total (qm_sub _ _); intro h
  apply bind_total (qm_sub _ _); intro i
  exact ⟨_,rfl⟩

import LPi_Total
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_NatBase
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem sub_word (x y : U32) (h : y.val ≤ x.val) :
    (U32.wrapping_sub x y).val = x.val-y.val := by
  rw [U32.wrapping_sub_val_eq]
  have hx := x.hSize
  have hy := y.hSize
  have he : x.val+(UScalar.size .U32-y.val)=(x.val-y.val)+UScalar.size .U32 := by omega
  rw [he,Nat.add_mod,Nat.mod_self,Nat.add_zero,Nat.mod_mod,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]

theorem add (x y : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) (hy : y.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val+y.val)%2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  let s := U32.wrapping_add x y
  have sv : s.val = x.val+y.val := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.add,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if s ≥ 2147483647#u32 then
    ok (U32.wrapping_sub s 2147483647#u32) else ok s) = ok z ∧ _
  by_cases h : s ≥ 2147483647#u32
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hp : 2147483647 ≤ s.val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]
      change s.val-2147483647 = (x.val+y.val)%2147483647
      rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hp,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]; change s.val-2147483647 < 2147483647; omega
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hp : s.val < 2147483647 := by scalar_tac
    exact ⟨_,rfl,by rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp],hp⟩

theorem sub (x y : U32) (hx : x.val < 2147483647) (hy : y.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub x y = ok z ∧
    z.val = (x.val+2147483647-y.val)%2147483647 ∧ z.val < 2147483647 := by
  let a := U32.wrapping_add x 2147483647#u32
  have av : a.val = x.val+2147483647 := by
    rw [U32.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
    rfl
  let s := U32.wrapping_sub a y
  have sv : s.val = x.val+2147483647-y.val := by
    rw [sub_word _ _ (by omega),av]
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.P,lift,bind_tc_ok]
  change ∃ z, (if s ≥ 2147483647#u32 then
    ok (U32.wrapping_sub s 2147483647#u32) else ok s) = ok z ∧ _
  by_cases h : s ≥ 2147483647#u32
  · rw [if_pos h]
    have hp : 2147483647 ≤ s.val := by scalar_tac
    refine ⟨_,rfl,?_,?_⟩
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]
      change s.val-2147483647 = (x.val+2147483647-y.val)%2147483647
      rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_sub_mod hp,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)]
    · rw [sub_word s 2147483647#u32 hp]; change s.val-2147483647 < 2147483647; omega
  · rw [if_neg h]
    have hp : s.val < 2147483647 := by scalar_tac
    exact ⟨_,rfl,by rw [←sv,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hp],hp⟩

import LPi_NatBase
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_CMProduct
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_Total
abbrev NC := FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31

def Canon (x : NC) : Prop := x.a.val<2147483647 ∧ x.b.val<2147483647

def realWord (a b c d : Nat) := ((a*c)%2147483647+2147483647-(b*d)%2147483647)%2147483647
def imagWord (a b c d : Nat) :=
  ((((a+b)*(c+d))%2147483647+2147483647-(a*c)%2147483647)%2147483647+
    2147483647-(b*d)%2147483647)%2147483647

def sum (x : NC) : U64 := U64.wrapping_add
  (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x.a) (core.convert.num.FromU64U32.from x.b)
def cross (x y : NC) : U64 := U64.wrapping_mul (sum x) (sum y)

theorem sum_value (x : NC) : (sum x).val=x.a.val+x.b.val := by
  unfold sum
  rw [U64.wrapping_add_val_eq,Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by scalar_tac)]
  rfl

theorem cross_value (x y : NC) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y) :
    (cross x y).val=(x.a.val+x.b.val)*(y.a.val+y.b.val) := by
  unfold cross
  rw [U64.wrapping_mul_val_eq,sum_value,sum_value]
  apply Nat.mod_eq_of_lt
  have h0 : x.a.val+x.b.val < 4294967296 := by obtain ⟨_,_⟩ := hx; omega
  have h1 : y.a.val+y.b.val < 4294967296 := by obtain ⟨_,_⟩ := hy; omega
  have h := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_lt_of_lt h0 h1
  norm_num [UScalar.size,UScalarTy.numBits,U64.size,U64.numBits] at h ⊢
  exact h

theorem source (x y : NC) (hx : Canon x) (hy : Canon y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul x y = ok z ∧ Canon z ∧
      z.a.val = realWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val ∧
      z.b.val = imagWord x.a.val x.b.val y.a.val y.b.val := by
  obtain ⟨m0,h0,v0,c0⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x.a y.a
  obtain ⟨m1,h1,v1,c1⟩ := LPf_BaseMultiply.source x.b y.b
  obtain ⟨m2,h2,v2,c2⟩ := LPf_CoreReduction.source (cross x y)
  have hr : FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 (cross x y) = ok m2 := by
    simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64,h2,bind_tc_ok]
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,ca⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub m0 m1 c0 c1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,cb⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub m2 m0 c2 c0
  obtain ⟨c,hc,vc,cc⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub b m1 cb c1
  refine ⟨⟨a,c⟩,?_,⟨ca,cc⟩,?_,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul,h0,h1,lift,bind_tc_ok]
    change (do let t ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.reduce_u64 (cross x y)
               let a ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub m0 m1
               let b ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub t m0
               let c ← FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.sub b m1
               ok (⟨a,c⟩ : NC)) = _
    simp only [hr,ha,hb,hc,bind_tc_ok]
  · simpa only [realWord,v0,v1] using va
  · rw [cross_value x y hx hy] at v2
    simpa only [imagWord,vb,v2,v0,v1] using vc

#print axioms sum_value
#print axioms cross_value
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.LPi_CMProduct

import LPi_CMProduct
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_FieldValues
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
abbrev NC := LPi_CMProduct.NC
abbrev NQ := LPi_Total.NQ
abbrev NE := LPi_Total.NE
abbrev CW := Nat × Nat
abbrev QW := CW × CW
abbrev EW := QW × QW
def cw (x : NC) : CW := (x.a.val,x.b.val)
def qw (x : NQ) : QW := (cw x.c0,cw x.c1)
def ew (x : NE) : EW := (qw x.c0,qw x.c1)
def canonC := LPi_CMProduct.Canon
def canonQ (x : NQ) : Prop := canonC x.c0 ∧ canonC x.c1
def canonE (x : NE) : Prop := canonQ x.c0 ∧ canonQ x.c1
def addM (a b : Nat) := (a+b)%2147483647
def subM (a b : Nat) := (a+2147483647-b)%2147483647
def addC (a b : CW) : CW := (addM a.1 b.1,addM a.2 b.2)
def subC (a b : CW) : CW := (subM a.1 b.1,subM a.2 b.2)
def mulC (a b : CW) : CW := (LPi_CMProduct.realWord a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2,
  LPi_CMProduct.imagWord a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2)
def byR (a : CW) : CW := (subM (addM a.1 a.1) a.2,addM a.1 (addM a.2 a.2))
def addQ (a b : QW) : QW := (addC a.1 b.1,addC a.2 b.2)
def subQ (a b : QW) : QW := (subC a.1 b.1,subC a.2 b.2)
def mulQ (a b : QW) : QW :=
  let ac := mulC a.1 b.1
  let bd := mulC a.2 b.2
  let cross := mulC (addC a.1 a.2) (addC b.1 b.2)
  (addC ac (byR bd),subC (subC cross ac) bd)
def mulU (a : QW) : QW := (byR a.2,a.1)
def mulE (a b : EW) : EW :=
  let ac := mulQ a.1 b.1
  let bd := mulQ a.2 b.2
  let cross := mulQ (addQ a.1 a.2) (addQ b.1 b.2)
  (addQ ac (mulU bd),subQ (subQ cross ac) bd)

theorem cm_mul (x y : NC) (hx : canonC x) (hy : canonC y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.mul x y = ok z ∧ canonC z ∧
      cw z = mulC (cw x) (cw y) := by
  obtain ⟨z,h,c,a,b⟩ := LPi_CMProduct.source x y hx hy
  exact ⟨z,h,c,Prod.ext a b⟩

theorem cm_add (x y : NC) (hx : canonC x) (hy : canonC y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add x y = ok z ∧ canonC z ∧
      cw z = addC (cw x) (cw y) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,ca⟩ := LPi_NatBase.add x.a y.a hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,cb⟩ := LPi_NatBase.add x.b y.b hx.2 hy.2
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.add,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],
    ⟨ca,cb⟩,Prod.ext va vb⟩

theorem cm_sub (x y : NC) (hx : canonC x) (hy : canonC y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.sub x y = ok z ∧ canonC z ∧
      cw z = subC (cw x) (cw y) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,ca⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub x.a y.a hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,cb⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub x.b y.b hx.2 hy.2
  exact ⟨⟨a,b⟩,by simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.CM31.sub,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok],
    ⟨ca,cb⟩,Prod.ext va vb⟩

theorem by_r (x : NC) (hx : canonC x) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r x = ok z ∧ canonC z ∧ cw z = byR (cw x) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,va,ca⟩ := LPi_NatBase.add x.a x.a hx.1 hx.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,vb,cb⟩ := LPi_NatBase.sub a x.b ca hx.2
  obtain ⟨c,hc,vc,cc⟩ := LPi_NatBase.add x.b x.b hx.2 hx.2
  obtain ⟨d,hd,vd,cd⟩ := LPi_NatBase.add x.a c hx.1 cc
  refine ⟨⟨b,d⟩,?_,⟨cb,cd⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.mul_by_r,FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.M31.double,
      ha,hb,hc,hd,bind_tc_ok]
  · exact Prod.ext (by simpa only [cw,byR,addM,subM,va] using vb) (by simpa only [cw,byR,addM,subM,vc] using vd)

#print axioms cm_mul
#print axioms cm_add
#print axioms cm_sub
#print axioms by_r
end AspisR1.LPi_FieldValues

import LPi_FieldValues
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.LPi_TowerValues
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result LPi_FieldValues

theorem qm_add (x y : NQ) (hx : canonQ x) (hy : canonQ y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.add x y = ok z ∧ canonQ z ∧
      qw z = addQ (qw x) (qw y) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := cm_add x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1

  refine ⟨⟨a,b⟩,?_,⟨ca,cb⟩,Prod.ext va vb⟩
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.add,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok]

theorem qm_sub (x y : NQ) (hx : canonQ x) (hy : canonQ y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.sub x y = ok z ∧ canonQ z ∧
      qw z = subQ (qw x) (qw y) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := cm_sub x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,vb⟩ := cm_sub x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  refine ⟨⟨a,b⟩,?_,⟨ca,cb⟩,Prod.ext va vb⟩
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.sub,ha,hb,bind_tc_ok]

theorem qm_mul (x y : NQ) (hx : canonQ x) (hy : canonQ y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.mul x y = ok z ∧ canonQ z ∧
      qw z = mulQ (qw x) (qw y) := by
  obtain ⟨ac,hac,cac,vac⟩ := cm_mul x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨bd,hbd,cbd,vbd⟩ := cm_mul x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := cm_add x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,vb⟩ := cm_add y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨cross,hcross,ccross,vcross⟩ := cm_mul a b ca cb
  obtain ⟨r,hr,cr,vr⟩ := by_r bd cbd
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,clo,vlo⟩ := cm_add ac r cac cr
  obtain ⟨diff,hdiff,cdiff,vdiff⟩ := cm_sub cross ac ccross cac
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,chi,vhi⟩ := cm_sub diff bd cdiff cbd
  refine ⟨⟨lo,hi⟩,?_,⟨clo,chi⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.QM31.mul,hac,hbd,ha,hb,hcross,hr,hlo,hdiff,hhi,bind_tc_ok]
  · simp only [qw,mulQ]
    rw [vlo,vhi,vdiff,vr,vcross,va,vb,vac,vbd]


theorem mul_u (x : NQ) (hx : canonQ x) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.mul_u x = ok z ∧ canonQ z ∧
      qw z = mulU (qw x) := by
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := by_r x.c1 hx.2
  refine ⟨⟨a,x.c0⟩,?_,⟨ca,hx.1⟩,Prod.ext va rfl⟩
  simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.mul_u,ha,bind_tc_ok]

theorem wide_mul (x y : NE) (hx : canonE x) (hy : canonE y) :
    ∃ z, FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul x y = ok z ∧ canonE z ∧
      ew z = mulE (ew x) (ew y) := by
  obtain ⟨ac,hac,cac,vac⟩ := qm_mul x.c0 y.c0 hx.1 hy.1
  obtain ⟨bd,hbd,cbd,vbd⟩ := qm_mul x.c1 y.c1 hx.2 hy.2
  obtain ⟨a,ha,ca,va⟩ := qm_add x.c0 x.c1 hx.1 hx.2
  obtain ⟨b,hb,cb,vb⟩ := qm_add y.c0 y.c1 hy.1 hy.2
  obtain ⟨cross,hcross,ccross,vcross⟩ := qm_mul a b ca cb
  obtain ⟨r,hr,cr,vr⟩ := mul_u bd cbd
  obtain ⟨lo,hlo,clo,vlo⟩ := qm_add ac r cac cr
  obtain ⟨diff,hdiff,cdiff,vdiff⟩ := qm_sub cross ac ccross cac
  obtain ⟨hi,hhi,chi,vhi⟩ := qm_sub diff bd cdiff cbd
  refine ⟨⟨lo,hi⟩,?_,⟨clo,chi⟩,?_⟩
  · simp only [FIo_Native.aspis_core.field.wide_exact.WideExact.mul,hac,hbd,ha,hb,hcross,hr,hlo,hdiff,hhi,bind_tc_ok]
  · simp only [ew,mulE]
    rw [vlo,vhi,vdiff,vr,vcross,va,vb,vac,vbd]

#print axioms qm_add
#print axioms qm_sub
#print axioms qm_mul
#print axioms mul_u
#print axioms wide_mul
end AspisR1.LPi_TowerValues
