import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBG_Utilities
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
def pack {α : Type} (a b c d e f g h : α) : Array α 8#usize :=
  Array.make 8#usize [a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h]

theorem shape {α : Type} (a : Array α 8#usize) :
    ∃ a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 a7, a=pack a0 a1 a2 a3 a4 a5 a6 a7 := by
  rcases a with ⟨xs,h⟩
  change xs.length=8 at h
  cases xs with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a0 xs =>
    cases xs with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons a1 xs =>
      cases xs with
      | nil => simp at h
      | cons a2 xs =>
        cases xs with
        | nil => simp at h
        | cons a3 xs =>
          cases xs with
          | nil => simp at h
          | cons a4 xs =>
            cases xs with
            | nil => simp at h
            | cons a5 xs =>
              cases xs with
              | nil => simp at h
              | cons a6 xs =>
                cases xs with
                | nil => simp at h
                | cons a7 xs =>
                  cases xs with
                  | nil => exact ⟨a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5,a6,a7,rfl⟩
                  | cons a8 xs => simp at h

theorem lists (xs ys : List U8) (width : xs.length=ys.length) :
    List.allM (fun (x,y) => do let b ← core.cmp.PartialEqU8.ne x y;ok (¬ b))
      (xs.zip ys)=ok (decide (xs=ys)) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil =>
    cases ys with
    | nil=>rfl
    | cons y ys=>simp only [List.length_nil,List.length_cons] at width;omega
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil=>simp only [List.length_nil,List.length_cons] at width;omega
    | cons y ys=>
      have tail : xs.length=ys.length := Nat.succ.inj width
      by_cases same : x=y
      · subst y
        have comp : core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne x x=false := by
          simp [core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne]
        simp only [List.zip_cons_cons,List.allM,comp,bind_tc_ok]
        change List.allM _ (xs.zip ys)=ok (decide (x::xs=x::ys))
        simpa only [List.cons.injEq,true_and,liftFun2,bind_tc_ok] using ih ys tail
      · have comp : core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne x y=true := by
          simp [core.cmp.impls.PartialEqU8.ne,same]
        simp only [List.zip_cons_cons,List.allM,comp,bind_tc_ok]
        change ok false=ok (decide (x::xs=y::ys))
        simp [same]

#print axioms shape
#print axioms lists
end NBG_Utilities

NBH_LiveFrontier.source:
import NBH_Frontier
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBH_LiveFrontier
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open NBD_DigestInduction
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
open NBH_Frontier

theorem live_loop (a : Frontier) :
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop a 0#usize =
    ok (if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalDigest) := by
  have spec : pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop a 0#usize
      ⦃ r => r = if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalDigest ⦄ := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat (fun i : Usize => 20-i.val)
      (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ 20 ∧ (CanonicalFrom a 0 ↔ CanonicalFrom a i.val))
      (fun r => r = if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalDigest)
      (fun i => pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop.body a i) 0#usize ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      rcases hi with ⟨bound,eqv⟩
      unfold pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop.body
      simp only [NBD_DigestInduction.source]
      step*
      all_goals simp_all [CanonicalFrom]
      all_goals first | scalar_tac | skip
      · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
        constructor
        · intro h j hj; exact h j (by omega)
        · intro h j hj
          by_cases same : j.val = i.val
          · simpa only [same] using (show Canonical (a.val[i.val]'(by have := a.property; scalar_tac)) from by assumption)
          · exact h j (by omega)
      · refine ⟨⟨i.val, by scalar_tac⟩, Nat.le_refl _, ?_⟩
        assumption
    · exact ⟨by scalar_tac, Iff.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

#print axioms live_loop
end NBH_LiveFrontier

import NBH_Audit
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace NBK_SliceStore

def store (output : Slice U8) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 32#usize) : Result (Slice U8) := do
  let (s, back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8)
    output { start, «end» := stop }
  let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
  ok (back copied)

theorem exact (output : Slice U8) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 32#usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ output.length)
    (width : stop.val - start.val = 32) :
    store output start stop bytes = ok (output.setSlice! start.val bytes.val) := by
  have room : 32 ≤ output.length - start.val := by omega
  have bs := bytes.property
  simp only [store, core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut, Array.to_slice]
  simp [Slice.length, Slice.len, order, bound, core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,
    List.slice, width, Nat.min_eq_left room, bs, Slice.setSlice!, lift]

#print axioms exact
end NBK_SliceStore

NBK_LiveBytes.source:
import NBK_LiveStep
import S2K_DigestBytes

/-! Symbolic byte equality for the actual frontier loop. Rows stay arbitrary;
no concrete recurrence or output array is kernel-normalized. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result ControlFlow WP
namespace NBK_LiveBytes
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open AspisR1.S2K
open AspisR1.S2K.LoopStep (Digest Iter next)
open NBK_LiveStep
abbrev Rows := AfterstateLoop.Rows

def fold : List Digest → Nat → Slice U8 → Slice U8
  | [], _, out => out
  | node::rest, k, out => fold rest (k+1) (out.setSlice! (160+32*k) (DigestBytes.bytes node).val)

def Inv (rows : Rows) (target : Slice U8) (s : Iter × Slice U8) : Prop :=
  ∃ k : Usize, k.val ≤ 20 ∧ s.1 = Iterator.cursor rows k ∧ s.2.length = 800 ∧ fold (rows.val.drop k.val) k.val s.2 = target

theorem loop_exact (rows : Rows) (count : Usize) (bound : count.val ≤ 20)
    (output : Slice U8) (size : output.length = 800) :
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop (Iterator.cursor rows count) output =
      ok (fold (rows.val.drop count.val) count.val output) := by
  let target := fold (rows.val.drop count.val) count.val output
  have h : WP.spec (pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop (Iterator.cursor rows count) output)
      (fun out => out = target) := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat
      (fun s : Iter × Slice U8 => 20-s.1.count.val)
      (Inv rows target) (fun out : Slice U8 => out=target)
      (fun s : Iter × Slice U8 => body s.1 s.2)
      (Iterator.cursor rows count,output) ?_ ⟨count,bound,rfl,size,rfl⟩
    rintro ⟨iter,out⟩ ⟨k,hk,same,sz,rest⟩
    change iter = Iterator.cursor rows k at same
    simp only [same]
    by_cases more : k.val < 20
    · have valid : k.val < rows.val.length := by rw [rows.property]; exact more
      have dropped := List.drop_eq_getElem_cons valid
      rw [body_write _ _ out k _ (DigestBytes.bytes (rows.val[k.val]'valid))
        (Iterator.next_row rows k more) more sz (DigestBytes.exact (rows.val[k.val]'valid))]
      change (Inv rows target (_,_) ∧ (20-(Usize.ofNatCore (k.val+1) _).val) < 20-k.val)
      refine ⟨⟨Usize.ofNatCore (k.val+1) (by scalar_tac),?_,rfl,?_,?_⟩,?_⟩
      · change k.val+1 ≤ 20; omega
      · simpa only [Slice.length,Slice.setSlice!,List.length_setSlice!] using sz
      · change fold (rows.val.drop (k.val+1)) (k.val+1) _ = target
        simpa only [dropped,fold] using rest
      · change 20-(k.val+1) < 20-k.val; omega
    · have eqk : k=20#usize := by scalar_tac
      subst k
      have stopped := body_done _ _ out (Iterator.exhausted rows)
      rw [stopped]
      change out=target
      have ending : rows.val.drop (20#usize).val = [] := List.drop_eq_nil_of_le (by
        change rows.val.length ≤ 20
        have := rows.property
        change rows.val.length=20 at this
        omega)

import S6CurrentCodecTotalV1
import S6CurrentFirstInstallationV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S6N_Decoder
open AspisS6CurrentCodecInstallation AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier
open AspisS6OuterNativeOps

/-- Complete wrapper Result, including decoder rejection, fail and divergence.
Safe Box introduction/moves use the existing D188 standard model. -/
theorem complete (bytes : Slice U8) :
    decode bytes = (do
      let reply ← rawDecoder bytes
      match reply with
      | .Ok value => ok (.Ok value)
      | .Err _ => ok (.Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData)) :=
  boxed_eq boxOps bytes

/-- A continuation consumes exactly the returned owned value or exact error. -/
theorem contextual {A : Type} (bytes : Slice U8)
    (next : core.result.Result Statement PE → Result A) :
    (do let value ← decode bytes; next value) =
    (do
      let reply ← rawDecoder bytes
      match reply with
      | .Ok value => next (.Ok value)
      | .Err _ => next (.Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData)) := by
  rw [complete]
  cases rawDecoder bytes with
  | fail e => rfl
  | div => rfl
  | ok r => cases r <;> rfl

/-- Native caller acceptance identifies the decoder value, rather than
postulating an independently successful decoder on the same bytes. -/
theorem accepted_content (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : Statement)
    (accepted : decode bytes = ok (.Ok statement)) :
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes =
      ok (.Ok (toPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 statement)) :=
  decode_success bytes statement accepted

/-- The wrapper cannot manufacture success on decoder rejection. -/
theorem error (bytes : Slice U8) (e : FormatError)
    (rejected : rawDecoder bytes = ok (.Err e)) :
    decode bytes = ok (.Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData) := by
  rw [complete, rejected]
  rfl

#print axioms complete
#print axioms contextual
#print axioms accepted_content
#print axioms error
end AspisR1.S6N_Decoder

import S6CurrentFirstInstallationV1
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S6N_Getters
open AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1
abbrev Statement := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
abbrev Common := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalCommonV1
abbrev Public := pair_forest_semantic_terminal.r0.Public

def commonValue : Statement → Common
  | .PrivateTransfer common _ => common
  | .Withdrawal common _ => common

def publicValue : Statement → Public
  | .PrivateTransfer common pub => .Transfer pub common.lane_transition
  | .Withdrawal common pub => .Withdrawal pub common.lane_transition

/-- The complete extracted getters are total field projections on both enum
variants. No validator, decoder success or canonicality premise is used. -/
theorem complete (statement : Statement) :
    pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common statement = ok (commonValue statement) ∧
    pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public statement = ok (publicValue statement) := by
  cases statement <;> exact ⟨rfl,rfl⟩

/-- Arbitrary continuations retain the same statement and selected public
fields. This is the Aeneas value/borrow model; native pointer checks are separate. -/
theorem contextual {A : Type} (statement : Statement)
    (tail : Common → Public → Statement → Result A) :
    (do let common ← pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common statement
        let pub ← pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public statement
        tail common pub statement) =
      tail (commonValue statement) (publicValue statement) statement := by
  rw [(complete statement).1,(complete statement).2]
  rfl

/-- The source semantic projection is exactly the public carrier consumed by
S6 and Claims. The same statement is retained across the conversion. -/
theorem selected (statement : Statement) :
    AspisS6CurrentVerifierCarrier.toPublic (publicValue statement) =
      AspisR1CurrentCaller.FirstComposition.toCurrentPublic
        (AspisR1PublicPreparation.PreparationBinding.preparationPublic
          (AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.toPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 statement)) := by
  cases statement <;> rfl

#print axioms complete
#print axioms contextual
#print axioms selected
end AspisR1.S6N_Getters

import DrvC_Installation
import S6N_Decoder
import S6N_Getters
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S6N_Installation
open AspisS6CurrentCodecInstallation

/-- Value-level deployment certificate for the actual selected SDK. Native
safe ownership/cleanup is interpreted under D188, with source pins and native
checks in the S6N receipt packet; it is not a new hypothesis of deployed. -/
structure Facts (ops : AdapterRw.Ops) : Prop where
  installed : ops.op47 = decode
  complete : ∀ bytes, ops.op47 bytes = (do
    let reply ← rawDecoder bytes
    match reply with
    | .Ok value => ok (.Ok value)
    | .Err _ => ok (.Err AdapterRw.solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData))
  total : ∀ bytes, ∃ result, ops.op47 bytes = ok result
  getters : ∀ statement : S6N_Getters.Statement,
    AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.common statement =
      ok (S6N_Getters.commonValue statement) ∧
    AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public statement =
      ok (S6N_Getters.publicValue statement)

/-- Every installed configuration uses the concrete decoder. The free adapter
record does not supply a native/public equality or decoder success premise. -/
theorem facts {F E : Type} (c : DrvC_Installation.Configuration F E) :
    Facts (DrvC_Installation.sdk c) := by
  refine ⟨rfl,?_,?_,S6N_Getters.complete⟩
  · exact S6N_Decoder.complete
  · exact AspisS6CurrentCodecInstallation.decode_total

/-- Applies to the actual source-selected cut statement, preserving the same
public bytes and successful output. No independent decoder witness is chosen. -/
theorem accepted {F E : Type} (c : DrvC_Installation.Configuration F E)
    (bytes : Slice U8) (statement : Statement)
    (run : (DrvC_Installation.sdk c).op47 bytes = ok (.Ok statement)) :
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.decode_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 bytes =
      ok (.Ok (AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.toPoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1 statement)) ∧
    AdapterRw.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1.semantic_public statement =
      ok (S6N_Getters.publicValue statement) := by
  rw [(facts c).installed] at run
  exact ⟨S6N_Decoder.accepted_content bytes statement run,(S6N_Getters.complete statement).2⟩

#print axioms facts
#print axioms accepted
end AspisR1.S6N_Installation

theorem equality (input output : Slice U8) (start n : Nat) (length : output.length=n)
    (bound : start+n ≤ input.length)
    (same : ∀ j : Nat, (h : j<n) → output.val[j]'(by change output.val.length=n at length;omega) =
      input.val[start+j]'(by change start+n ≤ input.val.length at bound;omega)) :
    output.val=(input.val.drop start).take n := by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · change output.val.length=n at length
    change start+n ≤ input.val.length at bound
    simp only [List.length_take,List.length_drop,length]
    omega
  · intro j hi hj
    rw [List.getElem_take,List.getElem_drop]
    exact same j (by change output.val.length=n at length;omega)

theorem canonical_slice (input output : Slice U8) (start n : Nat) (length : output.length=n)
    (bound : start+n ≤ input.length) (a : start%4=0) (z : n%4=0)

import Op4P_Refinement
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.JFz_Canonical
open AspisV8R19.DuplexFrames OraclePortCompactDraft

theorem nil : canonical [] := by
  constructor
  · rfl
  · intro j hj
    simp only [List.length_nil, Nat.zero_div, List.mem_range] at hj
    omega

/-- Four-byte induction; evaluation of each numeral is confined to one word. -/
theorem cons4 (a b c d : Fin 256) (tail : Bytes)
    (word : little [a,b,c,d] < 2147483647) (rest : canonical tail) :
    canonical (a::b::c::d::tail) := by
  rcases rest with ⟨multiple, valid⟩
  constructor
  · simp only [List.length_cons]
    omega
  · intro j hj
    simp only [List.mem_range, List.length_cons] at hj
    cases j with
    | zero => simpa only [Nat.mul_zero, slice, List.drop_zero,
        List.take_succ_cons, List.take_zero] using word
    | succ j =>
      have hj' : j ∈ List.range (tail.length / 4) := by
        simp only [List.mem_range]
        omega
      have h := valid j hj'
      simpa only [slice, Nat.mul_succ, List.drop_succ_cons] using h

#print axioms nil
#print axioms cons4
end AspisR1.JFz_Canonical
end

  rw [← List.take_append_drop n ((xs.drop off).take (n+m))]
  simp only [List.take_take, Nat.min_eq_left (Nat.le_add_right n m),

namespace NBN_WordArrayEq
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem list_eq (xs ys : List U32) (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) :
    List.allM (fun (x,y) => do
      let b ← AspisR1TerminalDecoder.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.ne x y
      ok (decide (¬ b = true))) (xs.zip ys) = ok (decide (xs=ys)) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => cases ys <;> simp_all [List.allM,pure]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => simp_all
    | cons y ys =>
      have tail : xs.length=ys.length := by simpa using hlen
      rw [List.zip_cons_cons]
      simp only [List.allM]
      have eqv : (do let b ← AspisR1TerminalDecoder.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.ne x y; ok (decide (¬ b = true))) = ok (decide (x=y)) := by
        simp [AspisR1TerminalDecoder.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31,core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default, core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.default, AspisR1TerminalDecoder.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.eq]
      rw [eqv]
      by_cases same : x=y
      · simp only [same,decide_true,bind_tc_ok,if_pos]
        simpa only [List.cons.injEq, true_and, liftFun2, bind_tc_ok] using ih ys tail
      · simp [same,pure]

theorem source {n : Usize} (a b : Array U32 n) :
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq AspisR1TerminalDecoder.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31 a b = ok (decide (a=b)) := by
  unfold core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq
  have length : a.length=b.length := by have := a.property; have := b.property; scalar_tac
  rw [if_pos length, list_eq a.val b.val (by have := a.property; have := b.property; scalar_tac)]
  have eqv : (a.val=b.val) ↔ a=b := by
    cases a
    cases b
    constructor
    · intro h; cases h; rfl
    · intro h; cases h; rfl
  simp only [eqv]

import NBN_BindingChecks
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBN_StatementCut
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder NBN_StatementResult
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev PE := pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError
abbrev AE := pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.PoolV1PairForestAccountErrorV1
abbrev LE := pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1
abbrev E := NBN_StatementResult.Error

def tail (s : Statement) (lane : core.result.Result U8 AE) (late : core.result.Result Unit LE) :
    core.result.Result Unit E :=
  match lane with
  | .Err e => .Err (.Account e)
  | .Ok l => if l ≠ (common s).output_lane then .Err .OutputLaneMismatch
    else match late with
      | .Err e => .Err (.LaneTransition e)
      | .Ok _ => .Ok ()

/-- Exact native K003 control cut. Child values are arbitrary, not successful. -/
def run (s : Statement) (pay : Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PE))
    (lane : core.result.Result U8 AE) (late : core.result.Result Unit LE) : Result (core.result.Result Unit E) :=
  if (common s).master_account = zero ∨ (common s).checkpoint_account = zero ∨
      (common s).selected_lane_account = zero then ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding)
  else if 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val then ok (.Err .InvalidOutputLane)
  else do
    let r ← pay
    match r with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Payment e))
    | .Ok _ => ok (NBN_BindingChecks.chain (common s) (parts s) (tail s lane late))

theorem source (s : Statement) :
    pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s =
      run s (payment s) (NBN_OutputLane.result (parts s).2.2.2.2.1)
        (lateStatus (common s).lane_transition) := by
  rw [NBN_StatementResult.source]
  cases s <;> rfl

/-- Substitution uses only exact lower Results on the SAME input/variant. -/
theorem lower_substitution (s : Statement)
    (pay : Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PE))
    (lane : core.result.Result U8 AE) (late : core.result.Result Unit LE)
    (payment_exact : pay = payment s)
    (lane_exact : lane = NBN_OutputLane.result (parts s).2.2.2.2.1)
    (late_exact : late = lateStatus (common s).lane_transition) :
    run s pay lane late =
      pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s := by
  rw [payment_exact,lane_exact,late_exact,source]

#print axioms source
#print axioms lower_substitution
end NBN_StatementCut

    cases unit

      cases s with

import NBK_LiveStep
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NBN_IteratorAssociation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1.S2K AspisR1.S2K.LoopStep
abbrev Rows := Array Digest 20#usize
abbrev Observation := Option (Nat × Digest) × Nat × Nat

def observe (out : Option (Usize × Digest) × Iter) : Observation :=
  (out.1.map (fun (k,d) => (k.val,d)),out.2.count.val,
    out.2.iter.slice.length - out.2.iter.i)

def projected (rows : Rows) (k : Usize) : Result Observation := do
  let step ← next (Iterator.cursor rows k)
  ok (observe step)

/-- Same index/row/next_index/remaining tuple as the native one-step K009 gate. -/
theorem next_row (rows : Rows) (k : Usize) (bound : k.val < 20) :
    projected rows k = ok
      (some (k.val,rows.val[k.val]'(by have := rows.property; scalar_tac)),
       k.val+1,19-k.val) := by
  rw [projected,Iterator.next_row rows k bound]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,observe,Option.map_some,Iterator.cursor,
    Slice.length,Array.to_slice,rows.property]
  simp [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]

theorem exhausted (rows : Rows) : projected rows 20#usize = ok (none,20,0) := by
  rw [projected,Iterator.exhausted]
  simp [observe,Iterator.cursor,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,rows.property]

#print axioms next_row
#print axioms exhausted
end NBN_IteratorAssociation

theorem fromLEBytes_cast {b : BitVec 32} {bs : List Byte}
    (same : bs=b.toLEBytes) : (BitVec.fromLEBytes bs).cast (by rw [same];simp [BitVec.toLEBytes_length])=b := by
  cases same
  rw [BitVec.fromLEBytes_toLEBytes (by decide : 32%8=0)]
  simp

theorem from_to (x : U32) : core.num.U32.from_le_bytes (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x)=x := by
  have point : ∀ b : Byte,U8.bv (UScalar.mk b)=b := by intro b;rfl
  have map : List.map U8.bv (List.map UScalar.mk x.bv.toLEBytes)=x.bv.toLEBytes := by
    rw [List.map_map]
    simpa [Function.comp_def] using congrArg (fun f : Byte → Byte => List.map f x.bv.toLEBytes) (funext point)
  apply U32.bv_eq_imp_eq
  simp only [core.num.U32.from_le_bytes,core.num.U32.to_le_bytes]
  exact fromLEBytes_cast map

theorem word_length (x : U32) : (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x).val.length=4 :=
  (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x).property

@[simp] theorem take_word (x : U32) : (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x).val.take 4=(core.num.U32.to_le_bytes x).val :=
  List.take_of_length_le (by rw [word_length])

theorem injective (a b : Array U32 8#usize)
    (same : AspisS6SourceCodec.DigestContents.chunks a=AspisS6SourceCodec.DigestContents.chunks b) : a=b := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [a.property,b.property]
  · intro i ha hb
    have small : i<8 := by simpa only [a.property,show (8#usize).val=8 from rfl] using ha
    have selected:=congrArg (fun xs : List U8 => (xs.drop (4*i)).take 4) same
    have word : (core.num.U32.to_le_bytes a.val[i]).val=(core.num.U32.to_le_bytes b.val[i]).val := by
      interval_cases i <;>
        simpa [AspisS6SourceCodec.DigestContents.chunks,word_length,List.drop_append,List.take_append] using selected
    have arrays : core.num.U32.to_le_bytes a.val[i]=core.num.U32.to_le_bytes b.val[i] := Subtype.ext word
    simpa only [from_to] using congrArg core.num.U32.from_le_bytes arrays

#print axioms fromLEBytes_cast

import Aeneas

/-! Aeneas discriminant readers with enum-qualified instance names for import unions.
The pinned generator supplies both commands; only its anonymous instance name
is changed. Scalar types, explicit tags, generic binders and reader bodies are
preserved. This adapter must be rebuilt when the Aeneas generator is repinned. -/
open Lean Elab Term Meta
open Lean.Parser.Term Lean.Parser.Command

namespace JHd_Discriminant

syntax (name := JHdNamedDiscriminant) "JHd_discriminant" ident ("["num,*"]")? : attr

initialize JHdNamedDiscriminantAttribute : AttributeImpl ← do
  let attrImpl : AttributeImpl := {
    «name» := `JHdNamedDiscriminant,
    descr := "Emit the Aeneas reader with an enum-qualified instance name",
    add := fun declName stx _ => do
      let (ty, values) ← match stx with
        | `(attr| JHd_discriminant $ty) =>
          pure (← Aeneas.Discriminant.elabTypeToken ty, none)
        | `(attr| JHd_discriminant $ty [$xs,*]) =>
          pure (← Aeneas.Discriminant.elabTypeToken ty,
            some ((xs.getElems.toList.map Syntax.isNatLit?).map Option.get!))
        | _ => throwUnsupportedSyntax
      liftCommandElabM do
        let cmds ← Lean.Elab.Command.liftTermElabM
          (Aeneas.Discriminant.generateReadDiscriminantCmds declName ty values)
        Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand cmds[0]!
        let instName := mkIdent (declName ++ `instDiscriminant)
        let id ← `(Parser.Command.declId| $instName:ident)
        let inst := cmds[1]!.rewriteBottomUp fun node => Id.run do
          if node.isOfKind ``Lean.Parser.Command.instance then
            return node.setArg 3 (mkNullNode #[id.raw])
          return node
        if inst == cmds[1]! then
          throwError "Pinned Aeneas generator no longer emits an instance command"
        Lean.Elab.Command.elabCommand inst
  }
  registerBuiltinAttribute attrImpl
  pure attrImpl

end JHd_Discriminant

model delegates to the existing Aeneas slice/slice comparator after the
array-to-slice coercion. Kani's slice_array_header_comparison_model checks eq

  core.slice.cmp.PartialEqSlice.ne cmp s a.to_slice

import S2W_D189Wrappers
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace AspisR1.JGx_SdkContinuation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open _root_.AdapterRw

def afterValidation (ops : Ops) (accounts : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts)
    (validated : r1_pool_adapter.ValidatedAsqa) : Result (core.result.Result Unit solana_program_error.ProgramError) := do
  let oa ← Slice.index_usize accounts 0#usize
  let r1 ← (r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops) oa
  let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
  match cf1 with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val1 =>
    let oa1 ← Slice.index_usize accounts 6#usize
    let r2 ← (r1_pool_adapter.owned.OwnedAccount.data ops) oa1
    let cf2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r2
    match cf2 with
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val2 =>
      let proof_start ←
        (aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_VERIFIED_AFTERSTATE_BYTES ops)
      let o1 ← lift (Usize.checked_add proof_start validated.proof_length)
      let r3 ←
        core.option.Option.ok_or o1
          solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData
      let cf3 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
      match cf3 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val3 =>
        let i1 := Slice.len val1
        if i1 != val3
        then
          ok (core.result.Result.Err
            solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidAccountData)
        else
          let r4 ←
            ops.op22
              validated.statement
          let r5 ←
            core.result.Result.map_err
              r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1ProgramError
              r4 ()
          let cf4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r5
          match cf4 with
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val4 =>
            let s1 ← lift (Array.to_slice val4)
            let i2 := Slice.len s1
            let i3 ←
              (aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_STATEMENT_BYTES ops)
            if i2 != i3
            then
              ok (core.result.Result.Err
                solana_program_error.ProgramError.InvalidInstructionData)
            else
              let s2 ← lift (Array.to_slice val4)
              let s3 ←
                core.slice.index.Slice.index
                  (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8)
                  val1 { start := proof_start, «end» := val3 }
              let o2 ← (observer ops)
              let r6 ←
                ops.op11
                  (SolanaDigest.Insts.Aspis_coreDigestDigest32 ops) s2 s3 val2
                  () o2
              let r7 ←
                core.result.Result.map_err (BuiltinFnOnce
                  aspis_r1_cost_probe.verifier.Error
                  solana_program_error.ProgramError) r6 (ops.op44)
              let cf5 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r7
              match cf5 with
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
                ops.op53 validated.statement
              | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
                core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
                  Unit (core.convert.FromSame
                  solana_program_error.ProgramError) residual
          | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
            core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
              Unit (core.convert.FromSame
              solana_program_error.ProgramError) residual
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          Unit (core.convert.FromSame solana_program_error.ProgramError)
          residual
    | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
        Unit (core.convert.FromSame solana_program_error.ProgramError)
        residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      Unit (core.convert.FromSame solana_program_error.ProgramError)
      residual

#print axioms afterValidation
end AspisR1.JGx_SdkContinuation
end

import JGx_SdkContinuation
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AspisR1.JGx_SdkAfterValidationEq
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

theorem source (ops : Ops) (program : solana_pubkey.Pubkey)
    (accounts : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Accounts) (data : Slice U8)
    (slot : S2W_ExtractionBoundary.Slot)
    (validated : r1_pool_adapter.ValidatedAsqa)
    (count : Slice.len accounts=7#usize)
    (magic : (do
      let o ← core.slice.Slice.get (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice U8) data {«end»:=4#usize}
      let s ← core.array.Array.index (core.ops.index.IndexSlice
        ((core.ops.range.RangeFull.Insts.CoreSliceIndexSliceIndexSliceSlice ops) U8))
        aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_TERMINAL_REQUEST_MAGIC ()
      core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default ((core.option.Option.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqOption ops)
        (core.cmp.PartialEqShared (Slice.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqSlice core.cmp.PartialEqU8))) o (some s))=ok false)
    (validation : r1_pool_adapter.owned.validate_asq8 ops program accounts data slot=ok (.Ok validated)) :
    r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned ops program accounts data slot=
      JGx_SdkContinuation.afterValidation ops accounts validated := by
  unfold r1_pool_adapter.owned.stage2_owned
  rw [count]
  simp only [show (7#usize !=7#usize)=false from by decide,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
  obtain ⟨o,read,rest⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ magic
  obtain ⟨s,index,neq⟩ := AdapterRw.Cuts.bind_success _ _ _ rest
  rw [read,bind_tc_ok,index,bind_tc_ok,neq,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
  rw [validation,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,bind_tc_ok]
  rfl
#print axioms source
end AspisR1.JGx_SdkAfterValidationEq

import JFt_DigestInjective
import JFu_PublicRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace AspisR1.JFt_Digest42
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result

def value : Array AspisR1TerminalDecoder.aspis_core.field.M31 8#usize :=
  Array.make 8#usize [19381883#u32,1308966873#u32,251977766#u32,474343397#u32,2069732268#u32,1863820229#u32,152153379#u32,665567443#u32]

/-- Exact numeric value is identified by the symbolic byte-injectivity lemma. -/
theorem local_call : AspisS6NativeSnapshotReadDigest.read_digest JFu_PublicDigest42.window=ok (.Ok value) := by
  obtain ⟨out,call,canon,contents⟩:=JFu_DigestSliceFacts.source JFu_PublicDigest42.window
    JFu_PublicDigest42.length JFu_PublicDigest42.canonical_bytes
  have bytes : AspisS6SourceCodec.DigestContents.chunks value=JFu_PublicDigest42.bytes := by
    simp [AspisS6SourceCodec.DigestContents.chunks,value,Array.make,core.num.U32.to_le_bytes,BitVec.toLEBytes,JFu_PublicDigest42.bytes]
    <;> (repeat' constructor) <;> scalar_tac
  have same : out=value := JFt_DigestInjective.injective out value (contents.trans bytes.symm)
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

theorem selected : JFu_PublicRange.segment 1632 32 (by decide)=JFu_PublicDigest42.window := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  dsimp only [JFu_PublicRange.segment,JFu_PublicDigest42.window]
  exact JFu_PublicDigest42.selected

theorem source : AspisS6NativeSnapshotReadDigest.read_digest
    (JFu_PublicRange.segment 1632 32 (by decide))=ok (.Ok value) := by
  rw [selected]
  exact local_call

theorem canonical : JFu_DigestCanonical.Canonical value :=
  JFu_DigestSliceCanonical.source _ _ source

#print axioms local_call
#print axioms selected
#print axioms source
#print axioms canonical
end AspisR1.JFt_Digest42

@[local step] theorem digest (q : Array U32 8#usize) (canon : JFu_DigestCanonical.Canonical q) :
    pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.digest_is_canonical q ⦃ b => b=true ⦄ := by
  rw [JFu_DigestCheck.source q canon,WP.spec_ok]

theorem source (a : Array (Array U32 8#usize) 20#usize)
    (canon : ∀ i : Fin 20,JFu_DigestCanonical.Canonical
      (a.val[i.val]'(by simpa only [a.property,show (20#usize).val=20 from rfl] using i.isLt))) :
    pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop a 0#usize=ok (.Ok ()) := by
  have spec : pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop a 0#usize
      ⦃ out => out=.Ok () ⦄ := by
    unfold pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat
      (fun i : Usize => 20-i.val) (fun i : Usize => i.val≤20)
      (fun out => out=.Ok ())
      (fun i => pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop.body a i)
      0#usize ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      unfold pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop.body
      step*
      all_goals first
        | scalar_tac
        | (simp_all;exact canon ⟨i.val,by scalar_tac⟩)
    · scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨out,call,same⟩:=WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

import JFu_FrontierCheck

namespace AspisR1.JFu_SnapshotValidator
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile

theorem capacity : POOL_V1_PAIR_CAPACITY=ok 1048576#u64 := by
  unfold POOL_V1_PAIR_CAPACITY POOL_V1_PAIR_TREE_DEPTH pool_v1.format.POOL_V1_TREE_DEPTH
  rfl

theorem source (s : PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1)
    (pool : core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 s.pool (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)=ok false)
    (domain : core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8 s.deployment_domain (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8)=ok false)
    (sequence : s.sequence=s.next_pair_index) (small : s.next_pair_index.val<1048576)
    (root : JFu_DigestCanonical.Canonical s.current_root)
    (frontier : ∀ i : Fin 20,JFu_DigestCanonical.Canonical
      (s.frontier.val[i.val]'(by simpa only [s.frontier.property,show (20#usize).val=20 from rfl] using i.isLt))) :
    validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s=ok (.Ok ()) := by
  unfold validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1
  dsimp only
  rw [pool,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
  rw [domain,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte]
  have check : ¬s.next_pair_index ≥ 1048576#u64 := by scalar_tac
  have seqCheck : (s.sequence != s.next_pair_index)=false := by simp [sequence]
  simp only [seqCheck,Bool.false_eq_true,↓reduceIte,capacity,bind_tc_ok,if_neg check]
  rw [JFu_DigestCheck.source s.current_root root,bind_tc_ok]
  simp only [↓reduceIte]
  exact JFu_FrontierCheck.source s.frontier frontier

end AspisR1.JFu_SnapshotValidator

def slice {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize) : Slice U8 :=
  ⟨output.val.slice start.val stop.val, by scalar_tac⟩

theorem index_mut {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val) :
    core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
      output {start,«end»:=stop} =
    ok (slice output start stop,fun s => output.setSlice! start.val s.val) := by
  simp [core.array.Array.index_mut,core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice,Slice.length,Slice.len,order,bound,output.property,
    Array.from_slice,Aeneas.Std.Array.setSlice!,slice]

theorem copy {W : Usize} (s : Slice U8) (bytes : Array U8 W)
    (width : s.length = W.val) :
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice = ok bytes.to_slice := by
  simp [core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,Slice.len,Slice.length,
    Array.to_slice,bytes.property,width]
theorem slice_length {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val) :
    (slice output start stop).length = stop.val-start.val := by
  simp only [slice,Slice.length,List.slice,List.length_take,List.length_drop,output.property]
  omega

theorem copy_range {N W : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 (slice output start stop) bytes.to_slice =
      ok bytes.to_slice :=
  copy _ bytes ((slice_length output start stop order bound).trans width)

theorem prefix_index {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (stop : Usize) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val) :
    core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice U8))
      output {«end»:=stop} =
    ok (slice output 0#usize stop,fun s => output.setSlice! 0 s.val) := by

    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeToUsizeSlice.index_mut,
    Array.to_slice,Slice.length,Slice.len,bound,output.property,
    Array.from_slice,Aeneas.Std.Array.setSlice!,slice]

theorem suffix_index {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start : Usize) (bound : start.val ≤ N.val) :

    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice,

    Array.from_slice,Aeneas.Std.Array.setSlice!,slice,List.slice,List.take_length,List.length_drop]
  apply Subtype.ext

  have len : (output.val.drop start.val).length = N.val-start.val := by simp [output.property]

import Aeneas
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NBP_Store
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result WP

def store {N W : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) : Result (Array U8 N) := do
  let (s,back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
    (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
    output {start,«end»:=stop}
  let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
  let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
  ok (back copied)

theorem exact {N W : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    store output start stop bytes = ok (output.setSlice! start.val bytes.val) := by
  have room : W.val ≤ N.val-start.val := by omega
  simp only [store,core.array.Array.index_mut,core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice,
    core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut,Array.to_slice]
  simp [Slice.length,Slice.len,order,bound,output.property,bytes.property,
    core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,List.slice,width,Nat.min_eq_left room,
    Array.from_slice,lift]
  rfl

theorem store_then {N W : Usize} {T : Type} (output : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (bytes : Array U8 W) (k : Array U8 N → Result T)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    (do
      let (s,back) ← core.array.Array.index_mut
        (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
        output {start,«end»:=stop}
      let src ← lift (Array.to_slice bytes)
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s src
      k (back copied)) = k (output.setSlice! start.val bytes.val) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun r => r >>= k) (exact output start stop bytes order bound width)
  cases indexed : core.array.Array.index_mut
      (core.ops.index.IndexMutSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
      output {start,«end»:=stop} with
  | fail e => simp only [store,indexed,bind_tc_fail] at h ⊢; exact h
  | div => simp only [store,indexed,bind_tc_div] at h ⊢; exact h
  | ok pair =>
    rcases pair with ⟨s,back⟩
    simp only [store,indexed,bind_tc_ok] at h ⊢
    change ((do
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice
      ok (back copied)) >>= k) = _ at h
    change (do
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice
      k (back copied)) = _
    cases copied : core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s bytes.to_slice <;>
      simpa only [copied,bind_tc_ok,bind_tc_fail,bind_tc_div] using h
theorem update {N : Usize} (output : Array U8 N) (index : Usize) (value : U8)
    (bound : index.val < N.val) :
    output.update index value = ok (output.set index value) := by
  obtain ⟨out,call,same⟩ := spec_imp_exists
    (Array.update_spec output index value (by simpa only [Array.length,output.property] using bound))
  simpa only [same] using call
#print axioms update
#print axioms exact
#print axioms store_then
#print Array.update
#print Array.setSlice!
end NBP_Store

theorem afterstate_loop (a : Frontier) :
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop a 0#usize =
    ok (if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalAfterstate) := by
  have spec : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop a 0#usize
      ⦃ r => r = if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalAfterstate ⦄ := by
    unfold aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop
    refine loop.spec_decr_nat (fun i : Usize => 20-i.val)
      (fun i : Usize => i.val ≤ 20 ∧ (CanonicalFrom a 0 ↔ CanonicalFrom a i.val))
      (fun r => r = if CanonicalFrom a 0 then .Ok () else .Err .NonCanonicalAfterstate)
      (fun i => aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop.body a i) 0#usize ?_ ?_
    · intro i hi
      rcases hi with ⟨bound,eqv⟩
      unfold aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.validate_verified_afterstate_loop.body
      simp only [NED_ScannerCohorts.profile_result]
      step*
      all_goals simp_all [CanonicalFrom]
      all_goals first | scalar_tac | skip
      · refine ⟨by scalar_tac, ?_, by scalar_tac⟩
        constructor
        · intro h j hj; exact h j (by omega)
        · intro h j hj
          by_cases same : j.val = i.val
          · simpa only [same] using (show Canonical (a.val[i.val]'(by have := a.property; scalar_tac)) from by assumption)
          · exact h j (by omega)
      · refine ⟨⟨i.val, by scalar_tac⟩, Nat.le_refl _, ?_⟩
        assumption
    · exact ⟨by scalar_tac, Iff.rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨r,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

import NED_RawAfterValidator

attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev Snapshot := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1
abbrev Error := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLiveSnapshotErrorV1

def result (s : Snapshot) : core.result.Result Unit Error :=
  if s.pool = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 ∨ s.deployment_domain = Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8 then .Err .ZeroRequiredBinding
  else if s.sequence ≠ s.next_pair_index then .Err .SequenceIndexMismatch
  else if 1048576 ≤ s.next_pair_index.val then .Err .TreeFull
  else if Canonical s.current_root ∧ CanonicalFrom s.frontier 0 then .Ok ()
  else .Err .NonCanonicalDigest

theorem source (s : Snapshot) :
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s = ok (result s) := by
  have spec : aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s
      ⦃ r => r = result s ⦄ := by
    unfold aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.validate_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1
    rw [NED_ScannerCohorts.profile_result, NED_RawLiveFrontier.live_loop]

      aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_TREE_DEPTH
    step*
    all_goals simp_all [result]
    all_goals scalar_tac
  obtain ⟨r,call,same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists spec
  rw [same] at call
  exact call

 | .ok r => .ok (mapResult f r)
 | .fail e => .fail e
 | .div => .div

/-- Reuse the symbolic bounded-store and frontier-fold theorems; no concrete
688-byte prefix or entire loop is evaluated by definitional equality. -/
theorem result (s : TAfter) :
    AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 (toRawAfter s) =
    mapOuter toRawPoolV1PairVerifierTransportErrorV1
      (AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 s) := by
  rw [NBK_AfterstateResult.source]
  unfold AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1
  rw [NED_LateValidatorCohorts.after]
  cases valid : NBH_Validators.afterResult s with
  | Err e => simp [mapResult,mapOuter,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
      core.convert.FromSame]
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp only [mapResult,bind_tc_ok,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,mapOuter]
    simp only [toRawAfter,AspisR1.JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PairVerifiedAfterstateV1,

      NED_AfterEncodingConstants.magic,NED_AfterEncodingConstants.transport_version,
      NED_AfterEncodingConstants.storage_version,NED_AfterEncodingConstants.digest_version]

    change AfterstatePrepare.run s output (fun iter out => do
      let encoded ← AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1_loop iter out
      ok (core.result.Result.Ok encoded)) = _
    rw [AfterstatePrepare.exact]
    rw [AfterstateBytes.loop_exact s.next_frontier 0#usize (by decide)]
    rfl

namespace NED_LiveEncodingCohort

def mapStateOuter {α E F State : Type} (f : E → F) :
    Result (core.result.Result α E × State) → Result (core.result.Result α F × State)
 | .ok (r,st) => .ok (mapResult f r,st)
 | .fail e => .fail e
 | .div => .div

theorem result (s : TSnapshot) (out : Slice U8) :
    AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 (toRawSnapshot s) out =
    mapStateOuter toRawPoolV1PairLiveSnapshotErrorV1
      (AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 s out) := by
  rw [NBK_LiveResult.source]
  by_cases size : out.length = 800
  · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr size)]
    have len : Slice.len out = 800#usize := by scalar_tac
    unfold AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1
    simp only [NED_LiveEncodingConstants.size,len,bne_self_eq_false,if_false]
    rw [NED_LateValidatorCohorts.snapshot]
    cases valid : NBH_LiveValidator.result s with
    | Err e => simp [mapResult,mapStateOuter,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual,
        core.convert.FromSame]
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      simp only [mapResult,bind_tc_ok,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch,mapStateOuter]
      simp only [toRawSnapshot,AspisR1.JHf_Carrier.toPoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1,
        AspisS6CurrentAdapterCarrier.fromPoolV1PairLiveSnapshotV1,
        NED_DigestCohorts.digest_encode,NED_EncoderLoopCohorts.live_loop,
        NED_LiveEncodingConstants.magic,NED_LiveEncodingConstants.version,NED_LiveEncodingConstants.format]
      have fill : core.slice.Slice.fill core.clone.CloneU8 out 0#u8 = ok NBK_LiveResult.zero := by
        rw [NBK_Fill.source]
        congr 1
        apply Subtype.ext
        change List.replicate out.length 0#u8 = List.replicate 800 0#u8
        rw [size]
      rw [fill]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      have zero_size : NBK_LiveResult.zero.length = 800 := by
        simp only [NBK_LiveResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
        rfl
      have prepared_size : (NBK_LivePrepare.value s NBK_LiveResult.zero).length = 800 := by
        simp only [NBK_LivePrepare.value,Slice.length,NBK_LiveResult.zero,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,
          List.length_setSlice!,List.length_set,List.length_replicate]
        rfl
      change NBK_LivePrepare.run s NBK_LiveResult.zero (fun iter bytes => do
        let encoded ← AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1_loop iter bytes
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok (),encoded)) = _
      rw [NBK_LivePrepare.exact s NBK_LiveResult.zero zero_size]
      rw [NBK_LiveBytes.loop_exact s.frontier 0#usize (by decide) _ prepared_size]
      rfl
  · rw [if_pos size]
    have len : Slice.len out ≠ 800#usize := by scalar_tac
    simp only [AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1,
      NED_LiveEncodingConstants.size,ne_eq,bne_iff_ne,len,not_false_eq_true,if_true,mapStateOuter,mapResult,
      toRawPoolV1PairLiveSnapshotErrorV1]

end NED_LiveEncodingCohort

import NED_LiveEncodingCohort
import NBN_LateTail
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_RawLateTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1.S2K
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement
open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile
abbrev Statement := NED_LateCarriers.TLate
abbrev Error := PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1

def run (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit Error × Slice U8) := do
  let i7 ← 32#usize + POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES
  let (s15, back) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
    (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8) output {start := 32#usize, «end» := i7}
  let (r, s16) ← encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 (NED_LateCarriers.toRawSnapshot s.live_snapshot) s15
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Snapshot e), back s16)
  | .Ok _ =>
    let r2 ← pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 (NED_LateCarriers.toRawAfter s.candidate_afterstate)
    match r2 with
    | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Afterstate e), back s16)
    | .Ok bytes =>
      let (dest, back2) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut
        (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice U8) (back s16) {start := i7}
      let copied ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 dest bytes.to_slice
      ok (.Ok (), back2 copied)

 theorem exact (s : Statement) (output : Slice U8) (size : output.length = 1520) :
    run s output = ok (NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1
      (NBN_LateTail.status s), NBN_LateTail.value s output) := by
  have len : output.val.length = 1520 := size
  unfold run
  simp only [NED_LiveEncodingConstants.size]
  have add : 32#usize + 800#usize = ok 832#usize := by
    have h : (32#usize + 800#usize) ⦃ r => r = 832#usize ⦄ := by step*
    obtain ⟨r, call, same⟩ := WP.spec_imp_exists h
    exact same ▸ call
  rw [add]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  simp [core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index_mut, Slice.length,Slice.len,len]
  rw [NED_LiveEncodingCohort.result,NBK_LiveResult.source]
  simp [Slice.length, Slice.slice,List.slice,len]
  cases hv : NBH_LiveValidator.result s.live_snapshot with
  | Err e =>
    simp [NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,NED_AfterEncodingCohort.mapOuter,NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult,NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1,hv,NBN_LateTail.status,NBN_LateTail.value,bind_tc_ok]
    apply Subtype.ext
    simp only [List.setSlice!,List.length_take,List.length_drop,len]
    simp only [show min 800 (1520-32) = 800 by decide,
      show min 800 (min 800 (1520-32)) = 800 by decide]
    simp only [List.take_take,Nat.min_self]
    have restored := List.take_append_drop 800 (output.val.drop 32)
    simp only [List.drop_drop] at restored
    simpa only [List.append_assoc, restored, List.take_append_drop]
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    simp only [hv,bind_tc_ok,NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult]
    rw [NED_AfterEncodingCohort.result,NBK_AfterstateResult.source]
    cases ha : NBH_Validators.afterResult s.candidate_afterstate with
    | Err e => simp [NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,NED_AfterEncodingCohort.mapOuter,NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult,NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1,ha,NBN_LateTail.status,NBN_LateTail.value,hv,bind_tc_ok,Slice.setSlice!]
    | Ok u =>
      cases u
      simp [NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,NED_AfterEncodingCohort.mapOuter,NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult,NED_ErrorCarriers.toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1,ha,hv,NBN_LateTail.status,NBN_LateTail.value,bind_tc_ok,
        core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut,core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice.index_mut,
        core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice,Array.to_slice,Slice.length,Slice.len,
        Slice.slice,List.slice,List.length_setSlice!,len,NBN_LateTail.live_length,
        (AfterstateEncoding.bytes s.candidate_afterstate).property,Slice.setSlice!,lift]

#print axioms exact
end NED_RawLateTail

set_option autoImplicit false

open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace NED_RawLateFactor
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct

open pool_v1.pair_tree_profile

def raw (statement : NED_LateCarriers.TLate) (output : Slice U8) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 × Slice U8) := do
      let i7 ← 32#usize + pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.POOL_V1_PAIR_LIVE_SNAPSHOT_BYTES
      let (s15, index_mut_back5) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice Std.U8) output { start := 32#usize, «end» := i7 }
      let (r, s16) ← pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_live_snapshot_v1 (NED_LateCarriers.toRawSnapshot statement.live_snapshot) s15
      let r1 ← core.result.Result.map_err pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1.closure.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairLiveSnapshotErrorV1PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 r ()
      let cf ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r1
      match cf with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        let r2 ← pool_v1.pair_terminal.encode_pool_v1_pair_verified_afterstate_v1 (NED_LateCarriers.toRawAfter statement.candidate_afterstate)
        let r3 ← core.result.Result.map_err pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1.closure_1.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairVerifierTransportErrorV1PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1 r2 ()
        let cf1 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
        match cf1 with
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val => let output9 := index_mut_back5 s16
                                                            let (s17, index_mut_back6) ← core.slice.index.Slice.index_mut (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeFromUsizeSlice Std.U8) output9 { start := i7 }
                                                            let s18 ← lift (Array.to_slice val)
                                                            let s19 ← core.slice.Slice.copy_from_slice core.marker.CopyU8 s17 s18
                                                            let output10 := index_mut_back6 s19
                                                            ok (core.result.Result.Ok (), output10)
        | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => let r4 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual Unit (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1) residual
                                                              let output9 := index_mut_back5 s16
                                                              ok (r4, output9)
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual => let r2 ← core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual Unit (core.convert.FromSame pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.PoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1) residual
                                                            let output9 := index_mut_back5 s16
                                                            ok (r2, output9)


theorem raw_eq (s : NED_LateCarriers.TLate) (output : Slice U8) :
    raw s output = NED_RawLateTail.run s output := by
  unfold raw NED_RawLateTail.run
  apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
  intro i7
  apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
  intro window
  rcases window with ⟨input,back⟩
  apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
  intro child
  rcases child with ⟨r,live⟩
  cases r with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok u =>
    cases u
    dsimp only [Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,bind_tc_ok,
      core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
    apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
    intro after
    cases after <;> rfl

#print axioms raw_eq
end NED_RawLateFactor

import NED_RawLateSource
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_LateEncodingCohort
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NED_LateCarriers NED_LateValidatorCohorts NED_ErrorCarriers
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
open aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile

theorem result (s : TLate) (out : Slice U8) :
    encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 (toRawLate s) out =
    NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1
      (AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1 s out) := by
  rw [NBN_LateResult.source]
  by_cases size : out.length = 1520
  · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr size)]
    by_cases index : U64.checked_add s.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 =
        some s.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
    · rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr index),NED_RawLateSource.factor s out size index]
      have fill : core.slice.Slice.fill core.clone.CloneU8 out 0#u8 = ok NBN_LateResult.zero := by
        rw [NBK_Fill.source]
        congr 1
        apply Subtype.ext
        change List.replicate out.length 0#u8 = List.replicate 1520 0#u8
        rw [size]
      have zero_size : NBN_LateResult.zero.length = 1520 := by
        simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
        rfl
      rw [fill]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [NED_RawLatePrepare.exact NBN_LateResult.zero zero_size]
      change NED_RawLateTail.run s NBN_LateResult.header = _
      rw [NED_RawLateTail.exact s _ NBN_LateResult.header_length]
      rfl
    · rw [if_pos index]
      have len : Slice.len out = 1520#usize := by scalar_tac
      simp [encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1,NED_LateEncodingConstants.size,
        NED_LateCarrierFields.live,NED_LateCarrierFields.after,NED_LateCarrierFields.live_index,
        NED_LateCarrierFields.after_index,len,lift,NED_RawLatePreflight.option_ne,index,
        NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,mapResult,toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1]
  · rw [if_pos size]
    have guard : (Slice.len out != 1520#usize) = true := by scalar_tac
    simp only [encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1,NED_LateEncodingConstants.size,
      bind_tc_ok,guard,if_true,NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,mapResult,
      toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1]

#print axioms result
end NED_LateEncodingCohort

import NED_LateEncodingCohort
import NED_TransferEncodingCohort
import NED_WithdrawalEncodingCohort
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_ValidatorStatus
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBN_StatementResult
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def payment (s : Statement) : core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize) PaymentError :=
  match s with
  | .PrivateTransfer _ p => NBP_PaymentModel.transfer_encoded p
  | .Withdrawal _ p => NBP_PaymentModel.withdrawal_encoded p

def status (s : Statement) : core.result.Result Unit NBN_StatementResult.Error :=
  let c := common s
  if c.master_account = zero ∨ c.checkpoint_account = zero ∨ c.selected_lane_account = zero then .Err .NonZeroBinding
  else if 8 ≤ c.output_lane.val then .Err .InvalidOutputLane
  else match payment s with
    | .Err e => .Err (.Payment e)
    | .Ok _ => suffix s

theorem payment_source (s : Statement) : NBN_StatementResult.payment s = ok (payment s) := by
  cases s <;> simp only [NBN_StatementResult.payment,payment,NBP_TransferEncode.result,NBP_WithdrawalEncode.result]

theorem source (s : Statement) :
    AspisR1TerminalDecoder.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (status s) := by
  rw [NBN_StatementResult.source]
  unfold NBN_StatementResult.result status
  rw [payment_source]
  dsimp (config := {zeta := true,zetaHave := true}) only
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  by_cases zero : (common s).master_account = NBN_StatementResult.zero ∨
      (common s).checkpoint_account = NBN_StatementResult.zero ∨
      (common s).selected_lane_account = NBN_StatementResult.zero
  · simp only [if_pos zero]
  · simp only [if_neg zero]
    by_cases lane : 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val
    · simp only [if_pos lane]
    · simp only [if_neg lane]
      cases h : payment s <;> rfl

#print axioms payment_source
#print axioms source
end NED_ValidatorStatus

import NBH_ArrayEq
import NED_DigestCohorts
set_option autoImplicit false
set_option linter.unusedSimpArgs false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_RawWordArrayEq
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

theorem list_eq (xs ys : List U32) (hlen : xs.length = ys.length) :
    List.allM (fun (x,y) => do
      let b ← AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.ne x y
      ok (decide (¬ b = true))) (xs.zip ys) = ok (decide (xs=ys)) := by
  induction xs generalizing ys with
  | nil => cases ys <;> simp_all [List.allM,pure]
  | cons x xs ih =>
    cases ys with
    | nil => simp_all
    | cons y ys =>
      have tail : xs.length=ys.length := by simpa using hlen
      rw [List.zip_cons_cons]
      simp only [List.allM]
      have eqv : (do let b ← AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.ne x y; ok (decide (¬ b = true))) = ok (decide (x=y)) := by
        simp [AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31,core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.trait_default, core.cmp.PartialEq.ne.default, AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31.eq]
      rw [eqv]
      by_cases same : x=y
      · simp only [same,decide_true,bind_tc_ok,if_pos]
        simpa only [List.cons.injEq, true_and, liftFun2, bind_tc_ok] using ih ys tail
      · simp [same,pure]

theorem source {n : Usize} (a b : Array U32 n) :
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31 a b = ok (decide (a=b)) := by
  unfold core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq
  have length : a.length=b.length := by have := a.property; have := b.property; scalar_tac
  rw [if_pos length, list_eq a.val b.val (by have := a.property; have := b.property; scalar_tac)]
  have eqv : (a.val=b.val) ↔ a=b := by
    cases a
    cases b
    constructor
    · intro h; cases h; rfl
    · intro h; cases h; rfl
  simp only [eqv]

theorem ne {n : Usize} (a b : Array U32 n) :
    Aeneas.Std.core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne
      AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31 a b =
      ok (decide (a ≠ b)) := by

import NED_StatementCarrierFields
import NED_OutputLaneCohort
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_RawValidatorTail
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBN_StatementResult NED_ErrorCarriers
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable
abbrev RE := AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1

def run (s : Statement) : Result (core.result.Result Unit RE) := do
  let lane ← AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.pool_v1_pair_forest_output_lane_v1 (parts s).2.2.2.2.1
  match lane with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Account e))
  | .Ok l =>
    if l ≠ (common s).output_lane then ok (.Err .OutputLaneMismatch)
    else do
      let (r,_) ← AspisR1AdapterReconstruct.aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1
        (NED_LateCarriers.toRawLate (common s).lane_transition) NBN_LateResult.zero
      match r with
      | .Err e => ok (.Err (.LaneTransition e))
      | .Ok _ => ok (.Ok ())

theorem result (s : Statement) : run s = ok
    (NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult toRawPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1 (NBN_BindingChecks.tail s)) := by
  unfold run NBN_BindingChecks.tail
  rw [NED_OutputLaneCohort.result]
  cases lane : NBN_OutputLane.result (parts s).2.2.2.2.1 with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok l =>
    simp only [NED_OutputLaneCohort.mapAccount,bind_tc_ok]
    by_cases mismatch : l = (common s).output_lane
    · simp only [mismatch,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false]
      rw [NED_LateEncodingCohort.result,NBN_LateResult.source]
      have len : NBN_LateResult.zero.length = 1520 := by
        simp only [NBN_LateResult.zero,Slice.length,Array.to_slice,Array.repeat_val,List.length_replicate]
        rfl
      rw [if_neg (not_not.mpr len)]
      unfold lateStatus
      by_cases index : U64.checked_add (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.next_pair_index 1#u64 =
          some (common s).lane_transition.candidate_afterstate.next_pair_index
      · simp only [if_neg (not_not.mpr index),NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
        cases NBN_LateTail.status (common s).lane_transition <;> rfl
      · simp [index,NED_LiveEncodingCohort.mapStateOuter,NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult,
          toRawPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1,toRawPoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1]
    · simp [mismatch,NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult,toRawPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1]

#print axioms result
end NED_RawValidatorTail

import NED_RawValidatorTail
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_RawValidatorControl
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBN_StatementResult
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
abbrev E := aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1

def tail (s : Statement) : Result (core.result.Result Unit E) := do
  let common := NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon (NBN_StatementResult.common s)
  let nullifier := (parts s).2.2.2.2.1
  let r2 ←
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.pool_v1_pair_forest_output_lane_v1
      nullifier
  let r3 ←
    core.result.Result.map_err
      aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1.closure_2.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairForestAccountErrorV1PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
      r2 ()
  let cf1 ←
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r3
  match cf1 with
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue val =>
    if val != common.output_lane
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err
        aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.OutputLaneMismatch)
    else
      let late_bytes := Array.repeat 1520#usize 0#u8
      let (s, _) ← lift (Array.to_slice_mut late_bytes)
      let (r4, _) ←
        aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_tree_profile.encode_pool_v1_pair_late_public_statement_v1
          common.lane_transition s
      let r5 ←
        core.result.Result.map_err
          aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1.closure_3.Insts.CoreOpsFunctionFnOnceTuplePoolV1PairLatePublicStatementErrorV1PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
          r4 ()
      let cf2 ←
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch r5
      match cf2 with
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Continue _ =>
        ok (core.result.Result.Ok ())
      | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual
        =>
        core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
          Unit (core.convert.FromSame
          aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
          residual
  | core.ops.control_flow.ControlFlow.Break residual =>
    core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTryTraitFromResidualResultInfallible.from_residual
      Unit (core.convert.FromSame
      aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
      residual

theorem tail_factor (s : Statement) : tail s = NED_RawValidatorTail.run s := by
  unfold tail NED_RawValidatorTail.run
  simp only [NED_StatementCarrierFields.lane,NED_LateCarrierFields.common_late]
  apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
  intro lane
  cases lane with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok val =>
    simp only [core.result.Result.map_err,bind_tc_ok,core.result.Result.Insts.CoreOpsTry.branch]
    by_cases same : val = (common s).output_lane
    · simp only [same,bne_self_eq_false,if_false,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,
        Array.to_slice_mut,lift,bind_tc_ok,Aeneas.Std.uncurry]
      apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
      intro late
      rcases late with ⟨r,out⟩
      cases r <;> rfl
    · simp only [bne_iff_ne,ne_eq,same,not_false_eq_true,if_true]

#print axioms tail_factor
end NED_RawValidatorControl

NED_RawValidatorBindings.source:
import NED_RawValidatorControl
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NED_RawValidatorBindings
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBN_StatementResult NED_ErrorCarriers
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def run (s : Statement) : Result (core.result.Result Unit NED_RawValidatorControl.E) := do
  let statement := NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw s
  let common := NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon (NBN_StatementResult.common s)
  let (pool, deployment, anchor_sequence, anchor, nullifier, _) ←
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.statement_public_common
      statement
  let b3 ←
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8 pool
      common.master_account
  if b3
  then
    ok (core.result.Result.Err
      aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.MasterBindingMismatch)
  else
    let b4 ←
      core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8
        deployment
        common.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain
    if b4
    then
      ok (core.result.Result.Err
        aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.DeploymentBindingMismatch)
    else
      let b5 ←
        core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne core.cmp.PartialEqU8
          common.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool
          common.master_account
      if b5
      then
        ok (core.result.Result.Err
          aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.MasterBindingMismatch)
      else
        if anchor_sequence != common.checkpoint_sequence
        then
          ok (core.result.Result.Err
            aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.CheckpointBindingMismatch)
        else
          let b6 ←
            core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.ne
              aspis_core.field.M31.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqM31 anchor
              common.historical_global_anchor
          if b6
          then
            ok (core.result.Result.Err
              aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1.HistoricalAnchorMismatch)
          else
            NED_RawValidatorControl.tail s

def chain (s : Statement) (t : Result (core.result.Result Unit NED_RawValidatorControl.E)) :
    Result (core.result.Result Unit NED_RawValidatorControl.E) :=
  let c := common s
  let p := parts s
  if p.1 ≠ c.master_account then ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch)
  else if p.2.1 ≠ c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain then ok (.Err .DeploymentBindingMismatch)
  else if c.lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool ≠ c.master_account then ok (.Err .MasterBindingMismatch)
  else if p.2.2.1 ≠ c.checkpoint_sequence then ok (.Err .CheckpointBindingMismatch)
  else if p.2.2.2.1 ≠ c.historical_global_anchor then ok (.Err .HistoricalAnchorMismatch)
  else t

theorem source_factor (s : Statement) : run s = chain s (NED_RawValidatorControl.tail s) := by
  unfold run
  dsimp (config := {zeta := true,zetaHave := true}) only
  rw [NED_ReconstructCarriers.parts_argument]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok,NBN_ArrayNe.bytes,NED_RawWordArrayEq.ne,
    NED_StatementCarrierFields.master,NED_LateCarrierFields.common_late,
    NED_LateCarrierFields.live,NED_StatementCarrierFields.pool,NED_StatementCarrierFields.deployment,
    NED_StatementCarrierFields.sequence,NED_LateCarrierFields.common_anchor]
  unfold chain
  simp only [bne_iff_ne,decide_eq_true_eq]
  rcases parts s with ⟨a,b,c,d,e,f⟩
  rfl

/-- Tail remains an arbitrary native computation here. This certificate is
only the five comparison controls, not a full validator bridge. -/
theorem tail_reached (s : Statement)
    (master : (parts s).1 = (common s).master_account)
    (deployment : (parts s).2.1 = (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.deployment_domain)
    (pool : (common s).lane_transition.live_snapshot.pool = (common s).master_account)
    (sequence : (parts s).2.2.1 = (common s).checkpoint_sequence)
    (anchor : (parts s).2.2.2.1 = (common s).historical_global_anchor) :
    run s = NED_RawValidatorControl.tail s := by
  rw [source_factor]
  simp only [chain,master,deployment,pool,sequence,anchor,ne_eq,not_true_eq_false,if_false]

#print axioms source_factor
#print axioms tail_reached
end NED_RawValidatorBindings

import NEE_RawValidatorPrefix
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_ValidatorGate
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
open NBN_StatementResult NED_ErrorCarriers
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

def normalized (c : NED_ReconstructCarriers.Common) (next : NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.R) : NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.R :=
  if c.master_account = zero ∨ c.checkpoint_account = zero ∨ c.selected_lane_account = zero
  then ok (.Err .NonZeroBinding)
  else if 8 ≤ c.output_lane.val then ok (.Err .InvalidOutputLane) else next

/-- Prefix transport is independent of every child computation. -/
theorem result (c : NED_ReconstructCarriers.Common) (next : NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.R) :
    NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.gate (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon c) next =
    normalized c next := by
  unfold NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.gate normalized
  simp only [NBH_ArrayEq.source,bind_tc_ok,NED_StatementCarrierFields.master,
    NED_StatementCarrierFields.checkpoint,NED_StatementCarrierFields.selected_lane,
    NED_StatementCarrierFields.lane,decide_eq_true_eq]
  have cast : core.convert.num.FromUsizeU8.from c.output_lane =
      Usize.ofNatCore c.output_lane.val (by scalar_tac) := by scalar_tac
  simp only [cast,lift,bind_tc_ok,
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_accounts.POOL_V1_PAIR_FOREST_LANE_COUNT]
  by_cases hm : c.master_account = zero
  · simp only [zero] at hm
    simp only [hm,decide_true,if_true,true_or]
  · by_cases hc : c.checkpoint_account = zero
    · simp only [zero] at hm hc
      simp only [hm,hc,decide_false,decide_true,if_false,if_true,false_or,true_or]
    · by_cases hs : c.selected_lane_account = zero
      · simp only [zero] at hm hc hs
        simp only [hm,hc,hs,decide_false,decide_true,if_false,if_true,false_or]
      · by_cases lane : 8 ≤ c.output_lane.val
        · have large : (Usize.ofNatCore c.output_lane.val (by scalar_tac)) ≥ 8#usize := by scalar_tac
          simp only [zero] at hm hc hs
          simp only [hm,hc,hs,decide_false,if_false,false_or,lane,large,if_true]
        · have small : ¬ (Usize.ofNatCore c.output_lane.val (by scalar_tac)) ≥ 8#usize := by scalar_tac
          simp only [zero] at hm hc hs
          simp only [hm,hc,hs,decide_false,if_false,false_or,lane,small]

#print axioms result
end NEE_ValidatorGate
