import NEE_ValidatorGate
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_ValidatorContinuation
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBN_StatementResult AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
open NED_ErrorCarriers
abbrev RawPayment := Result (core.result.Result (Array U8 216#usize)
  aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation.PoolV1PaymentStatementFormatError)

def payment (s : Statement) : RawPayment :=
  match s with
  | .PrivateTransfer _ p => aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_private_transfer_public_v1
      (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawTransfer p)
  | .Withdrawal _ p => aspis_statement.pool_v1.payment_relation.encode_pool_v1_withdrawal_public_v1
      (NED_PaymentCohorts.toRawWithdrawal p)

def run (s : Statement) : NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.R := do
  let r ← payment s
  match r with
  | .Err e => ok (.Err (.Payment e))
  | .Ok _ => NED_RawValidatorBindings.run s

/-- The complete raw continuation, with payment still left as an arbitrary
child Result. No source child is unfolded and no successful-parent premise is used. -/
theorem source_factor (s : Statement) :
    NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.continuation (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw s)
      (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRawCommon (common s)) = run s := by
  cases s with
  | PrivateTransfer c p =>
    unfold NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.continuation run payment
    rw [NED_StatementCarrierFields.transfer]
    apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
    intro r
    cases r <;> rfl
  | Withdrawal c p =>
    unfold NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.continuation run payment
    rw [NED_StatementCarrierFields.withdrawal]
    apply NBN_LateFactor.bind_ext
    intro r
    cases r <;> rfl

#print axioms source_factor
end NEE_ValidatorContinuation

  match NED_ValidatorStatus.payment s with
  | .Err e => .Err (.Payment e)
  | .Ok _ => suffix s

theorem payment (s : Statement) : NEE_ValidatorContinuation.payment s =
    ok (NED_CommonValidation.mapPayment (NED_ValidatorStatus.payment s)) := by
  cases s with
  | PrivateTransfer c p => exact NED_TransferEncodingCohort.result p
  | Withdrawal c p => exact NED_WithdrawalEncodingCohort.result p

    ok (NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult toRawPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1 (model s)) := by
  unfold NEE_ValidatorContinuation.run model
  rw [payment]
  cases h : NED_ValidatorStatus.payment s with
  | Err e => rfl
  | Ok bytes =>
    simp only [NED_CommonValidation.mapPayment,bind_tc_ok]
    exact NEE_ValidatorBindings.result s

import NEE_ValidatorContinuationResult
set_option autoImplicit false
noncomputable section
namespace NEE_RawValidatorCohort
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result NBN_StatementResult NED_ErrorCarriers
open AspisR1AdapterReconstruct
attribute [local instance] Classical.propDecidable

/-- Total emitted-family transport, including every rejection/error. This is
the model substitution part of the native composition, not a native-root claim. -/
theorem result (s : Statement) :
    aspis_statement.pool_v1.pair_forest_terminal.validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1
      (NED_ReconstructCarriers.toRaw s) =
    ok (NED_LateValidatorCohorts.mapResult toRawPoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1
      (NED_ValidatorStatus.status s)) := by
  rw [NEE_RawValidatorPrefix.source_factor,NED_ReconstructCarriers.common_argument]
  simp only [bind_tc_ok]
  rw [NEE_ValidatorGate.result,NEE_ValidatorContinuation.source_factor,
    NEE_ValidatorContinuationResult.result]
  unfold NEE_ValidatorGate.normalized NED_ValidatorStatus.status NEE_ValidatorContinuationResult.model
  dsimp (config := {zeta := true,zetaHave := true}) only
  by_cases hz : (common s).master_account = zero ∨ (common s).checkpoint_account = zero ∨
      (common s).selected_lane_account = zero
  · simp only [hz,if_true]
    rfl
  · simp only [hz,if_false]
    by_cases hl : 8 ≤ (common s).output_lane.val
    · simp only [hl,if_true]
      rfl
    · simp only [hl,if_false]
      rfl

#print axioms result
end NEE_RawValidatorCohort

  cases b with

   cases atr

   simp_all [project]

 actual = value a c := project_injective actual (value a c) windows

import NDM_SnapshotRef.Funs
import NDM_CommonCarrier
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NDM_StatementReference
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result AdapterRw
open aspis_statement.pool_v1
abbrev Statement := pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalStatementV1
abbrev Common := NDM_CommonCarrier.Common
abbrev Transfer := payment_relation.PoolV1PrivateTransferPublicV1
abbrev Withdrawal := payment_relation.PoolV1WithdrawalPublicV1
abbrev Validation := core.result.Result Unit pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1

def accepted (reply : Validation) : Bool := match reply with | .Ok _=>true | .Err _=>false

def lift {C P : Type} (build : C → P → Statement)
 (reply : core.result.Result (C × P) U8) : core.result.Result Statement solana_program_error.ProgramError :=
 match reply with | .Ok (c,p)=>.Ok (build c p) | .Err _=>.Err .InvalidInstructionData

def reference {C P : Type} (build : C → P → Statement) (c : C) (p : P) (valid : Bool) := do
 let reply ← NDM_SnapshotRef.validation_ref c p valid
 ok (lift build reply)

def call (ops : Ops) (statement : Statement) : Result
 (core.result.Result Statement solana_program_error.ProgramError) := do
 let reply ← ops.op21 statement
 ok (match reply with | .Ok _=>.Ok statement | .Err _=>.Err .InvalidInstructionData)

/-- Same constructed statement and SAME validator reply. The native callback
 association and its installed semantic interpretation remain separate obligations. -/
theorem transfer (ops : Ops) (c : Common) (p : Transfer) (reply : Validation)
 (sameCall : ops.op21 (.PrivateTransfer c p)=ok reply) :
 call ops (.PrivateTransfer c p) = reference (fun c p => (.PrivateTransfer c p : Statement)) c p (accepted reply) := by
 unfold call
 rw [sameCall]
 cases reply <;> rfl

theorem withdrawal (ops : Ops) (c : Common) (p : Withdrawal) (reply : Validation)
 (sameCall : ops.op21 (.Withdrawal c p)=ok reply) :
 call ops (.Withdrawal c p) = reference (fun c p => (.Withdrawal c p : Statement)) c p (accepted reply) := by
 unfold call
 rw [sameCall]
 cases reply <;> rfl

/-- Error payloads are discarded uniformly, not only for a fixture error variant. -/
theorem error_payload (ops : Ops) (statement : Statement)
 (error : pair_forest_terminal.PoolV1PairForestTerminalFormatErrorV1)
 (sameCall : ops.op21 statement=ok (.Err error)) :
 call ops statement=ok (.Err .InvalidInstructionData) := by
 unfold call
 rw [sameCall]
 rfl

#print axioms transfer
#print axioms withdrawal
#print axioms error_payload
end NDM_StatementReference

 (a : r1_pool_adapter.AuthenticatedAsq8Accounts) (c : NDM_CommonCarrier.Candidate) :

callee's unwrap domain is proved, not inferred from a successful parent. -/
theorem converted {N W : Usize} (bytes : Array U8 N) (start stop : Usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ N.val)
    (width : stop.val-start.val = W.val) :
    (do let s ← core.array.Array.index
          (core.ops.index.IndexSlice (core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice U8))
          bytes {start,«end»:=stop}
        core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from W core.marker.CopyU8 s) =
    ok (.Ok (NBP_Read.chunk bytes start.val (by omega))) := by
  have room : W.val ≤ N.val-start.val := by omega
  simp [room,core.array.Array.index,core.ops.index.IndexSlice,
    core.slice.index.SliceIndexRangeUsizeSlice.index,Array.to_slice,
    Slice.length,Slice.len,order,bound,bytes.property,
    core.array.TryFromArrayCopySlice.try_from,List.slice,List.length_take,
    List.length_drop,width,NBP_Read.chunk]

theorem bytes_retained {N W : Usize} (bytes : Array U8 N) (start : Nat)
    (bound : start+W.val ≤ N.val) :
    (NBP_Read.chunk (W:=W) bytes start bound).val = (bytes.val.drop start).take W.val := rfl

end NED_ReadDomains

    (h : validate_pool_v1_pair_forest_terminal_statement_v1 s = ok (.Ok ())) :
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq core.cmp.PartialEqU8
      (common s).master_account (Array.repeat 32#usize 0#u8) = ok false ∧

  selected_lane_account := (common s).selected_lane_account

JHb_S2K_TrustedStd.source:
import JHb_S2K_ResultEvent

/-! D157 pure slice-copy semantics. The surrounding carrier contains everything
outside the exclusively borrowed destination (including source bytes). This
explicit named library assumption is not a theorem about the native SDK or a
whole successful child. Valid typed slice provenance is a separate runtime port. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.StdCopy

inductive Outcome (Frame : Type) where
  | returned : List U8 → Frame → Outcome Frame
  | panicked : List U8 → Frame → Outcome Frame

def model {Frame : Type} (dst src : List U8) (frame : Frame) : Outcome Frame :=
  if dst.length = src.length then .returned src frame else .panicked dst frame

/-- The only new TrustedStd field: exact copy or length-mismatch panic;
all state outside the destination is preserved, including on mismatch. -/
structure TrustedStd {Frame : Type}
    (copy : List U8 → List U8 → Frame → Outcome Frame) : Prop where
  slice_copy_from_slice : ∀ dst src frame, copy dst src frame = model dst src frame

theorem consistent {Frame : Type} : TrustedStd (@model Frame) := ⟨by intros; rfl⟩

theorem equal_lengths {Frame : Type}
    (copy : List U8 → List U8 → Frame → Outcome Frame) (std : TrustedStd copy)
    (dst src : List U8) (frame : Frame) (equal : dst.length = src.length) :
    copy dst src frame = .returned src frame := by
  rw [std.slice_copy_from_slice]; exact if_pos equal

theorem different_lengths {Frame : Type}
    (copy : List U8 → List U8 → Frame → Outcome Frame) (std : TrustedStd copy)
    (dst src : List U8) (frame : Frame) (different : dst.length ≠ src.length) :
    copy dst src frame = .panicked dst frame := by
  rw [std.slice_copy_from_slice]; exact if_neg different

#print axioms consistent
#print axioms equal_lengths
#print axioms different_lengths
end AspisR1.S2K.StdCopy

JHb_S2K_CopyTransport.source:
import JHb_S2K_TrustedStd

/-! Exact width32 primitive join. Native validity/region interpretation is an
explicit runtime admission; this theorem supplies no enclosing caller success. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.CopyTransport

theorem range32 {Frame : Type}
    (copy : List U8 → List U8 → Frame → StdCopy.Outcome Frame)
    (std : StdCopy.TrustedStd copy) (frame : Frame)
    (output : Array U8 688#usize) (start stop : Usize) (bytes : Array U8 32#usize)
    (order : start.val ≤ stop.val) (bound : stop.val ≤ 688)
    (width : stop.val - start.val = 32) :
    copy ((output.val.drop start.val).take 32) bytes.val frame =
      .returned bytes.val frame ∧
    SourceStore.store output start stop bytes =
      ok (output.setSlice! start.val bytes.val) := by
  constructor
  · apply StdCopy.equal_lengths copy std
    have room : 32 ≤ 688-start.val := by omega
    simp only [List.length_take,List.length_drop,output.property,bytes.property]
    exact Nat.min_eq_left room
  · exact SourceStore.store_exact output start stop bytes order bound width

#print axioms range32
end AspisR1.S2K.CopyTransport

import JHb_S2K_CopyTransport

/-! Symbolic reflexivity for source array comparisons; no concrete arrays reduced. -/
set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.Equality

theorem array_self {T : Type} (cmp : core.cmp.PartialEq T T)
    (same : ∀ x, cmp.ne x x = ok false) {n : Usize} (a : Array T n) :
    core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq cmp a a = ok true := by
  have list_self : ∀ xs : List T,
      List.allM (fun (x,y) => do let b ← cmp.ne x y; ok (¬ b))
        (List.zip xs xs) = ok true := by
    intro xs
    induction xs with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons x xs ih => simp only [List.zip_cons_cons,List.allM,same,bind_tc_ok]; exact ih
  unfold core.array.equality.PartialEqArray.eq
  rw [if_pos rfl]
  exact list_self a.val

#print axioms array_self
end AspisR1.S2K.Equality

set_option autoImplicit false
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result
namespace AspisR1.S2K.Equality
open AspisR1TerminalDecoder

/-- A reached return-data syscall is observably not an empty event frame,
even if its returned Unit is erased. This keeps the op53 obstruction explicit. -/
theorem event_frame_changed {A E : Type} (state : State A E) (bytes : List U8) :
    (set state bytes).events ≠ state.events := by
  intro same
  change state.events ++ [.setReturnData bytes] = state.events at same
  have length := congrArg List.length same
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_singleton] at length
  omega

/-- Ruling (ab), 2026-11-04, adds RuntimeReturnData as runtime trust. This
model law preserves the visible set-return-data event; it is not an op53
Unit-erasure or proof of Solana platform behaviour. -/
theorem set_preserves_order {A E : Type} (state : State A E) (bytes : Array U8 792#usize) :
    (set state bytes.val).events = state.events ++ [.setReturnData bytes.val] := by rfl

theorem runtime_bound (bytes : Array U8 792#usize) : bytes.val.length ≤ 1024 := by
  have length : bytes.val.length=792 := bytes.property
  omega

/-- Ruling (ab) is used by an emission certificate only if this event remains
in its ordered trace. The platform readback assumption is additional trust. -/
theorem observable {A E : Type} (state : State A E) (bytes : Array U8 792#usize) :
    (set state bytes.val).events ≠ state.events := NEU_EmitFrame.event_frame_changed state bytes.val

#print axioms set_preserves_order

end NEX_ReturnData

import NEU_DecoderProjections
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NEU_EqualityLoop
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

def equalBytes (left right : List U8) : Bool :=
  match left,right with
  | [],[] => true
  | a::left,b::right => decide (a=b) && equalBytes left right
  | _,_ => false

/-- Symbolic induction; no concrete688-byte recurrence is normalized. -/
theorem prefix_exact (left right : List U8) : equalBytes left right=true ↔ left=right := by
  induction left generalizing right with
  | nil => cases right <;> simp [equalBytes]
  | cons a left ih => cases right <;> simp [equalBytes,ih]

/-- Arbitrary prestate accumulator is retained by one equality window. -/
theorem step_invariant (a b : U8) (same : Bool) :
    (same && decide (a=b))=true ↔ same=true ∧ a=b := by simp

theorem prefix_frame {State : Type} (left right : List U8) (state : State) :
    (equalBytes left right,state,([] : List Unit)) =
    (decide (left=right),state,[]) := by
  have eqv := prefix_exact left right
  have same : equalBytes left right=decide (left=right) := by
    cases h : equalBytes left right <;> simp_all
  rw [same]

#print axioms prefix_exact
#print axioms step_invariant
#print axioms prefix_frame
end NEU_EqualityLoop

NFH_ComparisonBoundary.source:
import NEU_EqualityLoop
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace NFH_ComparisonBoundary
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std

/-- Proposed, NOT adopted: only the zero/nonzero observation is needed.
No lexicographic sign or magnitude claim is required by the scanner. -/
def ZeroLaw (left right : List U8) (reply : Int) : Prop :=
  reply = 0 ↔ left = right

/-- Sufficiency reuses the existing symbolic byte-loop proof. The runtime
law remains a named hypothesis; this is SUPPORT, not native closure. -/
theorem reply_eq_loop (left right : List U8) (reply : Int)
    (runtimeZeroLaw : ZeroLaw left right reply) :
    decide (reply = 0) = NEU_EqualityLoop.equalBytes left right := by
  have loop := NEU_EqualityLoop.prefix_frame left right ()
  have exactLoop : NEU_EqualityLoop.equalBytes left right = decide (left = right) :=
    congrArg Prod.fst loop
  rw [exactLoop]
  by_cases h : reply = 0 <;> simp_all [ZeroLaw]

/-- Necessity prevents passing an unconstrained syscall reply as a proof of
native equality. The same two list values occur on both sides. -/
theorem zeroLaw_necessary (left right : List U8) (reply : Int)
    (association : decide (reply = 0) = NEU_EqualityLoop.equalBytes left right) :
    ZeroLaw left right reply := by
  unfold ZeroLaw
  have loop := NEU_EqualityLoop.prefix_exact left right
  rw [← association] at loop
  simpa only [decide_eq_true_eq] using loop

/-- Even equal688-byte buffers do not constrain an opaque integer reply.
No concrete recurrence or large numeral is evaluated. -/
theorem opaque_reply_insufficient (left : List U8) :
    ∃ reply : Int, ¬ ZeroLaw left left reply := by
  exact ⟨1, by simp [ZeroLaw]⟩

#print axioms reply_eq_loop
